dpe skrun gsal bshad/gser rta bla rung lnga rig nang bstan slob gling gi dbu khrid rnam pa'i thugs khur dang rgyab skyor 'og /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling gi bston ma 'ga' zhig gisanye ba'i lo shasaring la.ar+ya tā re'i dpe tshogs rtsom sgrig khang zhes pa'i rtsom sgrig khang zhig btsugs nas 'bad pa du mas/ dpe tshogs 'tshol bsdu dang / yig gtags/ zhu dag bcas mdzad nasaphyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i 'phags bod kyi skyes chen ma dag gi rnam par thar pa pad+ma dkar po'iphreng ba zhes bya ba pod bco lnga'i bdag nyid can 'di nyid/ bud med kyi rten can gyis rang don byang chen mngon du mdzad tshul dang / gzhan don phrin las kyi 'jug pas bstan 'grolidon mdzad tshul gyi rnam thar rgyas bsdus sna tshogs pa/ nyis brgya lhag tsam phyogasagacig tu bsgrigasate/ nged cag bod ldongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyisaspar du bsgrun pa yin la/ 'dir tshe lusa'akhyag la phulam cig char bgrod de grub pa'i go sa mthon por gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma dang / zag pa yongasasu zad pa'i dgra bcom ma/ rlabasachen gyi 'gro don mdzad pa'i byang chub semasam/'khor 'das ro mnyam du gzigs pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ dam pa'i tshul dgus phyug pa'i mkhan mo/ 'grornamasadug lasa'adren pa'i 'dasalog ma sogasadonaganyisamathar phyin pa'i skyes chen ma mang po zhig byon myong ba ra sprod byed thub la/ 'jig rten gtam dper/chos bdag med la snying rus su che zhes pa ltar/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos nyams su blangs nas don gnyis bsgrub pa la pho mcho/ mo dman gyi lta ba 'dzin mi dgos par/ da
lta dang phyi rabs kyi bod pa'i bu mo tshos bya mig gyen bltas kyi dpe ltar/ rlabs chen gyi skyes chen ma 'di tsho la mig dper bzung nas/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag gang yin yang / zhum pa med pa'i spobasapa dang / 'gyur ba med pa'i dam bca' brtan polingang nasabasgrub dgosapa dang / bsgrub nyab pa'i smon rtagusashig kyang red 'dugru4/ nga
sngon 'groligatam/༄4/ /de yang spyir btang 'jig rten 'di'i 'gro ba mi'i rigs la tshe sgog gi rin thang bstsal te/ byamasabartses bskyed bsrings shing 'tsho ba'i snum mdangs kyi mngar kha sbyin mkhan ni rlabs che ba'i ma yum gyi tshogs yin pa bshad mi dgosal/ bye brag tu 'dzam bu gling gi lo rgyus steng ma yum gyi rigs la bsam blo ba dang / lugs gnyis la gzigasapa yangs pa'i mdzangasam dang / grub pa brnyesapa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ dgra bcom ma/ skye dgu yongs kyi yid dbang cig char phrogs pa'i mdzes ma sogs 'gro ba mi spyi'i mig dper 'osapa yang du ma zhig byung myong ba nang bzhin/ rang re bod la yang 'das pa'i lo rgyus steng gdong dmar srin molirigs rgyud las chad pa'i mi moyitshul can gyi rlabs chen ma brjod lasa'adasapa zhig byon myong ba'i dpe mtshon tsam brjod na/ btsan mo 'bro bza' khri ma lod lta bu'i srid 'dzin ma dang / mkhar chen bza' ye shesamatsho rgyal lta bu'i grub brnyesakyi rig 'dzin ma/ ma cig lab kyi sgron ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor ma dang / myang tsha dkar rgyan lta bu'i mo rus dang zhe ru can gyi mdzangasam sogs brjod las 'das pa zhig byon myong ba ni lo rgyus bden don gyis ra sprod 'dug la/ de lasakyang bod kyi ma yum rnal 'byor ma skor zhig ni nang bsam blo'i shes rig gi tshad ches mtho zhing / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha'i gzhung lugs la thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin pa gnang ba'i 'bras rtags su sku tshe gcig gi yun la grub pa'i sa mthor gshegs tshul/ khong rnam pa rang rang gi mdzad pa rnam thar dang / phyi rabs gdul bya'i gsos su bzhag pa yang dag tshad ma'i rgyab rten dang byin rlabs kyi drod ༷ngas 'thul ba'i gsung rtsom bstan bcos
dga' ra ba 'di khyim bdag gi yin na ji ltar sbyin/ gal te khyod la kun dga' ra ba dgos na khyod kyi phyir de bas lhag par bzang ba gzhan zhig bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po legs par rab sad kyis lum bi ni'i ched du de bas khyad par du 'phags pa'i kun dga' ra ba zhig byed du bcug nasade'i ming lum bi ni'i tshal zhesabya bar gyurato/ /rgyal po seng ge'i 'gram la kun ring po nasakye ma'o bdag gi rgyud la 'khor los sgyur ba skye bar gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam pa 'di yod do/ /rgyal po legasapar rab sad la yang yun ring po nas kye ma'o bdag ni seng ge'i 'gram dang lhan cig gnyen du gyur kyang ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam pa 'di yod do/ /ji tsam dusagazhan zhig na de btsun mo dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo sems can dang ldan par gyur nas de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'dasapa na bu mo gzugasabazang zhing lta na sdug pa/ mdzesapa/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas so/ /btsas pa de'i gzugs bzang pos rgyal po legasapar rab sad btsun mo 'khor dang bcasapa dang / lhasabastan na gnas pa'i skye bo3tshogasarnamasamachog tu ngo mtshar skyesate/ the tshom du gyur nasaci 'di bu mo yin nam/'on te las sna tshogasasprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul yin snyam mo/ /de'i btsas pa'i btsas ston nyi ma bdun gsum nyi shu gcig tu rgya cher byas nas bu mo 'di'i ming cir gdags zhesaming 'dogasapar byed do/ /blon po rnamasakyisasmras pa/ lha lhasabastan na gnasapa'i skye bolitshogs lam po che dang / tshong dus dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo rnams su gleng ba kha cig gi mchid nas ni 'di bu mo kho na lags te sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas gzugs bzang zhing kha dog kun sum tshogs par gyur to zhes mchi'o/ /gzhan dag gi mchid nas ni 'di bu mo ma lags kyi/ 'o / ci zhe na/ las sna tshogs pas sprul pa'i sgyu
'phrul lagasaso zhesamachi lagasapasade bas na bu moliming sgyu 'phrul zhesagadagasaso zhesade'i ming sgyu 'phrulazhesabatagasaso/ /bu mo sgyu 'phrul ma ma brgyad la rjesasugatad de zhes bya ba nas chen mor gyur to zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de la mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan pa mtshan kun sum tshogs pa du ma dang ldan pa'i bu zhig btsa' bar 'gyur zhing stobasakyi 'khor losasgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhesabastanato/ /yang de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa lasabu mo gzugsbzang ba/ lta na sdug pa/ mdzes pa/ kha dog bzang mo rgyasapa mchog dang ldan pa zhig btsas so/ /de btsas pa na grong khyer de dag thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos snang bar byas te/ sgyu 'phrul la ji lta ba bzhin du de'i gzugs bzang ba rnam pa thams cad du dpyad par mi nusaso/ /de'i btsas pa'i btsas ston yang rgya cher byas nas bu mo 'di'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ /blon po rnams kyis smras pa/ sgyu 'phrul pasa'adi lhag par gzugasabazang bas de bsan sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhesabagyi bar gdags so zhes btags so/ /de yang bskyed bsrings nas chen mor gyur pa dang de la mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan pa/ skyes bu chen polimatshan sum bcu rtsa gnyis dang ldan pa zhig btsa' bar 'gyur te/ de ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhesabastan to/ /rgyal po legs par rab sad kyis rgyal po seng ge'i 'gram la pho nya btang ste/bdag la bu mo gnyis shig btsa' ba ni sgyu 'phrul dang / sgyu 'phrul chen mo lags te/ de la gcig la ni mtshan thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i bu zhig btsa' bar 'gyur zhing de ni stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /cig shos la ni skyes bu chen polimatshan sum bcu rtsa gnyidakyisabargyan pa'i bu zhig btsa' bar 'gyur
mkhan rnam par chesarin thang che ba'i legasaskyesashigs tshul du par bskrun 'grem spel byasapa yin la/ slad nasakyang mu nasamu ru skyesachen ma dang rlabaphuchen ma dag gi mdzad pa rnam thar dang / gsung rtsom tshad ldan gyi skor lag tu gang rnyed kyisagrub mtha'i phyogsris sogs med par phyogs sgrig dang 'grem spel ci nus su byed rtsis yin mod/ 'on kyang 'di 'dra'i rin thang che ba'i rnam thar dang gsung rtsom skor srung spel gyi bya bar mos'dun che ba tsam ma gtogs/ sbyir nga tsho dpe sgrig tsho chung la mtshon na shesa'ajon gyi tshad gzhi dma' ba dang / khyad par du dpe rnying phyogasasgrig gi lasarigasa'adi la nyams myong zhan pas/ dpe tshogs 'di nyid kyi phyi'i nus 'god dang nang gi zhu dag sogs gang ci'i thad nasakyang / nor 'khrul shor yod pa dang 'thusasgo ma tshang ba mi nyung ba zhig yod pa ni smos ma dgos pa zhig yin/ de las khyad par du 'das log gi skor dang rdo rje gling pa'i gter ma mkha' 'gro ye shesamatsho rgyal gyi skyesarabasarnam thar rgyasapar bkod pa sogskyisamatshon nas dpe dkon yig rnying phal che ba tshig don 'grel dka' ba dang ma yig mi gsal ba brda rnying dang skung yig mang ba/ sa cha re zung gi yul skad sor bzhag byas pa/sum rtagasadag gsum gyi dgongasadon ltar brisamed pa sogasamador na ma yig ma bor tsam las med pas tshig don gnyis char gyi phyogs la lhag chad mi nyung ba song yod pas/'dir nga tsho'i dbyings bzhugs ma yum mkha' 'gro'itshogs dang / rgya che'i klog mkhan dang dpyod ldan rnam par snying nas bzod gsol zhu ba dang chabs cig khyed rnam pas nga tsho'i bya bzhag 'di la dgongs 'char lhug stsol bcas/ phyogs so solim yum rlabs chen rnam pa'i na ma thar dang / gzhan 'brel yod kyi gsung rtsom mkho sprod kyi rgyab skyor gnang rgyur snying thag pa nadragabaka' drin che zhu ba lags/zhoyoslo rung /arutatshonapogatso/rtsomasgrina' /lhagur rangag chulharala'izla4tsheyo256gus phul/
dkar chag1 ston pa thugasarje can gyi ma yum sgyu 'phrul chen mo la rgyal bu don kunagrub pa ji ltar 'khrungasatshul gyi lo rgyus/ ji 12 ston pa thugasarje can gyi ma yum sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lo rgyusadang rgyal bu don kun grub pa ji ltar 'brungasatshul/ 173 yum sgyu 'phrul chen mo ston pa'i ma yum du gyur dgosapa'i skye ba sngon gyi lo rgyusango mtshar can/ ji 634 rgyal bu don kun grub pa'i btsun mo sa'atsho ma'i yon ṇ+ḍa dang lo rgyus/ ji 745 ston pa thugs rje can gyisabatsun mo drug khri bden pa la bkod tshul dang sku srasadagragacan 'dzin gyi ma yum gragasa'adzin ma ston pa la chagaphutshul sogasakyi lo rgyus/ ji 976 bran mo zhig gisachosatshig gcig blor bzung nasashi bsabu mo murtag can du skyesate sangasargyasakyi brisasku mthong nasa'abrasabu thob tshul/ ce 115ma sag ma'i bu sum cu rtsa gnyis rgyal po gsal rgyal gyisabasad kyang sangsrgyasakyisachosabastan nasa'abrasabu thob pa'i dbang gisasag ma la mya ngan ma skyesapa'i tshul/ 1328 btsun mo zla 'od kyisadage slong ma ri ma'i mdun nasachosathosate lha yul du skyes nas'brasabu thob tshul/ 1 158
9 rgyal po pad sa'i btsun mo dpal ldan la gnasabastan shā ri'i busachosabastan nasbden pa la bkod tshul/ ji 1641༷ bram ze'i mtshan mkhan gyisaskyesapa lnga brgya dang 'grogs par lung bstan pa'i bu mo 'od bzang ma'i skye ba snga phyi'i rnam thar gyi skor/ 17211 bramaze'i bu mo zhig bag ma 'gro ba'i lam bar nasasangasargyas la bsod snyomasaphul bsa'abrasabu shing n+ya gro dha'i dpe la bsten nas gsungasatshul/ ji ༷ 18512 mdze mo zhig gisasangasargyasal 'brasakhu lhung bzedagang phul basdga' ldan du skyesatshul/ 18913 dbul mo grong nyug masasangasargyas la mar me phul bsalo rgyus/ ji 19114 bu mo zhig gisasangasargyasal phul zin pa'i nasalhung bzed do gtsang mar byaste btsun mo rin po cher 'gyur bar smon lam btab tshul/ 19415 rgyal pogasal rgyal gyi btsun mo gzugasamadzes pa'i mchog dbyar tshul ma dang reg bya 'jam pa'i mchog phreng ldan ma gnyisakyi lo rgyus/ ji ji 20316 btsun pa zhwa ri'i bu skye ba snga mar bram ze'i bu mor gyur tshul gyi lo rgyus/ 21617 bu mo skra can masasmra btsong ste zhar sha pa ṇa lnga brgya'i rin gyisa'aphagasapa ka t+ya na la gdugasatshod phul ba'i tshul/ ce ce ji 21818 dad pa can gyi bu mo sde chen ma zhesabya bsabarla'i sha bcad nasabyin pasadage slong zhig nad lasathar ba'i tshul/ 22919 'phagasapa shā ri'i bu shesarab che ba'i mchog tu gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan sngon bramaze'i bu mor gyur tshe ji ltar smon lam btab tshul/ 2362
2༷ bu mo gophudakar mo zhesabya ba'ige ba snga phyi'i skor/ ce 23921 gzugasashin tu mi sdug pa bu mo rdo rje zhesabya bsasangasargyasalagasol ba btab nasagazugasamadzesapar gyur tshul/ ce 24522 bu mo gragasaldan masasangasargyasakyi mtshan dpe'i yonatan thob par 'dod nasaston pa la gdugasatshod phul bsam 'ongasapar sangasargyasarin chen ldan du 'gyur tshul lung bstan pa/ 25123 bston mo dpal gyi blo grosamasaston pa'i dbu skra'i mchod rten la mar me phul basma skyesadagrasabasad pa lhar skyesatshul/ ji ce ji ji 25724 'dzam bu chugaser gyi mdog kyang:la gyisaganon pa'i ser skya'i bu mo bzang mo dang nyan thosa'od srung chen po gnyisalo banaganyisakyi bar du mnyam du bzhugasakyang 'dod pa'i nyesapasamagosapar dgra bcom pa'i go 'phangasathob tshul/ 26425 rgyal po ka shi'i bu mo mdzesaldan ma phyogasakyi rgyal phran dgage btsun mor ma phebasapar rabasgyu byung nasa'abrasabu thob ste semasacan 'bum phrag du ma chosal bkod tshul/ 30426 tshong dpon rgyal ba'i bu mo mu tig rang gi khyo pho khyim bdag mgon med zasasbyin kyi bu rab sdug dang mnyam du rabasgyu byung tshul/ 31027 bu mo zhigagesarang gi gosaphud nasakhyim bdag mgon medazasasbyin la bskur te ston pa la phul tshul/ ji 31628 mgon medazlasasbyin gyi bu mo ma ga dhā bzang mo dang bran mo gnyisakyisargyang ring po nasaston pa la gsol ba btab pasasangasargyasa'akhor bcaphuṭu'aphrul gyisbyon nasachosabastan tshul/ ji 3203
29 bu mo 'od bzang ma 'brasabu thob ste dz+nyo'aphrul bstan nasasemasacan 'bum phrag du ma bden pa la bkod tshul/ ce 33630 khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi bu mo rab sdug ma'i rnam thar/ 34231 btsun mo bde bsabasnyen gnasakyi sdom pa slongasanasabatson pa la zasaster du phyin pasalam bar gyi srin moli'ajigasapa lasathar te phyug por gyur tshul/ 34932 rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu mo rasbra zhesabya ba gzugasashin tu mi sdug pa la sangasargyasakyi thugasarjesarjes bzung nasabyad gzugasamadzes par gyur cing 'brasabu thob tshul/ ji 35333 rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu mo bde byed ma bag mar phebasam 'dod nasston pa la gsol ba btab pasasangasargyas rdzu'aphrul gyis byon nas chosbstan nas 'brasabu thob tshul/ ji 36134 gdol ba'i bu mo gzugasabazang ma zhig kun dga' bo la chagasashing rjes su 'brang ba'i mthar sangasargyasakyis chosabastan te bden pa mthong tshul/ 369
ratsho8/ /ston pa thugs rje can gyi ma yum sgyu 'phrul chen mo la rgyal bu don kun grub pa ji ltar 'khrungs tshul gyi lo rgyus/'dul ba lungagazhi la phubatus/grong khyer lhas bstan du rgyal po legs par rab sad ces bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ 'byor pa dang rgyasapa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa/ skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba/ 'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa dang / chom kun med cing nad rab tu zhi bar gyur pa/ 'bras dang / bu ram shing gi phreng ba dang / ba 'a/nga 〉ji do/ /ma he phun sum tshogs pa na bu gcig pa la sdug pa bzhin du rgyal srid skyong bar rgyal po legasapar rab sad kyi btsun mo dam pa gzugasabazang ba/ lta na sdug pa/mdzes pa yul gyi bzang mo lum bi ni zhes bya ba yod do/ /lhas bstan na khyim bdag phyug cing nor mang ba longs spyod che ba yongs su gzung ba yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thosakyi bu la nor gyisa'agran pa zhig gnasapa de'i kun dga' ra ba me tog phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa dang / chu phun sum tshogs pa dang / bya sna tshogs skad 'byin pas de'i kun dga' ra ba dga' dga' lta ra 'dug pa der rgyal po dus dus su btsun mo'i 'khor dang lhan cig lhags nas de na dga' ba'i rtsed mo nyamasasu myong bar byed do/ /lum yi nisade mthong nasa'adod pa skye sate/desasmras pa/ lha kun dga' ra ba 'di bdag la stsal du gsol/ rgyal pos smras pa/ kun
du ma bzhugs pas shes thub/ des na rang re phyi rabs bod kyi bu mo tshos ma yum gong ma dag gi mdzad pa rnam thar dang / gsung zab zhal gdams kyi skor yid bzhin nor bu lta bu rnams la thos bsam zab mos nges cha yod par byas nas dam pa de dag gi ya rabs tshul mthun/ sbobs pa thod rgal/ dgongs spyod ngang bzang gi yon tan sogs la mig ltos nan gyis byas te/ gangs can bod kyi ma yum mdzangasama'i lugs srol phul du byung ba'i rgyun zin par bya rgyu gtsor bzhag gi thog dus rabs dang 'tshams shing dam pa'i lha chos dang 'jig rten mi chos kyi snying don dang ma 'gal ba zhig gi thog nas/ rjes rabs bod kyi ma bu mo tsho'i las dbang la sgul shugs gtong thub pa'i phyogs la gom pa spo ba de 'u tsho'i phrag la bab pa'i 'os 'gan du ngos zin byed pa ni ches gal che ba'i rang bzhin zhig red 'dug snyam/ rgyu mtshan der brten 'dir rang re kha ba ri ba la bka' drin gzhan las lhag pa'i rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas mchog gi thugs gter yongs kyi bdag mo/ ma tshogs mkha' 'groligatso mo dbyangs can ye shes mtsho rgyal mchog slar yang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir/ gangs ri'i gdul zhing 'dir dge ba'i bshes gnyen mi mo'i rnam par bzhengs pa'i bdag nyid chen mo/ gsang chen pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling gi spyi dpal/ bka' drin gzhal med kyi rje btsun ma 7yu med ye shes mtsho mo mchog gi zhabs rdul gtsug gi nor bur thob pa'i 'dus sde chen mo sku gsum mkha' 'groligling gi dge tshul ma skor zhig gis slob sbyong gi bar gseng bed spyad de/ rang re bod la sngon byon grub mtha' ris med kyi skyes chen ma rnam pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mdzad pa rnam thar dang / rin thang gzhal du med pa'i gsung rtsom zhal gdams kyi skor bsdu rub phyogs bsgrigs/ yig gtags dpe bsdur sogs kyi bgyi ba dang du len mgo brtsams shing / rigs kyi me tog phog pa'i skyabs gcig rje btsun ma 76 med ye shes mtsho mo
mchog la dgongs zhu dang / 'dzam gling mkhas grub yongasakyi gtso bo 'dren mchog mchos rje yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs sras bu chen gyi gtso bo mkhan chen 'chi med rig 'dzin sogs kyis thugs bkod kyi 'og nas (ar+ya tā re'i dpe tshogs )zhes nang don sngon byon gyi ma yum rlabasachen dag dang 'brel yod kyi dpe tshogs/ rnam pa deb phreng gi rang bzhin can par bskrun 'grem spel tsho chung zhig rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ gcig tu 'phags bod kyi sngon byon mkhas grub ma dag gi gsung rtsom 'jig rten gyi khyad nor lta bu'i dpe rgyun srung spel la ched du kha gtad pa dang / gnyis su 'dzam gling gi klog mkhan spyi dang lhag par du rang re bod kyi bu mo tshos/ pho mchog mo dman de dus rabs kyi lo rgyus tsam du bskyur zin pa'i gna' boligoms srol phyogs ris pa re zung dang / shed stobs sogs lus kyi grub cha re zung gi pho mo'i khyad par tsam rgyu mtshan du byas te rang cag ni bud med do snyam nas rang mgo rang gis smad de mi sdod par/ tshe 'di'i don dang skye ba tshe rabs kyi las don gnyis po gang gi bya gzhag la 'jug rgyu'i dbang du btang yang /bsgrub bya'i mthun phyogasadang mi mthun phyogasal 'dor len yang dag pa shesathabasadang /dus kyi gnas babs dang bstun te phyi'i ya rabs kun spyod nas/ nang bsam blolishes rig dang 'brel yod kyi blo spobs/ nus stobs sogs ji ltar mthor 'degs su gtong dgos min gyi dpyad gzhinam bslab gzhi kho na'i dmigasayul gtso bor bzung ste/ grub brnyesarig 'dzin mkha' 'gro nyisabargya tsam gyi rnam thar deb phreng rin thang che ba 'di/ rgya che'i gzigs mkhan rnam par bsam pa bzang polilegasaskyes kyi tshul du/ si khron bod yig dpe rnying myur skyob 'tshol sgrig khang gtso bo yin pa'i 'di ka 'brel yod dpe skrun khang gi rgyab skyor mthun sbyor gyi 'og nas/ dpe phreng rin po che 'di nyid spyir 'jig rten la phan bde 'byung ba'i gsos sman dang / /sa gangs ldongs kyi don gnyer che ba'i klog

spyod pa'i lha drug la lan gsum du bsgrags nas nam gyi gung thun la glang po cher bstan te| btsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen molilhumasasu zhugasaso/ /smrasapa/ 'gro ba yongasasu bskyab phyir dam bzhesanas/ /lha rnamasal bsgo de nasshi 'phos te/ /nangs par sprin rum nyi ma gsar 'char ltar/ /de ni bu ram shing pa'i lhumasasu zhugs/ /'di ltar sgyu 'phrul chen mo3rmi lam bzhi rmis pa/ grang po che dam pa dkar po mche ba drug pa zhig bdag gi rum dral nasazhugaphupa dang / steng gi nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / ri brag chen po la 'dzig pa dang / bdag la skye bo'itshogs chen po phyag byed pa'o/ /desargyal po zasagatsang la smrasapa dang / rgyal posablon po rnamasal bsgo ba/shesaldan dag rmi lam ston mkhan dang / mtshan mkhan gyi bram ze rnamasakhug cig de dag gis rmi lam ston mkhan dang / mtshan mkhan gyi bram ze rnams bkug pa dang / de nas rgyal posade rnams la rmi lam bsnyad pa las/ de rnams kyisasmrasapa/ lha bstan bcoslas ji ltar g.yar sngar bab pa dang sbyar na sras skyes bu chen polimatshan sum bcu rtsa gnyisakyi'(brgyan pa zhig bltam par 'gyur te/ gal te khyim pa khyim na gnasapar gyur na 'bor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /gal te skra dang kha spu bregs nas gos ngur smig bgos te dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar gyur na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya bar 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grag par 'gyur ro/ /chos nyid kyisagang gi tshe byang chub semasadapa' dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris nasshi 'phos te yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa de'i tshe sa chen po 'di shin tu g.yos par gyur/'jig rten 'di thams cad snang ba rgya chen pos gsal bar gyur cing 'jig rten na 'jig rten gyi bar gyi mun pa mun gnag smag tu ༷ra pa gang du nyi ma dang zla ba 'di ltar rdzu
'phrul che ba/ 'di ltar mthu che ba dag gisakyang 'od kyisasnang bar mi nusapa de dag kyang de'i tshe snang ba rgya chen por+sāgasal bar gyurato/ /der semasacan gang dag skyesapa de dag rang gi lag pa brkyang ba yang mi mthong ba las de rnams snang ba des sems can gcig gis gcig mthong nas shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so/ /shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so zhes bya bar shes so/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'dasayum gyi lhumasasu zhugs pa de'i tshe lha rnamasakyi dbang po brgya byin gyisade la mi'am mi ma yin pa sus kyang 'tshe bar mi 'gyur bar lha'i bu bzhi yum gyi srung mar 'jog pa ni lag na ral gri dang / lag na mdung dang / lag na mdung thung dang / lag na mda' bo che'o/ /chosanyid kyisagang gi tshe byang chub semasadapa' yum gyi lhumasan zhugs pa ni mdzod kyi nang du rdzas bzhag pa bzhin du mngal gyi dri ma dang / sha ma'i dri ma dang /khrag gi dri ma dang / mi gtsang ba gang yang rung ba sna tshogasakyis ma sbagasaso/ /dper na nor bu rin po che ka shi'i rasakyis mi gos pa dang / ka shi'i rasakyang nor bu rin po chesmi gos pa de bzhin du/ gang gi tshe byang chub semasadapa' yum gyi lhumasan bzhugasapa na mdzod kyi nang du rdzasabazhag pa bzhin du mngal gyi dri ma dang / sha ma'i dri ma dang / khrag gi dri ma dang / mi gtsang ba gang yang rung ba sna tshogasapasam sbagasaso/ /chosanyid kyisagang gi tshe byang chub semasadapa' bcom ldan 'dasayum gyi lhumasasu zhugasapa de'i tshe yum gyi lhumasan de dag thamasacad yongasasu rdzogs pasabazhugs pa mthong ngo / /dper na nor bu rin po che ni be+eḍūr+ya zur brgyad pa bzang po'i rigasadang ldan pa/ dang ba/ gsal ba/dri ma med pa tshon skud sna lnga sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang /le brgan la brgyus pa de skyes bu mig dang /sna pas mthong na 'di ni skud pa'o/ /'di ni
nor bu'o/ /skud pa 'di la nor bu brgyus pa yin no zhes shes pa de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das gang gi tshe yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa de'i tshe yum gyi lhumasan de thams cad yongasasu rdzogs pas bzhugasapa mthong ngo / /chosanyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa de'i tshe de'i yum 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' 'dzin pas ngal ba'am lus dub par 'gyur ba med do/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums na bzhugs pa de'i tshe yum deng phan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du brtul zhugs lnga'i gzhi blangs par gyur te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar ldog go /ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / rdzun du smra ba dang / sbyar ba'i chang dang / 'bru'i chang myosapar 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnasaspangasate/sbyar ba'i chang dang 'bru'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas las slar ldog par byed do/ /srog mi gcod dang ma byin mi len dang / /rdzun du mi smra chang la mi brkam dang / /'khrig pa'i mi tshangasaspyod pa spong ba 'di/ /'di ni donagrub yum gyi chosanyid yin/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums su bzhugs pa de'i tshe de'i yum 'di lta ste/ skyes pa rnams la 'dod pa dang ldan pa'i yid gtod pa med do/ /nyon mongs rnams la chags par mi 'gyur zhing / /de ni 'dod rgyus sems gdungs mi 'gyur la/ /de yum 'dod pa'i yon tan ldan pa yi/ /skyesapa rnams la sems ni gtod pa med/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo 'dod pa skyes pa/ /kye ma bdag gisargya mtsho chen po bzhi'i chu btung ngo snyam nas des rgyal po zas gtsang la smras pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang gis mtshan mkhan rnams la smras pa/ ci'i phyir btsun mo 'di 'di lta bu'i 'dod pa skye /tsho mtshan mkhan rnams kyis smras pa/ lha btsun mo la sras skyes bu chen po'i mchan sum 13
bcu rtsa gnyis kyis sku brgyan pa zhig bltam par 'gyur te/ de rab tu byung nas shes bya'i mtsho mtha' dag 'thung bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gal te 'di la mtsho chen polichu ma blud na cir 'gyur/ sras yan lag ma tshang ba zhig btsas par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ nga ming zasagatsang ma zhesabya ba'i bu yan lag ma tshang bar bya'am/ de'i tshe grong khyer ser skya'i gzhi na kun tu rgyu mig dmar zhes bya ba mig 'phrul la byang ba zhig 'dug pa de rgyal posabakug nasabasgo ba dang / des de steng gi khang bzang gi gzhi na 'dug pa la rgya mtsho chen po bzhi bstan te chu blud pa dang / de'i 'dod pa skyes pa gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang de'i 'dod pa skyes pa/ kye ma btson thams cad thar bar bya'o/ /snyam pa dang / rgyal pos btson thams cad thar bar byas nas/ de'i 'dod pa skyes pa gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang de'i 'dod pa skyesapa/ kye ma sbyin pa dag sbyin/ bsod nams dag bya'o snyam pa dang / rgyal pos sbyin pa dag byin/ bsod nams dag byas nas de'i 'dod pa skyes pa gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang de'i 'dod pa skyes pa/ kye ma bdag gis skyed mos tshal blta'o snyam pa dang / rgyal pos skyed mos tshal bstan nas de'i 'dod pa skyesapa gang yin pa de dang bral bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang de'i 'dod pa skyes pa/kye ma bdag skyed mos tshal du 'dug par bya'o snyam pa dang / rgyal po legs par rab sad la lum bi ni'i chal zhes bya ba'i skyed mos tshal yod nas de la rgyal po zas gtsang gis spring ba/ khyod kyi bu mo skyed mos tshal du 'gro bar 'dod kyis skyed mos tshal byi dor byos shig des zho shasa'atsho ba dag la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag skyed mos tshal ṣ+ṭi dor byos shigde rnamasakyisaskyed mosatshal byi dor byas so/ /de nas de 'khor rnams dang lhan cig dong ngo | |de nas des lum bi ni'i tshal du 'chag pa na shing mya ngan 'tshang me tog shin tu rgyas 14
pa zhig mthong ste/ de bltam par 'dod nas de la bzung ste 'dug pa dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bsams pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i yum ni ngo tsha shes pa dang ldan pas skye bo3tshogs chen pos bskor na bltam mi phod kyis thabs shig bsham par bya'o snyam nas des rlung dang char drag po zhig sprul nas des skye bo'i tshogs de kun tu bros so/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis bdag nyid ma ma rgan mo'i cha byad du mngon par sprul nasabatsun mo sgyu 'phrul chen molimadun du bsdad pa dang / des bltam par brtsams so/ /byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa dang / brgya byin gyis pags pa'i sleb mos bzung ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du dgongs te/ brgya byin 'di bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' blangasaso zhesadregs par 'gyur bar mkhyen nas bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur byin gyisabarlabs pa dang / lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin 'dar bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas bka' stsal pa/ no shi ka nga thongs shig thongs shigphar thongs shig chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das bltam pa de'i tshe yang sa chen po 'di yang g.yos par gyur zhes bya ba nas shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so/ /shes ldan dag sems can gzhan yang 'dir skyes so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums nas bltam pa na ral gri shubs nas byung ba bzhin du mngal gyi dri ma dang / sha ma'i dri ma dang / khrag gi dri ma dang / mi gcang ba gzhan dang gzhan sna tshogs kyis ma gos so/ /chos nyid kyis gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums nas bltam pa de'i tshe de'i yum mi 'dug mi nyal 'greng bzhin du rgyal rigs ma des rgyal rigs /snam par byed do/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub
sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod la sus kyang ma bzung bar phyogs bzhir gzigs nas gom pa bdun bdun 'dor zhing tshig tu yang gsungs pa/ 'di ni shar phyogs yin te/ mya ngan las 'dasapa'i thog mar 'gro bar bya'o/ /'di ni lho phyogs yin te/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gi yon gnas su gyur par bya'o/ /'di ni nub phyogs yin te/ nga'i skye ba tha ma ni 'di yin par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni byang phyogs yin te/ srid pa'i mtsho las brgal bar bya'o/ /de'i dbu'i steng nas lha rnams gdugs dkar po dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dag 'dzin to/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod la bar snang las chu bsil ba gcig dang / chu dron po gcig ste chu gnyis kyi rgyun sgyi gtsug gi steng du 'bab cing des byang chub sems dpa' khrus mdzad do/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod la bskrun pa'i yum gyi mdun du chu mig chen po byung nas 'bab par gyur te/ de la de'i yum chus chu'i bya ba byed do/ /chos nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa' bltam pa'i mod la lhas bar snang las lha'idzi.u la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po dang / a ga ru'i phye ma dang / rgya spos kyi phye ma dang / tsan dan gyi phye ma dang ta ma la'i 'dab mas 'thor ro/ /lha'i me tog man dwa ra bas kyang 'thor ro/ /lha'i sil snyan rnams kyis kyang sgra 'byin to/ /gos dag kyang 'thor bar byed do/ / / /16
༄rgyu/ /ston pa thugs rje can gyi ma yum sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lo rgyus dang rgyal bu don kun grub pa ja ltar 'khrungs tshul/rgya cher rol ba'i mdo lasadas/lha mo sgyu 'phrul yang khrudragabyas/ ludragabyug pas byugs/ rgyan sna tshogatha(kyis lag pa shin tu brgyan te/ gos shin tu 'jam pa mchog bgos shing btsun spu dang bcas la/dga' ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba dang / rangasapa thob nas/ bud med stong phrag bcus bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ lhan cig tu rgyal po zas gtsang ma rol mo bya ba'i khang bzang na bde bar gnas pa'i drung du phyin te/ g.yas rol na khri bzang po rin po che'i dra bas brgyan pa la 'dug nas/ 'dzum pa'i bzhin khro gnyer med cing rab tu dad pa'i mdog gisargyal po zas gtsang ma la tshigasasu bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /rgyal po sa bdag legs par bdag la gsan du gsol/ /rgyal po khyod la gsol gyis bdag la de gnongasashig bdag gi bsam pa yid la ci mchis cir dga' ba/ /de dag bdag la gsan cing thugasadagyes rangs par mdzod/ /lha bdag bsnyen gnas tshul khrims brtul zhugs len par gsol/ /bdag ni 'gro la byams pas yan lag brgyad len te/ /srog chagasaganod pa spangs shing bsam pa rtag dag pas/ /ji ltar bdag la byams pa de ltar gzhan la bgyi/ /rku sems rnam par spangs te 'dod dang dregs pa spangs/ /rgyal po 'dod pa rnamasal log par g.yem mi bgyid/ /bden la gnas shing phra ma ma mchis zhe gcod spang / /mi dge kyal 1pa'i tshig kyang yongs su mi spyod do/ /gnod
semasazhe sdang tha ba gti mug rgyags pa dang / /brnab sems kun sbangasarang gi nor gyis 'tshal bar bgyi/ /yang dag spyor bas kha gsag tshul 'chos phrag dog spang / /dge bcu'i las lam 'di dag bdag gis spyad par bgyi/ /bdag ni tshul khrims brtul zhugs mngon dga' rab bsdams kyis/ /mi yi dbang po bdag la bzhed pas sred ma mdzad/ /rgyal po khyod la yun ring mi dger gyur du mchi/ /bdag gi tshul khrimasabartul zhugs nyer gnas dgyes par mdzod/ /rgyal po bdag gi 'tshal ba 'di lags deng myur stsol/ /khang bzang bsil khang ldan pa ngang skya ldan pa'i nang / /me tog bkram pa'i mchis mal 'jam zhing dri bda' bar/ /grogasamosastagatu bskor cing bde dgaraganasasnyam bgyid/ /skyes pa nyung rum rnams dang de bzhin khye'u dag dang / /bud med phal pa rnams kyang mdun na mchisami 'tshal/ /snyan zhing yid mchi sgra snyan nyan pa ma gtogs par/ /gzugs dang sgra bsung yid du mi mchi bdag mi 'tshal/ /bcings dang btson rar stsal ba thams cad dgye bar gsol/ /nor gyis brel ba'i mi rnams nor dang ldan par mdzod/ /zas skom rang pa shing rta khyogs dang bzhon pa rta/ /'gro la bde ba'i slad du dgung bdun stsal ba mdzod/ /pho brang 'di na skyes pa khye'u dang bud med dag /ji snyed mchis pa 'thab rtsod khro ba'i tshig bral zhing / /phan tshun byamasapa'i yid ldan phan dang des sems kyis/ /dga' tshal gnas pa'i lha ltar mthun zhing bde spyod mdzod/ /rgyal polichad pa che phra gnyer gyis bda' ba dang / /gnod pa bgyid dang rdeg bcog sdigs ru mi mdzad par/ /kun la'ang dad pa'i thugs kyis byams dang phan dgongs te/ /lha yis skye bo rnams la sras gcig bzhin du gzigs/ /rgyal pos de skad tshig thosarab tu dgar gyur nas/ /smras pa khyod ni ci 'dod de kun de bzhin bya/ /khyod kyi bsam pa yid kyisagang rnams rjes bsamsshing / /khyod kyis mchog blangs gang yin de ni ngas sbyin no/ /rgyal po'i dam pas rang gi 18
'khor la bsgo ba ni/ /khang bzang dam pa'i steng du phun sum tshogs pa shoms/ /me tog mdzes pa khrom la bdug spos mchog gis bdugs/ /gdugs dang ba dan ta la'i phreng ba'i rgyan kyang gyis/ /'thab phod stong phrag nyi shu sna tshogs go cha can/ /mda' mdung lcags mda' mdung thung ral gri thogs pa dag /yid 'ong sgra gcan ngang skya ldan pa bskor gyis te/ /lha mo 'jigs pa med par bya phyir srung zhing gnas/ /khrus byas spos byugs gosamachog dag gisayan lag brgyan/ /bud med rnamasakyisade bskor lha yi bu mo 'dra/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sgra ldan sil snyan stong blangasate/ /lha mo de bzhugs lha yi bu mo bzhin du gnas/ /lha yi rin chen rin thang chen pos rtsa sprasapa/ /khri la gos mchog mang pos yid 'ong mal bshamasate/ /mal phyin gtsug gi nor bu rin chen klod byas nas/ /'dres pa'i nagasatshal lha yi bu mo bzhin du gnas/ /dge slong dag de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi dang /lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / lha'i bu rab 'thab bral dang / yongs su dga' ldan dang /rab 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / bdud kyi bu ded dpon dang / mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / mdun na 'don tshangs mchog dang / mdun na 'don tshangs bzangasadang / 'od bkod pa dang / 'od gsal dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi dbang phyug chen po dang / mthar thug dang / 'og min pa dang / de dag la sogs pa dang /gzhan yang lha brgya stong mang po 'dusate/ gcig la gcig 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /grogs po dag bdag cag gis byang chub sems dpa' gcig pu gnyis su med par gshegs su gsol na/ bdag cag gis byas pa ma shedragapar 'gyur te/ bdag cag la mi chas/ grogasapo dag khyed kyi nang nas byang chub semasadapa' thog ma yum gyi lhums su gshegs pa dang / lhums na bzhugs pa dang / bltam pa dang / thor bu dang / byis pa'i nang na rol pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na bzhugs pa dang / rol mo 19
gzigs pa dang / mngon par 'byung ba dang / dka' ba spyod pa dang / byang chub kyi snying por gshegasapa dang / bdud 'dul ba dang / byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /mya ngan las 'das pa chen po bstan gyi bar du phan pa'i sems dang / dga' ba'i sems dang / phangs pa'i sems dang / byams pa'i sems dang / mnyen pa'i semasakyisartag par rgyun du byang chub semasadapa'i zhabar+sā'bring na 'khod par su dag spro/ de'i tshe tshigasasu bcad pa 'di dag kyang smras so/ /khyed las su zhig rtag tu dga' yid kyis/ /gzugs mchog mnga' ba'i zhabs 'bring byed par spro/ /su dag rang gi bsod namasagazi brjed dang / /stobs dang grags pa rnam par spel bar 'dod/ /gang zhig lha yi pho brang 'di dag na/ /lha mo dag dang 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi/ /lha yi bde bas dga' bar 'dod pa dag /dri med zla ba'i zhal gyi zhabs 'bring gyis/ /de bzhin 'dres pa'i nagadragatshal mdzes pa mchog /lha yi 'byung gnas lha yi pho brang na/ /gser mdog me tog rgyas par dga' 'dod na/ /dri med gzi brjid mnga' ba'i zhags 'bring gyis/ /gang gis sna tshogasashing rta de bzhin du/ /dga' tshal me tog man dwar 'dab rgyasasu/ /lha mo lhan cig rtse bar 'dod pa dag /skyes bu chen po 'di yi zhabs 'bring gyis/ /'thab bral bdag po'am dga' ldan bdag po'am/ /yang na dbang phyug 'gyur bar 'dod pa dang / /'gro ba kun gyis mchod 'os 'dod pa dag /gragadragapa mtha' yadraga'adi yi zhabs 'bring gyis/ /gang zhig 'phrul dga'i khang pa mdzes pa dang / /dbang sgyur lha yi gnas su rtse 'dod cing / /yid kyi 'phrul gyis thams cad spyod 'dod pa/ /yon tan mchog mnga' 'di yi zhabasa'abring gyis/ /bdud kyi dbang po zhe sdang yid med pa/ /rdzu'aphrul dbang phyug kun gyi mthar phyin pa'i/ /'dod pa'i dbang phyug dbang mthar phyin 'dod na/ /phan pa mdzad pa 'di dang lhan cig deng / /de bzhin 'dod 20
pa'i khams las 'da' byas te/ /tshangs pa'i gnas su gnas par su 'dod pa/ /de ni tshad med bzhi yi gzi mnga' ba/ /skyes bu chen polikabs 'bring deng nas gyis/ /'on tam gang zhig mi yi nang dag tu/ /'khor los sgyur yul yangasapar skye 'dod na/ /rin chen 'byung gnas mi 'jigs bde sbyin pa/ /bsod namasayangs pa mnga' ba'i zhabs 'bring gyis/ /gang zhig sa bdag de bzhin tshong dpon bu/ /phyug cing skyid la nor mang tshogaphuchen dang / /dgra yi dpung bcom 'khor dang ldan 'dod pa/ /de ni phan mdzad 'di dang lhan cig deng / /gzugs dang longs spyod de bzhin dbang phyug dang / /snyan pa gragasadang spobs dang yon tan dang / /gzung 'osatshig dang mnyan pa'i tshig 'dod pa/ /de ni tshangs dbyangs mkhas pa'i gan du song / /lha dang mi yi 'dod pa gang yin dang / /srid pa gsum gyi bde ba thamasacad dang / /bsam gtan bde dang dbe+en pa'i bde 'dod pa| |de ni chos kyi dbang phyug zhabs 'bring gyis/ /'dod chags dang ni zhe sdang spong ba dang / /nyon mongasamun pa sel bar su 'dod cing / /zhi ba rab zhi nyer zhi yid ldan pa/ /de ni thugasadul zhags 'bring myur du song / /gang zhig slob dang mi slob rang rgyal dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob 'dod cing / /stobs bcus seng ge'i sgra sgrogs su 'dod pa/ /de ni yon tan rgya mtsho mkhas drung song / /gang zhig ngan song rnams kyi lam gcod cing / /bzang 'gro 'chi ba med pa'i lam dbye dang / /yan lag brgyad lam 'gro bas 'gro 'dod na/ /'gro lam mthar 'byin 'di yi zhagasa'abring gyis/ /gang zhig bde gshegs yongs su mchod pa dang / /thugs rje mnga' ba de las chos nyan dang / /dge 'dun yon tan thob par 'dod pa ni/ /yonaton rgya mtsho 'di yi zhabs 'bring gyis/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal zad pa dang / /'khor ba'i bcings pa rnam par grol ba dang / /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam rnam dag spyod 'dod pa/ /de ni sems can dag pa'i zhabs 21
'bring gyis/ /'gro ba kun na yid 'ong sdug mdzes shing / /gzugs mchog mtshan dang yon tan rgyas pa dang / /bdag dang de bzhin gzhan yang 'grel 'dod pa/ /de ni blta sdug mkhas pa'i gan du song / /tshul khrims ting 'dzin de bzhin shes rab dang / /zab cing blta dka' gting dpag dka' ba yi/ /rnam grol thob 'dod mkhasapagang yin de/ /sman pa'i rgyal po'i gan du myur du song / /yon tan 'di dang gzhan yang rnam mang dang / /srid pa'i bde dang de bzhin mya ngan 'das/ /yonatan thamasacad rabatu rdzogasa'adod pa/ /de ni brtul zhugs grub mkhas gan du song / /tshig de thosanasargyal chen bzhi'i risakyi lha 'bum phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha 'bum dang / 'thab bral gyi lha 'bum dang / dga' ldan gyi lha 'bum dang / 'phrul dga'i lha 'bum dang / bdud kyi ris kyi lha sngon gyi dge ba'i las kyis byung ba drug khri dang / tshangs ris kyi lha drug khri brgyad stong dang / 'og min gyi bar gyi lha brgya stong mang po dag 'dus par gyur pa dang /gzhan yang shar phyogasadang / lho phyogasadang / nub phyogasadang / byang phyogasanas lha'i bu brgya stong mang po 'dus par gyur pa de dag las gang dag mchog tu bya ba'i lha'i bu dag gisalha'i 'khor chen po de dag la tshigasasu bcad pa 'di dag smrasaso/ /bdag cag rnams kyis bsam pa yang dag ci 'dra yi/ /tshig 'di lha yi dbang po dag gis gsan du gsol/ /'dod pa'i dga' 'byor bsam gtan bde ba mchog spangstegi/ /sems can dag pa dam pa 'di yi zhabs 'bring bgyi/ /lhums su gshegs dang lhums na bzhugs dang bltam pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid chen po mchod 'os shin tu mchod par bgyi/ /bsod nams dag gis bsrungs pa'i drang srong yongasabasrungasan/ /zhe sdang sems kyis sus kyang glags rnyed 'gyur ma mchis/ /glu dbyangs sil snyan rol molidabyangs sgra legs bsgrags pas/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mnga' ba'i yon tan bsngags brjod de/ /gang 22
thos skye bo byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par/ /lha dang mi rnams thams cad rab tu dga' bar bgyi/ /rgyal po'ipho brang me tog sil masargyasapar dgang / /a ga ru mchog nag posabadugasate dri zhim bgyi/ /de yi dri tshor lha mi rab tu dga' 'gyur zhing / /nad med rims nad bral zhing bde bar 'gyur bar bgyi/ /me tog man dwa ra dang kun nas 'du ba dang / /sim byed rab tu sim byed smra la rnam snang dang / /me tog bzang pos phrin las dge las byung ba de/ /mchod pa'i slad du ser skya'i grong kun dgang bar bgyi/ /ji srid yum gyi lhums na dri gsum ma gos bzhugs/ /ji srid rga shi mthar 'byin bltam par gyur gyi bar/ /de srid dus su dang ba'i yid kyis zhabs 'bring bgyi/ /blo gros che mnga' mchod pa bgyi bar bdag cag sems/ /bltam nas gom pa bdun gshegs brgya byin tshangs pa yis/ /lag tu blangasate spos chu dag gisasku bsil ba/ /semasacan rnam par dag pa de ni mthong ba yi/ /lha mi de dag thob pa rgya chen legs par thob/ /ji srid bar du 'jig rten rjes su mthun mdzad cing / /'dod pa'i nyon mongs 'joms mdzad btsun molinang bzhugasal/ /ji srid cig na rgyal srid kun spangs khab nasa'abyung / /de srid dus su dad pa'i sems kyis zhabs 'bring bgyi/ /ji srid cig na ran bsnams byang chub snying por gshegs/ /ji srid cig na bdud bcom byang chub reg gyur cing / /tshangs pa khrag khrig 'khor lo bskor bar gsol btab pa/ /de srid bde bar gshegs la mchod pa rgya chen bgyi/ /sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'chi med btul gyur te/ /stong gsum khams su sangs rgyas phrin las nam lags nas/ /zhi zhing bsil ba'i mya ngan 'das par gshegs gyur pa/ /de srid kun gyis drang srong grags chen gtang mi bgyi/ /dge slong dag de nas 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu mo dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus gzugs phun sum tshogs pa mthong nas 'di snyam du sems te/ sems can dag pa 23
mchog dam pa 'di lta bu 'dzin par 'gyur ba'i na chung de ni ji lta bu zhig yod snyam nas/de dag ngo mtshar du gyur te/ me tog dang / sposadang / phreng ba dang / byug pa mchog tu bya ba dag khyer nasalha'i lusayid lasagrub pa thob cing bsod namasakyi rnam par smin pa'i dz+nyo'phrul gyisabyin gyisabarlabasapa/ de dag skad cig de nyid la lha'i pho brang de nasami snang bar gyur te/ ser skya'i grong khyer chen po dam pa skyed mos tshal brgya stong gis brgyan pa/rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i khyim mchog khang bzang chen po ngang skya ldan zhes bya ba lha'i dbang po'ipho brang lta bu der phyin nas/ lha'i bu mo gos lhug lhug po gyon pa/ dge ba dri ma med pa'i bsod nams kyi gzi brdzid kyis rab tu brgyan pa/ lha'i rgyan gyis lag pa shin tu brgyan pa de dag gis lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma la mchog gi steng na 'dug pa mthong nas/ phan tshun mdzub mos ston cing / nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod de/ gcig la gcig tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ lha gnas 'khod pa'i lha yi bu mo rnams/ /yid 'ong byang chub sems dpa'i sku mthong nas/ /de tshe de dag 'di snyam sems gyur te/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yum gyur ci 'dra snyam/ /lag na me tog phreng can de dag rnams/ /the tshom skyesanar+sārgyal polipho brang du/ /me tog de bzhin byug pa thogs nas su/ /sor bcu thal mo sbyar te 'dud cing lhags/ /lhug lhug gosagyon 'jo bgagazugs 'chang bas/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul mal steng gnas mthong nas/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mos phyag byas te/ /mi yi bud med gzugasal legs ltosa'adzer/ /bdag cag nga rgyal sems kyis mngon sems pa/ /lha yi bu mo gzugs mchog yid 'ong snyam/ /rgyal polibatsun mo 'di yi gzugs mthong na| |lha yi lus kyang zil gyis non par mthong / /'di ni gang zag mchog gi yum 'gyur du / |yon tan ldan pas shin tu gsha' zhing 'os/ /nor bu rin chen snod bzang gnas pa ltar/ /lha mo 'di ni lha yi lha snod yin/ /rkang lag mthil dang sgyi bo man chad du/ /yan 24
lag yid 'ong lha lasalhag pa ste/ /mig gis lta na ngomasapar 'gyur ma yin/ /yid dang sems ni phyir zhing dga' bar 'gyur/ /'di yi kha bzhin lus mdzes sdug pa ni/ /nam mkha'i dkyil na zla ba mdzes pa 'dra/ /nyi ltar dri med me ltar 'bar ba ste/ /'di yi luslasa'od gsal bzang po 'byung / /gser sbram btso ma bzang poligaser bzhin du/ /lha mo 'di yi kha dog rnam par mdzes/ /'di yi skra ni 'jam gtsang dri zhim ste/ /bung ba mchog gi mdog 'dra lcang lor 'khyil/ /'di yi mig ni pad ma'i 'dab ma 'dra/ /rnam dag so ni nam mkha'i skar ma bzhin/ /rked pa gzhu ltar phra zhing sta zur yangs/ /phrag pa zlum zhing tshigs rnams mngon pa med/ /brla legs glang po mchog gi sna 'dra ste/ /byin pa shin tu legs pa byin gyis phra/ /rkang lag mthil mnyam shin tu dmar ba ste/ /'di ni gzhan min lha yi bu mor nges/ /de ltar rnam mang du mar blta byas nas/ /me tog gtor te bskor ba byasanas ni/ /grags ldan rgyal ba'i yum la bstod byas te/ /skad cig gcig gis phyir yang lha gnas dong / /de nas phyogs bzhi skyong ba bzhi po dang / /'thab bral rab dang brgya byin 'phrul pa dang / /lha tshogasalha min grul bum srin po dang / /mi'am ci dang lto 'phye ches smrasapa/ /skyes bu mchog gi mdun du khyed deng la/ /skyesabu dam pa de la bsrung ba gyis/ /'gro ba dag la yid kyis sdang ma byed/ /mi rnamasal yang gtse ba ma byed cig /lha mo sgyu 'phrul khyim mchog gang gnas pa/ /der ni mthun par 'khor dang lhan cig kun/ /mda' gzhu ral gri mdung thung mtshon thogs la/ /nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas te blta bar gyis/ /de ltar shi 'pho'igadus shes lha'i bu rnams/ /me tog de bzhin byug pa thogs nas ni/ /sor bcu thal mo sbyar te 'dud byos la/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis sgyu 'phrul drung du deng / /smra ba'i seng ge dus ni deng lags kyis/ /'jig rten kun la thugs rje brtse bskyed de/ /mi dbang se/sna can dag pa 'chi 'pho ston/ /mchod sbyin
don du bdag cag gsol ba 'debs/ /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'chi 'pho ba'i dusakyi tshe shar phyogasanas byang chub semasadapa' skye ba gcig gisathogspa dga' ldan gyi gnas dam pa na gnas pa brgya stong phrag mang po dag byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' ga la ba der lhags so/ /de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' skye ba gcig gis thogasapa/ dga' ldan gyi gnasadam pa na gnasapa brgya stong phrag mang po dag byang chub semasadapa' la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub semasadapa'ag la ba der lhagasaso/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang nas lha'i bu mo 'bum phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs sna tshogs len cing byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub semasadapa'ag la ba der lhagasaso/ /de bzhin du sum nartsagasum dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi nang nas lha'i bu mo 'bum phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sil snyan dang / glu dbyangasasna tshogasalen cing / byang chub semasadapa' la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub semasadapa' ga la ba der lhagasaso/ /de nas byang chub semasadapa' khang pa brtsegasapa chen po bsod namasathams cad kyis yang dag par byung ba dpal gyi snying po lha rnams kyis kun nas blta ba'i nang du 'dug snye/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gis yongasasu bskor cing mdun du bdar nas/ dga' ldan gyi gnasadam pa nas bskyod par brtsams so/ /dge slong dag de ltar bskyod par brtsams pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpas 'od gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di ltar rgya che zhing yangasal tha gru che ba 'dir sngon chad ma byung ba'i 'od snang ba lha'i 'od las shin tu 'das 26
pasayongasasu gsal zhing snang bar gyurato/ /'jig rten gyi bar gang sdig pa sdig pas khebasanasamun pa mun nag smag tu gyur pa snang ba med pa gang du nyi ma dang zla ba 'di gnyisa'adi ltar dz+nyo'aphrul che zhing 'di ltar mthu che la 'di ltar dbang che bar gragasapas kyang 'od dang / kha dog dang / gzi brdzid kyisalam mer ma gyur/ thal ler ma gyur/ lhang nger ma gyur pa der semasacan gang dag skyesapa de dag rang rang gis lag pa brkyang ba'ang mi mthong ba de dag tu'ang de'i tshe snang ba chen pos rgyasapar khyab par gyur cing / der skyes pa'i semasacan de dag snang ba deskhyab par gyur nasagacig gisagacig mthong zhing gcigagisagacig shes te/ 'di skad du kye grogasapo dag semasacanagazhan dag kyang 'dir skyesaso/ /kye grogasapo dag semasacan gzhan dag kyang 'dir skyesaso zhesazer bar gyur pa de lta bu'i 'od lus las bkye'o/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams 'di'ang rnam pa drug dang / ltas chen po bca brgyad du g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun tu rab tu g.yosaso/ /'gul rab tu 'gul/ kun tu rab tu 'gul to/ /ldeg rab tu ldeg /kun tu rab tu ldeg go /'khrugasarab tu 'khrugs/ kun tu rab tu 'khrugasaso/ /'ur kur rab tu kur 'ur/ kun tu rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /chem chem rab tu chem chem/ kun tu rab tu chem chem mo/ /mtha' dma' na dbus mtho bar gyur to/ /dbus dma' na mtha' mtho bar gyur to/ khrar phyogs dma' na nub phyogs mtho bar gyur to/ /nub phyogasadama' na shar phyogs mtho bar gyur to/ /lho phyogs dma' na byang phyogs mtho bar gyur to/ /byang phyogs dma' na lho phyogasamatho bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe sgra dga' bar 'gyur ba/ tshim par 'gyur ba/ mgu bar 'gyur ba/ dad par 'gyur ba/ sim par 'gyur ba/ mnyan nga ra 'os pa/ bsngags par 'os pa/ mtshungs pa med pa/ mnyan na gtang mi bra ba/ mi mthun pa 27
med pa/ dngang bar 'gyur ba med pa dag kyang grag par gyur to/ /skad cig de la semscan gang la yang gnod pa'am/ 'jigs pa'am/ dngang ba'am/ bag non pa med par gyur to/ /skad cig de la nyi zla dang / brgya byin dang / tshangasapa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dag gi 'od kyang mi snang bar gyur to/ /semasacan dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro3skye gnasdang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes pa'i sems can thams cad kyang skad cig de la sdug bsngal dang bral zhing bde ba thams cad dang ldan par gyur te/ sems can gang la yang 'dod chags kyis gnod par mi 'gyur/ zhe sdang gis gnod par mi 'gyur/ gti mug gisaganod par mi 'gyur zhing / phrag dog gam/ ser sna'am/ nga rgyal lam/ 'chab pa'am/ rgyags pa'am/ khro ba'am/ gnod semasasam/ yongasasugadung bsaganod par 'gyur ba med par gyur te/ sems can thams cad kyang skad cig de la/ phan lhun pha ma tsam du semasapa'i 'du shesasu gyur nas/ byamasapa'i semasadang / phan pa'i semasadang ldan par gyur to/ /lha dang mi'i rol mo sil snyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dag kyang ma dkrol ma blangasapar yid du 'ong ba'i sgra 'byin par gyur to/ /lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dag kyang lag pa dang phrag pa dang spyi bos gzhal med khang chen po de dag 'deg cing khyer bar gyur to/ /lha'i bu mo brgya stong dag gis kyang rang rang gi glu dbyangs blangs te/ mdun dang / rgyab dang / g.yasagayon dag nas byang chub sems dpa' la glu dbyangs kyi sgra skad kyis mngon par bstod pa/ khyod kyis sngon chad dge las bsags pa dang / /yun ring dus kyi dge bas byung ba dang / /khyod kyis chos rnams kun gyi tshul sbyangs pas/ /de ring mchod pa rgya chen byung bar gyur/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por khyod kyisasngon/ /sras mo sras sdug sbyin pa mdzad pas na/ /lha yi me tog char du bab pa 'di/ /sbyin pa spyad pa de yi 'bras bu lags/ /gtso bo khyod kyisarang gi sha bcad 28
de| /srang la bcal nasathugasabyon bya phyir btang / /sbyin pa de spyad pa yi 'brasabu des/ /yi dwagasa'ajigartenarnamasakyangazasaskom thob/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por khyod kyisasngon/ /tshul khrimadragam zhig ma nyamaphubasrungadragapasan/ /tshul khrimadragade spyad pa yi 'brasabu des/ /mi khom ngan song yongasasu dag par gyur/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por khyod kyis sngon/ /byang chub bsgrub pa'i gzhir ni bzod pa bsgoms/ /bzod pa de spyad pa yi 'bras bu des/ /lha dang mi kun byams pa'i sems su gyur/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por khyod kyis sngon/ /brtson 'grusamagod dam pa bsgomasapasan/ /brtson 'grusade spyad pa yi 'brasabu des/ /sku ni ri rab bzhin du mdzesapar grub/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por khyod kyis sngon/ /nyon mongs sbyang slad bsam gtan bsgoms mdzad pas/ /bsam gtan de spyad pa yi 'bras bu des/ /'gro ba dag la nyon mongs gnod mi 'gyur/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por khyod kyis sngon/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i shes rab bsgoms mdzad pas/ /shes rab de spyad pa yi 'bras bu des/ /'od gsal dam pa rnam par snang zhing mdzes/ /byams pa'i go mnabs nyon mongasa'ajoms mdzad cing / /sems can kun la thugs rje ches byung ba/ /dgyes pa mchog brnyes btang snyoms mchog ldan pa/ /bde gshegs tshangs gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal 'o1/ /shesarab sgron ma'i 'od dang gzis 'phags shing / /gti mug skyon gyi mun pa kun sel ba/ /'dren pa stong gsum dag na mig gyur pa'i/ /thub pa lam ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzu'aphrul rkang pa mngon shes mchog la mkhas/ /bden pa gzigs shing dam pa'i don bslabs pa/ /rgal nasasrog chags gzhan dag sgrol mdzad pa/ /bde gshegs grol gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs dang mngon shes dam pa kun la mkhas/ /'chi 'pho 'chi 'pho med pa'i 'pho ba ston/ /'jiX rten chos kyi rjes su mthun mdzad kyang / /
'jig rten gang du'ang chags pa khyod mi mnga'/ /gang dag khyod ni nyan tam ltar lhags pa/ /de dag thob pa dam pa bsam mi khyab/ /khyod la chos nyid thos te gang dad cing / /dga' ba yangs pa skyes pa smos ci 'tshal/ /dga' ldan gnas rnams kun ni mog mog gyur/ /'dzam bu'i gling du nyi ma mngon du shar/ /srog chags bye ba khrag khrig bsam mi khyab/ /nyon mongs gnyid kyis log las sad par mdzad/ /deng ni pho brang 'byor cing rgyas gyur la/ /bye ba khrag khrig lha rnams lang long gyur/ /lha yi bu mos sil snyan sgra phyung bas/ /rgyal polikhab na sil snyan grags par 'gyur/ /bsod nams gzi brdzid rdzogsshing las dge ba/ /bud med gzugasakyi mchog dang ldan gyur pa/ /de yi srasagyur de ni de ltar 'byor/ /dpal gyisa'ajig rten gsum ni zil gyis gnon/ /mi mchog 'byung ba de yi gzi brjid kyis/ /de phyi phyin chad pho brang dam pa 'dir/ /lus can rnams la 'dod dang 'thab rtsod med/ /kun kyang byams pa'i sems kyis sri zhur bcas/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rigs rgyal byung bas na/ /rgyal polirigs ni rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ /ser skya'i grong 'di shin tu phun sum tshogs/ /rin chen mdzod kyis rab tu gang bar 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin srin po grul bum gsang ba pa/ /lha dang lha min tshogs rnams dbang por bcas/ /mi mchog srung ba gang dag gnas pa rnams/ /de dag ring por mi thogs thar pa 'thob/ /gus dang sri zhu la ni gnas nas su/ /'dren pa khyod bstod bsod nams gang bsagasapa/ /kun kyang byang chub tu ni yongasasu bsngo/ /mi yi dam pa khyod ltar myur du shog /skyod par brtsamasapa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o/ /dge slong dag de ltar dgun 'das te/ dpyid kyi dus la dpyid zla tha chungs kyi tshe/skar ma sa ga la bab pa dus kyi dam pa la shing rnams kyi lo ma rgyas shing / me tog mchog tu rgyas nas grang dro dang / mun pa dang / rduX med cing sa'i gzhi sngo gzhon nu skyes pas
khebs par gnas pa'i tshe/ 'jig rten gsum gyi gtso bo 'jig rten gyis mchod pas dus la bab pa'i tshod la rnam par gzigasanas/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya la skar ma rgyal gyi dus su/ yum gso sbyong blangs pa'i rum du/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnasadam pa nas 'phos te/ dran zhing shes bzhin du/ gling polithu gu thal dar mche ba drug dang ldan pa/ mgolikha dog srin bu lham bu chu gsher gyi mdog lta bu/ mche ba la gser 'tshig pa/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa/ dbang po nyams pa med par byas te/ ma'i glo g.yas pa nas zhugs so/ /zhugs nas kyang glo g.yas pa logs su brten te gnas kyi/ glo g.yon pa logs su nam yang ma brten to/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul mal bde ba na nyal ba desakyang rmi lam 'di lta bu mthong ngo / /glang po kha ba dngul mdog mche ba drug /rkang lag rab mdzes mgo bo dmar sdug pa/ /'gros bzang lus migs rdo rje bzhin brtan pa/ /gling po mchog gcig khong du song snyam byed/ /des ni de 'dra'i bde ba brgya lam na'ang / /ma mthong ma thos myong bar ma gyur te/ /lus kyang bde zhing sems kyang bder gyur nas/ /bsam gtan mnyam par bzhag pa bzhin du gyur/ /de nas lha mo sgyu 'phrul rgyan dang gos lhug lhug por gyon cing / thogs pa las lus dang sems bde bar gyur te/ dga' ba dang / rangs pa dang / nyams bde ba thob nas/ mal dam pa de las langs te bud med kyi tshogs kyis yongasasu bskor cing mdun du bdar nasakhang bzang de'i steng nas babs te/ shing mya ngan 'tshang gi nags tshal ga la ba der song nas/ de mya ngan 'tshang gi nags tshal du bde bar 'dug ste/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i drung du pho nya btang nas/ rgyal po gshegs su gsol/ lha mo de khyod kyi zhal mthong bar bzhed do/ /zhes byas pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang mas tshig de thos nas/rab tu dga' bar gyur te/ lus g.yos nas khri bzang po las langs te/ blon po dang /31
grong rdal pa dang / 'khor dang / gnyen pa'i skye bo dag gis yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ mya ngan 'tshang gi nags tshal ga la ba der song ngo / /song nas kyang bdag gi lus shin tu lci ba snyam byed nas/ mya ngan 'tshang gi nags tshal du 'gro ma nus te/ mya ngan 'tshang gi nags tshal gyi sgor 'dug nas/ cung zad cig bsams te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras so/ /bdag ni g.yul du dpa' ba'i phul phyin pa/ /deng ltar lus lci bdag gis myong mi dran/ /bdag gi khyim du'ang 'gro bar deng ma nus/ /kye ma 'di ci su la dri bar bya/ /gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha dag nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod nas lus phyed mngon par sprul te/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/dka' thub brtul zhugs yon tan ldan pa 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod/ /byams dang snying rje thob pas bsod nams ye shes dbang bskur ba'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' che ba dga' ldan gnas nas 'phos gyur te/ /rgyal po khyod kyi sras gyur lha mo sgyu 'phrul mngal du zhugs/ /de tshe rang gi mgo cogs sor bcu thal mo sbyar byas te/ /rgyal po rim gro bya bar ldan gyur de yi nang du zhugs/ /nga rgyal dregs pa med pas lha mo sgyu 'phrul ngor bltas te/ /ngas ni khyod la ci bya ci sbyar khyod kyis nga la smros/ /lha mos smras pa/ kha ba dngul gyi mdog 'dra nyi zla'i 'od las 'phagasapa ste/ /rkang lag legs shing rab 'byes mche ba drug ldan che ba nyid/ /glang polidam pa rdo rje bzhin du tshigs brtan gzugs bzang ba/ /bdag gi rum du zhugs kyisade yi lo rgyus gsan par gsol/ /stong gsum khams 'di mdzes par rab rib ma mchis bdag gis mthong / /bdag ni nyal zhing mchisan lha rnams bye bas rab tu bstod/ /'on kyang bdag la khro zhing 'tshig dang zhe snang rmongasam mchis/ /zhi ba'i sems su gyur cing bsam gtan bde dang ldan snyam bgyid/ /bdag gi rmi lam 'di ni rigs la dge'adi )ngo'am ci/ /bdag gi rmi lam 'di ni yang
dag ldan par lung ston pa/ /rig byed rmi lam gzhung la mkhas shing gza' yi cho ga mkhan/ /rgyal po myur du bram ze 'dir ni legs par dgug tu gsol/ /de skad tshig thos rgyal pos de yi dus kyi skad cig la/ /bram ze rig byed bstan bcos gzhung la shin tu mkhas pa gnyer/ /sgyu 'phrul bram ze rnamasakyi mdun du 'dug nas 'di skad smras/ /kho mos rmi lam 'di 'dra mthong na de yi lo rgyusagason/ /bram ze rnams kyisasmras pa/ lha mo bka' stsal du gsol/ khyod kyis rmi lam ci 'dra ba zhig gzigs/ thos nas kyang dpyad par bgyi'o/ /lha mos smras pa/ kha ba dngul gyi mdog 'dra nyi zla'i 'od las 'phags pa ste/ /rkang lag legasashing rab 'byesamache ba drug ldan che ba nyid/ /glang po'i dam pa rdo rje bzhin du tshigs brtan gzugs bzang ba/ /bdag gi rum du zhugs na de yi lo rgyus mnyan par gyis/ /de skad tshig thosanasani bram ze rnams kyis 'di skad smras/ /rigs la dngo ba ma mchis dgyes pa rgya chen brnyes par 'gyur/ /khyod la sras mnga' mtshan gyis yan lag brgyan pa skye bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i rigasasu rigasaldan 'khor losasgyur ba che ba nyid/ /gal te 'dod pa dag dang rgyal srid pho brang spangs gyur te/ /'jig rten kun la thugs brtse chags med rab tu byung gyur na/ /de ni 'jig rten gsum na sbyin gnas sangs rgyas 'gyur ba ste/ /bdud rtsi mchog gi ro yis 'jig rten thams cad tshim mdzad 'gyur/ /de skad tshig snyan lung bstan te/ /rgyal po'i pho brang zan zos nas/ /bya dga' byin pa blangsnas su/ /bram ze de dag phyir dong ngo / /dge slong dag de ltar rgyal po zas gtsang mas bram ze mtshan dang ltas shes shing rnam par 'byed pa dang / rmi lam gyi gzhung shes pa dag las de skad kyi tshig de thos nas/ tshim zhing mgu ste/ yi rangs la/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyesanas/ bra/ ṭ+wāṃ de dag bza' ba dang btung ba dang / myang
ba mang po nyamasasu bsod pasatshim zhingangomasapar byasanas/ bya dga' byinate bkye'o/ /de nyid kyi tshe grong khyer chen po ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po de'i sgo bzhi na/ grong khyer gyi bzhi mdo dang sum mdo thams cad du sbyin pa byin te/ ji tsam du byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ zas 'dod pa rnamasal ni zas/ skom 'dod pa rnams la ni skom/ gos 'dod pa rnamasal ni gos/ bzhon pa 'dod pa rnams la ni bzhon pa/ spos 'dod pa rnamasal ni spos/ phreng ba 'dod pa rnamasal ni phreng ba/ byug pa 'dod pa rnams la ni byug pa/ mal cha 'dod pa rnamasal ni mal cha/ gnas 'dod pa rnamasal ni gnas/'tsho ba 'dod pa rnams la ni 'tsho ba byin no/ /dge slong dag de nas rgyal po zasagatsang ma 'di snyam du semasate/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul 'di khyim gang na 'dug na bde zhing nyon mongs pa med par 'dug par 'gyur snyam pa dang / de nas skad cig de nyid la rgyal po chen po bzhi rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i drung du 'ongs te 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha thugs las su ma mdzad par btang snyoms su bde bar bzhugs shig bdag cag gis byang chub sems dpa'i pho brang bsham mo/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i gan du 'ongasate 'di skad cesasmras so/ /skyong ba'i gzhal med khang rnamasangan/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa yi bzang / /byang chub sems dpa'i pho brang ni/ /rnam par rgyal tsam bdag gis 'bul/ /de nas lha'i bu rab 'thab bral rgyal po zasagatsang ma'i gan du 'ongasate 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /kho bo'i khang khyim mthong gyur nas/ /brgya byin bye ba ngo mtshar gyur/ /'thab bral rab kyi dpal ldan khang / /rgyal ba'i srasal bdag 'bul lo/ /de nasalha'i bu yongasasu dga' ldan rgyal po zasagatsang ma'igan du 'ongasate 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /gragasapa che mnga' sngon chad ni/ /dga' ldan gang du bzhugs gyur pa/ /pho ༷༷ dam pa dgyes pa de/ /rgyal ba'i sras la
bdag 'bul lo/ /de nas lha'i bu rab 'phrul dga' rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i gan du 'ongasate/ 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /dpal ldan yid lasagrub pa'i khang / /de ni rin chen rang bzhin te/ /byang chub semasadapa' mchog don du/ /rgyal po bdag gis 'bul bar bgyis/ /de nasalha'i bu gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i gan du 'ongs te 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /'dod pa'i khamasaganasaji snyed pa/ /gzhal med khang mdzes gang yod pa/ /bdag gi gzhal med khang drung na/ / 'od dang mdog kyang stor bar snang / /de bas dpal ldan bdag gis 'bul/ /byang chub semasadapa' mchod pa'i phyir/ /rin chen rang bzhin pho brang bzang / /de ni rgyal po blang bar gyis/ /lha yi me tog rab bkang ste| |lha yi spos kyi ngad ldang ba'i/ /pho brang yangs pa bdag gis 'bul/ /der rje lha mo bzhugs par gyis/ /dge slong dag de ltar 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i dbang po thams cad kyisabyang chub semasadapa' la mchod pa'i phyir ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po dam pa der rang rang gi khyim phul bar gyur to/ /rgyal po zas gtsang mas kyang mi'i las ni 'das kyi lha yir ni ma gyur pa bshams par gyur te/ de la byang chub sems dpa' bkod pa chen politing nge 'dzin gyi mthus khyim de dag thams cad du lha mo sgyu 'phrul mngon par bstan to/ /byang chub semasadapa' lha mo sgyu 'phrul gyi rum na 'dug pa'i tshe/ glo g.yas phyogs logs su skyil mo krung bcas te gnas par gyur to/ /lha'i dbang po de dpe/ thamasacad kyang so so nas bdag nyid kyi khyim na byang chub semasadapa'i ma 'dug gi gzhan ma yin no zhes de ltar shes par gyur to/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ ting 'dzin bkod pa che la gnas gyur te/ /sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab sprul byas nas/ /lha rnams thams cad bsam pa rdzogs par byas/ /rgyal po'ang ( 5ltar yid bzhin bsam pa grub/ /de nas
'khor de'i nang nas lha'i bu kha cig 'di snyam du sems te/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha gang yin pa de dag kyang mi'i lus kyi dri bro na skyo zhing 'byol na/ de ma yin pa'i lha gzhan sum cu rtsa gsum mam/ 'thab bral lam/ dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu dag lta smos kyang ci dgos na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' gtsang zhing dri nga ba dang bral ba/ 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa/ sems can rin po che dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris nas 'phos te/ yum gyi lhums mi'i lus dri mi zhim par bzhugs par gyur snyam pa dang /de nas sangs rgyasakyi mthus tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji tsam du bud med kyi lus ni smad pa lags pa dang / 'dod chags la spyod ces bgyi ba'i bar du de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ngo mtshar che na/bcom ldan 'das de bas kyang 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa/ sngon byang chub sems dpar gyur pa/ 'di ltar dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris nasa'aphos te/ yum gyi lhumasami'i lus su slo g.yas phyogs su brten te bzhugs so/ /zhes bgyi ba 'di ni rab tu'ang ngo mtshar che ste/ bcom ldan 'das/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyis de ltar mdzad do zhes de skad du smra bar ni bdag la spro ba ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod byang chub sems dpa'i yongasasu spyad pa rin po che bkod pa zhes bya ba gang byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum na gnas pa'i yongs su spyad par gyur pa mthong bar 'dod dam/ gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'dasade'i dus ni da lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de'i dus ni da lags te/ de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su spyad pa de bstan te mthong na glo ba dga'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam pa de lta bu'i mtshan ma mdzad de/ ༷sa mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa tshangs
pa 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad dang lhan cig tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nasami snang bar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'dasakyi spyan sngar phyin nas/ des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabasal mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byasanasathal mo sbyar te/bcom ldan 'das la 'dud cing phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen bzhin du mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa la bka' stsal pa/ tshangs pa khyod kyis sngon nga byang chub sems dpar gyur cing ma'i rum na zla ba bcur 'dug 'dug pa'i byang chub semasadapa'i yongasasu spyad pa blangs sam/ gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'dasade de lta lagaphuso/ /bde bar gshegasapa de de lta laga'(so/ /bka' stsal pa/ tshangasapa da de ga la yod ston cig gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'dasade ni tshangasapa'i 'jig rten na mchisso/ |bka' stsal pa/ tshangasapa de'i phyir zla ba bcu pa'i byang chub semasadapa'i yongasasu spyad pa de 'dir khyod kyisaston cig dang / ji tsam du 'dusabyasapa shesapar 'gyur ro/ /de nasami mjed kyi bdag po tshangasapas/ tshangasapa dag la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /kho bosabyang chub sems dpa'i yongs su sbyad pa rin po che bkod pa de blang gisade'i bar du khyed 'khod cig de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangasapa bcom ldan 'dasakyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas mi snang bar gyur nas skad cig de nyid la tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du phyin to/ /de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas lha'i bu tshangs pa bzang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po khyod song la tshangs pa'i 'jig rten 'di man chad sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas yan chad du sgra phyugs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su spyad pa rin po che bkod pa bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar bkur na khyed kyi nang nas mthong bar su dga' ba myur du shog cig ces sgras go bar gyis shig de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangasapas/ lha bye ba khrag 37
khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang lhan cig tu byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su spyad pa rin po che bkod pa blangasate/ tshangasapa'i gzhal med khang chen po dpag tshad sum brgya pa'i steng du bzhag nas/ lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas kun nas bskor te/'dzam bu'i gling du phab bo/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs 'bring du 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i bu 'dusapa chen por gyur te/ byang chub semasadapa'i yongasasu spyad pa rin po che bkod pa de yang lha'i gos dang / lha'i phreng ba dang / lha'i spos dang / lha'i me tog dang / lha'i rol molidabyangs sgra dang / lha'i longs spyod rnams kyis mngon par 'dus byas par gyur cing lha dbang che bar grags pa dag gis yongs su bskor bar gyur pa ni 'di tsam ste/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin rgya mtsho chen polidabus su 'dug nas rgyang ring po nas gdong thal mos bskyabs te mgo byol nas bltas kyang mthong bar mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha'i nang na tshangasapa dag ni mthu che ba ste/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha dag kyang de dag gi drung na dma' ba yin na/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin lta smos kyang ci dgos/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe/ lha'i rol mo dbyangs sgra'i sgra de dag zhi bar mdzad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de thos pa tsam gyisa'adzam bu'i gling gi mi rnamasamyo phyo por 'grar du 'ong ba'i phyir ro/ /de nasargyal po chen po bzhi lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi drung du lhagasanas 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha'i dbang po byang chub semasadapa'i yongasasu spyad pa rin po che bkod pa 'di bdag cag gis mthong bar mi nus na ji ltar bgyi/ des de dag la smrasapa/ grogspo dag kho bos kyang ji ltar bya/ kho bo nyid kyis kyang mthong bar mi nus so/ /grogs po dag 'on kyang de ni nam bcom ldan 'das ༈ stan sngar phul ba de'i tshe mthong grang ngo / /de
dag gis smras pa/ lha'i dbang po de bas na ci nas kyang myur du mthong bar 'gyur ba de ltar mdzad du gsol/ smrasapa/ grogasapo dag lha'i bu mngon par 'phagasapa mngon par 'phagasapa de dag bcom ldan 'dasakyi spyan sngar phyin te/ dga' bar bya ba'i tshig brjod par gyur gyi bar du sdod cig de nas de dag phyogs gcig tu 'khod de mgo byol nas bcom ldan 'dasalogasasu lta zhing 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi po de dag dang lhan cig tu byang chub semasadapa'i yongs su spyad par bya ba rin po che bkod pa de khyer te/ de bzhin gshegs pa ga la ba der phul lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yongasasu spyad pa rin po che bkod pa de ni gzugasabazang ba mdzesapa lta na sdug pa khu/ bzhi lham pa/ ka ba bzhi zug pa/ steng khang pa brtsegs pas legs par brgyan pa ste/de'i tshad ni 'phang du 'di lta ste/ dper na byisapa btsasanasazla ba drug lon pa tsam mo/ /khang pa brtsegasapa/ de'i nang du khri bshams pa ni 'di lta ste dper na byisapa btsas nas zla ba drug lon pa 'dug pa'i stegs bu tsam mo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su spyad par bya ba rin po che bkod pa de'i kha dog dang dbyibs ni 'di lta bu ste/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na de'i dbyibasadang kha dog 'dra ba gang yang med do/ /lha rnams kyis de mthong na yang mig 'phrugasashing ngo mtshar du 'gyur ro/ /de de bzhin gshegasapa'i spyan sngar bzhag na lham me/ lhan ne+e/ lhang nge ste/ dper na mgar ba mkhas pas shin tu bzhu ste/ legs par sbyangs nas/ dri ma'i skyon med par byas pa'i gser bzhin du khang pa brtsegs pa de rnam par mdzes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yongasasu spyad pa de'i nang du khri bshamasapa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i dung mgrin ma gtogs pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na de'i dbyibs dang / kha dog 'dra ba gang 39
yang med do/ /tshangs pa chen pos gos bgos pa de yang byang chub sems dpa'i khri de'i drung na mdzes par mi snang ste/ 'di lta ste dper na/ rlung dang char gyis btab pa'i lwa ba nag po bzhin no/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de ni tsan dan sprul gyi snying po las byas pa ste/de'i phye ma zho gcig la'ang stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyis rin du mi chog go /khang pa brtsegs pa de ni tsan dan sprul gyi snying po de lta bus kun nas bskor ba lta/ khang pa brtsegs pa de dang 'dra ba gnyis pa gcig kyang khang pa brtsegs pa dang po de'i nang na ma chags ma reg par 'dug go /khang pa brtsegs pa de kho na dang 'dra ba gsum pa gcig kyang khang pa brtsegs pa gnyis pa de'i nang na ma reg ma chags par 'dug go /spos kyi khang pa brtsegs pa gsum pa de'i nang du khri de bzhag ste gdan bting ngo / /tsan dan sprul gyi snying po de'i kha dog ni rnam pa 'di lta bu ste/ dper na be+eḍūr+ya sngon po rigasadam pa dang ldan pa bzhin no/ /spos kyi khang pa brtsegs pa de'i 'khor na me tog lha'i las 'das pa gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang ma bskyed par byang chub sems dpa'i sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rnam par smin pas khang pa brtsegs pa der skye'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su spyad pa/ rin po che bkod pa de ni rdo rje'i rang bzhin te/ sra zhing brtan la mi shigasapa ste/ ka tsa yin da'i gos ltar reg na bde ba'o/ /'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyi gnas bkod pa gang ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su spyad pa rin po che bkod pa der kun tu snang ngo / /gang gi nub mo byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum du 'jug pa de yi nub mo 'og gi chu'i phung po nas bzung ste/ sa chen poyirngamasadapag tshad 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad brtol te pad ma byung bas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du mngon par 'phaX so/ /pad ma de ni kha lo sgyur ba skyes bu'i
dam pa dang / tshangs pa chen po brgya phrag bcu'i stobs la dbang bas mthong du zad kyi gzhan sus kyang mthong ba med do/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams 'di na snying khu dang / snying po dang / bcud ji snyed yod pa de dag thamasacad pad ma chen po de la ril dngar gyi thigs par chags te/ 'dug nas de tshangs pa chen pos be+eḍūr+ya'i snod bzang pos blangs shing byang chub sems dpa' la phul nas byang chub sems dpas kyang de blangs te tshangasapa chen po la snying brtse ba'i phyir 'thungasapar gyur to/ /snying khu'i thigs pa de 'thungs na byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa ma gtogs par de yang dag par bde bar zhu bar nus pa sems can gyi khams na sems can de lta bu de gang yang med do/ /ladragagang gi rnam par smin pa'altasnying khu'i thigs pa de lta bu byang chub semadragadapa' la yod par gyur ce na/ byang chub semasadapas sngon yun ring por byang chub semasadapa'i spyod pa spyad pa'i tshe/ sems can nad pa dag la sman byin pa dang / sems can bsam pa la rten pa rnams kyi bsam pa yongs su bskang ba dang / skyabs su 'ongs pa rnams yongs su ma btang ba dang / rtag par me tog gi phud dang / 'brasabu'i phud dang / roliphud de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnams dang / pha dang ma la phul zhing phyis bdag nyid yongs su spyod spyod pas las de'i rnam par smin pas tshangs pa chen po ril dngar gyi thigs pa de byang chub semasadapa' la 'bul lo/ /khang pa brtsegs pa der gnas kyi khyad par dga' ba dang / rtsed mo dang / phreng ba brgyus pa dang ldan pa 'phags pa 'phags pa ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa'i sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas der byung bar snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su spyad pa rin po che 41
bkod pa der gosastong phrag brgya'i rgyan cesabya ba phrugs shig byung ste/ de'i byung ba ni byang chub semasadapa' srid pa tha ma pa ma gtogasapar semasacan gyi risan semasacan de lta bu de gang yang med do/ /gzugasadang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg mchog tu bya ba dam pa gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thamasacad kyang khang pa brtsegasapa de ni med pa gang yang med do/ /yongs su spyad par bya ba khang pa brtsegasapa de ni 'di ltar phyi nang shin tu yongs su grub pa/ 'di ltar shin tu yongasasu rdzogs pa ste/ 'di lta ste dper na/yul ka ming ka nasabyung ba'i dar ltar reg na bde ba'o/ /de yang 'ol byir bstan par zad kyi/ de la dpe med do/ /byang chub semasadapa'i sngon gyi smon lam gyisa'adi ni bsamasapasa'agrub ste/ gdon mi za bar byang chub semsdpa' semasadapa' chen po mi'i 'jig rten du skye ba dang / mngon par byung nasabla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / ma gang gi rum du skye bar 'gyur ba de'i rum g.yasapar khang pa brtsegs pa rin po che bkod pa dam pa sngar mngon par 'grub cing / phyis byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'phos te khang pa brtsegs pa der skyil krung bcasanas 'dug par 'byung ba dang / byang chub semasadapa' srid pa tha ma pa'i lus nur nur po dang / mer mer po dang / ltar ltar po dang / reng reng por 'gyur ba med cing /yan lag dang / nying lag dang / mtshan thams cad phun sum tshogasapar 'dug bzhin du 'byung la/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul gyi rmi lam du glang po chen po 'ongs par mthong ba 'di ni chos nyid do/ /de de ltar 'dug pa la lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / gang las lag na rdo rje skyes pa'i gnod sbyin gyi rigs gsang ba pa zhes bya ba de dag byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum du 42
zhugs par shes nas rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par phyi bzhin 'brang bar gyur to/ /byang chub semasadapa' la rim gro byed pa'i lha mo bzhi yod de/ u khu li zhesabya ba dang / mu khu li zhesabya ba dang / rgyal mtshan ldan pa zhesabya ba dang / 'od dang ldan pa zhesabya ba ste/ bzhi po de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum du zhugs par shes nas rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par srung ngo / /lha'i ngabang po brgya pyin yang lha'i bu lnga brgya tsam dang lhan cig byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum du zhugs pa shes nas/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par phyi bzhin 'brang bar gyur to/ /byang chub semasadapa' ma'i rum du zhugasapa'i lusani rnam pa 'di lta bur gyur te/dper na mtshan mo mun pa shin tu gnag pa'i nang na ri'i spo la me'i phung po chen po 'dug pa ni dpag tshad gcig nas kyang snang ngo / /dpag tshad lnga'i bar nas kyang snang ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum du zhugs pa'i lus mngon par grub pa yang de lta bur gyur te/ 'od gsal zhing gzugs bzang la mdzesashing lta na sdug par gyur pa de/khang pa brtsegs pa de'i nang du skyil mo krung du 'dug na gser gyi sa le sbram rigs dang ldan pa rin po che be+eḍūr+yas brgyan pa ltar shin tu mdzes par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rum na 'dug pa mthong bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na sprin gyi tshogs chen po'i nang nas glog byung ba ni snang ba chen po skyed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub semasadapa' ma'i rum na 'dug pa yang dpal dang / gzi brdzid dang /kha dog gisanye bar rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa dang po de snang bar byed do/ /snang bar byas nas spos kyi khang pa brtsegs pa gnyis pa snang bar byed do/ /spos kyi khang pa brtsegs pa gnyis pa snang bar byas nas/ spos kyi khang pa brtsegadragapa gsum pa snang bar byed do/ /spos kyi khang pa brtsegs pa gsu/ 3pa snang bar byas nas ma'i lus thams cad
snang bar byed do/ /de snang bar byasanas de stan gang la 'dug pa de snang bar byed do/ /de snang bar byas nas khyim thams cad snang bar byed do/ /khyim thams cad snang bar byas nasa'od 'phro ba khyim gyi steng du byung ste/ shar phyogasasnang bar byed do/ /de bzhin du lho phyogasadang / nub phyogasadang / byang phyogasadang / 'og dang / steng dang / phyogasabacu kun tu rgyang grags tsam du phyogasare rer yang byang chub semasadapa' ma'i rum na 'dug pa'i dpal dang gzi brjid dang kha dog gisasnang bar byasapar gyur to/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub semasadapa' de blta ba dang / de la phyag bya ba dang /bsnyen bkur bya ba dang chosamanyan pa'i phyir rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad gnod sbyin lnga brgya tsam dag dang lhan cig tu snga dro'i dusakyi tshe 'ongs te/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpas de dag 'ongs par rig nas lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste mdzub mo bsgreng nas stan ston to/ /'jig rten skyong ba la sogs pa de dag kyang ji ltar bting ba'i stan la 'khod par gyur te/ de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum na 'dug bzhin du/ skyes zin pa'i gzugs dang 'dra bar lag pa bskyod cing 'deg la/ rnam par bskyod cing gzhog pa mthong nas/ de dag dga' mgu zhing nyams bde ba thob ste/ byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang de dag de ltar 'khod pa mthong nas/ chos kyi gtam gyisayang dag par ston/yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug yang dag par gzengs stod/ yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /gang gi tshe de dag 'dong bar 'dod par gyur pa de'i tshe'ang / byang chub sems dpas de dag gi sems sems kyis rnam par shes nas lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste de dag 'dong ba'i brda ston to/ /de ltar lag pa brkyang ste/ 'dong ba'i brda bstan nas/phyir skum par byed de/ ma la gnod pa med do/ /de'i tshe rgyal po chen po bzhi dag kyang 'di 44
snyam du bdag cag ni byang chub sems dpas kyang 'dong bar gnang ngo snyam sems shing /de dag byang chub semasadapa' dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ma la lan gsum bskor ba byas nasa'adong bar gyur to/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' nub mo mi nyal nas lag pa g.yas pa brkyang zhing brkyangs nas kyang bskum pa dang / bskums nas kyang dran zhing shes bzhin du lag pa de 'jog pa'i rgyu ni de yin no/ /rkyen ni de yin no/ /gzhan yang gang gi tshe skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ khye'u'am/ bu mo su yang rung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa de'i tshe/ thog mar ni byang chub sems dpa' dga' bar bya ba smra'o/ /de'i 'og tu byang chub sems dpa'i ma dga' bar bya ba smra'o/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum na 'dug pa'i tshe/ sngar dga' bar bya ba smra ba la mkhas par gyur te/lha'am/ klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ mi'am/ mi ma yin pa su yang rung byang chub sems dpa' la sngon du dga' bar bya ba'i tshig smra bar nusapa med do/ /byang chub semasadapa' nyid thog mar dga' bar bya ba smra zhing de'i 'og tu byang chub sems dpa'i ma dga' bar bya ba smra'o/ /de nas snga dro4dus zad de/ nyi ma gung la bab nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i bu mngon par 'phags pa/mngon par 'phags pa dag byang chub sems dpa' blta ba dang / de la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'ong ba dang / byang chub sems dpas de dag rgyang ring po nas 'ongs pa mthong nas/ gser gyi mdog tu 'dug pa'i lag pa g.yos pa brkyang ste/lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha dag dga' bar byed cing mdzub mo brkyang ste/ stan ston to/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe'ang lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' la phyir bzlog ma nus nas ji ltar bting ba'i stan de dag la lha'i 45
