dbang po brgya byin dang / de ma yin pa'i lha'i bu gzhan dag kyang 'khod par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas de ltar 'khod par rig nas chos kyi gtam gyis yang dag par ston/yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug yang dag par gzengs stod/ yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpas lag pa gang du brkyang ba de logs su byang chub sems dpa'i ma yang lta bar gyurato/ /desan lha de dag kyang 'di snyam du bdag cag ni byang chub sems dpa' dang dga' bar bya ba smra'o snyam mo/ /de dag re re zhing yang 'di snyam du byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag 'ba' zhig la smra ste/ bdag 'ba' zhig la dga' bar bya ba smra'o snyam mo/ /khang pa brtsegs pa der lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha de dag gi gzugasabarnyan snang bar gyur to/ /ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum na gnas pa'i longs spyod yongs su dag par gyur pa de lta bu ni gzhan dag na med do/ /dge slong dag gang gi tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / de ma yin pa'i lha'i bu gzhan dag 'dong bar 'dod par gyur pa de'i tshe'ang byang chub sems dpasade dag gi sems kyi rtog pa sems kyisayongasasu shes nas/lag pa g.yasapa brkyang ste de dag 'dong ba'i brda ston to/ /brda bstan nas phyir bskum pa byas te/ dran zhing shes bzhin du lag pa bzhag kyang ma la gnod pa med do/ /de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / de ma yin pa'i lha'i bu sum cu rtsa gsum pa dag kyang 'di snyam du bdag cag ni byang chub semasadapas kyang 'dod par gnang ngo snyam du semasashing /de dag kyang byang chub semasadapa' dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ma la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas dong bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag nyi ma phyed kyi dus 'das nas phyi dro3dus la bab pa dang / mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangasapa lha'i bu brgya stong du masayongasasu bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ lha yul ba'i snying khu'i thigs pa de khyer nas byang chub sems 46
dpa' ga la ba der/ byang chub sems dpa' de blta ba dang / de la phyag bya ba dang /bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / chosamanyan pa'i phyir 'ong bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag byang chub sems dpas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa 'khor dang bcas te 'ongs par shes nas/byang chub sems dpas yang gser gyi mdog tu 'dug pa'i lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste/mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu de dag la dga' bar bya ba smrasate/ mdzub mo brkyang nasastan ston to/ /dge slong dag mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa des kyang byang chub sems dpa'i bka' las bzlog par ma nus nas/ ji ltar bting ba'i stan de dag la mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu gzhan dag kyang 'khod par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas de ltar 'khod par rig nas chos kyi gtam gyis yang dag par ston/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug yang dag par gzengs stod/ yang dag par dga' bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpas lag pa gang du brkyang ba de logs su lha mo sgyu 'phrul yang lta bar gyur to/ /de ltar na lha de dag kyang bdag cag ni byang chub sems dpa' dang dga' bar bya ba'i gtam byed do snyam ste lha'i bu de dag re re zhing yang 'di snyam du byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag 'ba' zhig la smras te/ bdag 'ba' zhig la dga' ba'i gtam byed do snyam mo/ /dge slong dag gang gi tshe mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / tshangasaris kyi lha'i bu de dag 'dong bar 'dod par gyur pa de'i tshe yang byang chub sems dpas de dag gi sems kyi rtog pa sems kyidrag81ngas su shedrananas lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste/ de dag 'dong ba'i brda ston to/ /de ltar 'dong ba'i brda bstan nas phyir bskum pa byas te/ dran zhing shes bzhin du lag pa bzhag kyang ma la gnod pa med do/ /de'i tshe mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / tshangs ris kyi lha de dag kyang 'di snyam du 47
bdag cag ni byang chub sems dpas kyang 'dong bar gnang ngo snyam du sems shing de dag byang chub sems dpa' dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ma la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas 'dong bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' yang dran zhing shes bzhin du lag pa 'jog par gyur te/ dge slong dag shar phyogs dang / lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang /byang phyogs dang / 'og dang / steng dang / phyogs bcu kun nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' brgya stong mang po byang chub sems dpa' de blta ba dang / de la phyag bya ba dang /bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / chos mnyan pa dang / chos yang dag par brjod par bya ba'i phyir 'ong bar gyur to/ /de dag de ltar 'ongs pa dang / byang chub sems dpas lus las 'od bkye ste/ 'od kyi bkod pa de dag seng ge'i khrir sprul nas/ de ltar sprul pa'i khri de dag la byang chub sems dpa' de dag 'khod du bcug ste/ de dag de ltar 'khod par shes nas 'di lta ste theg pa chen po 'di nyid rgya cher rnam par dbye ba'i don du dris te brtags kyang skal ba mnyam pa'i lha rnams ma gtogs par gzhan sus kyang de dag ma mthong ste/dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpas nub mo mi nyal nas lus las 'od bkye ba'i rgyu ni de yin no/ /rkyen ni de yin no/ /dge slong dag lha mo sgyu 'phrul gyis kyang byang chub semasadapa' ma'i rum na 'dug pa'i tshe/ lusalci bar ma tshor te/ gzhan du na yang ba dang /'jam pa dang / bde bar tshor zhing lto mi bde ba'i sdug bsngal gang yang myong bar ma gyur to / —/'dod chags kyis yongs su gdung ba'am/ zhe sdang gis yongs su gdung ba'am/gti mug gis yongs su gdung bas kyang yongs su gdung bar ma gyur/ 'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa'am/ gnod sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'am/ gtse ba'i rnam par rtog pa dag la yang rnam par rtog par ma gyur te/ grang ba'am/ tsha ba'am/ bkres pa'am/ skom pa'am/ mun pa'am/ rdul lam/ ngal ba tshor ba'am/ mthong bar ma gyur te/ de la 48
gzugasadang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg yid du mi 'ong ba snang bar ma gyur to/ /rmi lam ngan pa yang mthong bar ma gyur to/ /de la bud med kyi sgyu'am/ g.yo'am/ phrag dog gam/ bud med kyi nyon mongasapa dag kyang nyamasasu gnod par byed par ma gyur to/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i ma ni bslab pa'i gzhi lnga yang dag par blangs te/ tshul khrims dang ldan zhid dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la gnas par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ma yang skyes pa gang la yang 'dod chagasakyi semasaskye bar ma gyur la/ skyesapa gang yang byang chub sems dpa'i ma la 'dod chags kyi semasami skye'o/ /ser skya'i grong khyer chen po de dang / yul gzhan dag na skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo su gang lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / 'byung pos non pa ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa'i ma mthong ma thag tu sos shing dran pa thob par gyur to/ /mi ma yin pa de dag kyang myur du gnas gzhan du 'dong bar gyur to/ /semasacan gang la la zhig nad sna tshogs kyisathebs par gyur te/ rlung dang / mkhris pa dang / bad dzin dang / 'dus pa las byung ba'i nad kyis gnod par gyur pa dang / mig gi nad dam/ rna ba'i nad dam/ sna'i nad dam/ lce'i nad dam/ mchu'i nad dam/ solind dam/ lkog ma'i nad dam/ shu ba'am/ 'bras sam/mje'am/ sha bkra'am/ skem pa'am/ brjed byed dam/ rims sam/ lnga ba'am/ phol mig gam/ me dbal lam/ rkang shu la sogs pa'i nad kyisabatab par gyur pa de dag la byang chub sems dpa'i mas/ lag pa g.yadragapa spyi bor bzhag pa tsam gyis nad dang bral bar gyur cing / rang rang gi gnas su 'dong bar gyur to/ /tha na lha mo sgyu 'phrul gyis rtswa nyag ma 'ga' zhig bzhaladragablangadragate sems can nad pa dag la byin yang de dag de blangs ma thag tu nad med cing nyams pa med par gyur to/ /gang gi tshe lha mo sgyu 'phrul des 49
bdag gi lto g.yaphupar bltas pa de'i tshe/ byang chub semaphudapa' ma'i rum na 'dug pa de 'di lta ste dper na me long gi dkyil 'khor shin tu dag pa la gdong gi dkyil 'khor snang ba bzhin te/ de ltar de mthong nasathim zhing mgu la yi rangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes par gyur to/ /dge slong dag byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum na gnas pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ nyin mtshan rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par lha'i rol mo sil snyan gyi sgra 'byung zhing lha'i me tog gi char 'bab par gyur to/ /char ni dus bzhin du 'bab/ rlung ni dus bzhin du ldang / dus dang skar ma dag kyang dus bzhin du pa༈ ༵ k+ham̐ ༵ ༷ r+nghi ༵ twā gyur to/ /rgyal srid kyang bde zhing lo legs la 'brug pa med cing ser skya'i grong khyer chen po de na shākya'i rigasadang / semasacan gzhan dag 'khod pa thamasacad kyang za zhing 'thung / dga' zhing rtse la dga' mgur spyod do/ /sbyin pa dag kyang gtong / bsod nams dag kyang byed de/ zla ba bzhi 'das pa'i dus ston bzhin du thamasacad kyang dga' ba'i mchog gisartse zhing bde bar gnasapasaganas par gyur to/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ma yang tshangs pa'i spyod pa yang dag par blangs te/ rgyal po'ilas btang nas dka' thub kyi nags tshal yongs su dag pa na gnas pa bzhin du thams cad kyang dga' ba'i mchog gisachosakyi rjes su 'brang bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag byang chub sems dpa' ma'i rum na gnas pa ni rnam pa de lta bu'i mu'aphrul gyi cho 'phrul dang ldan pasaganasapar gyurato/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su spyad pa rin po che bkod pa sngon byang chub semasadapa' ma'i rum na gnasaX tshe gnasaganasapa mthong ngam/ gsol ba/
bcom ldan 'dasamathong lagasaso/ /bde bar gshegs pa mthong lags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / lha'i dbang po brgya pyin dang / 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang / de ma yin pa'i lha dang / mi gzhan dag kyang bstan te mthong nas/de dag tshim zhing mgu la yi rangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes so/ /mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas de'i phyir yang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du mchod par bya ba'i phyir bteg ste khyer nas bzhag par gyur to/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis yang dge slong dag la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de ltar byang chub semasadapa' ma'i rum na 'dug pas lha dang mi khrag khrig phrag sum cu rtsa drug theg pa gsum la yongasasu smin par byasapar gyur to/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gang tshe rgyal sras sems can dam pa ma yi rum gnas pa/ /de tshe sa 'di tshal dang bcasapar rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ /gser mdog 'od bkye ngan song thams cad rnam par sbyangs par gyur/ /chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur zhes lha yi tshogs rnams rab tu dga'/ /gzhal med khang chen dbyibs legs rin chen du mas rnam par spras/ /der ni dpa' bo rnam par 'dren pa zhugasapar gyur nas 'dug /tsan dan dri zhim mchog gis rab tu gang zhing rnam par mdzes/ /stong gsum rin chen yongs bkang de yi srang phyed rin mi chog /stong chen 'jig rten khamasakyang 'og nas brtol ba byas nas ni/ /yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas kyi pad ma'i snying khu'i thigs pa byung / /de bzhin zhag bdun bsod nams gzi brjid tshangs pa'i 'jig rten 'phags/ /de las snying khu'i thigs blangs tshangs pa rgyal ba'i srasal 'bul/ /byang chub semasadapa' dpa' bo tshangasapa 'dra ba ma gtogasapar/ /sems can gang gis de zos 'jur 'gyur sems can ris na med/ /bskal pa du rma/'i bsod nams gzi brdzid snying khu'i thigs gnasapa/ /de zos lus dang sems dang shes 51
pa rnam par dag par gyur/ /'dren pa mchod phyir brgya byin tshangs pa 'jig rten skyong ba rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa'i drung du rtag par dus gsum rgyun tu 'ong / /phyag byas mchod byas chos kyi dam pa de dag thos gyur nas/ /bskor ba byas te kun kyang gang nas 'ongs pa'i gnas su 'dong / /'jig rten khams rnams kun nas chos 'dod byang chub sems dpa' 'ong / /'od bkod khrir gyur rnams la de dag gnas par phan tshun snang / /mchog tu bya ba'i theg pa dam pa'i chos ni thos gyur nas/ /kun kyang dga' ba'i sems gyur bstod pa'i phreng ba brjod cing 'dong / /bud med byis pa gang dag sdug bsngal ldan par gyur pa dang / /'byung pos non dang sems 'khrugs gos med rdul gyis yog pa rnams/ /de kun lha mo sgyu 'phrul mthong nas sems ni rnyed gyur te/ /blo gros rtogs dang dran dang ldan zhing so sorikhyim khyim 'dong / /rlung dang bad dzin mkhris pa'i nad dang 'dus pa'i nad thebs dang / /mig nad rna nad dag gis lus sems mi bder gyur pa dag /rnam mang tha dad nad kyi rnam pas gang dag gnod gyur pa/ /de dag sgyu 'phrul lag pa mdzasha la bzhag pas nad med gyur/ /yang na rtswa yi nyag ma 'ga' zhig sa las blangs byas te/ /sgyu 'phrul nad pa byin na thams cad rims nad med par gyur/ /bde ba thob cing da rod ma nyams so so'ikhyim du 'dong / /de ni sman gyur sman pa'i rgyal po rum na 'dug phyir ro/ /gang tshe lha mo sgyu 'phrul bdag gi lusal brtag byasapa/ /de tshe byang chub sems dpa' rum na 'dug pa mthong ba ni/ /ji ltar bar snang gnas kyi zla ba skar mas bskor gnasapa/ /de bzhin byang chub semasadapa' mtshan gyiphukun nasabargyan pa snang / /de la 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gnod par 'gyur ba med/ /'dod la 'dod pa de med de la phrag dog 'tshe ba med/ /dga' ba'i sems dang mgu ba'i sems dang dga' dang yid bder gnas/ /de la bkresadang skom dang tsha dang grang ba'i gnod pa med/ /lha 52
'dulaba'i sdesnod lasab6yopa'i dge sbyong masog kyirnamatharasnor/yi rol mo sil snyan dbyangs sgra ma byas rtag tu 'byung / /lha yi spos dri me tog dam pa mchog mdzesachar yang 'bab/ /lha dang mi rnamasade la lta zhing lha mi thams cad kyang / /de dag phan tshun gnod pa med cing 'tshe ba gang yang med/ /sems can dga' bder rtse zhing zasadang skom gyi sbyin pa byed/ /dga' ba'i sgra sgrog de dag dga' zhing mgu ba'i yid dang ldan/ /rgyal po〉srid bde 'khrug pa med cing char pa dus bzhin 'bab/ /rtswa dang sman dang metog rnamasakyang de yi dusasu skye/ /rgyal polikhab tu zhag bdun rin chen char pa bab gyur pas/ /sems can dbul po de las len cing sbyin byed bde bar spyod/ /sems can dbul zhing sdug bsngal gyur pa de tshe gang yang med/ /ri rab zom gyi dga' tshal semasacan bzhin du dga' dang ldan/ shākya'i rgyal po de yang gso sbyong rab la nyer gnas shing / /de ni rgyal polibya ba mi byed chos la rtag par spyod/ /de ni dka' thub nags tshal song naphulha mo sgyu 'phrul la/ /sems can mchog srel khyod kyi lus la bde ba ci 'dra rmed/ /lhumasasu 'jug pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o/ /dge slong dag de ltar zla ba bcu 'dasate/ byang chub semasadapa' btsa' ba'i dusla bab pa dang / rgyal po zasagatsang ma'i skyed mos tshal du snga ltasasum cu rtsa gnyisabyung ngo / /sum rtsartsa gnyisagang zhe na/ me tog thamasacad kha 'buphunasargyasapar gyur pa dang /rdzing dag na me togayud pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang / pad ma dkar po yod pa dag kyang kha 'bus nas rgyas par gyur pa dang / me tog dang 'bras bu'i shing ljon pa gsar pa dag kyang sa las 'thon te kha 'bus nas rgyas par gyur pa dang / rin po che'i shing ldon pa brgyad byung ba dang / gter chen po nyi khri 'bus te byung nas gnas par snang ba dang / khyim gyi nang du yang rin po che'i myu gu 'thon pa dang spos chu'i dpal gyi wa 'bru mar dri zhim pos sbags pa rnams kyang zag par gyur pa dang / gangs kyi ri'i ngos las 53
seng ge'i 〈khu dag 'ongasate/ dga' bar rtse zhing ser skya'i grong khyer dam pa la bskor ba byasanasasgo na gnasapar gyur kyang semasacan gang la yang 'tshe ba med par gyur pa dang /glang po〉phru gu thal dar lnga brgya lhags te/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i rkang pa la sna'i rtse mosanyug cing gnas par gyur pa dang / lha'i byisapa rogasapa ska ragasabacingasapa dag kyang rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i btsun moli'akhor gyi pang pa nas pang pa dag tu 'gre ldog par snang bar gyur pa dang / klu'i bu mo mchod pa sna tshogs kyi yo byad thogs pa dag kyang lusaphyed phyung zhing nam mkha' la rgyu bar snang ba dang / lha'i bu mo khri yang rma bya'i mdongs lag na thogs shing nam mkha' la 'khod par snang ba dang / bum pa gang ba khri yang ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po la skor ba byed par snang ba dang / lha'i bu mo khri yang sposchu'i ril ba bring ga ra slad la thogs shing 'khod par snang ba dang / lha'i bu mo khri yang gdugasadang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan thogasashing 'khod par snang ba dang / lha'i bu mo brgya stong mang po dag kyang dung dang / rnga dang / dzornga dang / mkhar rnga mgul nasaspyangs te sdod cing 'khod par snang ba dang / rlung thams cad kyang mi ldang par gnas par gyur pa dang / chu klung dang chu bran thamasacad kyang mi 'gul zhing mi 'bab par gyur pa dang / nyi zla dang / gzhal med khang dang / rgyu skar dang / skar ma'i tshogs rnams kyang mi rgyu bar gyur pa dang / skar ma rgyal dang yang ldan par gyur pa dang / rgyal po zasagatsang ma'i khyim yang rin po che'i dra bas yog par gyur pa dang / me yang mi 'bar bar gyur pa dang / khang pa brtsegasapa dang / khang bzang dang / yang thog dang / rta babasadag la'ang nor bu dang /rin po che dag 'phyang bar snang bar gyur pa dang / rasabacos bu'i mdzod dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi mdzod rnams kyang sgo bye bar snang ba dang / bya rog dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rgod dang / spyang zhi dang / wa'i sgra dag kyang med par gyur pa dang / sgra skad snyan pa'i sgra 54
dag kyang 'byung bar gyur pa dang / skye bo thamasacad kyi lasakyi mtha' 'ang rgyun chad par gyur pa dang / sa'i phyogs mthon dman du 'dug pa rnams kyang mnyam par gnas par gyur pa dang / lam gyi bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dang / srang dang / tshong 'dusakyi 'khor kyang lag mthil ltar gzhi mnyam zhid 'jam la me rtag sil masagang ste mdzes par snang ba dang / sprum pa thamasacad kyang bde ba dang / legasapar btsa' bar gyur pa dang / shing swa la'i nags tshal gyi lha thamasacad kyang shing gi lo ma'i nang nasalusaphyed phyung ste/ phyag 'tshal zhing gnasapar snang ba ste/ snga ltasasum cu rtsa gnyisapo de dag byung bar gyur to/ /de nas lha mo sgyu 'phrul byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyi gzi brdzid dang mthus byang chub sems dpa' btsa' ba'i dus la bab par shes te/ nam gyi sgod la rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i drung du 'ongs nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bdag gi bsam pa gang lags gsol gyis lha ni gsan du gsol/ /yun ring ring po 'dasanas skyed mos tshal gyi blo skyes te/ /gal te khyod mi bkyon cing zhe snang phrag dog mi mnga' na/ /bdag ni rtse nas skyed mos tshal du myur du mchi bar bgyi/ /chos dgongs brtson pa dka' thub spyod pas khyod kyang skyon mkhyen grang / /bdag kyang sems can dag pa bsrel nas yun ni ring lags la/ /swa la'i shing ldon sdong po mchog kyang me tog kha 'busate/ /skyed mos tshal gyi dog sar da ni mchi ba'i rigs so lha/ /sos spu'i dus mchog bud med rnams kyi rgyan du gyur lagasate/ /nags rgyu khu byug dang ni rma bya sgra rab snyan pa 'byin/ /gtsang zhing mdzesla sna tshogs me tog rdul gyi ngad kyang ldang / /da ni mchi na ma thogs legs par bka' lung stsal du gsol/ /rgyal polidabang posalha mo las ni de skad tshig thos nas/ /dga' zhing rab tu mgu ba'i sems kyis 'khor la smras pa ni/ /bzhon pa bzhon che mgyogasapa'i shugs ldan dag kyang bstad par gyis/ /yon tan phun sum tshogs ldan lum bi ni tshal 55
brgyan par gyis/ /ri sngo'i mdog ldan sprin gyi kha dog mthun par gyur pa yi/ /glang po stong phrag nyi shu snyed cig myur du bstad par gyis/ /glang polidabang po mche ba drug ldan dril mdzesaglo labargyus/ /gser dang nor busarnam par sprasashingagaser gyi drabs1da/ /rgyal polibacibs pa rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i shugasadang ldan pa ste/ /dngul dang kha ba'i mdog 'dra rnga rngog lcang lo bzang 'khril ba'i/ /rta mchog stong phrag nyi shu bgrangs pa myur du stod gyis te/ /gser dril g.yer kā'i dra ba slo nas spyang ba gyis/ /skyes bu rtul phod g.yul la mosashing 'thab 'dod dpa' bo dag /mda' gzhu ral gri mdung thung zhagasapa mtshon cha rno thogs pa/ /stong phrag nyi shu bgrangs pa myur du chos te bsham gyis la/ /sgyu 'phrul 'khor dang bcas pa bag yod par ni bsrung bar gyis/ /lum bi ni der gser dang nor bu'i rgyan khrom brgyan par gyis/ /gosadamar rnam pa mang posashing rnamasathams cad brgyan par gyis/ /lha yi dga' tshal bzhin du me tog sna tshogasachal par khrom/ /de ltar thamasacad bshamasazin myur du nga la sbran par gyis/ /'khor rnamasakyisani de skad tshig thosaskad cig tu/ /bzhon pa kun bshamasade bzhin lum yi ni yang brgyan byasate/ /rgyal gyur rgyal gyur sku tshe ring skyongs rgyal po gshegasasu gsol/ /ji skad bka' stsal de bzhin kun bgyisadus bab lha gzigs shig /mi yi bdag po dam pa de yang dga' ba'i sems gyur nam/ /khyim gyi dam par zhugs te bud med rnams la 'di skad smras/ /gang zhig nga la snying nye nga la dga' bar 'dod pa dag /nga yi bka' bzhin gyis te bdag gi lusakun brgyan par gyis/ /sbosamachog ngad kyi dri zhim kha dog sna tshogasasdug pa'i gos/ /'jam zhing yid 'ong dga' ba'i sems kyis legs par bgo bar gyis/ /brang na 'phyang ba'i mu tig se mo do yis brgyan par gyis/ /rgyan gyi khyad par thams cad de ring kun gyis bstan par gyis/ /mkhar rnga rgyud gcig gling bu pi wang rdza rnga dum dum pheg /sil 56
snyan yid du 'ong ba brgya stong dag kyang bsham par gyis/ /sgra snyan thosanasalha rnamasarab tu dga' ba skye 'gyur zhing / /lha mo rnamasakyang de bzhin dga' bar 'gyur ba khyed kyis gyis/ ṇ+ṭhang rta'i mchog 'dir lha mo sgyu 'phrul gcig pu 'dug par gyis/ /bud med skyespa gzhan dag su yang shing rta der ma 'khod/ /na chung sna tshogasago can rnamasakyisashing rta de drongs te/ /gang du'ang i da du mi 'ong mi mthun sgra rnams mi grag kyis/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul khyim nas byung ste sgo drung phyin pa'i tshe/ /rta dang glang po shing rta rkang thang dpal ldan sna tshogs dpung / /rgyal polisgo drung lhags tshe sgra chen mang po grag par gyur/ /rgya mtsho chen po 'khrugs pa'i sgra ltar de dag yongs su grag /de tshe bkra shisadon du dril bu brgya stong dkrol bar byas/ /shing rta de yang de ltar rgyal pos sna tshogs brgyan pa la/ /lha rnams stong gis lha yi khri yang legasapar bsham pa byas/ /rin chen shing ldon me tog lo ma ldan bzhin ldan par byas/ /rma bya khrung khrung ngang pa yid du 'ong ba'i sgra yang 'byin/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan che phra kun nasa'akhor bar bsgreng / /lha yi gosadang dril bu g.yer spu'i dra ba mchog gisabakab/ /lha yi bu mo nam mkha' lasani shing rta de la lta/ /lha yi sgra dbyangs snyan pa sgrog cing bstod pa'i tshig brjod de/ /gang tshe lha mo sgyu 'phrul seng ge'i khri la 'dug gyur pa/ /de tshe stong gsum sa'adi rnam pa drug tu rab tu g.yos/ /lha rnamasagosakyi g.yab mo 'byin cing me tog sna tshogs 'thor/ /de ring lum bi ni 'dir 'gro ba'i dam pa bltam gyur te/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhi ni shing rta'i mchog de 'dren par byed/ /sum cu rtsa gsum bdag po dbang po'ang lam gyi byi dor byed/ /tshangasapa skye bo mi srun sel cing sngon du 'gro bar gyur/ /lha rnams brgya phrag stong yang thal mo sbyar bas phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rgyal po rab tu dga' ba'i sems kyis bkod pa de la lta/ /de ni 'di snyam 'di ni lha yi lha zhig yin snyam byed/ /gang la skyong ba bzhi dang tshangs pa dbang 57
por bcaphupa'i lha/ /mchod pa rgya chen byed pa 'di ni ngesapar sangasargyasa'agyur/ /srid pa gsum na lha klu brgya byin tshangs pa 'jig rten skyong / /gang yang mchod pa 'di 'dra bzod pa'i semasacan de med de/ /yang na mgo 'gasayang na de dag phrog dang bral bar 'gyur/ /'di ni lha yi dam pa yin pasamachod pa thams cad bzod/ /dge slong dag de nasalha mo sgyu 'phrul rta'i shing rta rgyan thamasacad kyisabargyan pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gisani kun nas bskor/ grang po che'i shing rta rgyan thamasacad kyisabargyan pa brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / rkang thang dpa' zhing rtul phod pa yan lag dam pa dang ldan pa/ go cha legasapar bgosapa sra ba'i go gyon pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gis ni yongasasu bsrungs/ shākya'i bu mo stong phrag drug khris ni mdun du bdar/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i phu nu'i rigs su skyes pa'i shākya rgan pa dang / gzhon pa dang / bar ma bzhi khrisani yongasasu bsrungs/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i slas glu dang rol molidabyangs sgra ni byed/ khar ba'i sil khrol dang /pheg rdob sil snyan dang / klu dbyangs len pa drug khris ni kun nas bskor/ lha'i bu mo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / klu'i bu mo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / dri za'i bu mo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / mi'am ci'i bu mo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / lha ma yin gyi bu mo brgyad khri bzhi stong bkod pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa sha stag glu dang rol mo'i dbyangs sgra sna tshogasakyis bsngags pa brjod pa/ rjes su 'brang bsa'agro'o/ /lum bi ni'i nags tshal de thams cad kyang spos chu'i chag chag gis btab cing lha'i me tog gis gtor bar gyur to| |nags tshal dam pa de'i nang na shing ldon pa ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang dus la ma bab par lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu skyed par gyur to/ /nags tshal de ni lha rnamasakyisakyang legasapar brgyan par gyur te/ 'di lta ste dper na/ 'dres pa'i tshal lha rnams kyisalegs par brgyan pa bzhin no/ /58
de nas lha mo sgyu 'phrul lum bi ni'i nags tshal du phyin nasashing rta dam pa de lasbabasate/ mi dang lha'i bu mo dag gisayongasasu bskor cing / shing drung nasani shing drung dag tu 'gro/ nagasatshal nasani nags tshal dag tu 'chag ldon pa nas ni ldon pa dag la lta zhing de rim gyisashing rin po che chen po mchog dang phul du bya ba/ yal ga shin tu rnam par 'byes pa/ lo ma dang ོ/ga pa bzang po dang ldan pa/ mi dang lha'i me tog sna tshogs rab tu rgyas pa/ spos mchog dang phul du bya ba'i dri'i ngad dang ldan pa'i gos kha dog sna tshogasaspyangasapa/ nor bu dang rin po che sna tshogasalta bu'i 'od rnam pa tha dad pa 'bar ba/rtsa ba dang / sdong po dang / yal ga dang / lo ma rnams rin po che thamasacad kyisalegs par brgyan pa/ yal ga ring zhing shin tu rnam par 'byes pa/ blag sha zhes bya ba sa'i phyogs lag mthil ltar mnyam zhing shin tu bzang la yangs pa/ rtswasngon po rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bu skyes pa/ ka tsa yin di'i gosaltar reg na bde ba'i phul 'dug pa/ sngon gyi rgyal ba'i yum gyisabarten pa/ lha'i glu dbyangasablangasapa/ gnasagatsang ma'i lha bzang zhing dri ma med la rnam par dag pa rab tu zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams kyis thor tshugaphudang cod pan mngon par btud pa'i sgyi bos mngon par phyag bya ba'i shing ldon pa blag sha de'i drung du phyin to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i gzi brdzid dang mthus shing blag sha des mngon par btud de phyag byas so/ /de nas lha mo sgyu 'phrul nam mkha'i dkyil du snang ba'i glog gi phreng ba lta bu'i lag pa g.yas pa brkyang nas/ blag sha'i yal ga las bzung ste/ tshul du shis par nam mkha'i dkyil du bltas nas bya smyangs byed cing 'dug par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i nang nas lha'i bu mo drug khri lhags te/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul la rim gro dang bkur sti byed par gyur to/ /byang chub semaX )pa' ma'i rum na 'dug pa'i tshe/ rnam pa de
lta bu'i ṭu'aphrul gyi cho 'phrul dang ldan par gnasaso/ /de zla ba bcu tshang nasama'i glo g.yas pa nasadran zhing shesabazhin du mngal gyi dri masam gosapar byung ste/ gzhan ltar ma yin zhing gzhan dag la mngal gyi dri ma zhesabya ba brjod pa de lta bu med par gyur to/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa gnyis mdun na 'khod de/ de gnyisakyis rim gro dam pa chen pos lha'i gosaka shi pa'i sleb mos lus dang yan lag thams cad kyis dran zhing shes bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' blangs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' khang pa brtsegs pa gang gi nang na 'dug cing ma'i rum na gnas gnasapa de yang mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangasapa dang / tshangasarisakyi lha rnams kyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du gyen du bteg ste/ mchod rten du bya ba dang /mchod pa bya ba'i phyir khyer ro/ /de ltar byang chub semasadapa' de ni mir gyur pa gang giskyang ma blangasakyi/ byang chub semasadapa' de ni lha rnamasakyisablangasaso/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' btsas ma thag tu sa la 'bab ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de sal babs par gyur ma thag tu pad ma chen po zhig gisas 'di yang brtol te byung ngo / /klu'i rgyal po chen po dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo gnyisakyang nam mkha'i dkyil na lus phyed phyung ste 'khod nas bsil ba dang / dro ba'i chu'i rgyun gnyis mngon par sprul nasabyang chub sems dpa'i lusabakrusaso/ /brgya byin dang / tshangasapa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba la sogs pa gzhan yang lha'i bu brgya stong mang po dag byang chub sems dpa' btsas ma thag tu spos chu sna tshogs dang / me tog sil mas lus 'khru zhing mngon par 'thor ro/ /bar snang lasakyang rdul yab kyi rnga ma gnyisadang / rin po che'i gdugs byung bar gyur to/ /de pad ma chen po de la 'dug nas phyogs bzhir rnam par lta ste/ seng ge'i lta stangs dang / skyes bu chen po〉lta stangs kyis rnam par lta'o/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems 60
dpasasngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rnam par smin pa lasabyung ba lha'i mig thogs pa med pas stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams thams cad grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang yul 'khor dang / pho brang 'khor dang / ldongs su bcas/ yul du bcas/ mi dang lhar bcasapa rnamasamathong bar gyur to/ /sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa'ang rab tu shes te/ shes nas kyang sems can gang tshul khrims sam/ ting nge 'dzin tam/ shes rab bam/ dge ba'i spyod pasabadag dang 'dra ba de lta bugang la la zhig yod dam zhesarnam par lta'o/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag dang mtshungs pa'i sems can gang yang ma mthong nas/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' seng ge ltar 'jigs pa med cing bag tsha ba med de/ zhum pa dang bag 'chums pa med pas legs par bsam pa dran par byas te/ bsams brtags nas sems can thams cad kyi semasakyi spyod pa shesapar bya ste/ susakyang bstan pa med par byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba'i chos thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro bar bya'o zhes shar phyogs logs su gom pa bdun bor ro/ /de ltar byang chub semasadapa' gang dang gang du gom pa bor ba de dang de dag tu pad ma dag kyang skyes par gyur to/ /lha dang mi rnams kyi sbyin pa'i gnas su 'gyur bar bya'o zhes lho phyogs logs su gom pa bdun bor ro/ /nub phyogs logs su gom pa bdun bor nas gom pa bdun pa la gnas te nga ni 'jig rten na phul du phyin pa'o/ /'di ni nga'i skye ba tha ma ste/ skye ba dang /rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba mthar dbyung ngo zhes seng ge ltar tshim par gyur pa'i sgra bsgrags so/ /sems can thams cad kyi nang na bla na med par bya'o zhes byang phyogs logasasu gom pa bdun bor ro/ /bdud dang bdud kyi sde ni gzhom par bya'o/ /61
sems can dmyal ba pa thams cad kyi semadragacan dmyal ba'i me gsad pa'i phyir chos kyi char sprin chen po〉char phab ste/ de dag bde bas tshim par bya'o zhes 'og gi phyogs logs su gom pa bdun bor ro/ /sems can thams cad kyi gyen du blta bar 'gyur bar bya'o zhes steng gi phyogs logs su gom pa bdun bor nasasteng du lta'o/ /byang chub sems dpas tshig de brjod ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir sgrasamangon par go bar gyur te/ de ni byang chub semasadapa'i las kyi rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i mngon par shes pa'i chosanyid do/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa btsa' bar 'gyur ba dang / gang gi tshe bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba de'i tshe/ rdzu'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyi rnam pa de lta bu de dag byung ngo / /dge slong dag de'i tshe semasacan thams cad kyang rab tu dga' zhing spu g.yos par gyur to/ / / /
༄9rgyu/ /yum sgyu 'phrul chen mo ston pa'i ma yum du gyur dgospa'i skye ba sngon gyi lo rgyus ngo mtshar can/drin lan bsab mdo lasanas/de nasadri za'i bu chos kyi phreng ba 'dug pa las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yasapa'i lha nga phul btsugasanas sangasargyasagang na bar thal mo sbyar ba btud de bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /yum lha mdzes 'di bsod nams ci bgyis na ci'i rgyu ci'i rkyen gyis de bzhin gshegs pa bltam par gyur/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ legs par nyon la shin tu yid la zungs shig dang khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /sngon 'das pa grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i pha rol na sangasargyasarnam par gzigs zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangasargyasarig pa dang / zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skye bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ ston pa rgyal ba zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /sangs rgyas de'i dam pa'i chosanub nas gzugs brnyan la chos spyod pa'i bar du nub par gyur nas/ de'i tshe yul bā rā ṇa sī zhes bya ba na 'phags pa gnas zhes bya ba'i ri zhig yod de/ ri de la rang sangs rgyas zhes bya ba brgya stong snyed gnasaso/ /ri de la drang srong mngon bar shesapa lnga dang ldan pa grangs med pa zhig kyang ri de la gnas so/ /ngas de ltar 'phags pa dang drang srong mang po gnas pa'i phyir/ ri de yang 'phagasapa gnas zhes btags so/ ri de la drang sgong gcig ni ri de'i lho phyogs na gnas so/ /drang srong gcig ni ri de'i byang ༷paphun gnas te/ drang srong de gnyis gnas
pa'i bar na chu mig gcig yod de chu mig de'i drung na pha bong phya leb bzang po gcig yod do/ /de'i tshe de'i dus gcig na ri'i lho phyogs logs na gnas pa'i drang srong de pha bong de'i steng du gos dang rkang pa bkrus te phyir gnas su song ba dang / ring po ma lon par shwa ba yu mo gcig chu mig la chu 'thung du 'ongs pa dang chu mig la chu 'thungs pa'i 'og tu pha bong de'i steng na drang srong gisagosabakrusapa'i khu ba 'thungasaso/ /gos bkrus pa'i khu ba 'thungs pa'i 'og tu phyir 'phongs rol du bltas te mo mtshan la bldags so/ /de nas zhwa ba yu mo de'i ltor bu chags te zlo ba tshang ba dang / ri dwags kyi chos kyis bu 'byung ba na thog ma gnasagang du mngal du chags pa der bu 'byin pas chu mig gi dngor 'ongasate pha bong de'i steng ngu zhing 'gre nasabu mo gcig byung ngo / /de'i tshe na lho phyogasalogs kyi drang srong des ba ngu ba'i skad thosanas snying rje ba'i semasaskye ste shwa ba'i drung du ltar song ba dang / sha yu mo de la bu mo gcig byung ste shwa ba de la ldag cing 'dug pa las drang srong der 'ongs pa dang shwa ba yang bu bor nas song ngo de nas drang srong de shwa ba la btsas pa'i bu mo de mdzes shing sdug la/ mtshan dang ldan par mthong bsasnying rje'i sems kyis rtswa'i gosakyis dkris te pang du blangs nas phyir gnas su 'ongs nasashing tog dang / 'bras bu brdas nas gsos gsos pa dang / mthar gyis cher skyes nasalo bcabazhi lon pa dang / drang sgong yang bu mo de la shin tu byamasate rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par me gsor bcug pa lasanyi ma gcig le rngo1 byas nasame shi bar gyur pa dang / drang srong gis tshig gis spyosate bu mo thog ma bskyed nas da tsam gyi bar du me shi ma myong na ci'i phyir me bsad cesagashes te/ ri'i byang phyogasalogs naganasapa'i drang srong gi thad du me len du btang ngo / /de nas bu mo desaphas bsgo ba bzhin du ri'i byang phyogs logs su song ba las gom pa re re zhing rkang pa'i 'og nas pad mo re re skyes te/ 'gro 64
ba'i rjes bzhin khod mnyam par dngar ba dang pad mo skyes nas ri'i byang phyogs logs su me len du song ngo / /de'i tshe na drang srong des bu mo de shin tu bsod namasadang ldan zhing rkang pa'i 'og nasapad mo skyes pa mthong nas bu mo de la 'di skad cesasmras so/ /khyod me 'dod na kho po'i spyil po 'di lan bdun skor la gom pa'i bar mnyam pa dang / nye ring thag ran par gom pa'i 'og nasapad mo skyes par byosashig de ltar lan bdun bskor ba byasanasakyang bu mo la khyod me 'dod na phyir yang g.yasaphyogs nasabaskor te songasashig dang me sbyin no bar bsgo'o/ /de'i tshe na bu mo me 'dod pa'i phyir drang srong gis bsgo ba bzhin byas me blangs nas phyir song ngo / /bu mo de phyir song nasaring po ma lon par yul bā rā ṇa sī'i rgyal po dang blon po chen po dang / 'khor brgya stong snyed dang bcas su ri de la 'chag cing ri dwags la mings 'debs su 'ongs pa dang / de nas bā rā ṇa sri'i rgyal po bal gyi glang po che la zhon nas ri byang phyogs logs kyi drang srong ga la ba der 'ongs nas der phyin pa dang / drang srong de'i spyil po la pad mos 'khor bar bskor ba de mthong nas rab tu dga' rangasapa'i semasaskyes te/ drang srong chen po 'a jen tu legasaso legasaso/ /yon tan chen po dang ldan pa'i drang srong ston cing 'dren pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa dge'o zhes bstod do/ /de nas drang sgong des rgyal po la 'di skad gsol to/ /rgyal po chen po mkhyen tam/pad mo 'di dag ni bdag gi nus pa ma legs so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ 'o na 'di sus byas/ drang sgong gis gsol ba/ rgyal po chen po ri lho phyogs logs na gnas pa'i drang srong la ri dwags kyis btsas pa'i bu mo byad bzhin bzang zhing sdug pa/ mi'i mtshan dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten na dkon pa 'gro ba'i rjes bzhin rkang pa'i 'og nas pad mo skye ba zhig yod do/ /rgyal po de skad smras pa thos pas sems rab tu dga' rangs te/ ri'i lho
phyogs logs kyi drang srong ga la ba logs su song ste phyin pa dang / drang srong de'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas drang srong des sgor byung nas bsus te rgyal po chen po shul ring po nasagashegs na rab tu ngal bar ma gyur tam zhes bro dris so/ /de nas rgyal po chen pos drang srong de la 'di skad cesasmras so/ /btsun pa khyod la bu mo zhig yod pa de gnyen bya bar 'dod do/ /drang sgong gis smras pa/ rgyal po chen po bdag phongs pa la bu mo gcig pu zhig yod pa de chung la ci yang mi shes te/ chung nas ri la bskyed bskyed pasami'i chos tshul ci yang ma rtogs te/ rtswa'i rtsa ba dang 'bras bu gzhan mi za na/ ji ltar rgyal po la 'bul du rung bu mo 'di yang ri dwags kyis btsas te 'bul du mi rung ngo zhesaji ltar gyur pa rgyusakyisazhib tu gsol ba'i bar du'o/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ de lta bu yin yang sla'i da ltar gang na 'dug ston cig drang srong gisasmrasapa/ da ltar spyil po'i nang na 'dug go zhes smras so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po chen po sgyil polinang du zhugs nas bu mo la bltas te rab tu dga' ba'i sems skyes te ri dwags kyi bu mo spos chus bkrus nas/ rin thang med pa'i gos bskon te/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan nas/ bal gyi glang po che'i steng du bzhag nas/ 'khor brgya stong snyed kyisabaskor te/ rol mo byed cing phyir yul du 'ongs so /de'i tshe ri dwags kyi bu mo de thog ma btsas nas/ de lta bu'i mi mang po ma mthong bas dngangs shing skrag go /de'i tshe drang srong de ri mthon polikhar song nas bu mo de la mig mi 'dzum par lta zhing 'di snyam du/ da ni bdag gi bu mo yang je ring je ring song basma mthong bar gyur nas phyir gnas su 'gro'o snyam bsams nas mig mchi ma zag cing mchisate/ bdag gis bu mo gsos pa 'di ci yang shes pa med par bral bar gyur to/ /yang 'di snyam du bsams te/ bdag da duX panasa'adi las mi g.yo bar bya'o/ /de ci'i
phyir zhe na/ gal te bdag gi bu mo phyir bdag la lta bar gyur la/ ci ste ma mthong bar gyur na mi dga' zhing sdug bsngal gyis gdungs par 'gyur gyis/ re zhig 'di ṇa nar bsdad do snyam nas/ de nas kyang ring zhig bsdad de ma mthong gi bar du bltas kyang bu mos phyir ma bltas so/ /de ltar bu mos phyir ma bltas pas drang sgong de khro ba'i sems skyesanasa'adi skad ces smradragaso/ /yang byol song latha(skyedragapadragang la yang phyir ma bltas te/ ngas chung ngu nas gsos gsos nas da mir gyur te rgyal pos phrogs pas bdag ye'ur gyur to zhes:la por zhugs nasarig sngags byasate/ gal te rgyal pos bor bar gyur na ni der yang zad do/ /ci ste gces su byas la bor bar ma gyur na bsams pa ltar ma grub cig cedragasngags kyidragabatab bo/ /de'i tshe na bā rā ṇa sī'i rgyal po chen po de pho brang du phyin nas gces su byas nas mtshan yang btsun mo ri dwags ma zhes btags so/ /mtha'i rgyal phran dang / blon po rnams kyang 'dus nas rgyal po la tshig snyan pas bstod nas rgyal po yang rab tu dga' rangs par gyur to/ /de nas kyang ring po ma lon par mngal du bu chags par gyur nas rgyal po nyid btsun molirim gro byed de/ mal cha dang / zas dang / btung ba la sogs pa bzang zhing 'jam por spyor to/ /de nas zla ba bcu tshang nas bu khye'u gcig bcas na rgyal poligadung 'tshob par re ba lasazla ba tshang nasapad mo zhig btsasaso/ /drang srong gi rig sngags kyi mthus rgyal po khros par gyur nas 'di skad du/ byol song las skyes pa bden zhes btsun mo las phyung ste pad mo yang bor du bcug go /de nas ring zhig lon pa dang r+pā rā ṇa sī'i blon po rnams dang skyed mos tshal du ltad mo lta zhing rtser phyin pa dang / rtse zheng rol mo byed de rta dang glang po che yang 'thab tu bcug gyad rnams kyang stobs 'gyed du bcug pa las rgyad kyi nang na rgyad rab tu mchog tu stobs che ba gcig rdog pa sa la 67
brdabasan sayang 'gul te/ drung na pad molirdzing zhig yod pa yang 'gul bar gyur to/ /pad molirdzing de'i drung na pha bong zhig yong de/ de'i 'og na pad mo zhig yod pa rdzing gi nang du lhung ngo / rdzing du lhung ba'i pad mo de mdog rab tu bzang la kha dog le brgan du 'dug la 'tsher ba'i 'od chags pa rgyal pos mthong nas sems rab tu dga' ste/ blon po rnams la pad mo 'di lta ku ni sngon chad yang mthong ma myong ngo zhes smras so/ /de nas pad mo de chu'i nang nas phyungs shig ces bsgo nasapad mo len du btang ba las/ pad mo de la 'dab ma lnga brgya yod de/ 'dab ma re re'i 'og na khye'u gzhon nu byad bzhin bzang zhing mdzes la phal las 'phags pa re re yod par mthong ngo / de nas pad mo len pa'i mi des pad mo de la ngo mtshar che ba de lta bu dag mthong nas/ rgyal po chen po pad mo de la 'dab ma lnga brgya mchisate/ 'dab ma re re'i 'og na lha'i bu re re yod do zhesagasol to/ /rgyal pos tshig de thos nas ba spu kun langs pa tsam du dngangs nas mi de la yang dag par bden nam zhes bka' stsal to/ /de nyid btsun mo ri dwags mas btsas pa'i pad mo yin nam zhes btsun mo las btsasapa'i pad mo gar bor zhes dris na/ btsun mos gsol ba/ rgyal po chen po pad mo de rdzing gi 'gram na pha bong zhig mchis pa'i 'og tu sbas so zhes gsol ba dang / de nyid bston mo ri dwagasamasabatsasapa yin par yid chesapasaphyir pho brang gi nang du 'ongasaso/ /phyir pho brang du phyin nas btsun mo ri dwags ma la bdag ni gti mug can/ shes pa med pa/mdzangs ngan mi rtogs pas btsun mo bden par 'ong ngo snyam nas btsun mo'igayid dang 'gal bar gyur pa bshags so zhes smrasanas phyir btsun mo dam par dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rgyal po shin tu dga' nas blon po rnams dang / bram ze dang / rgyal phran dang /mtshan mkhan kun bsdus nas rgyal bu lnga brgya pang du blangs nas mtshan mkhan rnams la 68
mtshan bzang ngan bltar bcug go /mtshan mkhan gyis gsol ba/ rgyal bu 'di dag t+na rgyal polibasod nams dang dbang thang gis grub ste/ gal te khyim na gnas na mtha' bzhi rang 'du zhing lha rnamasakyang 'go bar 'gyur/ gal te rab tu byung na gdon mi za bar skye shi'i rtsa ba gcod cing 'dod pa'i chu klung las thar te/ 'bor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin cing / rig pa gsum dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang ldan zhing dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi thob par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos tshig de thos nas lhag par dga' bar gyur nas/rgyal bu lnga brgya gso ba'i ma ma lnga brgya btus pa dang / de nas btsun mo ri dwags mas rgyal po la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rgyal po chen po yul khams kun tu ma ma btu mi dgos te/ da ltar rgyal polipho brang na btsun mo lnga brgya yod la/ bston mo de dag bdag la bu yod pasathamasacad phrag dog byed do/ /da rgyal pos btsun mo re re zhing rgyal bu re re gsor bcug na rgyal bu rnamasakyang sos par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos btsun mo la smrasapa/ btsun mo lnga brgya btsun mo la phrag dog byed par gyur na gzhu ba dang / brdeg pa dang / spang ba dang / bskrad pa dang / srog la dbab pa'i bar du btsun mo'iyid dang mi 'gal bar bdag byed na/ ci'i phyir dgrar gyur pa de dag la de lta bu'i shin tu bzod dka' ba nyams su len cing /gnam sa'i bar na drin che ba bdag gi bu btsun mo rnams la sbyin par sems/ de'i tshe btsun mo lnga brgyasade skad cesasmras pa thos te rab tu dga' nas btsun mo ri dwags mas bdag cag la bde ba dang skyid pa rgyun du bstabs la da yang sras bu bdag cag la byin pas rab tu dga'o zhes smras so/ /de'i tshe na 'khor brgya stong snyed kyang tshig de dag thos nas rab tu dga' ba'i sems skyes te byang chub tu sems bskyed par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po chen pos btsun mo la ṭ+wāṃ mtshar che ste/ bdag ni khyod tsam mi phod do
zhes smras so/ /btsun mos smras pa/ phrag dog gi dbang gis zhe sdang skye ste/ nyes pa'i gnyen por ni bzod pa sgom/ khro ba'i gnyen por ni byams sems bskyed dgos te/bdag ni thog ma nas ci la yang rtsod pa ma myong ste/ btsun mo rnams rang la 'tshe zhing gnod pa byed du zad do/ /dper na mi zhig mtshan mo song song ba zhig lasashing dum cig mthong ba las/ dgra'am yi dwags su 'du shes skyes te/ mod la dngangasaskrag nasabrosso/ /mun khung du bros pa las la la ni brag mthon po las g.yang du lhung / la la ni chu'am/ me'am/ tsher phung tham/ nagasatshal gyi nang du lhung nasalusarmasashing zhig par gyur te/ de ltar 'du shesalog pa'i rkyen gyis de lta bu'i gnod pa dang phrad do/ /de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang rang skye/ rang 'chi ba ni dar gyi srin bu'am/ phye ma leb mer song ba dang 'dra ste sus kyang bzhen ma btab bo/ /nyes pa thams cad ni mi bden par 'du shesapa lasabyung ste/ btsun molirnamasakyang de dang 'dra bsan bdag ni shesapa med pa 'am/ phal dang rtsod pa ci yang med do/ /btsun mo lnga brgya po rnams btsun mo ri dwags ma la phyag byas te/ rang gi nyes pa mthol bshags nas btsun mo ri dwags ma'i g.yog dang rim gro byed cing ma'am/ bu mo ltar sems te/ rgyal bu la yang bdag gi bu dang 'dra bar gso zhing rim gro byed do/ /de nas rgyal bu lnga brgya bags kyis cher skyes nas/ rgyal bu gcig cig gis mthu stobs ni mi stong thub pas/ mtha'i rgyal phran dag ldog cing bka' mi nyan pa yod na/dmag rnam bzhi mi dgosapar rgyal bu nyid 'bebasashing rgol du 'gro ste/ de'i tshe na yul yang bde zhing skyid la srungs ma'i lha yang dga' bas/ rlung dang char chu yang dus bzhin du ldang zhing 'bebasaso/ /mi rnamasakyang dal la bde skyid do/ /rgyal bu lnga brgya yang bal gyi gling po dam pa la zhon zhing skyed mos tshal sta spyad bzhin du rtse dga' zhing 'khod pa la pha
ma yang rgyal bu de dag la mig gisa'abrasabu dang 'dra bar semasate byamasaso/ /de'i tshe rgyal bu lnga brgya cher skyes te/ shed rdzogs nas phyis dus gzhan zhig na thams cad pad molirdzing de'i 'gram du 'dusate 'dug 'dug pa lasaso soligazugasabarnyan rdzing gi chu la snang bar gyur nasagacig la gcig 'di skad cer+sāsmraphuso/ /'di lta ste/ chos thams cad ni sgyu ma'am/ sprul pa'am/ rmi lam 'am/ chu'i gzugasabarnyan lta bu ste/ bden pa'am/ yang dag pa med do/ /bdag cag kyang da ltar de dang 'dra ste/ rigs che zhing btsun la pho brang gi nang na gnas nas 'dod pa lnga la bag med par spyod pas longs spyod mod kyi/ dar ba'i tshe lo dang gzugs bzang po ni yid brtan du mi rung ste/ grub pa yod na 'jig par 'gyur/ skye ba yod na 'chi bar 'gyur te/gzhan zhing dar ba yang ring por mi thogs te rgas shing rgud par 'gyur/ kha zas kyi dzod ma zin na na bar 'gyur/ 3 lo brgya thub na yang tha mar shi dgos so/ /zhes rgyal bu rnamasami dga' ba'i mya ngan gyis non to/ /zas dang skom yang mi 'dod par phyir pho brang du 'ongasanasayab rgyal po la 'di skad cesagasol to/ /'jig rten dag ni sdug bsngal ba ste bde ba ma mchidrangapasayab rgyal po bdag cag rab tu 'byung bar gsol lo/ /rgyal posargyal bu rnamasal smrasapa/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang /na ba dang / shi ba ni thams cad la yod par 'dra na khyed 'ba' zhig mya ngan byar yang ci yod/ rgyal bus gsol ba/ bdag cag ni shi nas skye ba yang nas yang du len pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / 'gro ba lngar rgyun du 'gro bar mi bzod do/ /de nasargyal pos kyang rgyal bu'i yid dam ma bzlog ste/ rab tu 'byung bar gnang ngo / /btsun mosargyal bu rnamasal smras pa/ khyed rab tu byung nas kho mo spangs la lam ring du ma 'gro bar pho brang rgyab kyi skyed mosatshal na rab tu dben la shing dang tshal yang dben pa yod kyis/ der 'dug cig 71
dang / yod byad rnam bzhis mi brel bar bya zhing 'bul lo/ /rgyal bu rnams rab tu byung nas btsun mos gsol ba bzhin rgyab kyi skyed mosatshal na gnasapa las rgyal bu de dag thamasacad kyisare re nas mthar gyisarang sangasargyasakyi byang chub thob par gyur to/ /de ltar rgyal bu bzhi brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu mthar gyis rab tu byung / rang byang chub kyi 'bras bu thob par gyur nas rgyal polipho brang du lhags te/ yab rgyal po dang yum la bdag cag rab tu byung ba'i don de thob bo zhesasmrasanas/ dge slong de dag steng gi nam mkha' la 'phagasate shar phyogasanasami snang bar gyur na nub phyogasanasabyung ngo / /nub phyogs nas mi snang bar gyur na shar phyogs nas byung ngo / /lto phyogs nas mi snang bar gyur na byang phyogs nas byung ngo / /byang phyogs nas mi snang bar gyur na/ lho phyogs nas byung ngo / /ched 'ga' ni lus chen posanam mkha'i khamasagang bar gyur/ ched 'ga' ni lus gcig las lus grangs med par sprul/ ched 'ga' ni lus kyi cha stod na chu 'bab na/ lusakyi cha smad na me 'bar ba la sogs pa cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogasapa bstan naslusal me btang nasamya ngan lasa'adasaso/ /de nas btsun mo ri dwags mas sku gdung bsdus nas rgyab kyi skyed mos tshal du mchod rten bzhi brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu byas nas mchod pa byed do/ /rgyal bu nang gi chung ngu yang zhag dgu bcu 'dasanas rang sangasargyasakyi byang chub thob ste/ de yang yab dang yum la chos 'phrul chen po bstan to/ /cho 'phrul chen po bstan nasamya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas btsun slo ri dwags mas sku gdung bsdus nas mchod rten brtsigs te mchod pa byas so/ /de'i tshe na btsun mo ri dwags mas nyin gcig bzhin bdug spos dam pa dang /me tog dam pa dang / rol mo sna tshogs kyis rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya'i mchod rten la mchod pa byed cing mchod rten de dag gi drung na mi dga' zhing mya ngan byed de 'di skad ces 72
smrasasob/ da/ga gisabu lnga brgya btsasanasarab tu byung mod kyi/ de lagacig tsam yang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu semasabaskyed pa med pas 'di skad ces smon lam du btab bo/ /bdag gisarang sangasargyasalnga brgya la mchod pa byasashing mchod rten lnga brgya brtsigasate/sku gdung la mchod pa'i bsod nams : yod pa sems can thams cad la bsngo'o/ /bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dusan bu mang du btsas shing bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems mi bskyed pa mi 'dod kyi/ bu gcig pu zhig btsas la bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems lcu/ sbyināshā/ swāhā ༵ ༵shā tsho snang nasathamasacad mkhyen pa'i ye shesadang ldan par shog bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ de'i tshe de'i dus na btsun mo ri dwagasam de gzhan zhig yin snyam du semaphun de ltar mi blta ste/ de'i tshe de'i dus na btsun mo ri dwags ma de nyid ni da ltar yum lha mdzes nyid yin no/ /yum lha mdzes de ltar rang sangasargyasalnga brgya la mchod pa byasate dge ba'i rtsa ba grangs med pa bskyed pasade bsan da ltar de bzhin gshegasapa'i sku bltamasapa yin no/ /sangasargyaskyi chos 'di bstan pa na lha dang mi grangs med pa 'bras bu dang po thob pa nas 'bras bu bzhi pa'i bar du thob par gyur to/ /semasacan tshad med pa snyed ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i byang chub tu semasabaskyed par gyur to/ / / /
༄4//rgyal bu don kun grub pa'i bston mo sa'atsho ma'i yon tan dang lo rgyus/dusagag zhig na rgyal po zasagatsang ma shākya'i tshogasadagā r+nghi ṭ+wāṃ rnyilhas ༵༵༵༵/na 'dug 'dug pa de'i tshe/shākya rgan rabs rgan rabasakha cig gisargyal po zasagatsang ma la 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ gzhon nu don thamasacad grub pa 'di ni bram ze ltasamakhan rnamasadang / blo ngesapa dang ldan pa'i lha mang posa'adi skad du bstan te/ gzhon nu 'di gal te mngon par byung bar gyur na ni/ de bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangasargyasasu 'gyur ro//ji ste mngon par ma byung na ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba chosakyi rgyal po chosadang ldan zhing rin po chesna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de'i rin po che sna bdun ni 'di dag ste/ 'di ltar 'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / blon po rin po che dang bdun no/ /de la bu dpa' ba/rtul phod pa/yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ gzhan gyi sde rab tu 'joms pa stong tshang ba 'byung ngo //de gnod par bya ba dang /mtshon cha med par chos dang mthun pas sa'i dkyil 'khor 'di las mngon par rgyal bar byas te/ gcig pu gnas par 'gyur ro zhes mchi na /de'i slad du gzhon nu de'i btsun mo blang bar bgyi'o//de ltar mdzad dang bud med kyi tshogs kyis yongasasu bskor te/ dgyes pa ṭ+wāṃ longs spyod cing mngon par 'byung bar yang
mi 'gyur te/ de ltar gyur pa dang bdag cag gi 'khor los sgyur ba'i gdung yang mi 'chad/ khamasakyi rgyal po thamasacad kyisakyang mi snyan par mi brjod cing rim gror bgyi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nasargyal po zasagatsang masasmrasapa/ gal te de ltar bya na de'i phyir gzhon nu'i tshul dang mthun pa'i bu mo gang zhig yod khyed kyis ltos shig de'i tshe shākya lnga brgya tsam so so nasa'adi skad du bdag gi bu mo ni gzhon nu'i tshul dang mthun no/ /bdag gi bu mo ni gzhon nu'i tshul dang mthun no zhesazer ro/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gzhon nu de ni shin tu phul che ba yin gyis/ gzhon nu nyid la khyod bu mo gang 'dod ces dri bar bya'o zhes/ de dag kun kyang 'dus te/ gzhon nu la dngosapo de brjod do/ /gzhan nusasmrasapa/ da ste dgung bdun na 'di'i lan gsan par gsol/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du bsams te/ 'dod pa'i skyon ni bdag gis mtha' yadragarig /'thab mo 'khon bcadrangamya ngan sdug bsngal rtsa/ /'jigs byed dug gi lo ma 'dra ba ste/ /me dang 'dra zhing ral gri'i so dang 'dra/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bdag 'dod ma yin te/ /bdag ni bud med tshogs dang mdzes ma yin/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin bde bas zhi sems su/ /bdag ni mi smra nags tshal gnas par bya/ /yang des brtags nasathabasamakhas pa mngon du byasate/ semasacan yongs su smin par bya ba la bltasanas/ snying rje chen po bskyed de/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so / —/'dam dang lcag lcig khrod nasapad ma rnam par 'phel/ /mi rnams gang ba'i nang na rgyal po mchod pa 'thob/ /gang tshe byang chub sems dpa' 'khor mchog thob gyur pa/ /de tshe sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'chi med 'dul/ /sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa gang byung ba/ /de dag kun gyis btsun mo sras dang slas kyang bsten/ /'on kyang 'dod pas chags med bsam gtan bde ma nya/sna/ /bdag kyang de dag yon tan rjes su
bslab par bya/ /gang la spyod lam yon tan bden pa'i tshig med pa/ /bud med phal pa gang yang bdag gi tshul mthun min/ /gang zhig bdag gi sems ni mngon par dga' byed cing / /bag yod gzugs dang na tshod rusarigasadag pa 'os/ /desani yon tan tshigasasu bcad de yi ger bris/ /'di 'dra'i bu mo mchisan bdag la bka' stsol cig /skye bo phal pa ma bsdamasabadag la mkho ma lags/ /yonartan brjod pa 'di ldan mchisna bdag stsol cig /dar cing gzugasabazang ldan yangagazugasakyi dregasadang bral/ /phu nu ma la byamasaltar byams pa'i semasaldan zhing / /gtong la dga' ste dge sbyong bram ze sbyin tshul can/ /de 'dra'i bu mo mchis na yab kyis bdag stsol cig /gang la nga rgyal khengasadang zhe sdang ma mchisashing / /g.yo dang phrag dog sgyu spangasadrang ba'i ngang tshul can/ /rmi lam na yang skyes pa gzhan la chags dang bral/ /bdag gi khyos ni chog 'tshal rtag sdom bag mchis la/ /rgyagasapa ma mchisami g.yeng zung thub tshul 'chang zhing / /nga rgyal ma mchisa'agying dang bral bsabran mo bzhin/ /sgra dri ro la ma chagaphuchang lam chagasate/ /'dod bral brnab sems ma mchis rang gi nor gyis 'tshal/ /bden la gnas shing mi 'phyar g.yeng ba ma lagasapa/ /ngo tsha'i gosa'atshal rgod dang khengasapa ma mchisaganas/ /lha dang bkra shis ma chags rtag tu chos la brtson/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi dngos po rab dag pa/ /gnyid dang rmugs pa mi mang nga rgyal glen bral zhing / /rtog dang ldan la legs pa'i las rnams rtag spyod de/ /gyos sgyug gnyis la'ang ston pa bzhin gyi rim gror ldan/ /bran dang bran mo kun la'ang bdag bzhin byams srel ba/ /smad 'tshong bzhin du bstan bcos cho ga 'tshal cing mkhas/ /slad kyis nyal zhing sngon du mal nas ldang bgyid pa/ /byams pas rjes snyegs ma bzhin tshul 'chos ma mchis pa/ /de 'dra'i bud med mchisan yab kyis bdag stsol cig /dge slong dag de nas rgyal po zas gtsang 76
mas tshigs su bcad pa de dag thos nas/ mdun na 'don la smras pa/ bram ze chen po khyod ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen por song la/ khyim thams cad du'ang song ste/ bu mo dag ltos la gang la yang rung ste yon tan de lta bu dag yod na/ rgyal rigs kyi bu mo yang rung / bram ze'i bu mo yang rung / rje'u rigasakyi bu mo yang rung / dmangs rigs kyi bu mo yang rung gis/ bu mo de dag 'dir 'on cig de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzhon nu 'di ni rigs don du gnyer ba ma yin rus don du gnyer ba ma yin gyi/ gzhon nu 'di ni yon ga don du gnyer ba yin no/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang smras so/ /rgyal rigs bram ze'i bu mo dang / /rje'u rigs dmangs rigs de bzhin te/ /su la yon tan 'di yod pa'i/ /bu mo de ni 'dir 'on cig /nga yi bu 'di rigs dag dang / /rus la ngo mtshar 'dzin ma yin/ /yon tan bden pa chosakyi rnams/ /de la 'di yi yid dga'o/ /dge slong dag de nas bram ze mdun na 'don desatshigasasu bcad pa yi ger brisapa de khyer te/ ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen por song nas/ khyim nas khyim du yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i bu mo lta zhing tshol du song song ba las/ yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i bu mo ma mthong ste/ de nas rim gyis shākya lag na be con can gyi khyim du phyin nas/ des bltas na/ bu mo gzugs mdzes shing lta na sdug la yid du 'ong ba/ mdog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/ ha cang yang mi ring ba/ ha cang yang mi thung ba/ ha cang yang mi sbom pa/ ha cang yang mi skem pa/ha cang yang mi dkar ba/ ha cang yang mi gnag pa/ gzod ma dar la bab pa/ bud med rin po che ltar snang ba zhig mthong ba dang / bu mo desabram ze mdun na 'don de'i rkang pa gnyis nas bzung ste 'di skad ces smras so/ /bram ze chen po khyod la dgos pa ci zhig mchis/ bram ze mdun na 'don gyis tshigasta su bcad de smras pa/ zas gtsang sras po
gzugs ni mchog tu mdzes gyur cing / /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan yon tan gzi brdzid can/ /de yis bud med rnams kyi yon tan yi ger bris/ /su la yon tan 'di yod de yi chung mar 'os/ /zhes smrasate/ des de la yi ge de byin no/ /de nas bu mo des tshigs su bcad pa'i yi ge de bklagadraganas/ bzhin kuṇ+ḍasam pa bstan te/ bram ze mdun na 'don de la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bram ze yon tan 'di dag bdag la kun tshang gis/ /des pa'i gzugs can de ni bdag gi khyim thab bo/ /gal te gzhon nu bzhed na phyi bshol ma mdzad gsungs/ brgya la skye bo phal dang bzhugasapar 'gyur yang gda'/ de nasabram ze mdun na 'don de/ rgyal po zasagatsang ma'i drung du song ste don de brjod do/ /rgyal po chen po bdag gis gzhon nu'i tshul dang mthun pa'i bu mo mthong ngo / /rgyal pos smras pa/ su la de lta bu zhig yod/ smras pa/ lha shākya lag na be con can la bu mo de lta bu zhig mchisaso/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma 'di snyam du semasate/ gzhon nu de ni shin tu phul che zhing bzang ba la mos pa yin la/ bud med dag ni phal cher yon tan med pa dag kyang / bdag la yon tan yod par khasalen gyis/ bdag gis yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad dag cig byasate/ gzhon nu 'di bu mo thams cad la sbyin pa byed du gzhug go /bu mo de dag gi nang nas gang la gzhon nu mig mngon par chags par gyur pa de/ gzhon nu la sbyin par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad gser dang / dngul dang / rin po che sna tshogs las byed du bcug nasaser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen por dril gyi sgra bsgrags te/ deng nas zhag bdun na kun gyis kyang gzhon nu mthong bar 'gyur te/ yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad dag kyang bu mo dag la sbyin pa byed kyis/bu mo thams cad kyang 'dun khang du shog cig ces bsgo'o/ /dge slong dag de nas zhag bdun lon pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'dun khang du song ste/ seng ge'i khri la 'dug 78
go /de'i tshe rgyal po zasagatsang masabya ra ba dag bkod nas/ gzhon nu 'di bu mo gang la mig chagasapa de nga la gyisashig ces bsgo'o/ /dge slong dag de nas ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po de na bu mo gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad 'dun khang ga la ba de dang / byang chub semasadapa' gang na ba der byang chub semasadapa' blta ba dang yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad blangs pa'i phyir der dong ngo / /dge slong dag de nas byang chub sems dpas bu mo ji ltar 'ongasapa de dag la yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad rnams byin no/ /de nas bu mo de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i dpal dang gzi brdzid ma bzod nas/ yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad de dag blangs shing myur ba myur bar phyir dong ngo / /de nasshākya lag na be con can gyi bu mo sa 'tsho ma zhes bya ba/ bran mo3tshogs kyis bskor cing mdun du bdar te/ 'dun khang ga la ba dang / byang chub semasadapa' ga la ba der song ste phyin pa dang / mig mi 'dzums par byang chub sems dpa' la lta zhing phyogs gcig tu 'dug par gyur to/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpas yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad de dag byin zin par gyur pa de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i drung du 'ongs nas 'dzum dmul te byang chub semasadapa' la 'di skad cesasmrasaso/ /gzhon nu bdag gis khyod la nongs pa ci zhig bgyis na/ bdag la de ltar dngan sdang mdzad/ smras pa/ ngas ni khyod la dngan sdang byasapa'ang med na/ khyod ni shin tu 'phyis te 'ongs so zhesasmrasanasadesasor gdub srang brgya stong du ma ri ba phud de de la byin no/ /bu mo des smras pa/ gzhon nu khyod la bdag gis 'di lta zhig 'tshal ba 'odrangasam/ smras pa/ 'o na rgyan gzhan dang gzhan dag yod pa 'di dag kyang khyod khyer cig des smrasapa/ gzhan nu bdag ni rgyan ma mchis par bgyid pa ma lagasakyi/ rgyan dang ldan par bgyid pa lagasaso/ /zhesasmrasanasabu mo de song ngo / /de nas bya ra bar bkod pa'i mi de dag rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i drung du song 79
nas/ lo rgyusade dag smosate smrasapa/ lha shākya lag na be+e con can gyi bu mo phu'atsho ma zhesbgyi ba de la gzhon nu spyan chags par gyur la chung zad cig tu bka' mchid kyang bgyis so| |de nasargyal po zasagatsang masatshig de thos nasashākya lag na be con can gyi gan du bram ze mdun na 'don pho nyar btang ste/ khyod kyi bu mo zhig yod pa de nga'i gzhon nu la byin cig cesaspring ngo / /lag na be+e con can gyisasmrasapa/ 'phagasapa gzhon nu de ni pho brang na skyid de bar 'khrungs pa lags la/ bdag cag gi rigs kyi chos ni 'di lta bu lags te/ sgyu rtsal shes pa la bu mo gtong gi /sgyu rtsal mi shes pa la mi gtong ba lags na/ gzhon nu de ni sgyu rtsal shesapa yang ma lagasal/ ral gri'i thabasadang / 'phong dang /stobasadang / gyad kyi 'dzin stangasakyi tshul shesapa yang ma lagasan/ bdag gisasgyu rtsal shes pa ma lags pa la bu mo ji ltar gtang / tshig de rgyal po la bzlas pa dang / de nas rgyal po 'di snyam du sems te/ nga la desa'adi dang lan gnyis su bsngos te/ gang gi tshe ngas shākya gzhon nu dag gzhon nu'i rim gro byed du ci'i phyir mi 'ong zhes byas pa de'i tshe yang / ci nged lugs kyi rim gro byed du 'ong ngam zhes zer la/ da'ang 'di skad zer ro snyam du sems shing 'dug par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang gtam de thos nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma ga la ba der song ste phyin nasa'adi skad ces smras so/ /ci nongasate de ltar zhal zung gnag par bzhugs/ rgyal posasmrasapa/ gzhon nu de dri bas ci zhig bya/gzhon nus smras pa/ lha de ni bka' mi stsal du mi rung ngo zhes lan gsum gyi bar du byang chub semasadapasargyal po zasagatsang ma la drisapa dang / de nas rgyal po zasagatsang mas byang chub sems dpa' la dngos po de dag brjod do/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/lha grong khyer 'di na bdag dang sgyu rtsal gyis 'gran par nus pa 'ga' mchis sam de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma bgad nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras 80
so/ /bu khyod kyis sgyu rtsal bstan par nus sam/ smras pa/ lha de ni bdag gis legs par rngo thog go /de bas na sgyu rtsal 'tshal ba rnams kun kyang bsog tu gsol/ de dag gi mdun du bdag gis/ sgyu rtsal bstan par bgyi'o/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang masaser skya'i gnasakyi grong khyer chen por dril gyi sgra bsgrags te/ deng nas zhag bdun na gzhon nu rang gi sgyu rtsal ston gyis/ der sgyu rtsal shes pa thams cad shog cig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas zhag bdun lon pa dang / shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya tsam tshogs par gyur to| |de nas shākya lag na be con can gyi bu mo sa 'tsho ma rgyal ba'i ru mtshon du bzhag ste/'dir ral gri'i thabasadang 'phong dang / stobs dang / gyad kyi 'dzin stangs kyis su rgyal ba de ni 'di khyer cig cesadam bcasanas/ de'i tshe thams cad kyi thog ma la gzhon nu lha sbyin grong khyer nas byung ngo / /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i bzhon par glang po dkar po bong shinasgyu che ba zhig grong khyer du khrid pa gzhan nu lha sbyin gyisamathong nasaphrag dog dang /shākya'i nga rgyal dang / stobs kyi nga rgyal gyis dregs nas/ des glang po de lag pa g.yon pas sna nas bzung ste/ lag pa g.yas pas thal mo lan cig bsnun pas bsad par gyur to/ /de'i 'og tu gzhon nu mdzes dga' bo byung ba dang / des glang po chen po de grong khyer gyi sgor bsad pa mthong nas/ sus bsad ces drisapa dang / smras pa/ lha sbyin gyis bsad do/ /smras pa/ lha sbyin gyis de ni ma legs pa zhig byas so zhes/ des glang po de'i mjug ma nas bzung ste/ grong khyer gyi sgo nas gud du bor ro/ /de'i 'og tu byang chub semasadapa' shing rta la zhon te byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpas glang po de ltar bsad pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang sus bsad ces dris pa dang / smras pa/ lha sbyin gyis bsad do/ /smras pa/ lha sbyin gyis de ni ma legs pa zhig byas so/ /grong khyer 'di'i sgo nas sus bor zhes dris pa dang smras pa/ mdzes dga' bos bor ro/ /smras pa/ mdzes 81
dga' pos de ltar byasapa yang legs na/ sems can 'di ni lusachen po dang ldan pa ste/rul na grong khyer thams cad dri mi zhim pas gang bar 'gyur ro zhes nas/ de nas byang chub sems dpas shing rta la 'dug bzhin du rkang pa ya gcig sa la brkyang ste/ rkang pa'i mthe bos glang po de blangs te/ ra ba bdun rim dang 'obs bdun rim 'das nas grong khyer gyi phyi rol rgyang grags gcig tsam du 'phangs so/ /gling po de phyogs gang du lhung ba'i phyogasade shong chen po zhig tu gyur nas/ da ltar glang po3shong zhes bya ba yin no/ /de'i tshe lha dang mi brgya stong mang po ye ma.a la la zhes zer zhing ca co dang ga zha'i sgra brgya stong 'byin la/ gos kyi g.yab mo 'byin par gyur to/ /nam mkha'i dkyil nas lha'i bu dag gis kyang tshigasasu bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gling polidabang po bdo ba bzhin bzhud pa/ /zhabs kyi mthe bos glang polidabang po blangs/ /ra ba bdun dang 'obs bdun yongs 'dasanas/ /grong khyer 'di yi phyi rol rgyang ring 'phangs/ /mkhyen pa mchog mnga' 'dis ni gdon mi zar/ /nga rgyal stobasakyis mtho ba'i lus can rnams/ /'khor ba'i grong nas phyi rol rgyang ring du/ /shesarab stobs kyis 'dis ni 'phen par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag de nas shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya tsam grong khyer nas 'thon nas/ sa'i phyogs gang du shākya gzhon nu dag sgyu rtsal ston pa der dong ngo / /rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang /shākya rgan rabs rgan rabasadag dang / skye bo phal po che dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' dang / shākya gzhon nu gzhan dag gi sgyu rtsal gyi khyad par mthong bar 'dod de sa'i phyogs der dong ngo / /de nas thog mar shākya gzhon nu yi ge mkhas shing yi ge'i cho ga shes pa de dag dang / byang chub sems dpar yi ge 'gran to/ /de'i tshe shākya de dag gis slob dpon kun gyi bshephuganyen dpang du bzhag ste/ gzhon nu 'di dag gi nang nas/ yi ge 'bru'am/yi ge'i sna grangs kyi mthar phyin pas khyad par du 'phags pa gang yin khyod kyis bye brag 82
phyes shig de nas slob dpon kun gyi bshos gnyen byang chub sems dpa' yi ge la mkhas pa mngon du mthong bas bzhin 'dzum pa bstan te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smrasaso/ /mi yi 'jig rten lha yi 'jig rten nam/ /lha min 'jig rten dri za'i 'jig rten nam/ /'jig rten kun gyi yi ge ji snyed gang / /de la sems can dag pa 'dis ma/thar phyin/ /mi yi zla ba 'di yisagang mkhyen pa'i/ /yi ge dag dang yi ge'i sna grangasakyi/ /ming yang khyed dang ngasani yong mi shes/ /'di la mngon sum ngas shesa'adi rgyal 'gyur/ khrakya rnams kyis smras pa/ gzhon nu 'di yi ge shes pa la khyad par du 'phags pa lta'ang 'phags par chug ste/ gzhon nu 'di grangs kyis shes pa la khyad par ci yod 'gran par bya'o/ /de nas shākya srid sgrub cesabya ba rtsisapa chen po byed pa bgrang ba dang / rtsis kyi pa rol tu phyin pa zhig yod pa de dpang du bzhag ste/ gzhon nu 'di dag gi nang nas grangs kyi shes pa la khyad par du gang 'phags khyod kyis ltos shig ces byas te/ de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpas ni rtsis mgo phog shākya gzhon nu gcig gis ni brtsis pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' la slebadragapar ma nus so/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / bcu dang /nyi shu dang / sum cu dang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu dang / brgya nas/ shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya'i bar gyis dus gcig tu brtsis kyang byang chub sems dpa' la ma slebs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ khyed kyis ni rtsis mgo phog cika kho bos ni brtsi'o/ /de'i tshe shākya gzhon nu gcig gis rtsis mgo phog na/ byang chub sems dpas rtsis kyi chod pa la ma slebasaso/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu gnyis dang / gsum dang /bzhi dang / lnga dang / bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu dang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu dang /brgya nas shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya'i bar gyis dus gcig tu rtsis mgo phog kyang byang chub 83
sems dpas rtsisakyi chod pa la ma slebs so/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'di la brtsad de yang ci rung gis/ khyed thams cad gcig tu 'dus te rtsis mgo phog cig dang /kho bos brtsi'o/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu lnga brgyas tshig gcig tu brjod pas snga phyi med par rtsis mgo phog na/ byang chub sems dpas rmongs pa med par brtsis te/ de ltar shākya gzhon nu de dag thams cad ni phug thug par gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' la t+na thug pa'i mtha' med par gyur to/ /de nasartsis pa chen po srid sgrub ngo mtshar du gyur te tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /legs pa'i blo mnga' 'di dris na/ /mkhyen pa shin tu myur ba ste/ khukya gzhon nu lnga brgya tsam/ /kun kyang rtsis kyi lam la thug /de yi shes rab 'di 'dra ste/ /ye shesablo gros dran ldan yang / /rtsisakyi mkhyen pa rgya mtsho de/ /da dung sbyong zhing slob pa mdzad/ /de nas shākya'i tshogs thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur te/ shin tu rmad du byung bar sems shing / de'i tshe thams cad mgrin gcig tu tshig 'di skad ces smrasaso/ /kye don grub gzhon nu khyod ni rgyal lo rgyal lo zhes thams cad stan las langs te/thal mo sbyar nas byang chub sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal te rgyal po zas gcang ma la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po chen po khyod la sras de ltar dris pa la spobs pa myur zhing mgyogs la/ yang zhing shugs dang ldan pa can mnga' ba ni brnyes pa legs par brnyes so /tsho / de nas rgyal po zasagatsang mas byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /bu rtsis pa chen po srid sgrub grangs kyi shes pa la mkhas pa dang / rtsis kyi lugs 'gran nus sam/ smras pa/ lha rngo thog go /smras pa 'o na rtsis shig de nas rtsis pa chen po srid sgrub kyis byang chub sems dpa' la 'di skad ces smras so/ /gzhon nu khyod bye ba las brgyar gong du bsgres pa zhes bgyi ba'i rtsis kyi lugs mkhyen tam/ smras pa/ shes so/ /smras pa/ 'o na bye ba las brgyar gong du bsgres pa'i rtsis kyi lugs la ji ltar rjes su 84
'jug par bgyi/ byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ bye ba phrag brgya na ther 'bum zhes bya'o/ /ther 'bum phrag brgya na khrag khrig cedragabya'o/ /khrag khrig phrag brgya na gtamasapa zhesabya'o/ /gtamasapa phrag brgya na dkrigs pa zhesabya'o/ /dkrigasapa phrag brgya na mi 'khrugasapa zhesabya'o/ /mi 'khrugasapa phrag brgya na khyad phyin cesabya'o/ /khyad phyin phrag brgya na phang steng zhesabya'o/ /phang steng phrag brgya na mang 'dzin cesabya'o/ /mang 'dzin phrag brgya naglang polistobasazhesabya'o/ /glang polistobasaphrag brgya na ngogasa'athob cesabya'o/ /ngogasa'athob phrag brgya na rnam par gzhag pa gdags pa zhesabya'o/ /rnam par gzhag pa gdagasapa phrag brgya na rgyu rig cesabya'o/ /rgyu rig phrag brgya na lag sbyin zhes bya'o/ /lag sbyin phrag brgya na rgyu dbang zhesabya'o/ /rgyu dbang phrag brgya na rdzogasathob cesabya'o/ /rdzogs thob phrag brgya na bgrang rtogasazhesabya'o/ /bgrang rtogasaphrag brgya na sgrib pa zhesbya'o/ /sgrib pa phrag brgya na stobasazhesabya'o/ /stobasaphrag brgya na kun stobasazhesabya'o/ /kun stobasaphrag brgya na rnam par brda shesaldan zhesabya'o/ /rnam par brda shes ldan phrag brgya na brda shesakun zhes bya'o/ /brda shes kun phrag brgya na rnam 'byung zhes bya'o/ /rnam 'byung phrag brgya na de'i mtshan nyid ces bya ste/ 'di ltar de'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i rtsis kyis ni ri'i rgyal po ri rab brtsi ba'i gzhir byas kyang chod par rung ngo / /de yi yang gong na rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo3nor bu zhes bya ba'i grangasayod de/ grangs des ni gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed brtsi ba'i gzhir byasakyang chod par rung ngo / /de'i yang gong na rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo nges par sgrogs pa zhes bya ba'i grangs yod do/ /de'i yang gong na ded 'dren gdags pa zhes bya ba'i grangs yod do/ /de'i yang gong na gtan la 'bebs pa zhes bya ba'i grangs yod do/ /de'i yang gong na gcod rtogs zhes bya ba'i grangs yod do/ /de'i yang gong na gcod rtogs ldan zhes bya ba'i grangs yod do/ /de'i yang gong na thams cad 85
rnam par 'byesapa zhesabya ba'i grangasayod de/ grangasades ni gang gā'i klung bcu'i bye ma brtsi ba'i gzhir byas kyang chod par rung ngo / /de'i yang gong nalhang po mchog cesabya ba'i grangs yod de/ grangs des ni gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag brgya'i bye ma dang mnyam pa brtsi ba'i gzhir byasakyang chod par rung ngo / /de'i yang gong na rdul phra rab la 'jug pa'i rjes su song ba zhes bya ba'i grangs yod de/ grangs de la ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub kyi snying po mchog dam par gnasapa'i byang chub semasadapa' dang / chosathamasacad la dbang bskur ba mngon du gyur pa'i byang chub semasadapa' ma gtogasapar semasacan gyi ris na grangs de shes pa ni nga dang gzhan yang nga dang 'dra ba srid pa tha ma par gyur pa khyim gyi gnas nas mngon par ma byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ma gtogs pa gang yang med do/ /srid sgrub kyis smrasapa/ gzhon nu rdul phra rab la 'jug pa'i rjes su song ba'i grangs la ji ltar rjes su 'jug par bgyi/ byang chub semasadapasasmrasapa/ rdul phra rab kyi rdul bdun la ni rdul phra mogacigasho /rdulaphra slobadun lani rdulachung ngubacugasho /rdul chung ngu bdun la ni nyi zer gyi rdul gcig go /nyi zer gyi rdul bdun la ni ri bong rdul gcig go /ri bong rdul bdun la ni lug rdul gcig go /lug rdul bdun la ni glang rdul gcig go /glang rdul bdun la ni sro mgacigasho /hro ma bdun la ni yungasa'abru gcigasho /yungs 'bru bdun la ni nas gcig go /nas bdun la ni sor gcig go /sor bcu gnyis la ni mtho gang ngo / /mtho do la ni khru gang ngo / /khru bzhi la ni gzhu gang ngo / /gzhu stong la ni yul ma ga ṅgā'i rgyang gragasagacig go /rgyang grags bzhi la ni dpag tshad gcig go |de la khyed kyis nang nas dpag tshad la rdul phra rab de lta bu du yod sus shes/ srid sgrub kyis smras pa/ gzhon nu bdag nyid kyang de la mgo rmongs na gzhan blo chung ngu dang ldan pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de bas na gzhon nus dpag tshad la rdul phra rab de lta bu 86
du mchisabashad du gsol/ byang chub semasadapas smrasapa/ de la dpag tshad la ni rdul phra rab mi 'khrugadragakhrag khrig gcig dang / bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag sum cadang / bye ba drug cu phrag brgya dang / bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa gnyisadang / 'bum phrag lnga dang / khri nyisstong yod de/ dpag tshad la ni rdul phra rab de snyed cig yod do/ /de ltar 'jug pa des 'dzam bu'i gling 'di la ni dpag tshad bdun stong yod do/ /nub rmya ba lang spyod la ni dpag tshad brgyad stong yod do/ khrar gyi lusa'aphagasal3 dpag tshad dgu stong yod do/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan la ni dpag tshad khri yod de/ de ltar 'jug pa desagling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di la sogs pa gling bzhi pa chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya dang / rgya mtsho chen po bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'khor yug dang 'khor yug chen po bye ba phrag brgya dang / ri'i rgyal po ri rab bye ba phrag brgya dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i risakyi lha bye ba phrag brgya dang / sum cu rtsagasum bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'thab bral bye ba phrag brgya dang /dga' ldan bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'phrul dga' bye ba phrag brgya dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshangasarisabye ba phrag brgya dang / tshangasapa'i mdun na 'don bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshangs 'khor bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshangs chen bye ba phrag brgya dang /'od chung bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshad med 'od bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'od gsal bye ba phrag brgya dang / dge chung bye ba phrag brgya dang / tshad med dge bye ba phrag brgya dang / dge rgyas bye ba phrag brgya dang / sprin med bye ba phrag brgya dang / bsod nams skyes bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'bras bu che bye ba phrag brgya dang / sems can 'du shesamed pa bye ba phrag brgya dang /mi che ba bye ba phrag brgya dang / mi gdung ba bye ba phrag brgya dang / gya nom snang bye ba phrag brgya dang / shin tu mthong bye ba phrag brgya dang / 'og min gyi lha'i ris bye ba phrag brgya la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig ces bya ste/ yangs shing rgya che ba 87
de la dpag tshad du yod pa dang / dpag tshad brgya phrag du yod pa dang / dpag tshad stong phrag du yod pa dang / dpag tshad bye ba phrag du yod pa dang / dpag tshad ther 'bum phrag du yod pa dang / dpag tshad khrag khrig phrag du yod pa dang / de bzhin du sbyar te/ dpag tshad snying po dam pa'i rtsis kyi bar du thug pa la rdul phra rab de lta bu du yod cesabya ba'i rtsisade ni grangasadang bgrang ba lasa'adasapa ste/ de ni grangasamed pa zhesabya'o/ /de bas kyang shin tu grangasamed pa de snyed kyi rdul phra rab ni stong gsum gyi stong chen poli'ajig rten gyi khams na yod do/ /byang chub sems dpas rtsis kyi le'u 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ rtsis pa chen po srid sgrub dang / shākya'i tshogasathams cad kyang tshim zhing mgu la yi rangs te ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba thob nas/ de dag thams cad kyang gos re re zhig bzhag ste gos dang rgyan lhag ma gzhan byang chub sems dpa' la yon du kul lo/ /de nasartsisapa chen po srid sgrub kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smrasaso/ / 'di ltar bye ba brgya na ther 'bum de bzhin du/ /khrag khrig dang ni gtamasapa'i rgyud dang de bzhin du/ /dkrigs pa mi 'khrugs bdag gi shes thug de gong min/ /mtshungs pa med kyi mkhyen pa rtsis la de bas lhag /yang kye shākya dag stong gsum dag gi rdul dang nadang nags tshal dang / /sman dang chu yi thigasapa ji snyed yod pa yang / dokha zhesabya ba gcig la 'di yisrtsi nusan/ /lnga brgya tsam dag gi lta ngo mtshar ci zhig che/ /de nasalha dang mi brgya stong dag /e ma a la la zhes zer zhing ca co dang / /ga zha'i sgra brgya stong 'byin par gyur to/ /nam mkha'i dkyil nas lha'i bu dag gis kyang tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag brjod do/ /dus gsum sems can ma lus ji snyed gang yod pa'i/ /sems dang sems byung 'du shes rnam par rtog pa dag /mchog dang tha ma de bzhin rgya chung yangs pa dag /tham sa cad sems kyi 'gyur ba gcig gis rab tu mkhyen/ /dge slong dag de ltar shākya gzhon nu de dag thams 88
cad zil gyisanon par gyur te/ byang chub semasadapa' 'ba' zhig khyad par du 'phagspar gyur to/ /de'i rjes la mchongs pa dang / rkyal dang / bang la sogasapa thams cad la'ang byang chub sems dpa' nyid khyad par du 'phags par gyur nas/ nam mkha'i dkyil nasalha'i bu dag gisatshigasasu bcad pa 'di dag smrasaso/ /brtul zhugaphudaka' thub sdom pa'i yon tan darnga / /bskal pa bye bar bzod dul byams stobasakyis/ /lus dang sems ni ci nas yang mdzad pas/ /de yi shugs kyi khyad par mnyan par gyis/ /semasacan mchog 'di grong khyer 'di na bzhugasapar khyed kyisamathong / /'on kyang 'di ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khamasarnamasathams cad du/ /skad cig gcig la rin chen gser dang mchod pa sna tshogasakyis/ /rgyal ba dpag tu med pa dag la mchod pa mdzad du bzhud/ /'on kyang rdzu'aphrul de 'dra brnyesapa de/ /byon tam bzhung par khyed kyis yong mi shes/ /ji tsam zhugs zhes de la ci zhig bskyed/ /'di ni mtshungs pa med kyis rim gro skyed/ /de ltar byang chub semasadapa' de gcig pu khyad par du 'phagasapar gyur to/ /de nasashākya de dag gis smras pa/ gzhon nu 'di la stobs kyi khyad par ci yod pa'ang sad par bya'o/ /de nasabyang chub semasadapa' phyogasagacig tu 'dug nas/ shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya po de dag kyang dus gcig tu so so nas stobs 'gyed par gyur te/ shākya gzhon nu sum cu rtsa gnyis shig 'tshogs nas byang chub sems dpa' la brgal ba ltar chas te 'khod do/ /de'i nang nas dga' bo dang / kun dga' bo gnyis kyis byang chub sems dpa' la stobs brgal ba'i phyir drung du phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lag gis reg ma thag tu de gnyisakasakyang byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang gzi brjid ma bzod de sa la 'gyel lo/ /de'i 'og tu shākya gzhon nu lha sbyin nga rgyal can mthu snyems pa de stobs kyi nga rgyal dang shākya'i nga rgyal gyis snyems la/ byang chub sems dpa' la sngo zhing thams 89
cad dang ldan pa'i ltad mo pa'i dkyil 'khor la bskoralha/ bsgyingasanasabyang chub semsdpa' la stobs brgal to/ /de nasabyang chub semasadapas ma brtabs shing mi rings par stangasabazang por gzhon nu lha sbyin lag pagayasapasabateg ste bsad pa'i blosam yin gyi nga rgyal bcag pa'i phyir byamasapa'i semasakyisanam mkha' lasabaskor bskor te sa'i steng du bor yang de'i lusalaganod par gyur pa med do/ /de nasabyang chub semasadapasasmrasapa/ de lta buganod par 'gyur bsachog gis thams cad gcig tu 'dusate brgal bar gyisashig de nasade dag thamasacad nga rgyal gyis rlom zhing byang chub sems dpa' la rub par gyur to/ /de nas de dag byang chub sems dpa' la reg ma thag tu byang chub semasadapa'i dpal dang gzi brdzid dang lus kyi mthu ma bzod de/ byang chub semasadapasareg pa tsam gyisasal 'gyel bar gyurato/ /de nas lha dang mi brgya stong de dag e ma a la la zhes zer zhing / ca co dang ga zha'i sgra brgya stong phyung ngo / /nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod pa'i lha'i bu dgagisakyang metog gi char chen po mngon par phab ste/ dbyangs gcig tu tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /phyogasabacu'i semasacan gang rnamasaji snyed pa/ /de dag rgyad chen stobasapo che 'dra la/ /cig car skyesabu'i mchog larbab gyur kyang / /reg pa tsam gyisasal 'gyel bar 'gyur/ /lhun po ri rab rdo rje'i 'khor yug dang / /phyogasabacu dag na ri gzhan gang yod pa/ /lag pas mnyesashing rmeg med phyer rlog na/ /mi lusasnying po med pa mtshar ci che/ /'di ni shing dbang mchog drung sdang ba'i rgyad/ /dpung bcaphubadud rnamasargyal mtshan sder bcar+sāpa/ /nag po'irtsa lag byamasapa'i stobs kyisa'ajoms/ /bla med byang chub zhi bar 'tshang yang rgya ༈ |de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de gcig pu khyad par du 'phags par gyur to/ /de nas shākya lag na be con can gyisashākya gzhon nu de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /'di 90
