dag ni sad kyang zin/ mthong yang zin gyisad ni 'phong zhig bstan par gyisashig de'i tshe kun dga' bosargyang gragasaganyisakyi pha rol tu lcagasakyi rngabacug 'ben du btsugs so/ /de'i 'og tu lha sbyin gyisargyang gragasabazhi'i pha rol tu lcagasakyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugs so/ /de'i 'og tu mdzesadaga' bosargyang grags drug gi pha rol tu lcagasakyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugs so/ /de'i 'og tu shākya lag na be con can gyis rgyang grags brgyad kyi pha rolatu lcagasakyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugasaso/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas rgyang grags bcu'i pha rol tu lcagasokyi rnga gcig 'ben du btsugs te/ de'i drung du shing ta la bdun dngar nas de'i pha rol tu lcags kyi phag rgod kyi gzugs 'khrul 'khor du byasapa gcig btsugs so/ /de nas kun dga' bosargyang gragasaganyisakyi pha rol na rnga'i 'ben 'dug pa la 'phangasan phog par gyur te/de phan chod kyi la phog par ma nusaso/ /lha sbyin gyis rgyang grags bzhi'i pha rol na rnga'i 'ben 'dug pa la 'phangasan phog par gyur te/ de phan chad kyi la phog par ma nusaso/ /mdzes dga' bos rgyang gragasadrug gi pha rol na rnga'i 'ben 'dug pa la 'phangs na phog par gyur te/ de phan chad kyi la phog par ma nus so/ /lag na be con can gyis rgyang grags brgyad kyi pha rol na rnga'i 'ben 'dug pa la 'phangs na phog par gyur te/ thal byung du phyin nas de phan chad kyi la phog par ma nusaso/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' la gzhu gang dang gang byin pa de dag la la ni gzhu rgyud chad/ la la ni chag nas byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ grong khyer 'di na gzhu gzhan la la bdag gis bdung bzod pa'am/ lusakyi stobs dang mthu bzod pa mchis sam/ rgyal pos smrasapa/ bu yod do/ /gzhon nus smras pa/ lha de lta bu gang na mchis/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bu khyod kyi mes seng ge'i za 'gram zhes bya ba byung ste/ de'i gnam ru da ltar lha khang na spos dang phreng bas 91
mchod de/ de ni susakyang bdung bar yang mi nusan/ dgang bar lta smosakyang ci dgosapa zhig yod do/ /byang chub semagudapasasmrasapa/ lha de blang dugasol/ sad par bgyi'o/ /de nas gzhu de blangs te 'ongs pa dang / shākya gzhon nu thams cad kyis nan tan gyi mchog gis bsgrims kyang gzhu de bdung bar yang ma nus na dgang bar lta smos kyang ci dgos te ma nus so/ /de nas gzhu de shākya lag na be con can gyisalus kyi mthu stobsthams cad phyung ste/ gzhu de bdung bar brgal na ma bdungs so/ /de nas gzhu de byang chub semasadapa' la byin no/ /de nasabyang chub semasadapasagazhu de blangasate stan lasma langasapar skyil mo krung phyed bcasate/ lag pa g.yon pasabazung nasalag pa g.yaspa'i sor mo gcig gisabadungasaso/ /gzhu de de ltar bdungasapa'i tshe ser skya'i gnasakyi grong khyer chen po thams cad du sgra mngon par grag par gyur to/ /grong khyer gyi mi thamscad kyang skrag skrag por gyur te/ gcig la gcig 'dri zhing 'di ltar ci'i sgra zhig ces zer ro/ /de la la la na re gzhon nu don grub kyisamesakyi gnam ru bdungasanasade'i sgra byung ba ni 'di yin no zhesazer ro/ /de nas lha dang mi brgya stong dag e ma.a la la zhes zer zhing ca co dang ga zha'i sgra brgya stong 'byin par gyur to/ /nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod pa'i lha'i bu dag gis kyang /rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang / skye bo'itshogs phal po che de dag la tshigasasu bcad de smraspa / gdan las ma bzhengs brtsal ba ma mchis su/ /thub pas gnam ru 'di 'dra bdungs pa las/ /gdon mi 'tshal bar dgongs pa rdzogs gyur te/ /bdud kyi sde bcom myur du thub par byon/ /dge slong dag de ltar byang chub sems dpas mda' blangs nas gzhu de dang sbyar te bkang nasa'aphangs pa'i mthu stobs kyis kun dga' bo'i 'ben du rnga btsugasapa dang / lha sbyin gyi 'ben du rnga bstaXsapa dang / mdzes dga' poli'aben du rnga
btsugs pa dang / lag na be con can gyi 'ben du rnga btsugs pa de dag thams cad las thal nas rgyang grags bcu'i pha rol tu bdag gi 'ben lcags kyi rnga btsugs pa dang /shing ta la bdun dngar ba dang / phag rgod kyi gzugs 'khrul 'khor du byas pa las kyang thal te mda' de sa la zug nasami snang bar nub par gyur to/ /saphyogs gang du mda' de zug ste nub pa'i sa phyogs der khron pa lta bu'i khung zhig byung nas da ltar yang mda'i khron pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /de'i tshe lha dang mi brgya stong dage ma a la la zhes zer zhing ca co dang ga zha'i sgra brgya stong 'byin par gyur to/ khukya'i tshogasade dag thamasacad kyang ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba thob ste/ kye ngo mtshar to/ /'disani bslabs kyang ma bslabasapar rtsal gyi shesapa de lta bu dang ldan pa ni ngo mtshar che'o zhes zer ro/ /nam mkha'i dkyil na 'khod pa'i lha'i bu dag gis kyang rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang / skye bo'itshogs phal po che de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /de ltar ngo mtshar yang ci che ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni sayi snying po sngon gyi sangasargyasagadan la bzhugs/ /zhi gnas gnam ru thogs shing stong pa bdag med mda' rnams kyis/ /nyon mongs dgra rnams bcom ste lta ba'i dra ba dral nas su/ /byang chub dam pa zhi ba rdul med mya ngan med pa 'thob/ /de skad cesasmrasanas/ lha'i bu de dag gisabyang chub semasadapa' la lha'i me tog dag gis mngon par gtor te dong ngo / /de bzhin du mchongs pa dang / yi ge dang /lag rtsis dang / rtsis dang / grangs dang / gyad kyi 'dzin stangs dang / rgyang nas phog pa dang / bang dang / tshar dang / rkyal dang / 'phong dpyad dang / glang po che'i gnyar zhon pa dang / rta rtsal dang / shing rta'i thabs dang / mda' gzhu'i thabs dang / brtan pa dang /mthu dang / dpa' ba dang / 'gyed stobs dang / lcags kyus sgyur thabs dang / zhags pa'i thabs dang / rma dun du bsnur ba dang / phyir bsnur ba dang / bzur ba dang / 'dzin 93
stangasadang / gom stabasadang / thor tshugasadang / gcad pa dang / dral ba dang / dbug pa dang / gzhig pa dang / gsheg pa dang / mi 'chor bar 'phog pa dang / gnad du 'phog pa dang / sgra grag par 'phog pa dang / tshabs che ba dang / cho lo'irtsed mo dang / snyan dngags sbyar ba dang / lam dang / ri mo dang / gzugasadang / gzugasakyi lasadang / thabasakyi dpyad dang / me'i lasadang / rol molidabyangasasgra dang / gar dang / glu dang / yi ge klag pa'i mig 'or dang / gtam dang / bshad gad dang / rtsed mo dang / bro dang / sgeg pa dang /phreng ba brgyu ba dang / rlung yab g.yob pa dang / nor bu tshon gyisabasgyur ba dang / gosatshon gyisabasgyur ba dang / mig 'phrul gyi cho ga dang / rmi lam gyi dpyad dang / bya'i skad dang /bud med kyi mtshan dang / skyesapa'i mtshan dang / glang po che'i mtshan dang / rta'i mtshan dang /ba lang gi mtshan dang / ra'i mtshan dang / lug gi mtshan dang / khyi'i mtshan dang / shes gsal dang / sgra ngesapar sbyor ba dang / nga ro sgyur ba dang / sngon gyi rabs dang / sngon byung ba dang / rig byed dang / lung bstan pa dang / nges pa'i tshig dang / yi ge lci yang dang /tshig bsdeb pa dang / mchod sbyin gyi cho ga dang / skar ma'i lugs dang / grangs can gyi lugs dang / rnal 'byor gyi lugs dang / lasakyi tshogasadang / bye brag pa'i lugasadang /nor gyi rig pa dang / phur bu'i lugs dang / chu'i lugasadang / lha ma yin gyi lugs dang /bya dang ri dwagasakyi skad dang / gtan tshigs kyi rig pa dang / rgya skyegs kyi 'khrul 'khor dang / spra tshil gyi lasadang / 'drub shur dang / brko bzhog dang / lo ma dra ba dang / spos sbyar ba la sogs pa'i sgyu rtsal 'jig rten pa dang lha dang mi las 'das pa thams cad la'ang byang chub semasadapa' 'ba' zhig khyad par du 'phagasapar gyur to/ /de'i tshe shākya lag na be con can gyis rang gi bu mo sa 'tsho ma/ byang chub sems dpa' la phul lo/ /rgyal po zas gtsang mas kyang / de rim gyis bag mar blangasate byang chub sems dpa' la 94
phul lo/ /de na byang chub semasadapasa'ajig rten dang mthun pa tsam du bya ba'i phyir bud med brgyad khri bzhi stong gi nang du 'dug ste/ dga' zhing rtse la yongasasu spyod pa ston to/ /bud med brgyad khri bzhi stong de dag thamasacad kyi nang na/ shākya'i bu mo sa'atsho ma btsun molimachog tu dbang bskur bar gyur to/ /de na shākya'i bu mo sa'atsho ma gyosasgyug gam nang mi gang mthong yang rung ste/ gdong mi sbed do/ /de dag kyang de la bag sar mo ni zhum zhum por 'dug pa'i rigasan/ 'di ni rtag tu ma g.yogs so zhes 'phya smod cing mi snyan par zer ro/ /de'i tshe shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho masagatam de thos nas nang mi rnams kyi mdun du 'dug ste/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /'dug dang 'greng dang 'chag pa la/ /'phagasapa dag ni ma g.yogasamadzes/ /nor bu rin chen 'od gsal ba/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mor gsal na mdzes/ /'phagasapa 'gro na'ang mdzesapa ste/ /'ong na'ang de bzhin mdzespa yin/ /'greng ba 'am de bzhin 'dug pa dang / /thamasacad du yang 'phagasapa mdzes/ /'phagasapa smra na'ang mdzesapa ste/ /mi smrar 'dug kyang de bzhin mdzes/ /dper na ka la ping ka ni/ /mthong dang sgra thosade bzhin no/ /kusha'ishosani gyon pa dang / /gosangan gyon dang lusarid pa/ /de ni rangagigazi yisamadzes/ /yonatan ldan pa yonatan brgyan/ /gang la sdig pa med gyur pa/ /'phagasapa kun tu dge ba yin/ /byisapa sdig pa byed pa ni/ /ji snyed brgyan kyang mdzes ma yin/ /gang dag snying la sdig pa yod cing tshig 'jam pa de dag dug gi bum par bdud rtsi blugasapa bzhin/ /brag gi ser ga rtsub pa lta bur nang yang rtsub/ /de 'dra de dag sprul gyi kha la nyug pa bzhin/ /desapa de dag gan du kun 'ong kun phyag 'tshal/ /'bab stegadragatham༄9cad lta bur 'gro ba kun gyi gsos/ /'phagadrangapa dag ni rtag tu 'o zhos bkang bum 'dra/ /bdag nyid dag pa de 'dra mthong na bkra shis dge /gang dag sdig pa'i grogasapo yun ring yongasaspong zhing / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po 95
ches ni yongs bzung la/ /sdig pa rnam spong sangs rgyas chos la mngon chags pa/ /de lta bu dag mthong ba bkra shis 'bras bu yod/ /gang dag lus bsdams lus kyi skyon rnams rab bsdams dang / /gang dag tshig bsdamasartag tu tshig 'chal med gyur la/ /dbang po sbasashing shin tu bsdamasal yid dang ba/ /de lta bu dgagadong g.yogasate ni ci zhig bya/ /gal te lusal gos ni stong gis g.yogasagyur kyang / /gang dag sems bshusango tsha med cing khrel med dang / /gang dag 'di 'dra'i yon tan med cing bden tshig med/ /de dag sgren mo bas kyang sgren mor 'jig rten rgyu/ /gang zhig sems sbas rtag tu dbang po bsdams gyur cing / /bdag gi khyos chog semasacan gzhan la mi sems pa/ /de 'dra ba dag nyi zla bzhin du ma g.yogs snang / /de 'dra ba dag gdong g.yogasate ni ci zhig bya/ /gzhan yang drang sgong bdag nyid che dang gzhan sems blo mkhas dang / /de bzhin lha tshogs dag gis kho molibasam pa dang / /kho mo'i tshul khrims yon tan sdom dang bag yod mkhyen/ /de lta bas na kho mos gdong bkab ci zhig dgos/ /dge slong dag rgyal po zas gtsang mas shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma'i spobs pa dang bstan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnam pa 'di lta bu 'di thos so/ /thos nas kyang tshim zhing mgu la yi rangs te rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas/ ras bcos bu bzang po rin po che du mas spras pa zung gcig dang / mu tig gi do shal srang bye ba brgya stong ri ba dang / mu tig dmar po bzang pos spros pa'i gser gyi phreng bas shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho ma la bkab nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /kho bo'ibu ni yonaston ci 'dras brgyan pa dang / /mna' ma rang gi yonatan ji ltar rab smra ba/ /semasacan dag pa de gnyisaphrad par gyur pa ni/ /mas dang mar gyi nying khu ji ltar 'dra ba bzhin/ /sgyu rtsal bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'/ / / / 96
ra༅ñja/ /ston pa thugasarje can gyis btsun mo drug khri bden pa la bkod tshul dang sku sras dgra gcan 'dzin gyi ma yum gragadranga'adzin ma ston pa la chags tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus/'dul ba lungagazhi lasabatus/gang gi nyi ma la byang chub sems dpa' phyir byung ba de nyid kyi nyi ma la grags 'dzin ma sems can dang ldan par gyur to/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' dka' ba spyad pa de'i tshe btsun mo yang dka' ba spyad pa la zhugs pas grags 'dzin ma mngal zhum par gyur to/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dka' ba spyad pa don med par thugs su chud nas ci bder dbugs 'byin pa dang / ci bder dbugs rngub pa dang /'bras chan dang zan dron gyi zhal zas mang po gsol zhing / mar dang til mar gyis sku byugs nas chu 'jam pos sku 'khru bar mdzad pa de'i tshe btsun mo yang ci bder dbugs 'byin pa dang / ci bder dbugs rngub pa dang / 'bras chan dang zan dron gyi kha zas mang po za zhing / mar dang til mar gyisalusabyugs nas chu 'jam posalusa'aphru bar byed pa de'i tshe mngal de yang slar rgyasapar gyur to/ /de'i mngal gyi mtshan ma skyes par gyur pa dang / shākya rnams kyis co dri ba dang bcasapar smrasapa/ byang chub semasadapa' dka' thub kyi nagasasu bzhung nasakhyod kyis byi phyin to/ /des smrasapa/ kho mo〉sdig pa zhi bsabyi ma phyin to/ /ji mngon khyod yid chespar bya'o/ /ji tsam zhig na de khye'u zhig baXs te/ de nyi ma gang la btsas pa'i nyi ma de
nyid la zla ba sgra gcan gyis zin to/ /de btsasapa'i btsas ston byas nas khye'u'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed do/ /de'i nye du rnams kyis smras pa/ 'di btsas pa na zla ba sgra gcan gyis zin pas de bas na khye'u'i ming ni sgra gcan zin du gdags so zhes btags so/ /gzhon nu btsas pa na shākya rnamasayang dang yang du gleng ba kho nar byed nas/ des bden pa gsol ba byas te/ sgra gcan zin bzang po byang chub sems dpa'i pang tshad kyi rdo la zhon nas rol pa rdzing gi nang du bcug ste/ gal te 'di byang chub sems dpa' las skyes pa yin na 'phyo bar gyur cig ces de bcug pa dang / de pha rol du byung ngo / /desapha rol nasatshu rol du 'ong bar gyur cig ces smras pa dang / de pha rol nasatshu rol du 'ongs nasade rnamasango mtshar skyesapar gyur to/ /grags 'dzin mas smras pa/ shes ldan dag ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' las skyes pa yin zhing kho mos byi ma phyin par yang yid ches par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis lo drug gisamangon par rdzogs par sangasargyasate lo bcu gnyis 'das pa na ser skya'i gzhir byon nasanyi ma gcig ni rgyal polipho brang du gdugs tshod gsol/ nyi ma gcig ni btsun molinang du gsol ba de'i tshe grags 'dzin ma 'di snyam du sems te/gang gis na bcom ldan 'das bdag gis dbang du 'gyur ba'i thabs legs pa ci zhig yod snyam mo/ /ser skya'i gzhi na kun tu rgyu mo dbang du bya ba la sogs pa las rnams la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yod de/ grags 'dzin mas de la kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin nas che zhe kār ṣā pa ṇa 'di rnams las dbang du bya ba byos la skur cig des dbang du bya ba'i la du zhig grags 'dzin ma la bskur ba dang / grags 'dzin mas sgra gcan zin gyi lag tu byin nas smras pa/ bu khyod kyi yab gang yin pa de la phul cig sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis de lta bu mi mkhyen pa dang / mi gzigs pa dang / thugs su mi chud pa 98
dang / rnam par mi rig pa ci yang mi mnga' bas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/grags 'dzin ma la mi snyan pa grag gis de spang bar bya'o snyam nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas lnga brgya sprul pa dang / sgra gcan zin gyis sangs rgyas thams cad la brtags nas bcom ldan 'das rgan pa'i ngang la bzhugs pa la phul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhes nas slar yang de la byin te sgra gcan zin gyis zos so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yon bsngo ba mdzad nas gshegs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes bzhin gzhon nu sgra gcan zin bzang po 'brang nas slar bzlog kyang ngus te slar ldog tu ma btub bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyisadagongs pa/ sems can 'di ni srid pa tha ma pa yin pas 'dis khyim gyi gnas pas gnas mi phod do snyam mo/ /sgra gcan zin gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal 'tshos pa dang / rgyal po zas gtsang btsun mo'ibud med dang shākya rnamasadang bcasapa ngo mtshar skyes nas/ grags 'dzin ma la lhag par mngon par dga' bar gyur to/ /de nas grags 'dzin ma'i mi snyan pa thams cad kyi thams cad du med par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhon nu sgra gcan zin bzang po rab tu dbyung bar brtsams pa/ rgyal po zas gtsang gis thos nas de bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te gzhon nu sgra gcan zin bzang po rab tu 'byin par mdzad par nges par lta na/ deng gi gdugs gcig la mchis su gsol cig dang / 'di la de'i bar du bdag gisamachod pa bgyi'o/ /rgyal po zasagatsang gisasgra gcan zin gyi skye bolidus ston chen po byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyisatshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu gzhon nu sgra gcan zin rab tu byung shig btsun pa shāka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshe dang ldan pa shā

skye bo ni dz+nyo'aphrul la myur du sems gtod pa yin pas ma la ngas pho brang du dz+nyo'aphrul gyi cho 'phrul bstan pasadad par bya'o snyam du dgongs te/ shar phyogasakyi steng gi bar snang la mngon par 'phags nas spyod lam rnam pa bzhi mdzad de/ 'di lta ste 'chag pa dang /bzhengs pa dang / bzhugs pa dang / mnal ba mdzad do/ /me'i khams la yang snyoms par 'jug par mdzad de/ me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs pa na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku lasa'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs dag 'byin par mdzad de/ 'di lta ste/sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shel gyi kha dog dag go /gzhan yang cho 'phrul zung du ston par byed de/ sku'i smad nas 'bar bar mdzad la sku'i stod nas chu grang molirgyun 'bebs par mdzad de/ sku'i stod nas 'bar bar mdzad la sku'i smad nas chu grang molirgyun 'bebs par mdzad do/ /shar phyogs la ji lta ba bzhin du nyo dang / nub dang / byang phyogs su yang de bzhin no/ /phyogs bzhir rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi bstan nas rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul mngon par 'du pa// ༵ gyur bsdus te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la de nas bud med de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dag mthong nas dad par gyur te/ shing rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la gtugs te chos mnyan pa'i phyir spyan snga na 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ba dang / khams dang / rang bzhin mkhyen nas/ gang thos pas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi so sor yang dag par khong du chud par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ sa 'tsho ma dang / ri dwags skyes la sogs pa bud med drug khris rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ /grags 107
'dzin ma ni lhag par 'dod chags kyisazil gyisanon pas bden pa mthong bar ma byas te/ de 'di snyam du semasate/ ma la bdag gis bcom ldan 'dasaro〉sred pasadabang du bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ rang nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi ched du bza' ba dang btung ba dag g.yosanas bdag rang gi lag nasabacom ldan 'dasal 'bul bar bya'o zhesapa dge slong rnamasakyisathosanasabacom ldan 'dasal gsol ba/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das la grags 'dzin ma ni rang gi lag nas bgyis pa'i ro〉sred pas dbang du bgyi bar 'tshal lagasaso/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga sngon 'dod chags dang bcas/ zhe sdang dang bcas/ gti mug dang bcasapasaro so sor nyamasasu myong zhing ro so so'ichagasapa nyams su myong ba lasad ltar nga 'dod chagasadang bral/ zhe sdang dang bral/gti mug dang bral te/ ro so sor nyamasasu myong yang ro la so sor chagasapar 'gyur ba'i nyams su myong ba med na/ da nga la grags 'dzin mas rolidred pas ji ltar dbang du bya/dge slong rnams the tshom skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasal zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gragasa'adzin mas dbang du bgyi ba'i slad du la dus dbang du bgyi bar brtsams pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong da ltar gyi 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi ji ltar 'dis 'das pa'i dus na yang dga' bar 'gyur bas dbang du byas pa de nyon cig dge slong dag sngon byung ba grong rdal med pa'i dgon pa'i gnas me rtog dang / 'bras bu dang / chu dang / rtsa ba kun sum tshogs pa zhig na drang srong dka' thub drag pa rtsa ba dang / 'bras bu dang / chu la longs spyod pa/ pags pa dang lo ma gyon pa zhig gnas te/ des mngon par shes pa lnga mngon sum du byas pas de la ri dwags gdug pa /sdus kyang 'dris pa'i gnas pas bsti gnas
na gnas so/ /de phyogs gzhan zhig tu gci ba'i phyir song ba na ri dwags mo zhig rjes bzhin rjesabazhin du 'breng ngo / /des khu ba dang bcas par gcisapa de ri dwagasamo des 'thungasanas lcesamo mtshan la bldags so/ /semasacan rnamasakyi lasakyi rnam par smin pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pas sems can dang ldan par gyur to/ /de 'byung ba'i dus su phyogs der 'ongs nas khye'u zhig byung ba dang des dri bsnams na ris mi mthun pa'i semasacan yin te/ skrag nas gcin rtug shor nas bor te song ngo / /ji tsam zhig na drang srong de phyogs der phyin pa dang / des khye'u de mthong nas 'di su'i bu yin snyam pa'i bsam pa la zhugs pa na/ bdag nyid kyi yin par mthong nas des de bsti gnas su khyer te bsnun bsnyod nas bskyed de/ de chen por gyur pa dang mgo la ri dwags kyi rwa skyes par spri( phyar/ bho/ la ri dwags kyi rwa 'dra ba yod pas drang srong rwa can drang srong rwa can zhes bya ji tsam na drang srong de nad kyis thebs par gyur nas/ drang srong de dang mthun pa'i sman rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byas kyang de'i nad zhi bar ma gyur te/ gang gi tshe de 'chi ba la thug pa'i tshor ba skyes nas ring po mi thogs par 'chi bar 'gyur ba de'i tshe des bu de la smras pa/ bu bsti gnas 'dir phyogs sna tshogs na gnas pa'i drang srong rnams dus dus su 'ong gis khyod nga la dga' bas de rnams la kun tu spyod pa'i chos kyis 'ongs pa legs so zhes brjod pas yang dag par dga' bar bya zhing / stan la mgron du bos la rtsa ba dang / 'bradragabu ci nus par stobs shig ces smras nas/ bsagadragapa kun gyi mtha' zad cing / /mthon po kun gyi mtha' lhung 'gyur/ /phrad pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ba ste/ /gson pa'i mtha' ni 'chi ba yin/ /zhes bya ba yin pas dus kyi chos dang ldan par gyur to / —/des de drang srong gi chos bzhin du bsregs te/ de pha dang bral ba'i mya ngan gyis non 109
pas skyo ba skyes nas mngon par shes pa lnga mngon sum du byas so/ /des dus gzhan zhig na chu'i don du bum pa khyer nas song ba na lhas char dbab par brtsamasaso/ /de chusabum pa bkang nas khyer te 'ong ba 'gred nas rdeg 'chos so/ /drang sgong rnams ni myur du khro ba yin pas des chu nyung zhig blangs te gtor nas dmod pa bor ba spyod pa ngan pa can khyod kyis bum pa chus bkang ba chag par byas kyis/ de lta bas na khyod nyi ma 'di nas bzung ste lo bcu gnyis su char mi 'bebs par gyur cig ces byas pas lha char mi 'bebs par gyur to/ /bā rā ṇa sīr mu ge chen po byung nas skye bo'itshogs kun tu dong ngo / /rgyal pos ltas mkhan rnams bkug ste smras pa/ shes ldan dag su zhig gi mthus na lha char mi 'bebs/ de rnamasakyis smrasapa/ drang srong khros pasalagasaso/ /ji ste drang srong de dka' thub de la bskyod par nusan lha de bzhin du char 'bebs kyi g.yin du na ni ma lags so/ /rgyal po sems khong du chud cing 'dug pa dang / btsun mo dang / blon po dang / gzhon nu rnamasakyis smras pa/ lha ci'i slad du thugasami dgyes/ desasmras pa/ drang srong khros pas lha char mi 'bebs la ltas mkhan rnams kyang 'di skad ces gal te drang sgong de dka' thub de las bskyod na de bzhin du lha char 'bebs kyi/ g.yin du na ma yin no zhes zer te/dka' thub de la su zhig gisabaskyod par nus pa mi shesaso/ /rgyal po de'i bu mo zhi ldan ma zhes bya ba des smras pa/ lha gal te de lta na thugs las chung ngur mdzod cig dang / bdag gis drang srong de dka' thub de las ji nas kyang g.yos par gyur pa de ltar bgyi'o/ /des smras pa/ thabs ci zhig gis bya/ des smras pa/bdag dang bud med gzhan rnams bram ze rnams la gsang tshig 'don du stsol cig gru zam gyi bsti gnas me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / chu phun sum tshogs pa bgyid du stsol cig des de dang bud med gzhan dag kyang bram ze la gsang tshig slob tu bcug go /gru 110
zam gyi bsti gnas kyang byed du bcug go /de nas des dbang du bya ba'i rdzas dang chang gis bkang ba'i 'brasabu de dag dang / gzhan yang 'bras bu rnam par bkra ba sna tshogsbyed du bcug nas/ drang srong gi cha byad du byas te/ de rtswadang shing shun gyon nasabud med rnams dang lhan cig bram ze rnams la gsang tshig 'don cing de'i bsti gnas su lhags pa dang / drang srong la slob ma rnams kyis smras pa/ mkhan po khyod kyi bsti gnas su drang srong mang du lhagasaso/ /drang srong rnams lhags pa legs kyis nang du shog cig de rnams nang du zhugs pa des mthong nas tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ brtags pa med par 'gying zhing 'gro ba dang / /bzhin yang kha spu rnams dang bral gyur cing / /'di rnams brang ni mtho dman gyur pa ste/ /e ma drang srong cha byad sngon ma byung / /de de rnams la the tshom gyi kun nas dkris pa'i blos rtsa ba dang 'bras bu bstabs so/ /de rnams kyis de dag zos nas drang sgong de la smras pa/ khyod kyi 'bras bu 'di dag ni rtsub pa kha ba bska ba yin gyi/bdag cag gi chu nang gi bsti gnasade na yod pa'i 'bras bu rnams ni bdud rtsi dang 'dra ba yod de/ 'di ltar khyod bdag cag gi bsti gnasasu spyan 'dren to/ /desakhas blangs nas de de rnams dang gru zam gyi skyed mos tshal du zhugs nas des de la dbang du bya ba'i rdzas chang gis bkang ba dang ldan pa'i na li ke ra'i 'brasabu rnams dang / gzhan dag kyang byin no/ /de chang gis myos pa dang dbang du bya ba'i rdzas kyi sbyor bas de de dang lhan cig mi tshangs par spyad pas rdzu 'phrul yongs su nyams so/ /char la mngon par dga' ba'i lhasasprin kun nas bsdus pa dang drang srong desabakag go /zhi ldan mas smras pa/ da dung khyod kyis bdag nyid su yin pa mi shes sam/ des de'i 'dod chagasakyi zhagasapasabacingasanasargyal po la phul nasalha drang srong de ni 'di lagasaso/ /de nas lhas char dbab par brtsams nas lo legs par gyur to/ /rgyal pos zhi ldan ma 111
'khor dang bcas te drang srong de la chung mar byin no/ /des zhi ldan ma spangs nas gzhan dag dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod pa la zhugs pa na/ de la zhi ldan ma phrag dog gi kun nasadakrisapa'i snying gis de la bkur sti ma yin pa bya bar brtsams pa dang / de nas phar cig tshur cig rtsod pas mchil lham dang bcasapa'i rdog pas mgor bsnun pa dang /des bsams pa/ sprin gyi 'brug sgra yang bdag gis mnags par mi bzod na da ni 'dod chags kyi zhags pas bcings na bud med tsam gyis kyang brnyas sam snyam nas desabartson 'grusal gnas pas slar yang mngon par shesapa lnga mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi drang srong gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /zhi ldan ma gang yin pa de ni grags 'dzin ma 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang 'disnga ro〉sred pas dbang du byas so/ /da ltar yang 'dis la dus dbang du bya ba la zhugs so / |gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das pho brang du gdugs tshod gsol nas phyi rol du byung ba de'i tshe grags 'dzin ma khyim thab kyi byams pa dang bral lo snyam ste re thag chad nas khang thog tu 'dzegs te bdag nyid mchongs so/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos can yin pas bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis de blangs so/ /dge slong rnams the tshom/ skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi slad du grags 'dzin ma khang thog nas bdag nyid mchongs pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar gyi 'di 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ ji ltar 'dis 'das pa'i dus na yang nga'i phyir bdag nyid bor ba de nyon cig dge slong dag sngon byung ba grong khyer thā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po tshangs sbyin zhes bya ba zhig byung ste/ de dus gzhan zhig na ri dwags shor zhing rim gyis song ste ri sul zhig tu 112
phyin pa dang / desade na mi'am ci pho dang / mi'am ci mo gnyisalas mi'am ci pho ni nyal/mi'am ci mo ni ma nyal ba zhig mthong nas rgyal pos gzhu rna drung du bkang ba'i mdas mi'am ci pho gnad du bsnun nas srog dang phral te/ rgyal pos mi'am ci mo chung ma'i don du bzung nas khrid de song ba las des smras pa/ lha re zhig gzhes la de'i bar du bdag gisami'am ci'i ro la mchod pa bgyid na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyal pos smrasapa/re zhig gang du 'gro bar 'gyur/ de la mchod pa ji ltar byed pa blta'o snyam nas des de la gnang ngo / /de nas des mi'am ci'i ro de la shing gi phung po byas nas me sbar te bdaka nyid mchongs so/ /lhas tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ mi'am ci mo dga' spyad ces/ /don gzhan du ni bsamasapa las/ /gzhan du yongs su bsgyur byas pas/ /sgog chags gnyisani bsad par gyur/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi mi'am ci gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /mi'am ci mo gang yin pa de ni grags 'dzin ma 'di nyid yin te/ de na yang 'disanga'i phyir bdag nyid me phung du mchongs so/ /da ltar yang 'disanga'i phyir khang thog nas bdag nyid mchongs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ da ni grags 'dzin ma gdul ba'i dus la bab kyis/ ma la 'di ngas 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa nas bsgral bar bya'o snyam du dgongs nas de la gang thos pas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yang dag par khong du chud par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ grags 'dzin ma 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byasate/ de dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas ji tsam na dgra bcom mar gyur pa dang / de rang gi rigs rgyud dang mthun par bya ba dang / 'phags pa'i lam thob pas dge slong ma rnams kyi nang du dgos pa byung ba rnams 113
la shin dzo (( parnyihā rnyi/ spra sdos/ /kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga'i nyan thos kyi dge slong ma rnams la 'dzem pa dang ldan pa'i mchog ni 'di lta ste sgra gcan:na gyi ma gragasa'adzin ma 'di yin no/ /zhesagasungasaso/ / / /
rabyañja/ /bran mo zhig gis chos tshig gcig blor bzung nas shi bas bu mo mu tig can du skyes te sangs rgyas kyi bris sku mthong nas 'bras bu thob tshul/'dul ba lungagazhi lasangatus/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yul ser skya'i gzhi n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na bzhugasaso/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis shākya rnamasabaden pa la bkod pa de'i tshe de rnams bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dus gsum du 'dong bar byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang de rnams la yang dang yang du chos 'chad par mdzad do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang gi kun tu spyod pa ni shākya'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dus gsum du 'gro bar byed do/ /ji tsam na dus gzhan zhig na bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i gung la bzhugs nas sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi dngas ma lta bu'i chos bshad pa na 'khor brgya phrag du ma dbang po rnams mi g.yo bas bcom ldan 'das lasasnyan pa snyan pa'i chos nyan par byed do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang yang chos mnyan pa'i phyir rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po dang /rgyal polimathu chen pos shākya'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste/ desachosamanyan nas song ngo / /de nas shākya ming chen gyis bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas chos mnyan te dad pa skyesanas rang gi khyim du song ste smrasapa/ kye ma'o sangsrgyas/ kye ma'o chos/ kye ma'o dge 'dun/ sangs rgyas byung ba ni bdag 'bras bu dang bcas pa yin no/ /ming chen gyi chung ma da/ 1pas smras pa/ rje'i sras de ci lags/ des
smrasapa/ deng bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dor brgya phrag du ma'i mdun du 'di 'dra ba'i chos bshad pa mdzad de/ de thos pas srog chags brgya stong phrag du mas khyad par chen po rtogasaso/ /desasmras pa/ rje'i srasasangasargyas byung ba ni bdag 'bras bu dang bcas pa yin no zhes gsungasapa gang lagasapa de mad de/ sangasargyasabyung ba ni khyed cag kho na la 'bras bu dang bcas pa lags kyi bdag cag la ni ma lags so/ /ci'i phyir 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ba ni skyes pa rnams kyi phyir lags kyi bud med rnams kyi phyir ni ma lags so/ /des smras pa/ bzang mo de skad ma smra zhig bcom ldan 'das ni sems cane thams cad la phan pa dang / thugs brtse ba yin gyisasong zhig dang /khyod kyisakyang bcom ldan 'dasakyi spyan snga nasachos thosapar 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ lha shākya'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i phyir dus gsum du bzhud la/ lha'i mdun du mngon sum du bdag gis chos mnyan pa g.yar tsha lags so/ /'di ltar gal te lha snga dro bzhud na bdag gis kyang slad dro bcom ldan 'das las chos mnyan par bgyi'o/ khrakya ming chen gyis bsamasapa/ lha la gsol gyis 'gro'o snyam pa las yang bsams pa/ rang gi chung ma'i ched la lta la gsol ba byed mi phod kyis/ lha ni skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo la bkur sti mang du byed de/ de'i tshig nyan par 'gyur bsade la don 'di rig par bya'o snyam nas/ de skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo go ta spri gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo go ta sī la don de smras pa dang / des smras pa/ bka' bzhin 'tshal/ lha la gsol bar bgyi'o/ /de nas shākya ming chen khyim du song nas shākya rnams kyi chung ma rnams la smras pa dang / de nas shwakya rnams kyi chung ma dang / gzhan dag gi chung ma rnams skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo go ta spri la 'di skad ces smras so/ /go 116
ta spri mkhyen par mdzod cig bdag cag gisabacom ldan 'das 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i mdun du snyan pa snyan pa'i chos sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi dngas ma lta bu bshad pa na 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i dbang po rnams mi g.yo bas bcom ldan 'das las snyan pa snyan pa'i chos nyan to zhes thos nas bdag cag kyang bcom ldan 'das las chos de thos par 'tshal gyis bdag cag gi phyir lha la ci nas kyang lha ni snga dro bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bzhung la/ bdag cag kyang slad dro mchi bar gsol cig desasmrasapa/ phu nu mo dag khyed kyis sems bskyed pa legs te/ rgyal po zas gtsang la brtag gis skad cig sdod cigde nasaskye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo go ta spri rgyal po zas gtsang gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ rgyal po zas gtsang la 'di skad cesasmras so/ /lha mkhyen par mdzod cig bdag gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i gung la bzhugs nas snyan pa snyan pa'i chosasbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi dngasam lta bu bshad pa na 'khor brgya phrag du ma dbang po rnams mi g.yo bas bcom ldan 'das las snyan pa snyan pa'i chos nyan to zhes thos so/ /shākya'i mchis 'brang rnamasakyis kyang de skad thos nasade rnams chos nyan par 'tshal na lha ni snga dro bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar gshegs pa'i rigs so/ /bdag gis kyang shākya'i mchis 'brang rnams ded de bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar slad dro mchi bar bgyi'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ snga dro ni de rnams bsdum pa'i bgyi ba dag bgyid pas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchi ba'i skabs ma mchis so/ /rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i kun tu spyod pa ni gang gi tshe skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo go ta spris tshig smras pa de'i tshe/ lus kyi ba spu zing zhes byed nasalangs te/ re zhig skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo'itshig gi lan ma byin pa de'i bar du mi 'dug pa yin pas des mgo bos btud de smras pa/ gau ta grwa bka' bzhin 'tshal/ de nas skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo gau ta spri shākya'i chung ma lnga brgyas yongs su 117
bskor te/ bcom ldan 'dasakyi spyan sngar chos mnyan pa'i phyir n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra bar song ngo / /ji tsam na shākya ming chen gyi chung ma yang rgyan thamasacad kyisabargyan nasade dang lhan cig song ste/ gzugs dang lang tsho dang ldan zhing rgyan thams cad kyisabargyan pas 'dod chags dang ma bral ba dag chags pa skye bar zhugs pa de tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos mthong nasasmrasapa/ sring mo re zhig khyod kyi rang bzhin gyi gzugasanyid kyang bzang mo lta na sdug pa mdzes pa yin na rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'dir 'ongasapa gang yin pa de ni ma legasapa zhig byas te / bdag nyid chen po 'di dag ni thamasacad 'dod chagaphudang bral ba kho na yang ma yin no zhesade la de skad smrasapa dang / ngo tsha ba snying la phog pas sgyi bo smad nas mtha' gcig tu song ste/ rgyan rnams bkrol nas sems khong du chud cing 'dug pa las/ de'i mngag gzhug ma bu mo bskyed ma zhes bya ba dang / de lhan cig chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'ongs pas des de la bos te smras pa/ bskyed ma song la rgyan 'di dag khyim du zhog la shog cig de ringasapar song nas desakhyim du bzhag ste slar 'ongasaso/ /de nasaskye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo go ta grwa 'khor lnga brgya dang bcom ldan 'dasakyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang chos bshad pa mdzad do/ /chos bshad pa de mdzad pa de'i tshe ji tsam na shākya'i bu mo zhig mgul pa na mu tig gi do shal btags pa la myur ba myur bar lta zhing lag pas nom par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'dasakyisami rtag pa dang ldan pa'i chos bshad par brtsams so/ /'on kyang de chosal mi gtod kyi mu tig gi do shal kho na la rtog par byed do/ /ming chen gyi chung ma dam pas shākya'i bu mo mgul pa na mu tig gi do shal btags pa la myur ba myur bar rtog par byed pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang 'di 118
snyam du semasate/ nyon mongasa'adi 'du byed rnamasa'adi ltar mi rtag par bshad na mu tig gi do shal 'di la lhag par chagasate myur ba myur bar brtag tu ci yod/ gal te bdag gi mu tig gi phreng ba mthong na 'di'i rgyags pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro snyam du bsams nas mngag gzhug ma'i bu mo bskyed ma la smrasapa/ bskyed ma song la kho mo'imu tig gi do shal myur du khyer te shog cig de chos nyan pa de la sems bsdus pas de 'di snyam du semasate/ kyi stod 'di 'dra ba'i chosa'achad na bdag jo mosamangagasapasachos kyi bar chad byung bar gyur te/ mdor na bran gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa ni re sdug snyam du bsams nas sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde bas gdungs par(tshigadragasu bcad pas smras pa| gang yang sdig pasade ring rgyal zhal blta ba dang / /bde gshegs zhag nas dri med chos mnyan mi 'thob pa/ /bran dngos gzhan dbang sdug bsngal mang po tha chad de/ /bdag gi 'tsho ba sngon byasalasakyisathob pa ngan/ /de nasabacom ldan 'dasa'adi snyam du dgongs te/ bu mo bskyed ma 'di ni sngon gyi sangasargyas rnams la lhag par bya ba byas pa yin mod kyi/ tshe chung zhig yod pasa'adi 'khor ba'i btson ra nasadagrang bar bya'o snyam du dgongs nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis gro ga la/ dge ma skye ba byung na ni/ /'jig pa yin par bsams nas su/ /ngas gsungs pa yi dge ba la/ /brtson 'grus bskyed nas mnyan par bya/ /zhes bris nas byin no/ /de nas bu mo bskyed ma dka' ba dang / mgu ba dang /rangs pa dang / yid bde ba skyes nas tshigs su bcad pa smras bzhin sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i sems kho nas song ba dang / lasarnamasabaskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /ces bya ba yin pas tshe chung zhig yod pa'i las tshogs pa rnyed pa de ba drus ma zhig gis bsad do/ /de sangs rgyas la sems mngon par dad par byas te shi bas sing ga 119
la'i gling du sing ga la'i rgyal polibatsun mo dam pa'i mngal du skyesapar gyurate/ gang gi nyi ma la nying mtshams sbyar ba de kho na'i nyin par mu tig gi char pa bab bo/ /rgyal pos ltasamakhan rnamasabakug ste smrasapa dang / de rnamasakyisasmrasapa/ lha 'di ni semasacan zhig btsun molilhums su zhugs pa de'i mthu lagasaso/ /ji tsam na mngal gyi smin par bya ba'i phyir de sgra yid du mi 'ong ba cung zad kyang mi grag cing grang ba na grang ba'i yo byad dang / dro ba na dro ba'i yo byad dang / sman pasabastan pa'i kha zas ha cang kha ba ma yin pa dang / ha cang skyur ba ma yin pa dang / ha cang lan tshwa can ma yin pa dang / ha cang mngar ba ma yin pa dang / ha cang rtsub pa ma yin pa dang / ha cang bska ba ma yin pa dang / kha ba dang /skyur ba dang / lan tshwa dang / mngar ba dang / rtsub pa dang / bska ba rnams spangasapa'i kha zasakyis bsnyen bkur byed cing do shal dang se mo dosalusabargyan nasalha'i bu mo dga' tshal na rgyu ba bzhin du khri nabadakhri dang / khri'u nas khri'ur 'gro zhing 'og gi sa la 'babs par mi byed do/ /de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das nas bu mo gzugasabazang ba mdzes pa lta na sdug pa zhig btsasate/ gang gi nyi ma la btsasapa de nyid kyi nyin par yang mu tig gi char bab nasargyal posabasamasapa/ 'di ltar bu molimathusamu tig gi char 'bab pa ni de nyid kyi mu tig tu 'gyur ro zhesadesade nyid la byin no/ /de nas nyi ma bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig tu de'i btsas ston rgya cher byas nas bu mo'i ming cir gdagasazhesaming 'dogasapar byed do/ /blon po rnamasakyisasmrasapa/ gang gi phyir 'di'i mthus mu tig gi char bab pas de bsan bu mo 'di'i ming mu tig can zhes gdags so zhes de'i ming mu tig can zhes bya bar btags te/ bu mo mu tig can ma ma brgyad la gtad de/ pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang /dri ma 'phyi ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtsen grogs kyi ma ma gnyisate/ de ma ma brgyad po dag 120
gisa'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi snying po dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi bye brag gtso bo gtso po dag gis sring bar byed skyed par byed cing rdzing na gnas pa'i pad ma bzhin myur du skyed par byed do/ /de gang gi tshe chen mor gyur pa de'i tshe rang gi rigasadang mthun pa'i spyod pa dang / gnasapasargyal po nang mi dang bcaphupasalhag par bkur sti byed do/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na mnyan yod kyi mong pa rnams kyis nor bsgrub pa'i phyir rgya mtsho'i gru bo che bsgrubasate/ rgya mtsho chen por zhugs pa dang de rnamsgru bo che phan phun med par rlung gi shugasakyisasing ga la'i gling du phyin to/ /de nas snod rnamasamakhosasu phab ste/ rgyal polipho brang dang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu 'brang btab bo/ /de rnams kyis mtshan molithun tha ma la ched du brjod pa dang /pha rol 'gro byed dang / bden pa mthong ba dang / gnasabartan gyi tshigasasu bcad pa dang /gnasabartan ma'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / ri gnas kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang / thub pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang / don gyi tshoms kyi mdo sde rnams rgyas par 'don pa la zhugs pa mu tig can khyim gyi nang na 'dug pas skar khung nas 'os nas/ de nas des rgyal po la smrasapa/ lha yul dbusakyi tshong pa rnamasamachisanasamachid snyan par len to/ /rgyal pos blon po dag la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag glu mkhan rnams khug cig de rnams bkug pa dang mu tig can gyis smras pa/ shes ldan dag yul dbus kyi rol mo ci 'dra ba kho mosamanyan gyis longasashig mas kyis smrasapa/ lha mo bdag cag sna rol mo mkhan ma lags te/ bdag cag ni mnyan yod kyi tshong pa rlung gi shugs kyis 'dir mchis pa lags te/ bdag cag gisamatshan mo'i thun tha ma la sangasargyas kyi gsung btan to/ /mu tig can gyis sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra sngon ma thos pa de thos nas snying dga' bas ba spu thams cad zing zhes byed de/ de ngo mtshar skyes nas dris pa/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba 121
'di ci yin/ de rnamasakyisasangasargyasakyi che ba'i bdag nyid rgyasapar smra bar brtsamasate/lha mo shākya rnamasakyi gzhon nu gangasari'i ngosadang nye ba/ chu bo skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram drang sbong ser skya'i bsti gnasadang ha cang yang mi ring ba zhig tu byung ste/ de bramaze mtshan mkhan rnams dang / ltas mkhan rnams kyis gal te khyim pa khyim na gnas par gyur na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhir rnam par rgyal ba/ chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de'i rin po che sna bdun 'di lta bu dag 'byung bar 'gyur ba 'di lta ste/ 'khor lo rin po che dang / glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / bdun pa blon po rin po che'o/ /de la bu dpa' ba/ rtul phod pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'jomasapa stong yang tshang bar 'gyur zhing /de rgya mtsho la thug pa'i sachen po ma lusapa gnod par sdo ba med cing 'tshe ba med pa 'di nyid chad pa med cing mtshon gyis bda' ba med la/ chos dang mthun zhing snyoms pas legadragapar phab ste gnasapar 'gyur ro/ /gal te skra dang kha spu bregs te gos ngur smrig bgos nas dad pa yang dag pa kho nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar gyur na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba 'jig rten du sgra rnam par grags par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan te/ de lta bu de ni sangasargyas zhes bgyi ba lags so/ /mu tig can gyis smras pa/ gang gi tshe khyed cag yul du 'dong ba de'i tshe kho mo la spron cig de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha mo bka' bzhin 'tshal/ sbran par bgyi'o/ /ji tsam na de rnams yul du 'dong ba'i dus la bab nas de rnams kyis mu tig can la sbran pa dang / des bcom ldan 'das la yi ge gsol ba/ lha dang lha min mi yis phyag bgyis pa/ /skye dang 122
snyun dang bsnyengs las ngesabyung zhing / /gtso bo gragasapa rgya chen rab gragasapa/ /drang srong bdud rtsi'i cha lasathugasarjesaganong / /zhesagasol to/ /de nasayi ge de tshong pa de rnams kyisakhyer nasarim gyis mnyan yod du phyin pa dang / lam gyisadub pa ngal sosnasabacom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas mnyan yod kyi tshong pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa sing ga la'i gling na sing ga la'i rgyal po〉bu mo desamachid yi ge gsol ba 'di lags so/ /bcom ldan 'dasakyisamu tig can gyi 'dul ba'i dusamakhyen nasanyid kyisblangs te bklags so/ /bklags nas bka' stsal pa/ gang gi tshe khyed cag slar 'dong bar gyur pa de'i tshe nga'i snyan du gsol cig btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshong pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas te dong ngo / /de nas zong bsgyur te bsgyur ba'i zong thogs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'dasabadag cag mchi na bdag cag gisamu tig can la ji skad bgyi bka' stsal par gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shin tu legs par byi dor byas pa'i ras dang ri mo mkhan dag khug cig de rnams kyis ras dang ri mo mkhan dag bkug nas phul ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ras la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i gzugs brnyan bris shig ri mo mkhan rnamasakyis sangs rgyaskyi sku'i gzugs brnyan bri bar brtsams pa las de bzhin gshegs pa ni bsod nams brgya phrag du masabasgrubs pa yin pasari mo mkhan rnams kyisabacom ldan 'das kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan bri bar ma nus nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ras ston cig dang 'od gtang ngo / /de rnams kyis ras bstan pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis 123
'od btang ba la ri mo mkhan rnams kyis tshon rtsi sna tshogs kyisargyas par byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sku'i gzugasabarnyan gyi 'og tu gsum la skyabasasu 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi lnga rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis po lugasadang mthun pa dang / lugasadang mi mthun pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa brisaso/ /gong du ni tshigasasu bcad pa gnyisapo/ brtsam par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim la glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gshog par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod pas/ /chosa'adul 'di la spyod 'gyur ba/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangasanas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur/ /zhesabrisanasasing ga la'i rgyal po la bka' yig spring pa/ rasal ri mor brispa ngas mu tig can la skyes su bskur ba yin gyis/ khyod kyisade la saphyogasayangasashing rgya che bar sing ga la'i gling na gnas pa'i skye bo3tshogs bsdusal/ bkur sti chen posrar+sā'adi khromasashig mong pa de rnamasal bka' stsal pa/ galahe mu tig can 'di ci yin zhesa'adri na/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'dasade'i sku'i gzugasabarnyan yin no zhesabarjod par bya'o/ /gal te 'og ma 'di ci yin zhesa'adri na de dag ni gsum la skyabasasu 'gro ba dang /bslab pa'i gzhi lnga rnams dang / lugasadang mthun pa dang lugasadang mi mthun pa'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung bar 'gro bar 'jug pa dang ldog pa'o/ /'di ni bdud rtsi rtogs pa'i 'phagasapa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yin no zhesabarjod par bya'o/ /gal te gong ma 'di ci yin zhes 'dri na spro bar bya ba yin te/ gang zhig skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs te/ lugs dang mthun pa dang lugs dang mi mthun pa'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba 'di la rtog cing brtson 'grus rtsom pa de bdud rtsi rtogs pa'i 'phagasapa'i lam thob nas sdug bsngal thamasacad las grol bar 'gyur ba yin no zhes 124
brjod par bya'o/ /btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes tshong pa de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas dge mtshan dang / bkra shis dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dag byas te/ zong khyer nas sing ga la'i gling du song ste/ rim gyis sing ga la'i gling du phyin nas lam gyis dub pa ngal sos te/rgyal po'i drung du song nasarkang pa gnyis la gtugasate yi ge byin no/ /rgyal pos yi ge bklagasate bklags nas grong khyer de rdo ba dang / gseg ma dang /phyo mo bsal nasatsan dan gyi chusachag chag btab/ rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgreng / dar gyi chun 'phyang mang po btags/ shin tu dri zhim po'i pog por nye bar bzhag me tog sna tshogs bkram ste/ sing ga la'i gling na gnas pa'i skye bo'itshogs bsogs nas/ de nas bkur sti chen po byas te grong khyer gyi dbus su rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i seng ge'i khri bshams te/ ras phye ba dang skye bo3tshogs chen pos sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyadrangal phyag 'tshal 'o1 zhes gsang bstod de smras so/ /de nasargyal poyibu mo mu tig can dad pa drag pos gtad pa'i snying gis ba spu zing zhes byed cing mig mchi mas gang bas zhabs gnyis la gtugs te tshong pa rnams la dris pa/ shes ldan dag 'di ci yin/ de rnams kyis smra bar brtsamasapa/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das de'i sku'i gzugs brnyan lags so/ /'og ma 'di dag ci yin/ 'di ni gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi lnga rnams dang / lugs dang mthun pa dang lugs dang mi mthun pa'i rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba 'gro bar 'jug pa dang ldog pa'o/ /'di ni bdud rtsi rtogs pa'i 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa lags so/ /gong ma 'di ci yin/ spro bar bgyi ba lags te/ gang zhig skyabs su song nas bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangasate lugasadang mthun pa dang lugs dang mi mthun pa'i rten cing /'brel 125
par 'byung ba yan lag bcu gnyis pa 'di la rtog cing brtson 'grus rtsom pa de bdud rtsi rtogs pa'i lam thob nas sdug bsngal thams cad lasagrol bar 'gyur ba lags so/ /de nas mu tig can gyis rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yan lag bcu gnyis pa lugs dang mthun pa dang lugasadang mi mthun pa bsam par brtsams te/ ji srid lan gsum du ma bzlas pa de'i bar du desa'ajig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shesakyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugasapa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ desabaden pa mthong nas tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ ring na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /shes rab mig ni rnam sbyangs pas/ /gang la 'di 'dra'i gsos mnga' ba/ /sman mkhas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ring na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /lta ba'i ri bo drungs phyung ste/ /lta ba'i zug rngu sel mdzad pa/ /sman mkhas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pas smras nas tshong pa rnams la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shes ldan dag khyed cag nam 'dong ba de'i tshe kho mo la spron cig de nas tshong pa rnams kyis zong rnamasabasgyur te bsgyur ba'i zong rnams khyer nas mu tig can gyi drung du song ste/ lha mo bdag cag mchi na bdag cag gis ci zhig bgyi bar bka' stsal par gsol/ des smras pa/ kho molitshig gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshol la gnod pa chung ngam/ nyam nga ba nyung ngam/ 'tsho'am/ bskyod pa yang ngam/ stobs dang bde ba dang / sku nyams dang ldan nam reg par gnas sam zhes zhus la 'di skad ces/ btsun pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyisabagyi ba gang lags pa de bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzad de/ bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcom ldan 'das la brten nas sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dwags rnamasalas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams su ni bzhag 'khor ba las ni rgyang bsrings/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams/ rus pa'i ri bo las ni bsgral/126
ngan song gi sgo ni bskum/ mtho ris thar pa'i sgo ni phye/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du bgyis te/ btsun pa bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bdag bcom ldan 'das dang chos dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yis/ dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du srog dang yang bsdos de skyabs su mchi bar mngon par dad lags so/ /zhes gsol la/ mu tig bre gsum po 'di khyer la cha gcig ni sangs rgyas la/ cha gcig ni chosal/ cha gcig ni dge 'dun la phul cig de nas tshong pa de rnams kyis zong dang skyes bskur ba yang khyer te dong nas rim gyis mnyan yod du phyin pa dang / lam gyis dub pa ngal sos nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste zhabs gnyis la gtugs nas ji skad spring ba bzhin bcom ldan 'das la gsol nas 'di skad ces kyang gsol to/ /btsun pa skyes su phul ba'i mu tig bre gsum po 'di lags te/ mu tig cha gcig ni sangs rgyasal/ cha gcig ni chosal/ cha gcig ni dge 'dun la phul lags so/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa skyes 'di gang nas mchis/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis shākya ming chen gyi mngag gzhug ma bskyed ma zhes bya ba nga las chos mnyan nas song ba las/ lam dzir ba drus mas bsad pa mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /des nga la sems dang ba bskyed de shi bas sing ga la'i rgyal po'ibu mo mu tig can zhes bya bar gyur te/ bden pa mthong nas des skyes bskur ba 'di yin no/ /'di las sangs rgyas kyi skal ba gang yin pa des dri gtsang khang gi zhal zhal byos shig chos kyi gang yin pa de ni chos 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams la'o/ /dge 'dun gyi gang yin pa de ni dge 'dun gyis mnyam par bgos shig127
dge slong rnams ze tshom skyes nas ze tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasal zhusapa/ btsun pa mu tig can gyis las ci zhig bgyis na desan bran mor gyur lags/ las ci zhig bgyis na des rgyal po phyug po'irigs su skyes shing bden pa mthong bar bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mu tig can 'di nyid kyis las tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ 'od pa bzhin du nye bar gnas pa gdon mi za bar 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las dag byas shing bsags pas mu tig can 'di nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis so sor myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa dag ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la mi 'gyur/ me'i khams la mi 'gyur/ rlung gi khams la mi 'gyur gyi/ 'di ltar las dge ba dang mi dge ba dag byas shing bsags pa dag ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams la rnam par smin par 'gyur te / las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni/ /chud mi za ba'ang tshogs dang dus/ /rnyed na lus can rnams la ni/ /'bras bu dag tu 'gyur ba nyid/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na 'jig rten du ston pa rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung nas/ des sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag mdzad nas bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du bā rā ṇa sīr phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / rgyal po kṛ rkus de'i sku dri zhim po'i shing thams cad kyis spungs lta/ spungs nas bkur sti chen pos bsregs te me de 'o mas bsad nas sku gdung de rnams gser gyi bum par blugs te//28
lam po che'i bzhi mdor rin po che sna bzhi las byung ba'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la/ 'phang du dpag tshad phyed pa zhig brtsigs nas dus mchod chen po btsugs so/ /thā rā ṇa sī na tshong dpon phyug pa nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba/yongs su gzung ba yangasashing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu la nor gyisa'agran pa zhig yod pa des/ rigasam nyam pa lasachung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed de/ de rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed kyang de la bu pho yang med bu mo yang med nas/ de lag pa 'gram pa la gtad nas bdag gi khyim du nor phal po che bsags kyang bdag la bu pho yang med bu mo yang med pas bdag shi nas bdog pa thams cad bu med do zhes byas te rgyal pos dbang byas par 'gyur ro snyam nas sems khong du chud cing 'dug pa de la dge spyong dang bram ze dang / grogs po dang mdza' bshes dang / nye du dang /ltasamakhan rnams kyis smras pa/ lha mnyes par byos shig dang khyod la bu yod par 'gyur ro / /de bu med de bu mngon par 'dod pas zhi ba dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa la rbe1gas pa gzhan yang lha khyad par can rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di lta ste/ kun dga' ra ba'i lha dang / nags tshal gyi lha dang / bzhi mdo'i lha dang / sum mdo3lha dang / gtor ma len pa'i lha dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang /chos mthun pa pa dang / rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba'i lha la yang gsol ba 'debasaso/ /'di ltar gsol ba 'debs pa'i rgyus bu pho dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ro zhesa'ajig rten na de skad du grags pa yod de/ de yang de lta ma yin te/ gal te de ltar 'gyur na ni re re yang dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bzhin du bu stong yod par 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang gnas gsum mngon du gyur pa las bu pho dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur te/ gnas 129
gsum gang zhe na pha dang ma gnyis chags par gyur cing lhan cig 'dus pa dang / ma mngal rung bar gyur cing zla mtshan dang ldan pa dang / dri za nye bar gnasapar gyur pa ste/gnas de gsum mngon du gyur pa las bu pho dang bu mo skye bar 'gyur ba yin na des bu yod pa'i las ma byas pas des na de la bu pho dang bu mo med do/ /ji tsam na de nad kyis thebasanas de rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu'i sman rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byasakyang de'i nad zhi bar ma gyur to/ /de nas de'i chung masabasams pa/ bdag gi khyim na snor phal mo che bsags pa ni bdag la bu pho yang med bu mo yang med la/ bdag gi khyim thab 'di ni 'chi bar 'gyur gyis/ da ni gal te 'jig rten pha rol gyi lam rgyags ma blangs na nor zas 'di thams cad bdag la bu med do zhes byas nas rgyal pos dbang byas par 'gyur ro snyam nas/de'i mu tig gi do shal brgya stong ri ba mgul na thogs pa des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten de la dri dang byug pas byugs nas mchod pa byas te btags nas dad pa drag pos drung du gtugs te smon lam btab pa/ sbyin pa'i chos yongs su btang ba dang sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag phyug polirigs su skyes shing yon tan 'di lta bu yang thob cing ston pa 'di lta bu mnyes par byed kyi/ mi mnyesapar ma gyur cig cesabyas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi tshong dpon gyi chung ma gang yin pa de ni mu tig can 'di nyid yin te/ 'dis yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten la bya ba byas nas/ smon lam btab pa gang yin pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas phyug polirigs su skyes shing btsas pa na mu tig gi char bab po/ /nga'i bstan pa la yang dad pa bskyed pas 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 130
mngon lhalha mi hāpa ñcha/ da/pon nor mang du bsags pa de'i chung mar gyur pa na de na 'dis dbang phyug gi grags pas rgyagasanas spyod yul na gnasapa'i 'jig rten thams cad (spru tshig tu bran mo〉bu zhes smras pas/ de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas tshe rabs mang por bran mor gyur to/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa yin zhing / gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi ni gcig tu dkar la/ 'dren ma rnams kyi ni 'dren ma yin no/ /de bas na dge slong dag gcig tu gnag pa'i las rnams dang / 'dren ma rnams ni sbangs la/ gcig tu dkar ba'i las / sun+d+ra ༷༷ brtsal bar bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis de lta bu la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes
༄tsho/ /sa ga ma'i bu sum cu rtsa gnyis rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bsad kyang sangs rgyasakyisachos bstan nas 'bras bu thob pa'i dbang githags ga ma la mya ngan ma skyes pa'i 〈nya5/'dul ba lungagazhi lasabatus/ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi blon polimachog ri dwags 'dzin ces bya ba des rigasamanyam pa las chung ma blangs te de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/dga' mgur spyod par byed de/ de rtse bar byed dga' bar byed dga' mgur spyod par byed pa las khye'u zhig btsas so zhes bya ba nas de bzhin du khye'u bdun btsas te/ de la drug gi ming ni ci dga' bar btagasaso/ /tha chung gang yin pa de'i ming ni sa ga zhes bya bar btags so/ /ji tsam na ri dwags 'dzin gyi chung ma shi nas/ des bu drug gi khyim phub pa dang de rnams rang rang gi chung ma rnams dang lhan cig byi dor lhur len cing khyim gyi 'tsho nam mi sems par 'dug go /khyim bdag ri dwags 'dzin 'gram pa la lag pa gtad nas semasakhong du chud cing 'dug go /de'i grogs bshes bram ze zhig yod pa de 'ongs nasadesade sems khong du chud pa mthong nasasmras pa/ khyim bdag ci'i phyir sems khong du chud/ bdag gi bu 'di dag rang rang gi chung ma dang lhan cig byi dor lhur len cing khyim gyi 'tsho nam mi sems par 'dug pasakhyim zhig par 'gyur ro/ /desasmrasapa/ ci'i phyir sa ga la khyim mi dbub gal te na yang lhag par phung krol byed kyang sus shes/ gal te na 'di lhag ༷༷ legs par byed kyang sus shes/ gal te
khyod dad na bu mo zhig btsal lo/ /de bzhin du gyisashig de tshol zhing rim gyisayul tsam par phyin to/ /tsam pa na khyir/ bdag stobs kyi bshesaganyen zhes bya ba yod de/ de'i bu mo dragag ma zhedrangabya ba gzugs bzang ba/ dar la bab pa/ tshul dang dul ba dang ldan pa/mkhas pa/ g.yer ba zhig yod pa de bu mo yid 'phrog ma gang 'dod pa rnams dang lhan cigatu skyed mosatshal gyi gzhir chas pa dang bram ze de yang phyogs der phyin te/ desabu mo rnams mthong nas des bsams pa/ 'di rnams kho na la re zhig brtag par bya'o snyam nas de brtag pa lhur len cing dal bus 'jab cing de rnams kyi phyi bzhin du song ngo / /bud med ni phal cher yang ba'i rang bzhin can yin pas de rnams las kha cig ni bang rgyug kha cig ni mchong bar byed/ kha cig ni 'gre/ kha cig ni dgod/ kha cig ni lus sgyur bar byed/ kha cig ni glu len par byed/ 'di dag dang gzhan yang spyod tshul ngan lcu // 〉〉 do/ /dul ba phun sum tshogs pa de ni gom pa dal gyis de dag dang lhan ji tsam na skyed mos tshal du phyin pa dang bu mo de rnams ni rdzing gi 'gram du gos rnams bzhag nas mod la zhugs te rtse bar brtsams so/ /de ni ji tsam ji tsam chur nub pa de tsam de tsam du gos dag rdze zhing 'jug la/ ji tsam ji tsam ldang ba de tsam de tsam du gos dag 'bebs shing ldang ste/ de lta bur spyod lam zhi ba yin no/ /de nas khrus kyi brtson pa byas nasaganasagacig tu 'dug pa dang / bu mo de rnams ni thog mar rang zas zos nas de'i 'og tu 'khor gyi skye bo la sbyin par rtsom mo/ /de ni 'khor gyi skye bo la sngar byin nas de'i 'og tu rang za bar rtsom mo/ /de nas zos shing 'thungasanas skyed mos tshal gyi bde ba nyams su myong bar byasanas dong ngo / /ji tsam na lam sgar chu rgal bar byed pa na bu mo de rnams ni mchil lham phud nas rgal rngo1/ /de ni mchil lham dang bcas pas 133
dong ngo / /yang dong ste/ de dag kun dga'i ra bar zhugs pa dang desani gdugasathogste.a ma'i tshal nasabyung ngo / /gzhan dag gisagadugasarnamasabor ro/ /de nasarlung dang char pa bab nasade'i tshe bu mo rnamasalha khang du zhugaphunasa'adug go /de ni bla gab med pa na'o/ /bram ze de yang de'i rjesabazhin du song ba lasadesade'i mtshan nyid dang spyod tshul de lta bu mthong nas/ de nas ngo mtshar skyes te bu mo de la dri bar brtsam pa/ bu mo khyod su'i stobasakyi bshephuganyen gyi bu mo'o/ /bu mo khyod la cung zad cig drisam khro zhig des 'dzum pa sngon du btang nasasmras pa/ khu gu 'di la khror ci mchisadrisashig bu mo 'di dag thamasacad ni rgyug pa dang / mchong ba dang / 'gre ba dang / lusasgyur bar byed pa dang / klu len par byed cing 'di dag dang gzhan yang spyod tshul ngan pa byed cing 'gro na/ khyod ni tshul dang dul ba phun sum tshogs pasadal busargyu zhing de rnamadragadang lhan cig skyed mos tshal du 'gro bar byed do/ /des smras pa bu mo thams cad ni pha dang mas btsong ba'i rdzas yin na/ gal te bdag gis mchongs sam 'gres nadragarkang pa'am lag pa chag par gyur na| bdag la su zhig slong bar 'gyur te/ ngesapar bdag ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du pha dang ma kho na'i gson mar 'gyur ro/ /bu mo legs te/ de ni khong du chud do/ /gzhan yang 'di dri ste/ bu mo 'di dag ni gos rnams mtha' gcig tu bzhag nas gos gcig kyang med par mod la zhugs nas rtse bar rtsom la/ khyod ni ji tsam ji tsam du chur nub pa de tsam de tsam du gos rdze bar byed do/ /khu gu bud med ni ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa dang ldan par bya dgos pas gal te bdag gi gos phud pa 'ga' zhig gis mthong na/ mi rigs par 'gyur ro/ /bu mo khyod la de na su zhig lta/ khu gu re zhig khyod kho nas kyang bdag mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bu mo legs te/ de yang khong du chud do/ /gzhan yang 'di dri ste/bu mo 'di dag ni rang sngar zos nas de'i 'og tu 'khor gyi skye bo la zan sbyin par byed la/134
khyod ni 'khor gyi skye bo la sngar zan byin nas de'i 'og tu rang za bar byed do/ /khu gu bdag cag ni bsod nams kyi 'bras bus 'tsho bas bdag cag la rtag tu dus ston mchidragal/ 'di dag ni tshegadranga'abyung ba'i 'bradragabudraga'atsho ba lags/ brgya lam na lan 'ga' rgya chen por 'thob pa'i phyir ro/ /bu mo legs te de yang khong du chud do/ /gzhan yang 'di dri ste/ 'jig rten thams cad ni skam la mchil lham gyon la khyod ni chu la phyon pa de ci/ khu gu 'jig rten blun mod/ chu kho na la mchil lham bgo 'tshal te/ ci'i slad du zhe na/ thang la ni sdong dum dang / tsher ma dang / rdo ba dang / zug rdo dang / nya phyisakyi dum bu dang / srin kog gi dum bu rnamasamangon la/ chu la ni de dag mi mngon pasadesan chu kho na la mchil lham bgo bar bgyi'i thang la ni ma lags so/ /bu mo legasate de yang khong du chud do/ /gzhan yang 'di dri ste/ bu mo de dag ni nyi ma la gdugs thogs na/ khyod ni kun dga'i ra ba'i shing gi grib ma la thogasapar byed na/ 'di la rigasapa ci zhig yod/khu gu 'jig rten blun mod kun dga' ra ba kho nar gdugasabacang 'tshal te/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ kun dga' ra ba ni rtag tu spre'u dang bya rnams kyisagang bsabya rnamasani gcin rtug 'thor zhing rus pa'i dum bu dag 'thor ro/ /spre'u rnamasakyang bshang ba dang gci ba byed cing 'bras bu'i za 'phro dag 'thor bar byed la/ rang bzhin gyis rgod bag can yin pas phan chun yal ga gzhan du 'gro bar byed pa na shing dum dag lhung bar byed do/ /bla gab ma mchis pa la ni de dag ma mchis so/ /brgya la mchis na yang de res 'ga' zhig 'bab par bas te/ des na kun dga' ra ba kho nar gdugasabacang bar bgyi'i/ bla gab ma mchis par ni ma lags so/ /bu mo legs te de yang khong du chud do/ /gzhan yang 'di dri ste bu mo 'di dag ni rlung dang char pa byung na lha khang du 'jug na khyod ni bla gab med par 'dug go /khu gu bla gab ma mchis pa kho nar gnasapar bgyi'i/ lha khang du 'jug par ni 135
ma lagar+sāso/ /bu mo 'di la rigasapa ci yod/ khu gu lha khang stong pa 'di dag ni rtag tu dwa dang / nal phrug dang / g.yon can rnams kyisami stong lagasate/ gal te bdag zhugs pa'i yan lag dang nying lag dag la 'ga' zhig gis reg na/ de lta na bdag gi pha ma dag la mi snyan par mi 'gyur ram/ nyisan bla gab med par srog dang phral ba ni bla'i/ lha khang stong par ni mi 'jug go /de nas bram ze de de'i spyod tshul gyisarangasashing yid bde ba skyes nas khyim bdag stobs kyi bshes gnyen gyi khyim du zhugs te bu mo thob par 'dod pa'i spro ba dang bcas pa'i bde legs su gyur cig bde legs su gyur cig ces smrasapa dang / khyim 'khor gyi skye bosasmrasapa/ bram ze re zhig bslang ba'i dusani ma yin na/ ci zhig slong / bu mo slong ngo / /su zhig gi ched du/ mnyan yod na blon polimachog ri dwagasa'adzin ces bya ba de'i bu sag zhes bya ba'i 'o/ /de rnamasakyis smrasapa/ de dang bdag cag ni rigs mnyam pa yin na/ 'on kyang yul ha cang yang thag ring ches so/ /desasmrasapa/ ring po kho na la bu mo sbyin par bya'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ nye na re zhig gal te bde bar gyur pa thosan dga' ba skyed par zad/ nye na sdug bsngal bar gyur na sbyin pa dang mchod pa dang / bkur sti bya bas dub par 'gyur zhing nor 'ged par yang 'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ gal te de lta na sbyin no/ /de nasabram ze de bde legs su gyur cig ces smras nas song ste rim gyis mnyan yod du phyin nas lam gyis dub pa bsal te blon polimachog ri dwags 'dzin gyi drung du song nas/ de nas bu mo'i za ba dang / gnas pa'i spyod tshul dang / gzugs bzang zhing dar la bab pa dang / mdzes pa dang mkhas pa dag ji lta ba bzhin du bsnyad nas smras pa/ bdag gi nyon slongs pa chen pos yul dang tshong rdal sna tshogasasu brgyusapasasdug bsngal gyisade rnyed kyisad ni songasal longs shigde nas blon po'ogamachog ri dwags 'dzin gyis nyi ma dang tshes grangs dang / yud tsam dang 136
n+dha spyazlo shārnyi bstun nas tsam par 'ongs te/ dpal gyi 'byor ba chen pos sa ga'i chung de mi yul du 'gro ba'i tshe masabaslabasapa/ bu mo khyod kyisanyi ma dang zla ba gnyisla rtag tu phyag bya/ me la bsnyen bkur bya/ me long dri ma phyi bar bya/ gos dkar po bgo bar bya/ blang bar bya'i sbyin par mi bya/ tshig bsrung bar bya/ langs nas su la yang stan bstab par mi bya/ zhin po bza' bar bya/ bde bar nyal bar bya/ them skasagazugasapar bya'o/ /de nasari dwagasa'adzin gyisathosanasadesabasamasapa/ bu mo 'di lta ba log par 'dzin du bcug ste/ bdag gisa'adi lta ba log pa dang phral la yang dag pa'i lta ba 'dzin du gzhug go snyam du bsams nas de blangs te chas so/ /de nas de'i ma sdug pas snying dmigasaṇ+ḍang mig mchi madragagang bsamagul nas 'khyud nathagangu bzhin gyi nga rosasmrasapa/bu mo khyod mthong ba'i tha ma ni 'di yin no/ /des de la shes par bya ba'i phyir smras pa/ yum re zhig khyod 'dir 'khrungs sam/'on te nye du'i khyim du bu mo nye du'i khyim du'o/ /khyod kyi khang pa de yin nam/ 'on te 'di yin 'di yin no/ /bdag kyang 'dir skyes la der bdag gnas par bsal 'du ba mchis na gdon mi za bar mthar 'bral bar 'gyur na/ bshums su ci mchis cang ma gsungs shig de nas ri dwags 'dzin ni thang la song ngo / /sa ga ma ni khyim thab dang /rang gi khyim nas thob pa'i 'khor gyi skye bo dang lhan cig tu grur dong ba las de na rta rgod ma rte'u smad byung nasaring po ma lon pa zhig grur gzhug par byas pa dang / rte'u thang la mi dga'o snyam nas bsgrims kyang 'jug tu ma btub pa dang ku co byung bas sa ga mas thos nas des smras pa/ ci'i phyir ku co 'di byung de rnams kyis ji ltar gyur pa rnams smras pa dang / sa ga mas smras pa rte'u sngar chug staX dang rang nyid 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de
rnamasakyisade bzhin byasapa dang zhugasaso/ /de nasari dwags 'dzin gyis de rnamasal drisapa/ ci'i phyir khyed cag ring zhig lon nasa'ongs/ rta rgod ma grur mchong du ma btub lagasaso/ /'o na ji ltar marmongs/ tsam pa mosathabasabashamasapa zhig bstan te/ rte'u sngar bcug pasaso/ /tsam pa mo ni mkhas pa yin no/ /ji tsam na mgron pa rnams lam sgar nub mo 'brang btab lta gnas pa las ri dwags 'dzin gyi mal bya skyibs shig tu bcasapa sag mas mthong nas dris pa/ 'di su'i mal/ ri dwags 'dzin gyi'o/ /sbos shig ci'i phyir gal te gnyid kyis log pa la bya skyibasasteng du ldab na gdon mi za bar non pas 'chi bar 'gyur te/ bdag la gang zhig blangs na gyos po khyim du ma phyin par lam sgar shi ba 'di lta bu'i bu mo bag mar blangs zhesaji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du mi snyan pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mal de yang sposapa lasagad pa zhig pa dang / skye bo'itshogasachen pos khyim bdag non to zhes kun brgyugs pa dang khyim bdag gis smras pa/ shes ldan dag bdag 'di na 'dug gis ma skrag par mal rtogs shig mal spos so/ /sus sa ga mas so/ /tsam pa mo ni mkhas pa yin no/ /yang skyed mos tshal rnying pa zhig tu nub mo 'brang btab ste 'khod pa las ri dwags 'dzin gyi mal lha khang stong pa zhig tu bcas pa dang sa ga mas mthong nas dris pa/ 'di su'i mal/ dpon poli'o/ /spos shig ci'i phyir gal te lha khang rdib ste/ des non na shi bar 'gyur te/ bdag la zhesabya ba nas mi snyan pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /mal de yang spos pa las lha khang zhig pa dang skye bo'i tshogs chen pos brgyugs pa dang zhes bya ba nas tsam pa mo ni mkhas pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /ji tsam na rim gyis mnyan yod du phyin nas lam gyis dub pa bsal te mdza' bshes dang / nye du dang gnyen gyi skye bo spras nas sa ga ma rang gi rdogs dang 'tsham pa'i khyim gyi las dag byed do/ /ri dwags 'dzin 138
gyi mna' ma drug gisare mo re mosakhyim mi'i zan sbyor ba lasasag ma la yang de bzhin du bsgo ste/ khyod kyisaresakyang zhag bdun pa la skyor cig de'i resal bab tu nye ba dang /myos po dang / sgyug mo dang / khyim bdag rnams kyi dri'i lhag ma gang yin pa de dag ril bur byasanasanyi ma re re zhing skemasaso/ /nyi ma re re zhing nod pa'i phye gang yin pa de laskyang dre kha phri ste bzhag la/ lhag ma mar dang bsresapasade dang tshad mnyam par gyur to/ /sang lta bu resabab pa na chang btung la rag par bya ba dang / khyim thab dang rang gi metog gi phreng ba rnying pa gang yin pa de dag bsilabar bzhag nas/ ji tsam na nam nangasapa dang /lasabyed pa rnamasal skyur midang / dri dang / metog dang / zasadang / tshang dag byin no/ /de rnams shin tu mgu nasabadag cag ring zhig lon nasakhyim bdag gi chung ma rnying pasbzhin bltas so zhesade rnams kyis de'i nyin par las nyisa'agyur du byas so/ /ji tsam na ri dwags 'dzin gyisaphyi dro'idus su lasakyi mtha' la bltas pa na lasamang du zin pa mthong nasades dris pa/ ci khyed cag gisagla mi gzhan dag cig bkug gam/ sus kyang ma bkug go /gang gis na las nyis 'gyur du byas pa 'di la rgyu ci zhig yod/ de rnamskyisasmras pa/ dpon po zas ci 'dra ba de 'dra ba'i las bgyid do/ /de ji lta bu yin/ de rnams kyis ji ltar gyur pa rgya cher smras pa dang / ri dwags 'dzin gyi bu rnams kyis rang rang gi chung ma la smrasapa lasade rnams kyis smras pa/ phug mas ji ltar bgyisapa bzhin du gal te bdag cag gisakyang khyim nasabarkusal gla mi rnamasadaga' bar bgyisapa dang /bdag la yang jo bo dang khyed gla mi rnamasadaga' bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas ri dwags 'dzin gyis sa ga ma la dris pa/ bu mo khyod kyis kha zas rnams ji ltar bshams/ des rgyas par smrasapa dang ri dwags 'dzin mgu nas des de kho na khyim gyi bya ba rnams byed du bcug ste/ nang mi thams cad la smras pa/ khyed cag lasagang zhig sa 139
ga mas byin pas mgu ba ni des gnas par bgyis la de dang rjes su mthun par yang gyisashig ji tsam na de khyim gyi dpon mor gyur nasaspyod tshul dang / gnasapa dang / despasanang mi thams cad dga' bar gyur to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na sa ga ma'i khyim steng nasangang pa rnamasakyisabyang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling nasam rmosam btab pa'i 'brasar+sā lu dag khyer nasadong ba lasargyal polikhab na 'dug pa'i ngang pa des de dag mthong nasskad phyung ba dang de rnams kyis kyang skye gnas mthun pa'i gcugs pas mnags ma sbyoX ṇā spru k+ta phyung ba dang rgyal polikhab kyi khang thog tu 'bras kyi snye ma rnams lhung de nas rgyal pos blon po rnamasal re re byin pa dang ri dwags 'dzin gyis rang gi skal ba sa ga ma la byin no/ /desaza ma tog gi nang du bcug ste zhing pa rnams la bsgo ba dang / de rnams kyang shin tu mgu ste/ de rnams kyisazhing chung ngu zhig legs par bstan nas dus shes par byas te btab pa las lhas dus bzhin du char phab pas sabon dang mthun par phun sum tshogasapar skyes so/ /phyi de lo la ni rab tu mang por skyes par gyur to| |yang phyi de lo la ni de bas kyang mang por gyur te/ de bzhin du ji tsam na bang ba thams cad ngang pas khyer te 'ongs pa'i 'brasaswā lus gang bar gyur to/ /ji tsam na ko phula'i rgyal po gsal rgyal nad kyis thebs nas des sman pa rnamasabakug ste dris pa dang /de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha gal te ngang pas 'tshal te mchis pa'i swa lu brnyes na de la/'jams bsgral nas gsol cig dang / sos par 'gyur lags so/ /rgyal pos blon po rnams bkug nas smras pa/ shes ldan dag khyed la ngang pas khyer te 'ongs pa'i swa lu'i snye ma byin pa de dag khyed kyis cir byas/ de nas kha cig gis smras pa/ lha bdag cag gisni lha khang du phul lo/ /gzhan dag gis smras pa/ bdag cag gis me'i nang du stsal to/ //40
gzhan dag gisasmrasapa/ bdag gis sgo khang du btagasaso/ /ri dwags 'dzin gyisasmraspa/ lha bdag gis sa ga ma la stsal na re zhig des cir bgyis smra bar 'tshal lo/ /des sa ga ma la dris pa dang / des smras pa/ jo bo ci ngang pas 'tshal te mchis pa'i swa lu 'tshal ba zhig mchis sam/ rgyal po snyun gyis thebs pa la sman pa rnams kyis ngang pas khyer te 'ongs pa'i swa lu bstan to/ /de nas sa ga mas gser snod kyi nang du ngang pas khyer te 'ongs pa'i 'bras kyis bkang nas rgyal po la bskur ba las rgyal pos zos nas sor+sāpar gyur to/ /dusagazhan zhig na rgyal po la ldongs kyi mi rnams kyis rta rgod ma smad gnyis shig phul ba las de la ma ni gang yin/ rte'u ni gang yin pa 'gas kyang ma shes nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag legs par rtogs la nga la gsol cig blon po rnamasakyisanyin thog thag tu dpyad na dub ste gtan la ma phebs so/ /ri dwags 'dzin phyi dro khyim du song ba dang sa ga mas rkang pa gnyis la gtugs nas smras pa/ jo bo ji ste de ring ring zhig lon nas gshegs/ des ji ltar gyur pa rnamasargyas par smrasapa dang sa ga mas smras pa/ jo bo 'di la dpyad du ci zhig mchis/ de gnyis chas mnyam par stsal dang bu gang lags pa de ni myur du 'chal nasama'i skal ba la 'tshal lo/ /ma gang lags pa de ni mi 'chal bar mgo steg ge mchis te/ rtags ni de lags so/ /ri dwags 'dzin gyis blon po rnamasal smrasanasade rnamasakyis kyang ji skad bstan pa bzhin brtags nasade nasnam nangs pa dang rgyal po la smras pa/ lha 'di ni ma lags so/ /'di ni bu lags so/ /rgyal posasmras pa/ khyed cag gisaji ltar shes/ lha 'di lta bu dang 'di lta bu lags so/ /khar rtsang ci ste ma shes/ lha bdag cag gis 'tshal bar rngo ga la thog sa ga mas de skad bstan lags mod/ rgyal pos smras pa1/4)ma pa mo ni mkhas pa yin no/ /mi zhig chu
'gram du lham bzhag nas khrus byed pa dang / mi gzhan zhig 'ongs nas des lham des mgo la dkris nas de nyid na khrus bya bar brtsams so/ /mi de khrus byas nas langs nas lham de ma mthong ngo / /mi des smras pa/ kye nang rje ci tshol lham slo/ /khyod kyi lham ga la yod/ gal te khyod la lham yod par gyur na/ ji ltar ngasamago la dkris nas zhugasapa de bzhin du khyod kyis kyang lham gyisamago la dkris nasazhugs par 'gyur ro/ /des smras pa/ 'o ni nyid kho bo'ilham yin no/ /de gnyis khyod kyi nga'i zhes rtsod par gyur nas/ de gnyis rgyal po'i drung du song ngo / /rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag legs par rtogs la gang gi yin pa de la byin cig de rnamasakyis brtag par brtsams nas gcig la dris pa dang / des smras pa/ bdag gi lags so/ /cig phregs la yang dris pa dang / des smras pa/ bdag gi lags so/ /zhes khyod kyi dang nga'i zhesapa la nyi ma 'das te blon po rnams dub nas dgongs ka gtan la ma phebs pa bzhin du khyim du dong ngo / /sa ga mas ri dwags 'dzin gyi zhes bya ba nas dris te zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ des ji ltar gyur pa rnams smras pa dang / sa ga mas smras pa/ jo bo 'di la dpyad du ci zhig mchis/ de gnyis la gcig kyang phyed khyer cig cig shos kyang phyed khyer cig ces gsungs shig dang / gang gi lags pa de'i mchid nas ni ci'i phyir bdag gi lham dral zhes mchi'o/ /gang ma lags pa de'i slo ba ni re zhig bdag gis phyed thob na yang der zad 'dir bdag la ci zhig 'ged snyam ste de ltar brtag par bgyi'o/ /ri dwags 'dzin song nas blon po rnamasal smras nasazhes bya ba nas rgyal pos smras pa/ tsam pa mo ni mkhas pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /rgyal po la tshong pa gru bas tsan+dan gyi sdong dum zhig skyes su phul ba dang / de'i mgo gang yin mjug gang yin pa ma shes nas rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba ji lta bu yin rtogs shig de rnams kyis nyin 142
thog thag dpyad na ma shes nas dgongs ka khyim du dong ngo / /sag mas zhes bya ba nas ri dwags 'dzin gyis dris pa zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /des ji ltar gyur pa rnams rgya cher smras pa dang / sa ga mas smras pa/ jo bo 'di la dpyad du ci mchis chab tu 'or cig dang rtsa ba gang yin pa de ni 'bying bar 'gyur ro/ /thor to gang lags pa ni steng du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la brtag pa ni de lags so/ /ri dwags 'dzin gyis blon po rnams la smrasanasazhes bya ba nas rgyal pos smras pa/ tsam pa mo ni mkhasapa yin no zhesbya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /ri 'or na khyim bdag cig yod pa des de dang rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs pa las de la bu pho yang med/ bu mo yang med/ de bu mngon par 'dod pas chun ma zhig blangs pa dang / de la chung ma chen mo shos rang bzhin gyis phrag dog can zhig pas de'i mngal ma rung bar bya ba'i sbyor ba zhig byas pa las de'i mngal shin tu rnam par dag pas sems can dang ldan par gyur nas ji tsam na zla ba dgu 'das pa dang / khye'u zhig btsas sog/ /des bsams pa/ sha khon rnams la ni 'di lta ste/ chen chun 'di tha chad yin pas gdon mi za bar ma yar mos thabs gang yang rung ba zhig gis gsod par 'gyur na/bdag gi khyim thab bam/ bdag gis ci byar yod/ bdag gis nam du ni srung ye de kho na la sbyin par bya'o snyam nas de dang khyim thab lhan cig gros byas te rung nas chen ma shos la smras pa/ che zhe bdag gi bu 'di khyod la byin gyisagasosashig desabasams pa khyim ni gang la bu yod pa de kho na'i yin par zad pas khyim gyi bdag mor gyur pas gso'o snyam nas/ desade gsos pa lasade'i pha yang shi bar gyur to/ /de gnyisakhyim gyi phyir rtsod par gyur nas gcig gis smras pa/ 'di kho mo3bu yin no/ /cig shos kyis smras pa/ 'di ni kho mo'ibu yin no/ /rgyal po'i drung du song 193 dang / rgyal pos blon po rnams la bsgo ba
