shes ldan dag deng la gang yin pa rtogs shig de rnams kyis dpyad pa las nyi ma 'das kyang gtan la ma phebs nas/ dgongs ka khyim du dong ba dang / sa ga mas ri dwags 'dzin la dris te zhes bya ba nasa'adi la dpyad du ci mchis zhesabya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ de gnyis la kho bo cag gis gang gi bu yin pa mi shes kyis/ khyed cag gnyisalas gang stobasache ba de khyer la song zhig cesagasungasashig dang / lag pa gnyis nas bzung nas 'dren par bgyid de/ de sdug bsngal gyis ngu bar gyur pa dang de'i ma gang lags pa de ni brtse ba mchis pas 'di gson na nam zhig na mthong bar 'gyur grang snyam nas gtong bar bgyid do/ /cig shos ni brtse ba ma mchis pas gang gi tshe mi gtong ba de'i tshe de la lcag gis gzhus shig dang ji ltar gyur pa smra bar 'gyur te/ 'di la brtag pa ni 'di lags so/ /ri dwags 'dzin gyis blon po rnamasal smras pa dang zhes bya ba nas rgyal pos smras pa/ tsam pa mo ni mkhas pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dus gzhan zhig na ri dwags 'dzin nad kyis thebs nas de la sman pas nyi ma gcig sman byin pa las theg gi bar gyur to/ /phyi de nyin par sman ma yin pa byin pas nad la bab par gyur to sna/ /sa ga mas bsams pa/ jo bo ji'i slad du nyin gcig ni theg gi bar gyur la/ nyin gcig ni na bar gyur snyam nas des sman gang dag gis theg gi bar gyur pa'i rtags de dag bzung nas/ de nas des sman pa rnams sgo nasaslar bzlog nasarang nyid kyis dpyad pa las sos par gyur to/ /ri dwags 'dzin gyis bsams pa/ gang gis na bdag nyin gcig ni theg gi nyin gcig ni na ba lasagang gi tshe sman pa mi 'ong ba de'i theg gi ba 'di la rgyu ci zhig yod snyam ste/ des sa ga ma la dris pa zhes bya ba nasatsam pa mo ni mkhas pa yin no zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi glang po che'i bla dpal skyed ces bya ba de la dus 144
gzhan zhig na rgyal po gshe bar gyur to/ /zhesas ga mas thos nas desari dwags 'dzin la smras pa/ jo bo blon po thamasacad la mthar gyisabaka' bab par 'gyur gyis/ dpal skyed la lha bzod pa mdzad du stsal ba'i rigs so/ /des smrasapa/ bu mo bzod pa byed du gzhug go de nas desargyal po la smrasapa/ lha dpal skyed ni lha la glo ba nye ba lags na de la bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ rgyal pos smrasapa/ bzod par bya'o/ /lha gal te bzod par mdzad na de'i dbang thang de dag stsal du gsol/ de bzhin du sbyin no/ /dpal skyed kyisaji ltar phug masabadag la rgyal po bzod pa byed du bcug pa shesanas de de la lan glan pa'i bsam pas gnas so/ /dus gzhan zhig na ri dwags 'dzin pho mtshan la nad byung ste/ de'i rim gro sa ga ma byed pa lasade 'dzem par gyur to/ /des smrasapa/ jo bo 'di la 'dzem du ci mchis/ ci pha'i rim gro bu mo mi bgyid dam/'on kyang de 'dzem par gyur to/ /des bsams pa 'di bdag gis rim gro byar ni mi btub pas de'i chung ma zhig blang ngo snyam pa nas de dpal skyed kyi khyim du song ba dang /des 'ongs pa legs so zhes bya ba'i tshig smras nas stan bstabs te 'dug go /dpal skyed la bu mo zhig yod pa de des de la smras pa/ bu mo sa ga ma'i rkang pa gnyis la zungs shig sag mas smras pa/ bdag gisa'adi'i rkang pa la gzung bar 'gyur ba'i gnas gang lags pa de ni mchis so zhephusmras nadragayang smrasapa/ bkra shis par gyur cig bkra shis par gyur cig dpal skyed kyisasmras pa/ ci zhig slong / bu mo slong ngo / /su zhig gi ched du/des smras pa/ gyos po'iched du'o/ /de cang mi smra bar 'dug go /dpal skyed kyi chung mas smras pa/ dgog cig na de la ci ste sbyin/ sa ga mas smras pa/ mi rnams kyi lang tsho ni nor yin pas dpyad du ci yod byin cig dpal skyed kyisasmras pa/ bzang mo bdag cag la sa ga mas phan btags kyis byin cig gal te de lta na sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas ri 145
dwags 'dzin gyis dpal gyi 'byor ba chen pos bag mar blangs nas/ de de'i rim gro byed par gyur te sa ga ma ni de ltar mi byed do/ /ri dwags 'dzin gyis smras pa/ bu mo bdag la tshig byin cig desasmrasapa/ jo bo cung zad nyams par ma gyur tam/ bu mo khyod la mas bslabs pa gang yin pa de cung zad blangs te mi gnas sam/ jo bo thams cad blangasalags te/ nyi ma dang zlo ba gnyis la phyag byos shig ces mchi ba gang lags pa ni mna' ma'i nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu ni gyos sgyug lags pas re zhig bdag gis phyag bgyis lags so/ /me la bkur sti bya'o zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni bud med kyi khyim thab ni me lta bu lags te/ khyim thab la ha cang bsnyen par mi bgyi/ ha cang bsring bar yang mi bgyi ste bdag ni khyim thab la me lta bur bsnyen bkur bgyid do/ /me long phyi bar bya'o zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni sdum pa ni me long lta bu lags pathagartag tu zhal zhal bgyi zhing phyag dar bgyi ba lagadragate/ sdum pa de la bdag gdugs gcig bzhin du pyi dor bgyid lagasaso/ /gos dkar po bgo bar bya'o zhesamachi ba gang lagasapa ni khyim gyi lasabagyid pa na gos gzhan dag kho nasaso/ /lha mchod pa dang khyim thab kyi drung du mchi ba na ni gos dkar po rnams bgo bar bgyi ba ste/ de yang bdag bgyid lags so/ /blang bar bya'i sbyin par mi bya'o zhesamachi ba gang lags pa la ci zhig blang bar bgyi zhe na/ 'jig rten lasatshig ngan pa smras pa'o/ /tshig ngan pa ni su la yang smra bar mi bgyi ba ste/ de yang bdag gis yang dag par blangs te gnas lags so/ /tshig bsrung bar bya'o zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni gsang ba'i tshig mi 'phel bar bgyi ba ste/bdag la ngag bsdam pa mchis lags so/ /langs nas su la yang stan bstab par mi bya'o zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni de 'di skad ces khyod rigs kyi mna' ma yin pas khyod gnas dben pa na 'dug par bya'o zhes mchi ba lags te/ bdag dben pa kho na na 146
mchis lags so/ /zhim po bza' bar bya'o zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni shin tu bkres nasabaza' bar bgyi ba ste/ bdag ni rtag tu khyim gyi skye bo zasa'atshal ba'i 'og tu 'tshal lo/ /bde bar nyal bar bya zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni mtshan mo khyim gyi dgos pa thams cad bgyis nas snod brtul te ci nas kyang ldang mi dgos par khyod nyal bar bya'o zhes bgyi ba lags te/ 'di ni legs par bzhag pa'o/ /'di ni nyes par bzhag pa'o zhes bdag de kho na bzhin du bgyid do/ /them skas bca' bar bya'o zhes mchi ba gang lags pa ni 'di skad ces khyod sngon dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan pa des lha'i 'gro ba thob nas 'dir mi'i 'jig rten du skyes pa 'di ni las kyis yin pas 'dir yang khyod kyis sbyin pa dag byin/ bsod nams dag byas te sdig pa mi bya'o/ /'di ni dbyig gi ya gad mtho ris kyi them skas lta bu yin no zhes bgyi ba lags te de yang bdag rngo ci thog gis bgyid do/ /sa ga ma legs so legs so/ /khyod kyi ma mkhas pa yin na/ gang gi phyir mas ldem por smrasapa rtogs pas na/ khyod ni lhag par yang mkhas pa yin no/ /de nas ri dwags 'dzin 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang na sa ga ma la bdag gis ma zhes bod do snyam nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / bcom ldan 'dasakyi zhagasaganyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad cesagasol to/ /btsun pa mna' ma la ma zhes bod du rung lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te chos lnga dang ldan na ste/ lnga gang zhe na nad g.yog byed pa dang /thab rir bab pa'i chung ma len pa dang / srog gi skyabs byed pa dang / nor srung ba dang /shesarab kyi bgo bsha' byed pa'o/ /bar sdom la/ nad g.yog dang ni chung ma dang / /srog dang nor ni sbyin pa dang / /shes rab sgrub ༷dī byed pa dang / /lnga po 'di dag mar bshad
do| |de nar+sāri dwagasa'adzin ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /lha bdag ni sa ga ma la ma zhes 'bod par 'tshal lo/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ sa ga mas nga la yang rim gro byas pas/ phyi mo la drisal ngas kyang de la sring mo zhesa'abod do/ /desaphyi mo ladrisapa dang / desasmras pa/khyod kyis bos kyang rung ma bos kyang rung / de ni khyod kyi sring mo kho na yin no/ /ring du 'phur tshangasasbyin mngag gzhug ma'i bu mo dang 'dusapa las de las bu pho zhig btsas te de'i ming stobs kyi bshes gnyen du btags pa las de rgyal po mes kyis nyes pa 'ga' zhig gi phyir sprugasapa lasatsam par song nasaganas pa de'i bu mo ni 'di yin pasadesan khyod kyi sring mor 'ong ngo / /de nasargyal posaglang po che la zhon nasadril sgrogasasu brtsa pa/phug ma 'di ri dwagasa'adzin gyi ni ma rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi ni sring mo yin no/ /des sngon gyi kun dga' ra bar gtsug lag khang brtsigs nas phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul ba dang / de bzhin du gnas brtan rnams kyis kyang mdo sde'i nang du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasamanyan yod na ri dwags 'dzin gyi ma sa ga ma'i sngon gyi kun dga' ra ba'i khang bzang na bzhugs so zhes gdags pa byas so/ /dus gzhan zhig na sa ga ma las sgo nga sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung ngo / /zhes ri dwags 'dzin gyis thos nas lag pa 'gram pa la gtad nas sems khong du chud cing 'dug ste/ yul gyi bzang mo la phung ba ci 'dra ba dag byung bar gyur snyam nas ri dwags 'dzin gyis dor bar brtsams pa dang / sa ga mas smras pa/ jo bo ma dor bar bcom ldan 'das la zhus shig de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ma dor bar gzeb sum bcu rtsa gnyis gyisal shing bal gyisakhong ste/ gzeb bu rnamasakyi nang du sgo nga re re zhog la sa ga mas dus gsum du lag pas byugs shig ces sgo zhig dang / de 148
nasanyi ma bdun pa lags nasagazhon nu sum bcu rtsa gnyisa'abyung bar 'gyur ro/ /desde bzhin du byasapa lasanyi ma bdun pa lags pa dang / gzhon nu sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung nasabasringasabaskyed de nar son pa dang rtsal po che thub rlag pa sha stag tu gyur to/ /dus gzhan zhig na de rnams shing rtar zhugs te phyir byung nas slar 'jug pa dang /mdun na 'don gyi bu shing rtar zhugs nas phyir 'byung ba dang ji tsam na phan tshun shing rta'i mda' gnyis thug pa dang / mdun na 'don gyi bus smras pa/ zur cig de rnams kyis smrasapa/ khyod nyid zur cig mdun na 'don gyi busamajal to zhesabyasanasatshig rtsub po smra bar brtsams pa dang / de nas phug ma'i bu rnams kyis shing rta'i mda' nas bzung ste 'phangs pas phyag dar gyi phung polistong du brdab bsnun to/ /de de nas gos kyis mgo bsgyur te pha'i drung du song nasamig mchi masagang bsasmrasapa/ yab phug ma'i bu rnamskyisabadag 'di 'dra ba'i gnasaskabasasu bgyisaso/ /bu ci'i phyir/ des rgyas par smras pa dang / des smrar+sāpa/ bu gal te de lta na thabasashig bsham par byas la de rnamasamathar gyis kha gdag gis mya ngan ma byed cig de de rnams la klan ka tshol ba lhur len cing gnas so/ /dus gzhan zhig na ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la ri 'or ba log par gyur nas/ rgyal pos de la dmag kha chen cig bkye ba lasardugasarab tu rdugasanasaslar log go /de bzhin du lan bdun gyi bar du dmag kha chen po bkye ba las rdugs rab tu rdugs te slar log nas rgyal po rang nyid dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang byung ba dang sa ga ma'i bu nang du 'jug pa de rnams kyisade mthong nasasmras pa/ lha gang du gshegs ri 'or ba rnams 'bebs su'o/ /lha bzhugs shig bdag cag mchi'o/ /de bzhin du gyis shig des de rnams la dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa gtad nas de rnams dong ste ri 'or ba rnams phab nas gte'u bzung dpya blangs te/ slar 'ongs pa dang mdun na 'don 149
gyis smras pa/ lha 'di dag ni 'phags par rtsal po che dag cig ste/ re zhig lha'i dka' bas bsgrub pa gang lags pa de ni 'di dag gidraga'abring gidragabasgrubs kyithagalhadranga'adi la dgongs shig rgyal po rnams ni khum phrig can yin pas snying la bzhag ste slar mdun na 'don la dris pa de la ji ltar bsgrub par bya/ desasmras pa/ lha de la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ gal te de dag 'tshal bar gyur na/ lha rgyal srid nas phyung nas rang nyid rgyal srid bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po je mi dga' nas bsams pa/ de ltar 'gyur srid kyis ji ltar gsad par bya zhe na/ thabs bsham pa sems shing gsang 'phel du dogs pas su la yang mi 'dri bar de bdag nyid kyis dpyad pa las blo skyes pa 'di kho nar mgron du bos la bstungasate gtang ngo snyam nasadesasag ma la spring ba/ che zhe'i bu rnamssang 'dir zan zo zhig des bsams pa/ sang ni bu rnams zhang polider za bar 'gyur gyis/ bdag gis kyang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod gsol lo snyam du bsams nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang /bcom ldan 'dasakyi zhabaphuganyisal mgo bosaphyag byasanasaphyogasagacig tu 'dug go /phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis ri dwags 'dzin gyi ma sa ga ma la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis zhes bya ba nas yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad nas cang mi gsung ngo zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas ri dwags 'dzin gyi ma phug ma stan las langasate/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nasabacom ldan 'dasal 'di skad cesagasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang thabs cig tu sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod sbyor zhing mchis na gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas ri dwags 'dzin gyi ma sa ga ma la gnang ngo zhes bya ba nas dge slong gi 15()
dge 'dun gyi gung la gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs so zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /rgyal polipho nya de rnams kyis drung du 'ongs nas khye'u shog cig ces bos so/ /de nas rgyal pos dug ha la ha la dang zas su sbyar bas rmongs par byas nas mgo rnamasabacad de/ de nasagazeb bkang nas steng du phu bo shosakyi mgo bzhag ste rgya skyegs la rgyas btab nas sa ga ma la bskur ba dang sa ga mas bsams pa/ gdon mi za bar lhasasring mo3bu rnams la bgo ba zhig bskur ba yin gyis/ bdag gisakyang sangasargyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la bgo bar 'bul lo snyam nas/ de nas sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnamasabade bar bzhugs par rig nas gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba rnams kyis zhes bya ba nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyisagasol zin nasaphyag bcabs te lhung bzed gyu bar rig nasazhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /gzeb kha dbye bar rtsam pa dang bcom ldan 'dasakyis dgongasapa/ ga la te sa ga mas bden pa ma mthong bar bu bsad pa mthong na bden pa rnams kyi snod du mi 'gyur ba'i gnas gang yin pa de yod do snyam du dgongs nas sa ga ma la bka' stsal pa/re zhig 'dug la chos nyon la phyis ci dga' ba gyis shig des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas chos mnyan pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'dug go /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ba dang khams dang rang bzhin mkhyen nas zhes bya ba nas bden pa mthong bar mdzad do zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bden pa mthong nas gzeb kha phye ba dang bu'i mgo rnams mthong nas/ de nas gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'du byed thams cad ni 'di ltar mi rtag pa lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis sa ga ma'i bu rnams bstungs pa ni nyes so/ /151
gal te ma bstungs par gyur na 'di rnams kho nas grogs byasapas de'i lag mthil du sa mtha' dag 'jog par 'gyur ba zhig de nas na phula'i rgyal po gsal rgyal lusardul gyis yog cing bcom ldan 'dasagang na ba der song ste phyin pa dang bcom ldan 'dasakyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /phyogs gcig tu ༷|kā rnyi |k+ta bcom ldan 'das kyis ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la 'di skad ces rgyal po chen po khyod lus rdul gyis yog cing gang nas 'dir 'ongs/ btsun pa rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nasadabang bskur ba yul gyi dbang phyug dang mthu dang / brtson 'grusathob pa/ sa'i dkyil 'khor chen po legasapar phab ste gnasapa rnamasakyisargyal polibagyi ba dang / rgyal polisgrub pa tha dad pa gang dag lags pa de dag bdag gis bgyisate/ yongasasu rdzogasanasalusardul gyisayog cing nga mchis pa lags so/ /rgyal po chen po de'i phyir khyod nyid la dri bar byas/ khyod kyisaji ltar bzod pa de lan thob cigrgyal po chen po dper na khyod la 'dir shar phyogs nas mi yid ches pa yid brtan du rung ba/ brtan pa/ 'jig rten la mi slu ba zhig 'ongs nas/ de 'di skad ces lha bdag da gzod 'di nasashar phyogs su mchi mchi na/ de nasabadag gisari brag chen po ma chag pa/ser ka ma mchis pa/ phrag ma mchis pa/ shin tu mkhregs pa/ gcig tu sdug pa zhig sa'i bar dang nam mkha'i bar gyi sems can thams cad dang / srog chags thams cad dang /'byung po thams cad dang / rtswa dang / shing dang / yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'dab ma ji snyed pa thams cad phye mar rlog cing mchi ba mthong gisalha khyod kyi bgyi ba'am/ bsgrub pa gang lags pa de mdzod cig ces zer la de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang /byang phyogs nas mi zhig 'ongs te zhes bya ba nas bgyi ba'am bsgrub pa de mdzod cig ces 152
zer te/ rgyal po chen po 'jigasapa chen poliyang chen po mi bzad par byed pa mi bzad pa de lta bu nye bar gnas na mi nyid thob pa ni rnyed par dka' na/ khyod kyis ci zhig bya/btsun pa 'jigasapa chen poliyang chen po mi bas par bgyid pa mi bzad pa de lta bu nye bar gnasan mi nyid thob pa rnyed par dka' ba lagasapasadon spyod pa dang / chosaspyad pa dang / bsod namasaspyad pa dang / dge ba spyad pa dang / bzang po spyad pa dang / sangsrgyas rnams kyi bstan pa la brtson par bgyi ba ma lags par gzhan ci zhig bgyir mchis/ rgyal po chen po khyod ci'i phyir 'di skad cesabatsun pa 'jigs pa chen poliyang chen po de lta bu zhesabya ba nadragasangadradargyasarnamadragakyi bstan pa la brtson par bgyi zhephubya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /btsun pa rgyal po rgyal rigs sgyi bo nas dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du ste/ sa'i dkyil 'khor chen po legadra(par phab ste gnadragapa de rnamadra(kyis glang po che rnamasadang glang po cher 'gyed pa dang / rta pa rnamasadang rta par 'gyed pa dang / shing rta pa rnams dang shing rta par 'gyed pa dang / dpung bu chung rnams dang dpung bu chung du 'gyed pa dang / gsang tshig mkhan rnamasadang gsang tshig mkhan du 'gyed pa dang / nor rnamasakyisanor du rgyal ba tha dad pa gang dag lagasapa de dag thams cad de'i tshe 'gyed pa'i mthu ma mchisapa dang stobasam mchis pa dang / pha rol gnon pa ma mchis pa lagspas de'i slad du bdag 'di skad ces btsun pa 'jigs pa chen poliyang chen po de lta bu nye bar gnasan zhes bya ba nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa la brtson par bgyi ba ma lags par gzhan ci zhig bgyir mchis zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhin du srog chags 'di dag kyang rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par rga ba dang / 'chi bas 'joms pa yin no/ /rgyal po chen po ṭ+wāṃ snar rga ba dang 'chi bas 'dzoms pa na skyes
pa gang dag gis don spyad pa dang zhes bya ba nas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi bstan pa la brtson par bya ba ma yin par gzhan ci zhig byar yod ces bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pas bka' stsal pa/ ji ltar che zhing rgya che ba'i/ /ri bo nam mkha' las 'ong ba/ /kun nas yang dag 'ong ba yis/ /sani phye mar rlog pa na/ /de la gling po tshesami rdzi/ /dpung bu chung dab zhing rta dang / /rtar+sāmin gsang tshig mkhan dang ni/ /nor gyisa'agyed pasargyal mi 'thob/ /de bzhin rga dang 'chi ba yis/ /mi rnams 'joms par byed pa na/ /rgyal rigs bram ze rje'u rigs dang / /dmangs rigs gdol pa g.yung po dang / /tshul khrims 'chal dang tshul khrims ldan/ /khyim pa de bzhin brtul zhugs can/ /lang tsho nyid dang rgan po dang / /de bzhin bar ma'i mi rnamasal/ /cung zad kyang ni 'dzem med par/ /thamasacad mngon du 'jomspar byed/ /de lta bas na mkhas pa'i mi/ /bdag gi don la blta ba yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /bla med dag la dad bya zhing / /lus dang ngag dang yid dag gis/ /dam pa'i chos ni spyad byas na/ /'di na smad par mi 'gyur zhing / /mtho ris song nas dga' bar 'gyur/ /de nas ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa la mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rangs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabaphuganyisal mgo bos phyag byas te stan las langs nas song ngo / /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa ri dwagasa'adzin gyi ma sag mas las ci zhig bgyis na/las de'i rnam par smin pas sgo nga sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung ba de rnams las kyang bu pho sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung ste rtsal po che thub rlag pa sha stag tu gyur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyisabaka' stsal pa/ smon lam gyi dbang gis so/ /gang du smon lam btab lags/154
dge slong dag sngon byung ba bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer du khyim bdag cig gi bu shi nasade'i chung ma de rtag tu bu mngon par 'dod par gyur to/ /gang gi tshe yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangasargyasa'od srung gisasangasargyasakyi mdzad pa mtha' dag mdzad nasashing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan lasa'adas pa de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sīr rgyal po kṛ zhwa zhesabya ba byung ste/ des yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangasargyasa'od zung gi mchod rten rin po che sna bzhi lasabartsigs so/ /de nas bud med bu med pa bu mngon par 'dod pa gang yin pa de yang rgas par gyur nas mchodarten de la byi dor byasanasa'adug go /desa'adun pa'i slong mo byasanasamachod rten de la mchod par byas te smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten la bya ba byas pa gang yin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag bu mang por gyur cig cesabyasate song nasagrong khyer du zhugasaso/ /de na bud med cig bu nad kyi sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas nyen nas ngu ba dang des gzhan zhig la drisapa/ ci'i phyir 'di ngu bar gyur desaji ltar gyur pa rnams smrasapa dang des bsams pa/ gal te bdag kyang bu byung bar gyur na/ bdag kyang sdug bsngal 'di lta bu nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro snyam pa las/ ci tsam na sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dge 'dun gyis mchod rten de la mchod pa byed pa na bud med de yang de dang ha cang mi ring ba zhig na 'dug go /de rnams kyis mchod pa byasanas smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'disabadag cag tshan po che chen polistobasadang ldan par gyur cig ces byas so/ /des de rnams la dris pa bu dag khyed kyis smon lam ci zhig btab/ de rnams kyis smras pa/yum 'di dang 'di dag go /des smras pa/ bu dag gal te de ltar na khyed cig gi mar bdag kho na gyur cig yum de bzhin du gyur cig ces smrasanas de rnams dong ngo / /des 155
bsamasapa/ re zhig bud med de lan gcig btsa' na yang sdug bsngal gyi tshor bsanyen nasade ltar ngu na/ bdag la lan sum bcu rtsa gnyis btsa' na ji ltar bya zhesade de ltar rnam par rtog pa na/ mchod rten dang nye ba na bya gag mo zhig yod pa sgo nga 'byung bar de de thang cig tsam gyis sgo nga sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung la smre sngags kyang mi 'don to/ /des bsamasapa/ 'byung ba'i thabasa'adi ni rung ba yin no snyam du rig nasamachod rten de la dad pa drag pos smon lamagadab par brtsams pa/ ji ltar bya gag mo 'di thang cig tsam gyis sgo nga sum bcu rtsa gnyis byung ba de bzhin du bdag gi bu sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyang cig car sgo ngar 'byung bar gyur cig cesabyasaso/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dusakyi bud med rgan mo gang yin pa de ni sag ma 'di nyid yin no/ /sum bcu rtsa gnyisakyi dge 'dun gang yin pa de ni sa ga ma'i bu 'di rnamasakho na yin te/ 'disade na smon lam btab pa gang yin pa de'i lasakyi rnam par smin pasasgo nga sum bcu rtsa gnyisabyung ngo / /btsun pa/ sag ma'i bu rnamasakyis las ci zhig bgyis na lasade'i rnam par smin pasanongs pa ma bgyis shing skyon ma mchispar rgyal po gsal rgyal gyidragabakum nas de rnamadragakyi mgodragagazeb bkang ste sa ga ma la bskur lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di dag kho nas las rnams byas shing bsags pa dag ni zhes bya ba nas lus can rnams la 'bras bur 'gyur zhes bya ba'i bar gong ma bzhin du'o/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba ri 'or zhig na chang 'tshong zhig gnas so/ /chom rkun pa rab tu mang po chang tshol zhing de'i drung du 'ongs nas dris pa/ chang yod dam/ chang 'tshong gi chung mas smras pa/ yod do zhes de rnams la chang blud na 'dzar ba med nas des glang zhig bstan de 'di sod cig de rnams kyis smras pa / mtshon cha med do/ /des gta' blangs nas mtshon cha byin pa dang / de rnams kyis de 156
bsad par brtsamasaso/ /degasod pa na semasal bdag gsod pa gang yin pa 'di dag thams cad ni chang 'tshong gi chung ma 'di yin gyis/ bdag gang du 'di rnams kyi mgo bcad nas gzeb bkang ste 'di la bskur bar 'gyur ba der skye bar gyur cig ces bsamasaso/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dusakyi glang gang yin pa de ni ko gula'i rgyal po gsal rgyal 'di nyid yin no/ /chom rkun pa gang yin pa de rnamasani r+sāga ma'i bu 'di dag nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dusakyi chang 'tshong gi chung mgang yin pa de ni sag ma 'di nyid yin no zhes rgyasapar bya'o/ / / /mdo khu mdzangasablun du blon po ridwagasakyi le'u zhesapa'i nang du yang lha 'tshamaphum zhesabya'i lo rgyusa'adi lasacung bsdusal bya tshula'aga' re mi 'dra yangadon du 'didang donagakhyag pa'isnam thar zhig yod/
༄rgyu/ /btsun mo zla 'od kyis dge slong ma ri ma'i mdun nas chos thos te lha yul du skyes nasa'abras bu thob tshul/'dul ba lungarnama'abyed las2khus/bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ rgyal pokhu tra ya na'i btsun moli'akhor gyi bud med dang grong khyer sgra sgrogs na gnas pa'i bud med rnams dge slong ma gang gis gdul ba yin snyam du dgongs na/ dge slong ma ri ma'i gdul ba yin par gzigasanas de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong ma ri ma la bka' stsal pa/ ri ma grong khyer sgra grogs na rgyal pokhu tra ya na'i btsun moli'akhor gyi bud med dang / sgra grogs na gnas pa'i bud med rnams la soms shig dge slong ma ri mas btsun pa bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes bcom ldan 'das las mnyan nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyisal mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nas dge slong ma ri ma de nyid kyi mtshan mo 'das nas snga dro sham thabs bgos lhung bzed dang chos gos thogs te rgyal polikhab tu bsod snyoms la zhugasaso/ /rgyal polikhab tu bsod snyoms brgyus nas zas kyi bya ba byas te phyi ma'i zas kyi bsod snyoms las phyir logs pas ji ltar longs spyad pa'i gnas mal mkhos su phab steg/ lhung bzed dang chosagosathogs nasa'akhor lnga brgya dang grong khyer sgra sgrogasag la ba der song ngo / /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos kyang rgyal pokhu tra ya na la phrin yig 'di skad ces shed mthun dgyes pa khyod kyi phyir bdag gis nyan sgos ma chen mo ston pas bsngags pa 'di 'khor lnga brgya dang gtang /sdu khyod kyis kyang dpag tshad phyed dang gsum
'dul ba'i sde snod 'a sa ba pa'i dge sbyongamasogasakyi rnam thar skor/du lam dang grong khyer mdzes par bya (zhung bdag nyid dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang ldan pas bsu bar bya ste/ grong khyer gyi nang du dbyar khang lnga brgya yang byed du gzhug par bya/ khri dang khri'u dang / stan nang tshangs can dang / la ba dang sngas dang / gor bu lnga brgya yang 'bul bar bya/ bsod snyoms lnga brgya yang sbyor du gzhug par bya ste/ des na khyed kyisabasod nams chen po 'thob par 'gyur ro zhes bris te bskur ro/ /rgyal po36 tra ya nas 'phrin yig de bklags nas dga' ba dang mchog tu dga' ba skyesate/ des dpag tshad phyed dang gsum du lam dang grong khyer mdzes par byed du bcug nas bdag nyid dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dang / skye bo 'bum phrag du ma'i 'khor dang bcas pas bsu nas bkur sti chen pos grong khyer du 'jug tu bcug cing / grong khyer gyi nang du dbyar khang lnga brgya byed du bcug ste/ khri dang khri'u dang / stan nang tshangs can dang la ba dang sngas dang gor bu lnga brgya yang 'bul du bcug bsod snyoms lnga brgya yang sbyor du bcug go /dge slong ma ri ma nyin re zhing rgyal pokhu tra ya na'i btsun moli'akhor dang / grong khyer sgra sgrogs na gnas pa'i bud med rnams kyi nang du zhugs te chos ston par byed do/ /rgyal pokhu tra ya na ni pi waX mkhas pa yin la/ btsun mo zla 'od ni gar mkhas pa yin pas ji tsam du dus gzhan zhig na rgyal posnga/ tra ya nas pi lpaX sbrengs te btsun mo zla 'od gar byed do/ /des de gar byed pa na chud za ba'i mtshan ma mthong nas des de la mgo mjug tu brtags te bsams na zhag bdun 'das na 'di dus byed par 'gyur ro snyam nas de'i lag nas pi waṃ shor te sa la lhung ba dang / btsun mo zla 'od kyis smras pa/ lha bdag gis gar ma legs sam ci nongs/ zla 'od khyod kyis gar ma legs pa ma yin te/ 'di ltar ngas khyod gar byed pa na chud za ba'i mtshan dī pathong bas nyi ma bdun pa la khyed dus byed
par 'gyur ro/ /btsun mo zla 'od kyisargyal polirkang pa gnyisal gtugasate smrasapa/ lha gal te de lta na bdag gis lha la bsnyen bkur ni bgyis lagadragan/ gal te lhas gnang na bdag rab tu 'byung ngo / /rgyal pos smras pa/ zla 'od dus yin gyis gnang ngo / /gal te khyed rab tu byung nas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed na ni de nyid khyod kyi sdug bsngal gyi mtha' yin no/ /gal te kun tu sbyor ba lhag ma dang bcasapasadusabyasate lha rnamasakyi nang du skyes par gyur na ni khyed lhar gyur pas ngal blta bar bya'o/ /des smradra(pa/ lha bka' bzhin 'tshal/ rgyal po༄5 tra ya nas btsun mo zla 'od dge slong ma ri ma la gtad de smras pa/ 'phags ma btsun mo zla 'od legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ba dang rdzogs par bsnyen pa dge slong ma'i dngos po 'tshal gyis de'i slad du 'phags mas 'di rab tu 'byung ba dang /rdzogasapar bsnyen par mdzad pa'i rigs so/ /dge slong ma ri mas smras pa/ de ltar bgyi'o zhes des de rab tu byung zhing rdzo gas par bsnyen par byas so/ /dge slong ma ri mas bsams pas/ de la 'chi ba'i 'du shes sgoms shig ces gdams ngag byin no/ /btsun mo zla 'od kyis 'chi ba'i 'du shes bsgom par brtsams nas de nyi ma bdun pa la dus la bab nas rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu molichos nyid ni skyesanas ring po ma lon pa la sems gsum skye ste/ gang nas shi 'phos pa dang / gang du skyes pa dang / las gang gis skyesapa'o/ /lha'i bu mo zla 'od kyis bsams pa/ bdag gang nas shi 'phos snyam na/mi rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos pa dang / gang du skyes snyam na rgyal chen bzhi pa'i nang du skyes pa dang / las gang gis skyes snyam na bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la tshangs par spyod pa spyad pa nyid kyis skyes par mthong ngo / /de nas lha'i bu mo zla 'od 'di snyam du 160
semasaha/ gang gi phyir bdag yongasasu gnasapa bsten te bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir nye bar 'gro ba ni bdag gi tshul dang mthun pa ma yin gyis bdag yongs su gnas pa ma brten pa kho nar bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang /bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir nye bar 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas lha'i bu mo zla 'od rna cha gdub 'khor g.yo zhing dri ma med pa thogs te do shal dang se mo dosabargyan pa'i lusakyis lha'i56 la dang / pad ma dang / ku mu da dang /pad+ma dkar po dag gisathu ba bkang ste kha dog shin tu 'dasapasamatshan mo la bab pa dang /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song lta phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la me tog dag gis mngon par gtor te bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas mtha' gcig tu 'dug pa dang / 'di ltar lha'i bu mo zla 'od kyi kha dog gi mthusa'od ma'i tshal ka lan da dzi'i gnasathamasacad snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'dasakyis lha'i bu mo zla 'od kyi bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang / khamasadang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas gang thos nas lha'i bu mo zla 'od kyis stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogasal lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa de lta bur 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yang dag par so sor rtogs par byed pa'i chosabastan ba mdzad do/ /des bden pa mthong nasabatsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mes dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge spyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang mdza' bshes dang rtsa lag gi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyisate/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams/ rus pa'i ri dag 16/
las ni bsgral/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dwags dag nas ne+e rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnamasakyi nang du ni bzhag go zhesalan gsum du ched du brjod pa ched du brjod do/ /yang smras pa/ khyod mthus rab drag nyes pa mang ldan pa'i/ /ngan song shul bkag bsod nams rab ldan pa'i/ /mtho ris 'gro ba phye zhing bdag gis ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i shul yang thob par gyur/ man tu rnam dag khyod brten bdag gis ni/ /de ring skyon bral dag pa'i mig thob cing / /go 'phang zhi ba 'phagasapa dgyes thob ste/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i pha rol brgal bar gyur/ /'gro ba lha min mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang na 'chi bral ba po/ /srid pa stong du mthong ba rab dkon pa/ /thub pa de ring khyod mthong 'bras bu mchis/ /de nas gdud byas do shal rab 'phyang bas/ /zhabs la phyag 'tshal rangasapa skyes gyur nas/ /dgra thul g.yas nas yongasasu bskor byasate/ /lha yi 'jig rten mngon phyogasamakha' la song / /de nas lha'i bu mo zla 'od tshong pa khe spogs rnyed pa lta bu dang / zhing pa lo tog 'byor pa lta bu dang / dpa' bo g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba lta bu dang / nad pa nad thams cad lasayongasasu thar pa lta bur gyur te cha lugs gang gisabacom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'ong pa'i cha lugs de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis rgyal po༄5 tra ya na la khas blangs pas da de bltas pa'i dus yin no snyam nas/ de nasalha'i bu mo zla 'od rgyal po.u tra ya na ga la ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe na rgyal posgyu/ tra ya na gcig pu steng gi khang bzang gi gzhir gtogasapa na nyal zhing 'dug nas des de snang ba rgya chen pos khyab par byas te se gol gyi sgras bslang ba dang / de gnyid kyis non pa'i mig dang rnam par shes pa mi gsal bas smras pa/ khyod su/ des 162
smras pa/ bdag zla 'od do/ /rgyal posasmrasapa/ tshur shog dga' mgur sbyad par bya'o/ /des smras pa lha bdag shi zhing dus la bab nas rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ gal te bdag dang lhan cig mjal bzhed na bcome ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rab tu byung zhig dang / gal te tshe 'di nyid la nyon mongasapa thams cad spangs pas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du mdzad na mi de nyid khyod kyi sdug bsngal gyi mtha' lags so/ /gal te kun tu sbyor ba lhag ma dang bcas pas dus bgyis te rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skyes par gyur na ni der khyod bdag dang mjal bar 'gyur ro zhesasmrasate de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ / / /
༄rgyu/ /rgyal po pad sa'i btsun mo dpal ldan la gnas bstan shā ri'i bus chos bstan nas bden pa la bkod tshul/dus gag zhig na mgu byed rgasapar gyur nasades 'asngu pazlo rnyi/ rnyi ༷ ḍi zlo sna ༵༵/ btab pa/ bdag gis dge slong gi dge 'dun la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsnyen bkur byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yin pa 'dis bdag khyim bdag gdangs can gyi chung ma'i mchog gi mngal du skye zhing sngo bsangs can gyi chu zheng ci 'dra ba de lta bur bdag kyang gyur te| pad sa'i rgyal po shar pa bdag gi khyim thab tu gyur cig ces btab bo/ /de shi zhing dus la bab nas khyim bdag gdangs can gyi chung ma'i mchog gi mngal du skyesaso/ /gang gi nyin mo skyesapa de nyid kyi nyin mo khyim de dpal dag gis snang bar gyur to/ /de zla ba brgyad dam/ dgu 'dasate btsas pa lasabu mo gzugs bzang ba/ lta na sdug pa mdzes pa zhig byung ngo / /byung ma thag tu yang des pha'i khyim rgya cher dpal dag gis snang bar gyur to/ /de'i nye du dag 'dus shing lhags nas nyi ma bdun gsum nyi shu gcig tu btsas pa'i btsas ston rgya cher byas nas bu mo 'di'i ming cir gdags zhes ming 'dogasapar byed do/ /nye du rnams kyisasmras pa/ gang gi phyir bu mo 'di gang gi nyin mo ma'i mngal du zhugs pa de nyid kyi nyin mo khyim de dpal dag gis snang bar gyur la/btsas pa na yang 'dis pha'i khyim rgya cher dpal dag gis snang bar gyur pa de'i phyir bu mo 'di'i ming dpal ldan du gdagasaso zhes/༷ 4ming dpal ldan zhesabya bar btags so/ /
gang gi tshe de smra shes par gyur pa de'i tshe na dge slong gang dag khyim der bsod snyoms la zhugasapa de dgagi gan du song ste/ rkang pa la phyag 'tshal nasasnyun gsol bar byed do/ /ji tsam na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo der bsod snyomasal zhugasapadang / de de'i gan du song ste rkang pa gnyisal phyag 'tshal nasasmrasapa/ btsun pa kun dga' bo ji ltar bcom ldan 'das dang / dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan che ge mo dag gnod pa chung ngam/nyam nga ba chung ngam/ bskyod pa yang ngam/ 'tsho 'am/ stobasadang ldan nam/ bde 'am/ kha na ma thob ma mchisasam/ bde ba la reg paraganasasam/ desasmrasapa/ sring mo bcom ldan 'dasadang / dge slong gnasabartan gnasache ge mo dag gnod pa chung / nyam nga ba nyung /bskyod pa yang / 'tsho ba stobasadang ldan/ bde/ kha na ma thob med/ bde ba la reg par gnasaso/ /de smrasapa'i tshig thosanasakhyim bdagagadangasacan gyi nang mi dag mchog tu ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /de nasatshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bosa.a rog gya zhesabyasate song nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'dasakyi zhagaphuganyisal mgo bos phyag 'tshal te gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag gdangs can gyi bu mo byis pa zhig bcom ldan 'das dang / dge slong gnas brtan gnas brtan dag la snyun gsol zhing /khyim bdag gdangs can gyi nang mi dag gisade thosanasamachog tu ngo mtshar skyesapar gyur to / / bcom ldan 'dasakyisabaka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyisabu mo de mi shes sam/bcom ldan 'dasam 'tshal to/ /kun dga' bo de ni mgu byed yin te/ smon lam gyi dbang gis khyim bdag gdangs can gyi chung ma'i mchog gi mngal du skyes te da ltar bu mo dpal ldan zhes bya'o/ /gang gi tshe dpal ldan chen mor gyur pa de'i tshe na de slong ba rgyal po dag dang / nor can dag dang / tshong dpon dag/ stang / ded dpon dag dang / ko bya dag dang /
shākya dag dang / li ts+tsha bī dag dang / gzhan yang mang po dag 'ong bar brtsamasaso/ /khyim bdag gdangs can 'di snyam du dpal ldan slong ba mang po dag 'ong ste/ gang dag la ma byin pa de dag bdag gi dgrar 'gyur ro snyam nas/ de lag pa la 'gram pa gtad de semasa'ong du chud cing 'dug go /dpal ldan gyisade mthong nasasmras pa/ yab khyod ci'i slad du phyag la zhal gtad de semasakhong du chud cing bzhugs/ desasmrasapa/ bu mo khyod slong ba rgyal po dag dang / nor ga dag dang / tshong dpon dag dang / dedadaponadag dang /kau bya dag dang / shākya dag dang / l+latsā 'i dag dang / gzhan yang mang po dag 'ong ste/ gang dag lam byin pa de dag bdagagi dgrar 'gyur na/ ji ltar lag pa la 'gram pagatad de sems khong du chud cing mi 'dug tu rung / de smras pa/ yab thugs ngan ma mdzad cigbdagagisakhyim thab 'tshal lagasaso/ /bu mogang / yab pad sa'i rgyal po shar pa'o/ /bu mo gal te de lta na je go rim bya'o/ /yab go rim ji lta bu lagasabu mo kho bosapad sa'i rgyal po shar pa 'di nyid du spyan drang gis/ gang gi tshe desabazhophugasol ba de'i tshe na khyod steng gi khang bzang gi gzhi na 'dug pasapho long 'phang bar bya'o/ /yab ma nongasakyisade bzhin bgyi'o/ /desapad sa'i rgyal po shar pa khyim gzhan du mgron du bosate zan zosapa dang / dpal ldan steng gi khang bzang gi gzhin 'dug bas pho long 'phangs so/ /rgyal pos steng du brtag par brtsams pa dang / rgyal pos de mthongs nas smras pa/ gdangs can khyod na re sngo bsangs can dus la bab cesazer na 'di na 'dug pa 'di ma yin nam/lha 'di ni sngon bsangs can ma lagasaso/ /'o na 'di ci ming / lha 'di ni sngo bsangasacan gyi nu mo dpal ldan zhes bgyi'o/ /ci 'ga' zhig la byin nam/ lha su yang ma stsal to/ /gal te de lta na nga la ci'i phyir mi sbyin/ lha gsol lo/ khyim bdag gdangasacan gyisabyin nas pad sa'i rgyal po shar pas dpal gyi 'byor bas bag mar blangs te btsun moli166
'khor gyi nang du bcug go /dus gzhan zhig na des rgyal po la smras pa/ lha bdag dge slong mthong bar 'tshal lo/ /rgyal posasmrasapa/ khyod 'dod mod kyi/ dge slong dag rgyal polipho brang du mi 'jug go /lha de lta na bdag rnam pa thams cad du btson rar stsal du bas mod/ gal te dge slong mthong bar mi gnang na/ deng slan cad 'tshal ma yang mi 'tshal/ phyag kyang mi 'tshal lo/ /desazan gcad pa la zhugs pa dang / rgyal pos khyim bdag gdangs can la smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod so sor mi rtog gam/ lha ci lags/dpal ldan zan gcad pa la zhugadragaso/ /lha ci'i slad du dge slong mthong bar 'dod na dge slong dag rgyal polipho brang du mi 'jug go /lha 'o na 'di la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ khyim bdag de'i phyir khyod kyis bdag nyid kyi ming gis ra bar dge slong gi dge 'dun spyan drongasate/ bar du sgo thod la bshos gsol cig khyim bdag gdangasacan gyi khyim rgyal po dang 'dab chagasasu 'dug pas des ra ba'i bar du sgo gtod nas sa'i byi dor byed du bcug go /de nas de bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go /mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das khyim bdag gdangs can la chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyis yang dag nga ra ston par mdzad/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par mdzad/ yang dag par gzengs stod par mdzad/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad do/ /rnam grangs du mar chos dang ldan pa'i bka' mchid kyis yang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug yang dag par gzengasabastod/ yang dag par rab tu ngaga' bar mdzad nasacang mi gsung ngo / /de nas khyim bdag gdangs can gyis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la ༷༷ skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das
dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pas sang bdag gi sdum par gdugs tshod gsol bar ci gnang / bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag gdangs can la cang mi gsung bas gnang ngo / /de nas khyim bdag gdangs can gyisabacom ldan 'dasakyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyisal mgo bosaphyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'dasakyi spyan snga nas song ngo / /de nasakhyim bdag gdangasacan gyisade nyid kyi mtshan mo bza' ba dang / bca' ba gtsang zhing bsod pa dag sta gon byasanasanangasapar sngar langasate gdan bshamasanaschu ra bzhag ste/ bcom ldan 'das la spyan 'dren gyis btsun pa gdugs tshod g.yar dgongs 'tshal na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis da de'i dus la bab par dgongasasu gsol zhes spyan drangasapa dang / tshe dang ldan pa zhwa ri'i bu la sogasapa dge slong gi dge 'dun ni zhugs so/ /bcom ldan 'dasani rdzas lasabyung ba na bzhugasashing bsod snyomasamangon par bsgrub bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rgyu lngas rdzas las byung ba na bzhugs shing bsod snyoms mngon par sgrub par mdzad de/ lnga gang zhe na/ nang du yang dag 'jog bzhed pa dang / lha rnams la chos ston par bzhed pa dang / nad pa la lta bar bzhed pa dang / gnas mal la rtog par bzhed pa dang / 'dul ba la nyan thosarnamasakyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed pa'o/ /don 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das 'dul ba la nyan thos rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhi bca' bar bzhed pas rdzas las byung ba na bzhugs shing bsod snyomasamangon par sgrub par mdzad do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'jug pa na rgyal po btsun moli'akhor dang bcas pa 'dug nas de'i phyir ldog bar brtsams pa dang / rgyal pos mthong nasasmrasapa/ 'phagspa shā ri'i bu gshegs su gsol/ de nasatshe dang ldan pa shwa ri'i bus dge slong rnams la 168
smrasapa tshedang ldan pa dag bzhi po dgas tshig ni mispru9ga pa yin te/ de bzhinabashegspa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas kyi bka' dang / dge slong dgra bcom paragapa'od pa'i tshig dang / dge skosakyi tshig dang / rgyal po rgyal rigasaspyi por dbang bskur ba'i tshig yin gyis/ tshe dang ldan pa dag dran pa nye bar zhog cig dang 'jug pa( /sna zhesade zhugasanas/ dge slongs dge 'dun gyi gong du stan bshamasapa nyid la de nasabatsun mo dpal ldan gyisatshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la sogasapa dge slong shadage 'dun bde bar 'khod par riganas/ rangs laganasabaca' ba dang / bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pasatshim par byed/ stobasapar byed do/ /rnam grangs du mar rang gi lag nasabaca' ba dang / bza' ba gtsang zhing bsod pas tshim par byas shing bstabs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la sogs pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gdugs tshod gsol cing phyag bcabs lhung bzed bzhag par rig nas/ stan ches dma' ba zhig blangs te/ chosamanyan pa'i phyir tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu'i mdun du 'dug go /de nasatshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu btsun mo dpal ldan la chosadang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par ston par byed/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug par byed/ yang dag par gzengs stod par byed/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar byed do/ /rnam grangs du mar chosadang ldan pa'i gtam gyisayang dag par bstan/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs bstod/ yang dag par rab tu dga' bar byed na des bden pa dag ma mthong ngo / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i busabasamasapa/ ci 'di la dge ba'i rtsa ba dag yod dam/ 'on te med snyam na/ yod par mthong ngo / /su la rag las snyam na/ bdag nyid la rag lasapar mthong nas/ de de la chos ston cing rnam par dpyod pa na nyi ma nub 169
pa'i dusal bab nasadage slongarnamasastan lasalangasate dong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bsams pa 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang mod kyi/ 'di nyid rkyen du mdzad nas gnang bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa de lta bu'i gnas yod par 'gyur ro/ /snyam nas/ de gdul ba la ltosapasade nyid du 'dug go /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus btsun mo dpal ldan gyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khamasadang / rang bzhin khong du chud nas/ gang 'os nas btsun mo dpal ldan gyis stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas pa de ltar chos bstan pa byas so/ /desabaden pa mthong nasasmrasapa/ 'phagasapa bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'phags pa shā ri'i bu la brten nas 'phags pas bdag la gang mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bdag la phadragakyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal podragakyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi pha mesadag gis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag gis kyang ma bgyis/ byams pa dang / mdza' bshes dang / rtsa lag gi tshogs dag gis kyang ma bgyis te/ khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho ni bskams/ rus pa'i ri dag las ni bsgal/ ngan song gi sgo dag ni bkum/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo dag ni phye/ semasacan dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dwags dag nas ni rkang pa phyung / lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du ni bzhag 'khor ba ni mthar bgyis/ thog ma ma mchis pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni thob ste/ bcun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags so/btsun pa bdag ni mngon par zhugs pa lags te/ btsun pa bdag bcom ldan 'das dang / chos dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi yis/ bdag dge bsnyen mar 170
kāhādī spri pa/ kā/〉nga slan chad nasaji srid la'i bar du glo ba thag pa nasarab tu dang de nasatshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i busabaston mo dpal ldan bden pa dag la bzhag ste song nas/ bcom ldan 'dasag la ba der song ste phyin nasabacom ldan 'dasakyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i busaskabasade bcom ldan 'das la rgyasapar gsol ba dang /bcom ldan 'dasakyisabaka' stsal pa/shwa ri'i bu legasaso legasaso/ /bdun po dag gi tshig ni mi gcag pa yinarta/de bzhinabashegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogspa'i sangasargyasakyi bka' dang /dge slong dgra bcom pa༄ga pa zad pa'i tshig dang /dge 'dun gyi gnasabartan gyi tshig dang /dge skosakyi tshig dang /mkhan politshig dang /slob dpon gyi tshig dang /rgyal po rgyal rigs: bor dbang bskur ba'i tshigasho/
༄tsho/ /bramaze'i mtshan mkhan gyis skyesapa lnga brgya dang 'grogasapar lung bstan pa'i bu mo 'od bzang ma'i skye ba snga phyi'i rnam thar gyi skor/'dulacasalung phran chegaphulasabatus/sangasargyasabacom ldan 'dasamanyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /mnyan yod na khyim bdag phyug pa/ nor mang ba/ longasaspyod che ba/ yongasasugazung ba yangasashing rgya che ba/ rnam thosakyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des rigs mnyam pa lasachung ma blangasanas de de dang lhan cig rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed do/ /de dang rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed/ dga' mgur spyod par byed pa lasadus gzhan zhig na chung ma de la sems can zhugs par gyur to/ /gang gi nyin mo de semasacan zhugasapar gyur pa de nyid kyi nyin mo nasamadangs bzang bar gyur to/ /de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'das nadragabu mo gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ lta na sdug pa/ yan lag dang nying lag thamasacad dang ldan pa zhig btsas so/ /de btsas pa'i tshe de'i khyim nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du snang bar gyur nas mnyan yod kun tu khyim bdag che ge mo zhig gi bu mo gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ lta na sdug pa/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas so/ /de bcas pa'i tshe de'i khyim nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du snang bar gyur to zhes sgra de grags pa dang / srog chags brgya stong phrag mang po ngo mtshar du gyur nas khyim bdag de'i khyim du 'dusaso/ /re zhig na bram ze ltasamakhan zhig yul gzhan nas 'ongs pa de yang ngo mtshar gyi phyir de nyid du 'duraṃ ṭ+wāṃ des de la phan tshun du bltas nas skye bo'i
tshogs la smrathagapa/ shes ldan dag khyed kyis bu mo 'di mthong ngam/ de dag gis smras pa mthong ngo / /shes ldan dag bu mo 'di ni ci nas kyang skyes bu lnga brgya dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis smras pa/ bram ze 'di'i gzugs 'di ltar mdzes pa dang sbyar na 'di ni gdon mi za bar skyes pa lnga brgya dang dga' mgur spyod par 'gyur ro/ /mnyan yod thams cad du yang khyim bdag cig gi bu mo gzugs bzang ba/mdzedragapa/ lta na sdug pa/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa zhig btsas te/de btsas pa'i tshe de'i khyim de nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du snang bar gyur to/ /de la mtshan mkhan gyis bu mo 'di ni skyes pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod par lung bstan to zhes sgra grags nas gang gis sgra thosapa de yang der 'ong bar gyur to/ /zhag bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig tu de btsas pa'i bcas ston rgya chen po byas nas ming 'dogs par byed de/ bu mo 'di'i ming ji skad du gdags/ nye du dag gis smras pa/bu mo 'di bcas pa'i tshe khyim nyi ma'i 'od bzhin du snang bar gyur pas/ de'i phyir bu mo'i ming 'od bzang ma zhes gdags so zhesade'i ming 'od bzang ma zhesabya bar btagasaso/ /'od bzang ma ma ma brgyad po pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu zho sdud pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'phyi ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtsed grogs kyi ma ma gnyis la gtad de/lde ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar sar dang / mar rkar dang / mar gyi nying khu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par gtso po gtso bo dag gis bskyed bsrings te rdzing gi pad+ma bzhin du skyed drag par gyur to/ /de gang gi tshe chen mor gyur pa de'i tshe gzugs dang / lang tsho mdzes pa dang / g.yer ba dang / sgyu rtsal gyi yon tan gyi khyad par dang ldan pasanags chal me tog rgyasapa'i nang na nagasatshal gyi lha bzhin du khyim de na mdzesaso/ /de'i gzugs dang / lang tsho dang / kha dog dang / rgyu ba dang / gnas pa'i khyad par gyis /73
'jig rten pa'i lam gyis 'dod chags dang bral ba'i drang phrong dag kyang sems 'phyog par byed na thog ma med pa'i dus nas nyon slongs pa kun tu spyod pa bsags pa rigs dang / gzugs dang / lang tsho dang / dbang phyug gi dregs pas rgyagasapa'i mi rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyim bdag de yang nang mi'i skye boli'akhor dang bcas te de srung ba lhur len cing gnyid kyang mi log go /yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal btsun mo'i 'khor dang / gzhon nu dang / blon po dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi dang bcas pa dang /gzhan yang 'dab chagasan gnasapa'i rgyal po dang / blon po'ibu dang / mdun na 'don gyi bu la sogs pas bslang bar bsams kyang bu mo 'od bzang ma skyes bu lnga brgya dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod par mtshan mkhan gyis lung bstan pas na 'jig rten gyi dpyas su dogs pa'i phyir susakyang ma bslangs so/ /de yang de'i khyim gyi skar khung dra ba can dang / skar khung dang / stegasabu dang / khang thog tu 'dug nasasu slong snyam zhing skyespa dag la lta bar byed do/ /khyim bdag des de'i spyod pa mthong nas rang gi rigs rgyud dang mthun pa gzhan dag la mi slong yang de bzhin du sbyin par brtsams na 'ga' yang len du ma btub bo/ /de nas khyim bdag de de su yang ma 'dod pas yid mi bde ba skyes te bya ba thams cad kyi blo btang nas de sbyin pa'i thabs semasapasalusaskya bo bseng bseng po sha bri ngan pa rke ba shig shig po zhig tu gyur to/ /de'i tshe mnyan yod na khyim bdag phyug pa/ nor mang ba / longasaspyod che ba zhig gnasapa desarigasamanyam pa lasachung ma blangasakyang de rang gi lasakyis shi bar gyurato/ /de bzhin du gnyisapa dang / gsum pa nasabadun pa'i bar blangs kyang de yang rang gi lasakyisashi bar gyur to/ /de dag gisakyang tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i lasabyasal desakyang dbya bar 'gyur 1༷༷ lasabyas pasade'i ming chung ma gsod pa
chung ma gsod pa zhes bya bar chags so/ /des gzhan du bslangs pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ nged kyi bu mo ci ste gsad ces zer ro/ /des yugs sa mo dag kyang bslang bar brtsams pa dang / de dag kyang nged kyi lus ci'i phyir dor zhes zer nas de la thams cad kyisakyang ma ster ba dang / chung ma med kyang bla zhes chung ma 'dod pa'i re thag bcad nas dge spyong dang / bram ze dang / spyod pa pa dang / kun tu rgyu rnams dang lhan cig bsten par brtsams so/ /de'i pha sangs rgyas pa'i dge bsnyen zhig pas dedragabasams pa/ bdag gi pha sangs rgyas pa'i dge bsnyen yin na/ bdag la dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / spyod pa pa dang / kun tu rgyu ba rnams kyis ci zhig bya/ bcom ldan 'dasakyi nyan thos pa rnams la bsnyen bkur bya zhing de dag la bya ba byas nasade nyid du rab tu 'byung ngo snyam nas de yang dang yang du rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'gro bar gyur to/ /ji cam dus gzhan zhig na mdza' bo zhig gis mthong nas/ des smras pa/ grogs po khyod rgyal byed kyi tshal du yang dang yang du 'gro na rab tu 'byung bar mi rtsol grang /grogs po bdag rab tu byung zin na yang rab tu 'byung ci dgos/ bdag gis chung ma gcig blangs kyang rang gi las kyis shi bar gyur/ de bzhin du gnyis pa dang / gsum pa nas bdun pa'i bar yang rang gi las kyis shi bar gyur te/ de dag gis kyang tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las byas/ kho bos kyang dpyo bar 'gyur ba'i las byas pas kho bo'i ming chung ma gsod pa chung ma gsod pa zhes bya bar chags nas bdag yi chad do dge slong dag la nges par bsnyen bkur bya ba ni bdag gi pha'i lugs yin te 'di mi bya na gzhan su la bsnyen bkur bya/ des smras pa/ grogs po de yang bden na 'on kyang gdon mi za bar bu bskyed dgos te gzhan du na rabs 'chad par 'gyur na ci ste gzhan gyi bu mo slong bar mi byed/ des smras pa/ grogs po ci phan gang la bslangs pa de nged kyi bu mo ci ste gsad ces /75
zer ro/ /des smras pa/ grogs po gal te de lta na yugs sa mo dag bslang na ci nyes/des smras pa/ grogs po bdag gis bslang na de dag kyang nga'i lus ci'i phyir yongasasu dor zhes zer ro/ /des smras pa/ grogs po gal te de lta na 'od bzang ma ci'i phyir mi bslang / des smras pa/ grogs po 'jig rten kun tu grags pa des ji smad 'tshong ma'i khyim du bya'am/ desasmras pa/ grogasapo khyod dad pa can yin pasakhyod kyisakhyim du dge slong las su zhig 'ong slongs shig des smras pa/ grogs po gal te de yang mi ster mod/grogasapo slongs shig dang / de'i pha yang skyo zhing 'dug pasaster bar 'gyur ro/ /de khyim bdag de'i khyim du song ste des smras pa/ bde legasasu gyur cig bde legasasu gyur cig khyim bdag des smrasapa/ ci zhig 'dod/ 'od bzang ma'o/ /sbyin no/ /des de dpal gyi 'byor pa chen pos bag mar blangs te lde mig dang / lde mig kyog po dag byin nas khyim gyi bdag mor bcug ste smras pa/ bzang mo kho bo cag gi rigs kyi lugs kyis ni ston pa sangs rgyas dang / dge slong dag sbyin gnas yin pas khyod kyis kyang de dag la bya ba byosashig desasmrasapa/ jo bo legs kyis de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /khyim bdag de'i khyim du dge slong dag nyin gcig bzhin du zan za ba la 'od bzang ma rang gis lag dar te 'brim mo/ /de na dge slong gang dag kha dog dang / dbyibs dang / lang tsho'i khyad par phun sum tshogs pa de dag des mthong nas rnam par rtog pa skyesapar gyur to / / de de dag la rtog pa 'phel bsayid bde ba skyesapar gyur to/ /khyim bdag de yang ri 'or zhig tu don zhig yod nas des bzang mo kho bo ni ri 'or che ge mo zhig tu don zhig yod de/ bdag der 'gros khyod kyis yon gnas dag de bzhin du bshos gsol cig ces bsgo ba dang / des smrasapa/ rje'i sras legs kyis de bzhin du bgyis bzhud cigdes dge slong rnamasal yang 'phags pa bdag ni ri 'or che ge mo zhig tu bgyi ba zhig byung 176
nasabadag der mchi'i khyed cag de bzhin du bdag gi sdum par bshos gsol cig ces smrasapa dang / de dag gisasmrasapa/ khyim bdag song zhig nad med par gyur cig zan bza' bar bya'o zhesabyasapa dang / de yang ri 'or gyi grong du song ngo / /dge slong dag kyang de bzhin du de'i khyim du zan bza' bar brtsam pa dang / 'od bzang ma bdag gi khyo med do snyam nas/ bud med kyi g.yo dang / bud med kyi sgyu dang / bud med kyi tshul 'chos pa gang dag yin pa de dag dge slong rnamasal ston par rtsom pa dang / dge slong rnamasakyisgcig labacug nyesadamigasabyung na/ 'di la ji ltar bsgrub par bya zhesabagrosapa dang /de na kha cig gis smras pa/ 'di la bsgrub tu ci yod/ sang nas mi 'ong du zad mod/gzhan dag gis smras pa/ ñcha dang ldan pa bdag cag ni bsod snyoms pa yin pas sang nas bsod snyoms la 'dong du zad mod/ gzhan dag gis kye legs kyis de bzhin du bya'o zhesasmrasanas/ de dag phyi de nyin nasabasod snyomasal zhugasaso/ /ji tsam dusagazhan zhig na khyim bdag de slar 'ongs nasa'od bzang ma la dris pa/'od bzang ma yonaganasadag bzhophugasolatam/ desasmrasapa/ nyin gcig byon nasade phan chad ye ma byon to/ /desabasamasapa/ ngesapar 'dis de dag gi mdun du bud med kyi g.yo dag bstan te bkur sti ma byasapasa'adzem nasade dag ma 'ongasaso snyam ste/ des de dag gi drung du song nas yang spyan drangs pa dang / de dag gis smras pa/ khyim bdag bdag cag ni bsod snyomasapa yin pasabasod snyomasal rgyu'o/ /des smrasapa/ 'phags pa bdag gisa'atshal gyisabashegasadang de lta bu'i nyesadamigasami mchi'o/ /de dag gis khas blangasapa dang / de dgas rkang pa la phyag 'tshal nasasong ngo / /dge slong dag phyi de nyin de'i khyim du 'ongasapa dang / khyim bdag des 'od bzang ma khyim du bcug nas phyi sbo bcad de bzhag nas de nas de dag la rang gis lag dar te 'brim bar brtsams pa na 177
'od bzang ma khyim gyi nang na 'dug bzhin du dge slong zan za ba de dag la rnam par rtog pa skyes par gyur te 'phags pa che ge mo zhig gi rkang pa ni 'di 'dra/ byin pa ni 'di 'dra/brla ni 'di 'dra/ rked pa dang / rtsib logs dang / rgyab dang / lto dang / bzhin dang / so dang / mchu dang / sna dang / mig dang / dpral ba dang / mgo ni 'di 'dra'o zhes de de ltar rnam par rtog pa na sa bcu pa'i 'dod chags kyi me byung bar gyur pa rnam par rtog pa'i rlung gi shugs bdo ba des spar bas rtul te de nyid du 'chi ba'i dus byas so/ /dge slong dag zan zos te yon bshad pa byas nas dong ba dang / khyim bdag des sgo phye nas smras pa/'od bzang ma tshur rdzogag zan zo zhes byas na de dus las 'das pas su zhig lan 'debs/des nang du zhugaphun ci tsam na phul 'gyel ba mthong ngo / /des bsams pa gdon mi za bar 'di gnyid kyis log gis bslang ngo snyam nas des de bsgul bar brtsam pa dang / re zhig na dus las 'das par mthong nas de ngom zung gnag cing sma bab nas nang mi dag la smrasapa/ shes ldan dag bdag lta byur ngan pa chung ma rin po che 'di lta bu dang bral bar gyur gyis mdza' grogs dang / phu nu dang / gnyen dag la 'od bzang ma dus las 'das so zhes spron cig ces byas pa dang / de dag gis ku co bton te/ kha cig ni sa la skyel nas ngu zhing 'dug kha cig ni khyim bdag ngu ba'i lag pa dang / rkang pa nas 'dzin par byed/ mdza' bshesadang / phu nu dang / gnyen kha cig ni ngud mo'i sgra 'byin par byed do/ /khyim bdag de rang gi skye bo dang bshes kyi 'khor rgya che ba zhig pas de rnams ji srid du ngu ba de'i bar du nyi ma nub nas de dag gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po dag gis khyogs brgyan te/ bkur sti chen posade dur khrod du khyer ro/ /re zhig cig na mi rgod lnga brgya tsam zhig ri 'or zhig tu song nas rnyed pa dang khe phyin nas dur khrod de dang ha cang mi ring bar 'ongs pa grong khyer na gnas pa'i mi zhig gis mthong nas des 178
bsams pa/ skye bo3tshogs chen po grong khyer nas byung ste 'od bzang ma skyel bar dur khrod du song ba rnamasami rgod de dag gis tshul ma yin par gnod pa byas na mi rung gis sbranato snyam nasade mgyogasapar song ste/ skye bo'itshogasachen po de dag la shes ldan dag mi rgod lnga brgya tsam ha cang mi ring ba zhig na 'dug gis bros shig ces sbran pa dang / de dag gis kyang sang rim gro bya'o zhes srung ma gzhag ste/ 'od bzang ma ji ltar rgyan sna tshogs kyisabaklubasapa dang / dri dang / bdug pa dang / gos dang / phye ma dang / gdurgas dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis mdzesapar byas te phyung nas bsnyal ba bzhin du bor te 'brosabaslang nasagrong khyer du zhugasaso/ /ci tsam na mi rgod de dag phyogs der phyin pa dang / srung ma rnams bros so/ /mi rgod rnams kyis rab tu brgyan pa de mthong nas mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes so/ /de nas 'od bzang ma'i gos rnams bshus nas bltas pa dang / de dag gis de'i gzugs gzhon la mdzes pa mthong nas rab tu chagasate shes ldan dag gar bskor kyang bud med 'di lta bu dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad par zad do zhes smras nas de dag gis de dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad de kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya bzhag pa dang / 'od bzang ma'i ro la yang skyes bu lnga brgyasakar ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin te dga' mgur spyod do zhes kun tu sgra grags so/ /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa khyim bdag gi mchis 'brang 'od bzang mas ri las ci zhig bgyisan las de'i rnam par smin pas 'od dang ldan par gyur cing bcas ma thag tu khyim thams cad 'od kyisasnang bar bgyis pa dang / gum nas kyang mi rgod lnga brgyas kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya stsal nas dga' mgur spyad lags/ bcom lda na 'das kyis bka' stsal pa /dge slong dag khyim bdag gi chung ma 'od bzang ma nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa/179
tshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur ba/ dba' rgal bzhin du nye bar gnasapa nges par gyur pa yin te/ 'od bzang mas las byas shing bsags pa dag gzhan su zhig gis myong bar 'gyur/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khamasal rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams la ma yin/ me'i khams la ma yin/ rlung gi khams la ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched dag kho na la rnam par smin par 'gyur te/bskal pa brgya phrag rnams su yang / /las rnams chud zar mi 'gyur te/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /lus cacan rnam sa la 'bras bur smin/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na ston pa 'od srung zhes bya ba rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ste/ bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer na nye bar rten cing drang srong smra ba ri dwags kyi nagadragan bzhugadragaso/ /de'i tshe de'i dusan bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer na rgyal po kṛ kī zhes bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ rgyal srid 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang /skye bo dang / mi mang ngo sa gang ba dang / 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / nang 'grug dang /'khrug slong rab tu zhi ba/ nad med pa/ swa lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma he phun sum tshogs pa chos kyi rgyal pos chos bzhin byed du 'jug go /ji cam na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas 'od srung sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag mdzad nas bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / rgyal po kṛ kī btsun mo dang 1/8༷zhan nu dang / blon po dang / pho brang 'bor
gyi mi dang bcasapasade'i sku gdung la bkur sti chen pos sku gdung gi mchod pa byasanasrin po che sna bzhi'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig pa phang du dpag tshad phyed pa gcig brtsigs so/ /de na tshong dpon gyi bu mo zhig dad pa skyes nas srog shing la me long zhig btags so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten la dad pa skyes nas sgog shing la me long btags pa gang yin pa'i tshong dpon gyi bu mo de ni khyim bdag gi chung ma 'od bzang ma 'di nyid yin te / de'i tshe de'i dus na gang 'dis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi mchod rten gyi srog shing la me long btags pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas 'od dang phru( (zhin du skyes la skyes ma thag tu yang khyim thams cad 'od kyis snang bar gyur pa gang yang shi nasaskyes bu lnga brgyas kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin nasadaga' mgur spyad pa de yang nyon cig dge slong dag sngon byung ba bā rā ṇa sī'i grong khyer na rgyal po tshangs byin zhes bya ba rgyal srid byed du 'jug ste/ rgyal srid 'byor pa dang / rgyasapa dang / bde ba dang / lo legasapa/ skye bo dang mi mang posagang ba/ 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang / nang 'khrug dang / 'khrug slong rab tu zhi ba/ chom rkun dang / nad dang bral ba swa lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma he phun sum tshogs pa/ chos kyi rgyal pos chos bzhin byed du 'jug go /de'i tshe de'i dus na bā rā ṇa sī na gzugs kyisa'atsho ba bzang mo zhes bya ba gzugs bzang ba/ mdzes pa/ lta na sdug pa/ skyes pa'i yid du 'ong ba/ sngon rgyal po tshangs byin gyi zhang ngo sa yongs su spyad pa zhig 'dug go /re zhig dus gzhan zhig na dge 'dun pa lnga brgya bza' ba dang bca' ba mang po dag sbyar te skyed mos tshal du dong nas phan chun shes ldan dag bdag cag gis skyed mos tshal gyi longs spyod thams cad sna /81
bshamasan bud med med kyis dong la smad 'tshong 'ga' zhig dgug go zhesasmrasapa dang /legasakyis de bzhin du bya na su zhig dgug bzang mo'o/ /de dag bzang mo3drung du song ste bzang mo tshur shog skyed mos tshal du 'dong ngo / /des smras pa/ gal te kār khi pa ṇa stong byin na 'groligazhan du ni ma yin no/ /de dag gis smras pa/ kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya je khyer cig lnga brgya ni dga' mgur spyad nas sbyin no/ /des smras pa/ legs kyis de bzhin du byas byin cig de dag gis kwar ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin nas/ desasmrasapa/ dengasashig dri dang / phreng ba dang / gos dag bgos la 'ong ngo zhes byas pa dang / de dag dong ngo / /de 'gyod pa skyes nas gal te bdag dge 'dun pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad na bdag gi gnasaskabs ci 'dra bar 'gyur/ bdag gisakār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya zhig kyang blangasan da ji ltar bya snyam pa las/ des bdag rgyal polishad posayongasasu spyad pas de kho na la skyabasa'atshal gyi gzhan du ni ma yin no snyam pa'i blo skyes nas des de'i gan du bran mo mngag gzhug ma mngagasate/ bu mo rgyal po'izhad po'idrung du song la/ song nasa'adi skad cesabadag ngan te dge 'dun pa las kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya blangs na dge 'dun pa de dag lnga brgya yod de/ji ste bdag dge 'dun pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad par gyur na bdag gi gnasaskabasaci 'dra bar 'gyur/ khyod kyisasngon bdag yongasasu bzung bsade'i slad du khyod kyisabadag de dag las yongasasu bskyab pa'i rigs zhes smosashig bu mo des de'i drung du song ste smrasapa dang / de yang rgyal po larten pa yin pasade dag lasade phyogasaso/ /sangasargyas rnams 'byung ba med pa na rang sangasargyasadaman pa dang / phongasapa la thugsbrtse ba/ bas mtha'i gnas mal la dga' ba 'jig rten gyi sbyin gnas gcig pur gyur pa dag 'jig rten du byung ngo / /de nas ra stangs rgyas shig ljongs rgyu zhing bā rā ṇa sīr
phyin te/ bdag nyid chen po zhi ba'i bdag nyid can rab tu dben par gnasapa de rab tu dben par gnas tshol zhing skyed mosatshal der phyin pa dang / dge 'dun pa de dag gis lus mdzes pa dang / sems mdzes pa mthong nas de dag gidrangabasams pa/ gar bskor kyang yon gnas kyi zhing 'di lta bu la bya ba bya dgos so snyam nas de dag gis gcig la gcig dris te/ de la gtsang zhing bsod pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dag gisalhung bzed bkang ste phul lo/ /bdag nyid chen po de dag ni ngag gis chosami ston gyi lus kyisachos ston pa yin pas steng gi nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags te 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / char 'bab pa dang / slog 'gyu ba la sogasapa'i cho 'phrul bya bar brtsamasapa dang /so so'i skye bo ni rdzu 'phrul gyis dad par 'gyur bas shing rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du 95badragal gtugs nas gang bdag cag gidragayang dag pa'i sbyin gnadraga'adi lta bu la bya ba byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag cag gzugs kyisa'atsho ba la tha na shi na yang kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin nas dga' mgur spyod par shog shig cesasmon lam btab bo/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ gzugs kyis 'tsho ba bzang mo zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni khyim bdag gi chung ma 'od bzang ma 'di nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi dge 'dun pa lnga brgya po de dag ni mi rgod lnga brgya po 'di dag nyid yin te/ de'i tshe de'i dus na gang 'di dag gis rang sangs rgyas la bsod snyoms phul nas smon lam btab pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas 'di dag gis 'khor bar 'khor ba na tshe rabs lnga brgyar kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin zhing dga' mgur spyad de da ltar khyim bdag gi chung mar gyur pa las shi ba'i bar du yang kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya byin nas dga' mgur spyad pa yin no/ /de ltar na dge slong dag las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu gnag pa yin/ gcig tu dkar ba rnams dang / 'dren ma rnams kyi yang 'dren ma rnams 183
ja dag gcig tu gnag pa'i las pa ba'i lasakho na la tsholabar bya lha zhesagasung po////

sangasargyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mi mkhyen pa dang / mi gzigasapa dang / mi rig pa dang / rnam par mi mkhyen pa ci yang mi mnga' bas sangs rgyasabacom ldan 'das rnams ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃsnañjalha kyis zhesabya ba nas/ lusacan rnamasal 'brasabur smin ces bya ba'i bar snga de nasabacom ldan 'dasakyisade rjesasu gzung ba'i phyir lhung bzed bzed de sring mo khyod kyis gal te yongs su btang na lhung bzed 'dir byin cig ces bka' stsal pa dang / des shin tu dad pas bcom ldan 'das la bsod snyoms de phul nas zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal te smon lam btab pa/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bran mo dang dbul por mi 'gyur bar shog cig ji tsam na de'i pha'i grogs po bram ze mtshan mkhan zhig yod pa desade mthong nas smrasapa/ bu mo khyod ga lasa'ongs/ ri bragasade kho na nas so / be/su la gnasashing 'dug desasmras pa/ gang na skal ba chung ngu gnasapa na ste/ bdag ming chen gyi bran mo bgyis so/ /khyod kyi pha de gar song / gum mo/ /ma dang ming po de dag gar dong / gar mchisam 'tshal nyo/ /zla ba khyod bran mo'i'os ma yin na lag pa skyongs shig dang blta'o/ /des lag pa brkyang ba dang / des bltas nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gang gi lag pa'i mthil dag la/ /lcagasakyi 'khor lo'i mtshan yod pa/ /bran gyi rigs su skyes gyur kyang / /rgyal po'i btsun mor bzhes par 'gyur/ /gang gi bzhin ni rgyasapa dang / /ngang pa'i rgyal poyigadangasa'adra ba/ /bran gyi rigasasu skyesagyur kyang / /rgyal polibatsun mor bzhes par 'gyur/ /gang gi rkang pa'i mthil dag la/ /grong khyer cog dang rta babs bcas/ /bran gyi rigs su skyes gyur kyang / /rgyal po'i btsun mor drinasapar 'asdir/ /khyod mi dgar ma byed par song zhig dang / khyod bran mor mi 'gyur gya khyad rgyal po'abatsun mor 'gyur ro/ / 206
de gnas de nas skyed mos tshal du song ba dang / yul ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal ri dwags shor du chas pa rtas kha khyer te/ gcig pu ser skya'i gnasasu phyin to/ /de phan tshun 'khyam pa las ming chen gyi kun dga' ra bar song nas/ des bu mo de la dris pa/bu mo 'di su'i kun dga' ra ba yin/ desasmras pa/ lta shākya ming chen gyi lags so/ /de rta las babs te smras pa/ bu mo rkang pa bkrus chu longs shig de shin du myur bar smyu nga bur song ste nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis baphros pa'i chu blangs pa dang / des rkang pa bkrus nas yud cam zhig bsdad de smras pa/ bu mo gdong bkrus chu longs shig des chu'i steng rim lag pasabasal te/ chu ha cang dro ba yang ma yin ha cang grang ba yang ma yin pa blangs nas des gdong bkrus so/ /des yang smras pa/ bu mo btung dgos kyis chu 'o ngas shig des chu rnam par slongs te chu bsil ba'i lo ma'i snod du blangasapa rgyal pos 'grungs nas smras pa/bu mo kun dga' ra ba 'di na rdzing bu gsum yod dam ci na/ khyod kyis chu rnam pa gsum khyer te 'ongs/ des smras pa/ lha 'di na rdzing bu gcig kho na mchis kyi/ gsum mi ma mchis so/ /desasmras pa/ 'o na khyod kyis chu rnam pa gsum ga lasakhyer te 'ongs/ des ji ltar gyur pa brjod pa dang / rgyal pos smras pa/ des ni go'o 'di dri bar bya ste/ ci'i phyir khyod kyi chu rnam pa gsum khyer te 'ongs/ des smras pa/ lha bdag gis dang por chab dron po 'tshal te mchis pa gi lha mnyel bsos par bgyi ba'i slad du'o/ /slad kyis ha cang dro ba yang ma lags/ ha cang grang ba yang ma lags pa 'tshal te mchis pa ni dro ba dang grang ba gang lags pa dag spyan la gnod pa'i slad du'o/ /rnam par slongs nas shin tu bsil ba 'tshal te mchis pa ni lha skyems pa dang bral bar bgyi ba'i slad du'o/ /desabasamasapa/ bu mo 'di ni mkhasapa yin no snyam du rig nas smras pa/ bu mo mdzangs shing mkhas pa khyod rkang pa mnye dgos kyis re zhig mal chos shig des de'i 207
rkang pa mnyes pa dang / de reg bya dang ldan pa yin pas mnyes ma thag nyid du de gnyid log go /de gnyid log pa dang / des bsams pa/ rgyal ngo 'di dag la ni dgra ma/nga bas ga' te 'di gnyid log pa la 'ga' zhig gis gnod pa byed na nges par bdas gi rje bo 'a grags pa ma yin par 'gyur bas sgo gcad par bya'o snyam/ nas/ de sgo bcad de 'dug nga dang / ji cam na gcig nas gcig tu thos te dpung gi tshogs yan 'a ga bzhi pa das skyed mos chal der lhags nas de rnams sgo phye zhes zer ro/ /des sgo ma phye ba dang / rgya khu ngo ku co'i sgras sad nas smras pa/ bu mo de ci zhig des smras pa/ lha me dag cis chab sno phye zhes ma chi zhing / lha'i mchan yang smos so/ /des smras pa/ bu mo sgo 'ji sus bcad/ ñca bdag gis bkum mo/ /ci'i phyir bcad/ lha bdag gis rgu ba 'a rgyal po 'ji das 'a mi dgra ma/nga bas gal te 'ji mna'/ log pa 'a 'ga' zhis chis samod pa bzhus na nges par bdag gi rje bo 'a grags pa ma 'a gas par 'gyur ro snya ma/ nas/ de'i slad du bdag gis chab sgo bkum mo/ /des smras pa/ bu mo mdzangs ma khyod la nga'i the tshom 'di dri bar bya ste/ re zhig khyod ming chen gyi cir 'ong smros shig des smras nga / bdag de'i mngag gzhug bgyid pa'i bran mo lags so khyod de'i mngag gzhus byed pa'i bran mo ma yi na gyi/khyod nges par de'i bu mo yin gyis drang por smos shig de cang mi smra bar 'dug pa dang /rgyal ngo sa smras pa/ bu mo khyod ming chen gyi gan du song la/ rgya' po gsal rgyal khyod kyi kun darga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes byos shig de myur ba myur bar song ste/ jo bo ko sa 6 pa'i rgyal po gsal rgyal khyod kyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes smras so/ /shākya ming chen gyis thos nas bza' ba dang / btu ba dang / dri dang phreng ba dag bshams nas/ skye bo phal po ches bskor te kun dga' ra bar song ngo / /de nas gcig la gcig byon pa legs so zhes bya ba'i tshig gis kun tu spyad pas so so yang dag par 2(18
dka' bar byas nas/ rgyal po khrus byas lhang zan zos nas gtam dgo byas te yud cam zhis bsdang nas smras pa// ming chen bu mo 'di khyod kyi cir 'ong / lha mngag gzhus bgyid nga 'i bran mo lasas so/ /'di khyod kyi mngag gzhug byed pa'i bran mo ma yin gyi/ 'di khod kyi bu mo yi na gyis nga la byin cig des smras pa/ lha shākya'i bu mo rgazhan 'ji bas ches sbyar pa ra 'phags pa dag mchis na de dag bzhes su gsol / 'di cir 'cha spru / rgya ra ngo sa smra sa rwa / 'di nyid nga la dgos kyis/ 'di nga la byin cig des smras pa/ /sna ga la te de lnga na chu 5 bzhin bgyis te 'bul lo/ /de bzhin byos shig de nas shākya mingachen gyis grong khyer ma dzes par byed du bcug ste/ bu mo de rgyan thams cad kyis bklungs nas glang po che la bskyon rte lang po che dang / srang dang / lam gyi sum mdo dang / bzhi mdo dag tu grong khyer se ra skya'i sanas na 'dod pa dang / yul sna tshogs nas lhags pa'i skye bo'i tshogs la shes ji na dag nyon ceg shākya ming chen gyi bu mo phreng ldan ma ko sa 'a 'i rgyal po gsal rgya' gye bcun mor phul lo zhes dril bsgrags pa byas so/ /de nas de ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bcun mor phul bar skye bo phal po che rna4 sa kyis kyang shesaso/ /de nas lo sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis dang la gyi 'byar pa chen ngos blangs nas rma nyan yod du khrid pa dang / de'i mas bdag gi bus bran mo chung ma ra blangs so zhes thos te/ de kun nas dkris pa skyes nas bsam sa pa/ 32 mi nges par pha de'i bu ma yi na pa'am/ bdag gi khong du rdon me/da pa zhig bsrel rte/ 'di ltar bran mo'i byor skyes par gyur to snyam nas/ de yang sems khong du chud cing 'dug pa dang /rgyal pos kyang phreng ldan ma la smras pa/ phreng ldan ma song la sgyug mo'i zhabs la phyag byos shig de song ste de'i rkang pa gnyis la bzung ba dang / de reg bya dang ldan pa yin pas des reg pa cam gyes de tra/nyid log ste sad nas bsams pa/ bu zan ma'i bu slo 'di'i 2()lnga
reg pa 'di 'dra bas ko sa la'i rigs 'di rgyas par 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de'i tshe ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la btsun mo dam pa rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma dang / phreng ldan ma gnyis yod de/ gang gi tshe rgyal po phreng ldan ma dang thabs cig tu bzhugs pa de'i tshe/ phreng ldan ma rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma ni 'di lta bur yang gzugs bzang ngo zhes dbyar tshul ma'i bsngags pa brjod pa dang / des smras pa/ lha de bdag gis nam zhig na mthong bar 'gyur lags/ rgyal pos smras pa/ ma rings shig dang ring po me thogs par mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de re ba dang bcas pas 'dug go /gang gi tshe rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma dang thabs cig tu 'dug pa de'i tshe yang dbyar tshul ma phreng ldan ma ni de lta bu'i reg bya dang yang ldan pa yin no zhes phreng lda na ma'i bsngags pa brjod pa dang / des smras pa lha de bdag gis nam zhig na mthong bar 'gyur lags/ rgyal pos smras pa/ ma rings shig dang ring por mi thogasapar mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag rgyal pos ji lta ji ltar ya mtshan bskyed pa de lta de ltar phan chun mthong bar spro bar gyur to/ /ji tsam dus gzhan zhig na so ga'i dus la bab ste/ nags chal na shing rnams me rtog rgyas par gyur cing ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ni tso dang / ri skegs dang / khu byug dang / shang shang te'u sgra 'byin pa'i skyed mos tshal gyi gnas su rgyal po btsun mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing gshegs so/ /bud med ni me tog dang 'bras bu la dga' ba yin pas skyed mos tshal de dang de dag tu 'khyam par brtsams pa dang / rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma ngal bas skyo zhing snyom par gyur nas shing mya ngan 'tshang la snyesate 'dug pa dang / ji tsam na phreng ldan mas mthong ngo / /de de'i gzugs bzang ba mthong bas shing gi lha mo yin no snyam du rig nas/ mod la rkang pa la phyag byas pa dang /phreng ldan ma'i lag pas reg ma thag pa nyid du gnyid log par gyur to/ /ji tsam na rgyal 21()
posadabyar tshul ma la phreng ldan ma'i bsngags pa brjod par brtsams pa dang / des smras pa / lha de bdag gis nam zhig na mthong bar 'gyur lags/ rgyal pos smras pa/ de khyed kyis mthong ngo / /lha bdag mi dran no/ /ngas khyod dran par bya'o/ /legs so/ /gang sge lag pa gnyis kyis khyod kyi rkang pa la bzung ba de dran nam/ lha de lha mo phreng ldan ma lags sam/ de yin no/ /lha gang khyod reg bya dang ldan pa'i btsun mo de lta bu spangs te/bdag gi drung du gshegasapa de ni khyod bdag la nges par byams shing thugs gcugs pa lags so/ /de bzhin du phreng ldan ma la dbyar tshul ma ni 'di lta bu yin no zhes bsngagspa brjod par brtsams pa dang / des smras pa/ lha bdag gis nam zhig na mthong bar 'gyur lags/ rgyal posasmrasapa/ de khyod kyis mthong ngo / /lha bdag mi dran no/ /ngas khyod dran par bya'o/ /legasaso/ /khyod kyis shing mya ngan 'tshang la snyes te 'dug pa gang la phyag byas pa de dran nam/ lha ci de dbyar tshul ma lags sam/ de yin no/ /lta gang khyod kyis btsun mo gzugs bzang ba de lta bu spangs te bdag gi drung du gshegs pa de sna khyod nges par bdag la byams shing thugs gcugs pa lags so/ /skabs der ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal la btsun mo dam pa rgyal rigs dbyar tshul ma dang / phreng ldan ma gnyis yod de/ de dag lasagacig ni gzugs bzang ba rnam/sa kyi mchog yin la/ cig shos ni reg bya dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog yin no zhes phyogs su sgra grags pa dang /dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas/ the tshom thams cad gcod par mdzad pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasal zhusapa/ btsun mo phreng ldan ma dang / dbyar tshul ma sa las ci zhig bgyis na/ lasade'i rnam par smin pas gcig ni reg bya dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog nyu gyur la/ cig shosani gzugasabazang ba rnams kyi mchog tu gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de dag nyid kyisalasatshogs rnyed pa/ rkyen yongs su bsgyur 211

bud med kyi dug sno ba ni 'di yin te/ 'di ltar bud med ni phal cher 'dod chags lhag par che ba'o/ /de'i sring mo de nyon mongs pa dag gis gdungs nas/ des smras pa/ ming po bdag dgon pa'i rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / me tog dang / 'bras bus 'tsho ba'i rngo mi thog gis grong mthar bzhud do/ /desade khrid de grong mthar song ste/ de bram ze zhig gi der slong mo la zhugs so/ /des sring mo dang lhan cig slong moliphyir cig car sgra phyung ba bram zedragathodraganadragaphyir phyung nas smras pa/ drang 17nga dag kyang chung ma dang bcadragate rgyu'am/dedragasmras pa/ 'di bdag gi chung ma ma yin gyi sring mo6rdzo/ /'di su la byin/ su la yang ma byin no/ /gal te de lta na kho bo la ci'i phyir mi byin/ 'di ni dam pa ma yin pa sdig pa'i chos de spangs pa yin no/ /de 'dod pa'i 'dod chabasakyis gdungasapas smrasapa/ ming po ci bdag dgon pa'i rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang / lo ma dang / me tog dang / 'bras bus 'tsho ba'i m+ba mi thog pa med snyam mam/ bdag gis ni nyon mongs pa spang nī ma thog pa/'i slad du khyod 'a 'di skad bgyis kyis/ bdag bram ze 'di 'a stsal cig des smras pa/ de sna chos dang 'gal bas ngas khyod sbyin par mi bya'i khyod nyid shes nga ra zad ngo/ /bram ze des de dang de'i bsam pa shesapa nas 'byar pa'i dpal chen posade bag mar blangs rte/ rang gi byim du bcug go /de nas de'i ming po de la smras pa/ ming po chur byon khyod kyi khab dbub par mdzod cig dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /des smras pa/ sring slo kho bo mi 'dod pa don du mi gnyer te/ khyod kyis gnang na rab tu 'byung ngo / /des smras pa / dam/ zhig bca' ste/ gal te khyod skabs skabs su bdag gzigs shing byon na rganang bar bgyi'o/ /des smras pa/ du wegs te nge bzhin bya'o/ /je des gnang nas drang srong rnams kyi nang du rab tu byung ngo / /de das ba'i rtsa rba bskyed pa yi na pas des slob dpon med par byang chung | phyogs dang mthun pa 'i chos sum bcu —5
