te / chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon ras 'bul 'bul ba'i lha'i bu mo'i bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang kham/sa dang rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa 'i bden pa bzhi rtogs nga/ra 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas sngon ras 'bul 'bul ba'i lha'i bu mos 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ des bden pa mthong nas dga' ba'i tshig lan gsum du brjod de/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi khrag dang mchi ma'i rgya mtsho bskams pa dang / rus pa'i la bsgral ba dang / ngan song gi sgo rnams bcad pa dang / mtho ris dang thar pa'i sgo rnams phye ba dang / bdag lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du bzhag pa 'di lta bu mi bdag la phas kyang ma bgyis/ mas kyang ma bgyis/ rgyal pos kyang ma bgyis/ lha rnams kyis kyang ma/ bgyis/ nang mi dang gnyen gyi tshogs kyis kyang ma bgyis/ sngon gyi mchun rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis/ dge sbyong dang bram ze rnams kyis kyang ma bgyis lags so/ /yang smras pa/ nyis pa mang por ldan pa'i ngan song lam/ /shin tu mi bzad khyod kyi mthu yis bcad/ /bsod nams rab ldan mtho ris 'gro ba phye/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam yang bdag gis thob/ /bdag gis de ring nyes pa spangs pa'i mig /shin tu rnam dag /khyod las brten nas thob/ /bdag mi sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i pha rol rgal/ /'phags pa dgyesapa zhi ba'i ṣ+ka 'phang thob/ /mi mchogadabang po mi dang lhas mchod pa/ /skye dang rga dang 'chi ba'i nad spangs pa/ /srid pa stong du mthong bar dka' ba yi/ /thub pa khyod t+na deng tsha thong 'bras bu yod/ /de nas do shal 'phyang ba dga' gyur te/ /bag cing zhabs gnyis la ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /dgra thub la ni bskor ba byas nas kyang / /lha yi 'jig rten kha bltas lha yul song / /de nas sngon ras 'bul 'bul ba'i lha'i bu mo de tsho nga pa khe 318
spogs phyin pa dang / zhing pa 'bru rgyal bar gyur pa dang / dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba dang / nad pa nad thams cad las thar ba bzhin du 'byor pa gang gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'ongs pa'i 'byor pa de nyid kyis rang gi gnas su song ngo / /dge slong dag ni srod dang tho rangs mi nyal bar brtson pa lhur byed pa la gnas te/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du snang ba chen po byung ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang the tshom skyes te the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags mdang sum mi mjed kyi bdag po changs nga 'am lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i slad du mchis lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi nga la blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa ma yin gyi/ ras 'bul 'bul ba'i bud med de khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dad pa sdud par byed pa la ras phul nas shi ste/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha yul bzang por skyes nas/ de mdang sum nga'i thad du 'ongs te ngas de la chos bstan nas/ bden pa mthong bar gyur te rang gi gnas su song ngo / /dge slong dag de bas na 'di lta ra bslab nga ra bya ste / sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun rnams la bkur sti byas bkur sti med par mi bya'o zhus dge slong dag khyed 3spya de riltar bsgyub par shu'o4/ /bcom ldan ༷das kyis de spyanā shārnyi /kāX spra/ ( bhe+e dag slang da dag ya rangs ta bcam ldan 'das kyas gsungs 319
rabyarmya/ /mgon med zas sbyin gyi bu mo ma ga 3 bzang mo dang bran mo gnyis kyis rgyang ring po nas ston pa la gsal ba btab pas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas ldami'aphrul gyis byon nas chos bstan chul/rtogar+sābargya pa las bcas/rgya gar skad du/ su ma ga dhā a ba dwa na/ bod skad du/ ma ga dh+wa bzang mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa// sangadragargyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal 'o1 sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ de nas de'i tshe mnyan yod na mgon med zas sbyin gyi bu mo ma ga dhā bzang mo zhes bya ba dad pa dang ldan pa / rang bzhin bzang ba/ bsam pa dge ba / bdag dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir zhugs pa zhig gnas so/ /ji tsam na bu ram shing 'phel zhes bya ba'i grong khyer na tshong dpon gzhan zhig gnas pa la/ de'i bu khyu mchog byin zhes bya'o/ /de yang gzhan mu stegs pa bsten pas gcer bu pa rnams la mngon par dad pa zhig gnas pa dang / gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis cho 'phrul chen po rnam par bstan pa de'i tshe mu stegs pa rnams mtha' 'khob tu kun tu gnas te/ la la ni grong khyer bzang byed ces bya ba na'o/ /la la ni mud gi ri ka zhes bya ba'i yul na'o/ /la la ni bu ram shing 'phel zhes bya ba'i grong khyer na gnas so/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na khyu mchog byin de'i bar du khyim ma byas pa dang / de la gcer bu pa rnams kyis smras pa/ mgon med zas sbyin gyi bu mo ma ga dh+wa bzang mo zhes bya ba gzugs/ ba/rdo ḍi/ lta na sdu ga pa/ mdzes pa / skye bo dam pa
rnams dang 'dra ba zhig yod do/ /ji srid des thos pa dang bdag nyid gcer bu pa'i cha byad du byas te mnyan yod du song ngo / /ji tsam na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim du slong ba'i phyir zhugs pa dang / des bu mo de mthong ngo / /mthong ba'i mod kho na la bu slo de la kun tu chags par gyur la/ de der bslangs pa'i tshe zhwa'i nang du blangs so/ /de nas bu mo des log par spyod pa de mthong ba dang / 'di ni shes bzhin med par slongs mo len to zhes bgad do/ /de nas khyu mchog byin de ngo tsha bar gyur pa dang / bu ram shing 'phel gyi grong khyer du song ste pha la smras nas des bu mo de blangs so/ /mgon med zas sbyin gyis bcom lda na 'das la zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gzhan du na gang gi tshe ma ga dhā bzang mo 'di bu ram shing 'phel du song na rab tu byung ba rnam sa kyi bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /yang ji srid cig na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis nye du rnams la yang go bar byasanas byin pa dang bu ram shing 'phel du khyer ro/ /ji tsam na dus gzhan zhig gi tshe :ma de na gcer bu pa rnams zan za ba dang / de la sgyug mosasmrasapa/ de ring bdag cag gi khyim na rma chod gnasarnams bshos gsol gyis tshur shog mchod gnasarnams la ltos shig ma ga dh+wa bzang mos de thos pa dang dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rangs pa dang /yid bde ba skyes te bsams pa/ nges par bcun pa zhwa ri'i bu'am/ mod gal gyi bu chen po la sogs pa nyan thos chen po rnams byon par gyur to snyam nasade yid rab tu dga' ba dang / 'jigs pa med par song ba dang / gcer bu nags kyi ma he 'dra ba/ skra rnams btogs pa/ phug ron gyi phru gu 'dra ba'i gcer bu pa rnams mthong ngo / /mthong ba dang de'i mod la ma rga dhā bzang mo ngo tsha ste/ de gdong gzhan du bltas pa dang / de la sgyug mo des smrasapa/ bu mo khyod ci'i phyir yid mug par gyur/ des smras pa/ gang 'di lta bu mchod 32/
gnas yin na mchod gnas ma yin pa go ji lta bu zhig yod par 'gyur/ de la des smras pag/ bu mo khyod la 'di bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa 'ga' zhig yod dam bu mos smras pa bdag gi pha'i gtsug lag khang rgyal byed kyi tshal na sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i ston pa bzhusas te/ de ni rgyu ba dang / mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten gyi mchod gnas yin no/ //byod kyi ston pa de ji 'dra ba zhig smrasapa/ bdag gi ston pa btso ma'i tshogs ltar ser/ /bco ma'i gser ltar shin tu dri ma med/ /tshul khrims rnam dag shes rab shin tu dag /'jig rten gsum na mnyam med 'gro las 'phags/ /de thos ma thag tu sems rab tu dga' bar gyur nas smras pa / bu mo nged cag rnams la bcom ldan 'das de sang bstan par nus sam/ ma ga dhā bzang mos smras pa/ bshos gtsang rnams sbyor cig dang / sang bcom ldan 'das spya na drang bar bya'o/ /ji tsam na de rnams kyis smras pa/ bshos gtsang rnams sbyar gyis khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das sang spyan drongs shig de nas ma ga dhā bzang mos khang pa'i yas tog gi steng du mngon par 'dzegs nas phyogasagang na bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i phyogs der thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan rjes su dran te/ me tog rnams gtor cing spos kyang btul nas gser gyi bum pa'i chus bcom ldan 'das spyan drang ba'i phyir gser gyi bum pa'i chu yang sbrengs so/ /snying rje ba'i tshig 'di skad ces kyang smra ste/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ bdag t+na ri dwags dang 'dra bar gyur cing mtha' 'khob na mchis te/ dkon mchog gsum dang bral bar gyur pa la rjes su gzung bar mdzad cing dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa 'dir gshegs par mjad du gsol/ yang 'di skad cesakyang smras te/ tshul khrims rnam dag shes rab shin tu dag /dad ldan snying po nyan thos che rnams kyis/ /mgon med gyur pa bdag la rjes 322
gzung ba'i/ /don mdzad thugs rjes gshegs par mjad du gsol/ /ji cam na me tog dang spos dang gser gyi bum pa'i chu'ang nam mkha' la 'phags par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang de'i tshe nang du yang dag 'jog las bathengs nas 'khor rnam bzhi la chos ston to/ /gser gyi bum pa'i chu de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar baiḍūr+ya'i sdong bu bzhin du rnam par gnas so/ /me tog de bcom/ ldan 'das kye steng gi na ma mkha' la khang pa brtsegasapa bzhin du gnas so/ /dri ngad sposakyang sprin brtsegs pa bzhin du gnas par gyur to/ /de nas de mthong ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das spyan 'dren pa 'di rga las mchis/ bcom (lngan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo dpag chad brgya drug cu rtsa gsum na/ bu ram shing 'phel gyi grong khyer yod pa nas 'ongs so/ /kun dga' bo grong khyer de ni mu stegs pa rnams kyis bzung ba yin pas rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pas 'gro bar bya'o zhesadage slong rnamasal tshul shing brim sa shig ji tsam na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos rgan pa'i gnas mtha' nas bzung nas tshul shing brims te/ 'di skad ces kyang smras so/ /sang bu ram shing 'phel gyi grong khyer du 'gro bar bya ste/ grong khyer de ni mu stegs pa rnams kyis yongasasu bzung bas khyod cag rnams las gang rdzu 'phrul thob pa des tshul shing longs shig ji srid cig na rgan pa'i mtha' nas tshul shing len par brtsams so/ /yang de na gnas brtan gang po zhes bya ba yod de de yang rdzu'aphrul ma thob par lag pa brkyang ste chul shing len par brtsams pa dang / de la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos smras pa/ gnas brtan mgon med zas sbyin gyi khyim du 'jug pa ma yin gyi/gzhan du dpag chad brgya drug cu rtsa gsum na/ bu ram shing 'phel zhes bya ba'i gnas yod de/ der 'gro dgos so/ /de 'di snyam du sems te/ ngas ni thog ma med nga/'i dus 323
nas goms pa'i nyon mongs pa ni spangasan/ mu stegs pa rnams dang thun mong du gyur pa'i rdzu 'phrul lta zhig dka' ba ji zhig yod nas bskyed par mi bya snyam nas des kyang dus de nyid du rdzu'aphrul bskyed pa dang / ji srid du tshul shing gnyisapa ma brims pa de srid du des glang po che'i sna 'dra ba'i lag pa brkyang ste tshul shing blangs so/ /ji tsam na tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos rgan pa'i mtha' 'ordzogs su 'dug ste smras pa/ gang gis rdzu 'phrul gang thob pa des bu ram shing 'phel zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du 'gro bar bya'o/ /de nas nyi ma gnyis pa la nam nangs te dge slong rnams rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pas yang dag par chas so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi yang mnyan yod gang na ba der mngon par blta bar brtsams so/ /ji cam na bar skabs der kun shes koṇ+ḍi n+ya zhes bya ba rta'i shing rta la zhan te glog 'gyu ba'i snang ba ston cing dal bu dal busachar rab tu 'bebs te/ de lta bu'i rang gi rdzu 'phrul rnam par ston cing 'ong ngo / /de nas ma ga dhā bzang mo'i bdag pos de mthong ba dang dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des smras pa/ 'di ni kun shesakoṇ+ḍi n+ya zhesabya ba yin te/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo dang po bskor ba na/ 'dis thog mar bdag med pa mngon sum du byas pa de thog mar 'ongs pa 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der gnas brtan 'od srung chen pos brag gi ri chen po shing sna tshogs pa rnam pa brgyas khyab pa bya rnam pa sna 32gas kyis khyab pa/ me |(ga sna 〈rnagadragapas yang dag par khebs pa/ g.ya' chu sna 〈〈gas kyis nye bar mdzes par byas pa mngon par sprul te steng gi nam mkha' las 'ong ngo de nas khyim bdag des de mthong nas smras pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni 'od srung chen po zhes bya ba yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas par smra ba rnams kyi mchog tu gsungs pa ste/ 'dis 324
gcig gis ma tshang ba'i glang dor stong bor zhing / ser skya bzang mo skye bo dge ba rnams dang mtshungs pa dang / dbyig dang gser mang po mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin spangs nas mngon par byung ste rab tu byung ba de ni 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i busaseng ge'i shing rta mngon par sprul te/ steng gi nam mkha' la rdzu'aphrul gyis 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des de mthong ba dang dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo gang seng ge'i shing rtasa'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ de nasades de la smrasapa/ 'di ni dge slong shā ri'i bu zhes bya ba yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis shes rab dang ldaXn pa rnamasakyi mchog tu bstan pa yin te/ 'di ma'i mngal du zhugasapa tsam gyis 'dzam bu'i gling thamasacad kyi rtsod par smra ba rnamasalas rgyal bar gyur to/ /'di ni ston pa gnyis pa/ mchog gnyis pa/ chos kyi sde dpon/ chosakyi 'khor lo rjes su skor ba de ni seng ge'i shing rtas 'ongs pa 'di yin no/ /de'i rjes thogs nyid la tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos glang po che sa srung 'dra ba'i grang ngo 'i rgyal po mngon par sprul te/ steng gi nam mkha' la rdzu 'phrul gyis 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des de mthong nas/ ma ga dh+wa bzang mo la dris pa/ gang glang polirgyal po sa srung 'dra ba'i glang pos 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa / 'di ni dge slong mod gal gyi bu chen po zhes bya ba yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa ste/ 'di'i rdzu 'phrul gyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang rkang pa'i mthe bos kun tu sgul ba dang / 'dis klu'i rgyal ngo dga' bo dang nye dga' bo gnyisabartul ba de glang po'ishing rtasa'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas shing rta'i 'phang 'o( tsam gyi pad ma thamasacad gser lasabyasapa/ be+eḍūr+ya'i sdong bu can dngul gyi ge sar dang ldan pa mngon 325
par sprul te/ rdzu'aphrul gyisanam mkha' las 'ong ngo / /de nasakhyim bdag desade mthong ba dang dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa/'di ni dge slong ma 'gagasapa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyisalha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa ste/ 'di ni bsod nams kyi stobs kyis yongs su bzung bas snod tshos pas gang ba lnga brgya sgo na gnas pa dang / cung zad bsams pa tsam gyis chos gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal stan dang / nad kyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams 'byung ba la spyod pa de pad ma'i shing rtas 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa gang pos nam mkha' lding gi shing rta mngon par sprul te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis steng gi nam mkha' lasa'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des dris pa ma ga dhā bzang mo nam mkha' lding gi shing rtas 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong gang po zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das kyis chos ston pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de nam mkha' smyung gi shing rtas 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs/ der tshe dang ldan pa rta thul spyod lam rab tu zhi bas 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des de la dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo gang lhung bzed lag na thogs te spyod lam rab tu zhi bas 'ong ba de khyod kyi ston pa yin nam/ des de la smras pa / 'di ni dge slong rta thul zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di'i spyod lam rab tu zhi bas glang po che smyon pa btul ba dang / 'di'i spyod lam rab tu zhi ba mthong bas 'phags pa shā ri'i bus bden pa mthong bar gyur te/ de mngon par byung nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /rab tu byung nas kyang dgra bcom pa nyid thob pa de spyod lam rab tu zhi bas 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa nye bar 'khor gyisagaser gyi ta la'i nags mngon nga ra sprul te/ rdzu'aphrul ༷༷ steng gi nam mkha' las 'ong ngo / /de nas
khyim bdag des de la dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo gang gser gyi ta 'a 'i nags la brten cing 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smrasapa/ 'di ni dge slong nye bar 'khor zhesabya ba bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnamasakyi mchog tu bstan pa yin te/ 'di la shākya lnga brgya tsam rab tu byung ba rnams kyis do shal dang / gdu bu dang /dpung rgyan dang / gser gyi gdugasal sogs pa'i rgyan rnamasadang / gosarnams kyi phung po chen po mdun du bzhag pa dang / 'dis de mthong ba dang skyo ba chen po skyes te/ de dag thams cad mi rtag par shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ngo / /rab tu byung nas kyang dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas pa de gser gyi ta la'i nags la brten nasa'ong ba 'di yin no/ /de nas bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa zhwa t+yā ya na'i bu chen pos baiḍūr+ya'i khang pa brtsegs pa mngon par sprul te/ rdzu'aphrul gyis nam mkha' las 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag gis dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo be+eḍūr+ya'i khang pa brtsegs pa na 'dug ste 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smrasapa/ 'di ni dge slong kā t+yā ya na'i bu chen po zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde nga dang bye brag tu smra ba rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de be+eḍūr+ya'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i nang du 'durga nas 'ong ba 'ari yin rno/ /bar mabs der tshe dang ldan pa gsus po ches khyu mchog gi lhang rta mngon par sprul nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis steng gi nam mkha' las 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des dris pa/ ma ga dh+wa bzang mo gang khyu mchog gi shing rta la zhon te 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong gsus po che zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ri rga pa thob pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de khyu mchog gi shing rtas 'ong ba 'di yin rma/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa sruX stabang gi bu ngang pa'i shing rtas steng gi nam/
mkha' las〈'phrul gyisa'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo gang ngang pa'i shing rtas 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ desade la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong srung dbang gi bu zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'dasakyis snying rje la gnas pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa de 'di yin te/ 'di chu bo gang gā rgal bar 'dod pa na dmangs mo 'dug cig ces smras pa dang / tshig de'i rjes thogs nyid la ri bo brtsegs pa bzhin du gnas te/ rnam pa thams cad du mi 'bab par byed pa de ngang pa'i shing rtas 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa rna ba bye ba nyi shu ri nags kyi tshogs la 'chag cing 'dug pa de 'chag bzhin du 'ong ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang slo gang nags shing brgya dag gis khyab pa'i nags 'di la 'chag cing 'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ des de la smras pa/ 'di ni dge slong rna can zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'dasakyis brtson 'grus rtsom pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa yin te/ 'di skyes pa tsam gyis rna ba bye ba nyi shu ri ba dang bcasapar skyes pa dang / gang gi rkang mthil gyi 'og nas sor bzhi tsam gyi gser gyi spu yang dag par skyes pa dang / gang 'di dang po'i zan la kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya zad par byas pa dang / gang bcom ldan 'das snyung ba dang / mod gal gyi bu chen pos bshos gtsang nye bar blangs pa dang / gang gi dris 'od ma'i chal thams cad kun tu gang ba na/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos mnams nas mchog ñca ngo mtshar skyes te/ gang gi rkang pa gnyis bzhag pa cam gyis sa 'di rab tu g.yos pa dang /gang zhig rab tu byung nas 'chag sar 'chag pa na de'i rkang r+b+ya gnyis las khrag byung ba zags pa khā rnams 'thung ba de 'chag cing 'ong ba 'di yin no/ /bar skabs der tshe dang ldan pa sgra gcan 'dzin 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs su mngon par sprul te 'ong ba dang / de nas khyim bdag des dris pa/ ma ga dhā bzang mo gang 328
'khor losasgyur ba'i cha byad kyisa'ong ba 'di khyod kyi ston pa de yin nam/ desade la smras pa/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi sras bcom ldan 'das kyisabaslab pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan pa yin te/ 'dis yab kyis spangs pa'i dpal ston par byed cing 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs kyis rin po che sna bdun dang ldan pa bu stong gis yongs su bskor te/ gza' dang rgyu skar dang skar ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i zla ba lta bu dang /rgyal poyilam bzung nasa'agro ba mi'i bdag po lta bu dang / chu bo stong phrag gi chu 'bab pas kun tu 'gengs pa'i rgya mtsho lta bu dang / 'jigs pa dang nad dang mya ngan sel ba'i skye dgu skyong ba chen po lta bu dang / ri dwags kyi nang na seng ge lta bu dang / bya rnams kyi nang na nam mkha' lding lta bu dang / thams cad sel ba'i nyi ma dang / gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor losasgyur ba dang / chos bzang na mig stong ldan pa chosaskyong ba lta bur 'ong ba yin no/ /de bzhin du la la ni 'bar bar byed pa dang / la la ni char 'be+ebs pa dang / de bzhin du cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa ston cing 'ong ba yin no/ /la la sa las 'phagadragapa dang / /la la nam mkha'i gzhi la gnas/ /la la stan ni sprul byed de/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i mthu la ltos/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi slob ma rnams yang dag par song ba dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od gang gis 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad gser btso ma'i mdog 'dra ba'i 'od kyis gang ba de lta bu'i 'od bkye zhing / mnyan yod nas brtsams te bu ram shing 'phel gyi bar 'dir 'od kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bkye bas gang du'ang mig gis mi mthong ba med pas thams cad kyis mthong bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang nam mkha' la gshegs pa dang / lag na rdo rje ni snam logs nas 'greng ngo / /gnas gtsang ma pa rnams ni steng nas so/ /'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha rnams ni 'og nas so/ /g.yon logs nas ni brgya byin no/ /g.yas nas 329
ri tshangs pa'o/ /de bzhin du gtsug phud lnga pa dang / shin tu dga' dang mig sbyin la sogs pa dri za rnams yi wang dang gling bu dang rnga dang rdza rnga la sogs pa rol mo3bye brag snyan pa rnams rdung zhing / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / phreng ba rnams kyang 'thor zhing 'byor pa chen posagashegasate/ bar skabasader bcom ldan 'dasakyisasrog chags stong phrag bdun cu rtsa bdun bden pa la thog mar rab tu bkod par mdzad nas de'i 'og tu bu ram shing 'phel gyi grong khyer du gshegs te/ grong khyer de na yang sgo bca brgyad yod pa dang / der bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas ba'o brgyad sprul par mdzad nas sgo re re zhing sangs rgyas snang bar gyur pa nas bcom ldan 'das ma ga dhā bzang mo'i khyim du gshegs so/ /de nas skye bo3tshogs chen po de rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma mthong ste/ de rnams khros nas de'i khyim bshig par brtsams so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis grong khyer de thams cad shel gyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs te/ gang khyim thams cad du'ang sangs rgyas kyi sku bzhugs par mthong bar mjad do/ /ji srid bu ram shing 'phel du ma ga dhā bzang mo la sogs pa'i srog chags brgya stong du ma rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la me tog dang dri dang / phreng ba dang / spos rnams kyis mchod pa byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ma ga dhā bzang mo la sogs rdza 'i skye bo'i tshogs chen po de rnams la gang zhig thos na ma ga dhā bzang mo la sogs pa'i srog chags brgya stong du ma rnams kyis bden pa mngon du mthong ba thob pa ra gyur pa de r+nghi rte bu'i chos bstan pa mjad cing / 'khor de thams cad kyang sangs rgyas la gzhol ba dang /chos la bab pa dang / dge 'dun la 'bab par gyur to/ /yang dge slong rnam sa the tshom skyes te/ the tshom thams cad gcod par mdzad pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa / bcom ldan 'das ji srid du ma ga dhā bzang mo mchis nas srog chags brgya stong du) ma 330
mtho risadang thar pa la gzhol bar gyur pa dang / 'disasangasargyas kyi mdzad pa bgyis pa ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ da lta 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ 'dasapa'i dusan 'disasangasargyasakyi bya ba byasapa de nyon cig dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung zhes bya ba/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar btanags pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyesabu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byung ste/ yang dus de'i tshe grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po kṛ kī zhes bya ba rgyal po byed de/ de'i bu mo gser gyi phreng ba dang ldan pa zhig btsadragate/ de'i ming yang gser phreng can zhedragabya bar btags so/ /ji srid cig na bu mo de cher skyes par gyur pa dang na zla gzhon nu ma lnga brgya thams cad kyang gzhon nu mas bskor cing thabs cig tu yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la bsnyen bkur byed de/ de la dad pa yang dag par thob pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du chos gos dang / bsod snyomasadang gzim cha dang snyan gyi rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams kyisabasnyen bkur byed do/ /yang dus de'i tshe rgyal po kṛ zhwas mtshan gcig la rmi lam bcu smra/sa te/des smras pa/ glang po che'i rgyal po skar khung nas byung ba na mjug ma phra mo thogs pa dang /skom pas phyi nas khron pa snyegs par rmis ba dang / phye bre gang dang mu tig bre gang tshong byed nga/ dang / tsan dan dang shing rin mnyam par byed pa dang / kun dga' ra ba me tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa ma/ byin par len pa rnams kyis phrogs pa dang / glang ngo che phru gus spos kyi glang po 'jigs par byed pa dang / spre'u mi gcang bas gos pas gzhan la skud pa dang / spre'u rgyal por dbang bskur bar mthong ba dang / ras gcig mi bas brgyad 331
kyisadrasakyang ma ral ba dang / skye bo3tshogs chen po gcig tu 'duphunas 'thab pa dang /rtsod pa dang g.yul 'gyed pa dang mtshang 'bru bar gyur pas 'jigs pa mthong ngo de nas rgyal po de sad pa dang 'jigs shing skrag la skyo bas nga'i 'tsho ba'i srog gi bar chad du gyur pa'am/ rgyal srid lasanyams par mi 'gyur ram snyam ste/ desabram ze rmi ltas kyi mtshan ma ston shes pa rnamasabasdusanasade rnams la rmi lam de rnamasasmrasaso/ /de rnams kyang gser phreng can la zhe sdang ba yin padragade rnamadragakyis smras pa/ lha khyed la thams cad kyi nang na thugs su byon pa de'i snying dang me la sbyin sreg gi mchod sbyin mdzod cig de nas rgyal po de yi mug pas bsams pa/ thams cad kyi nang na nga la sdug pa ni nga'i gser phreng can yin no/ /gser phreng can gyis de thos pa dang / de yang mkhas pa yin pas rgyal po de'i gan du song ste phyin nas smras pa/ lha nyi ma shar na sgron ma me'i 'od dgos pa ci mchis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung 'di drang srong smra ba ri dwags rgyu ba na bzhugs te der gshegs la zhus shig dang / bcom ldan 'das des khyed la ji ltar lung bstan pa de bzhin du khyed kyis zungs shig de nas rgyal po kṛ zhwas grong khyer bā rā ṇa sīr nga deng bcom ldan 'das de'i drung du 'gro'o zhes dril chen po bsgrags nas de 'khor brgya stong du ma dang / gser phreng can de dang thabs cig tu bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos phyag byas 'e chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go /ji srid cig na rgyal ngo kṛ kī stan las langs te bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dir dgung gcig la bdag gis rmi lam bcu khums pa/ gla lci che skar khung nas byung ba na/ de'i ma jug ma
thogs pa la sogs pa snga ma bzhin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rmi lam de'i 'bras bu 'dir bdag la lung bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po ma 'jigs shig khyod kyi yul 'khor nyams par mi 'gyur la/ srog gi bar chad du yang mi 'gyur gyis/ rgyal ngo chen po gzhan du na ma 'ongs pa'i tshe skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya thub pa na shākya thub pa zhedragabya ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ste/ de'i phyi ma'i dudragan nyan thodragarnamadragaṭa/sa ma bsnams pa/ sems ma bsdams pa/ tshul khrims ma bsdams pa/ shes rab ma bsdams pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de rnams gnyen gyi tshogs spangs nas rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de nas gtsug lag khang rnams su khyim gyi 'du shes 'dzog pas chags par 'gyur te/ glang po che skar khung nas byung ba na de'i mjug ma thogs pa ni de'i snga ltas yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis skom pa'i phyi nas khron pa snyegs par rmi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa de ni de rnams gtsug lag khang gi nang na lhan cig gnas pa rnams la chos ston par 'gyur yang de rnams nyan par 'dod pa ra mi byed cing yid la mi 'jog ste/ de'i snga ltas ni 'di yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis phye bre gang dang mu tig bre gang tshong byed par rmi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa de ni de nyid kyi nyan thos rnams te/ gang bza' ba tsam gyi don du dbang po dang stobs dang byang chub kyi yan lag rin po che rnams yang dag pad ston par 'byung bar 'gyur te de'i snga ltas ni 'di yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis tsan dan dang shing mnyam por tshong byed par rmi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa de sna de nyid kyi nyan thos rnams mu stegs kyi tshig gang yin pa rnams bzung nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang snyoms pa 'byung bar 'gyur te de'i snga ltas ni 'di yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis kun dga' ra ba 'bras bu phun sum tshogs sdu sna byin par len pa rnams kyis phrogs nga/ra
rmi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa de ni de nyid kyi nyan thos lus ma bsdams pa/ sems ma bsdams pa/ tshul khrims ma bsdams pa/ shes rab ma bsdams pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de rnams dge 'dun rnams kyi me tog gi mchog dang / 'bras bu'i mchog rnams 'tsho ba'i phyir dge 'dun las bcad nas khyim pa rnams la ster bar 'gyur te/de'i snga ltas ni 'di yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis gling po phru gus spos kyi glang po 'jigs par byed par rmi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa 'di ni de nyid kyi nyan thos rnams tshul khrims 'chal ba/ sdig pa'i chos can de rnams gang dge 〈snang tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i chos can rnams zil gyis gnon par byed par 'gyur te de'i snga ltas yin ༄rdo/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis spre'u mi gtsang bas gos pas gzhan la skud par rmi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa 'di ni de nyid kyi nyan thos tshul khrims 'chal ba/ sdig pa'i chos can rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de rnams kyis tshul khrims dang ldan pa rnams la skur pa 'debs par 'gyur te de'i snga ltas yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis spre'u rgyal por dbang bskur bar mthong ba gang yin pa de ni dus de'i tshe rmongasapa rnamasargyal por dbang bskur bar 'gyur te de'i snga ltasayin no/ /rgyal ngo chen po khyod kyis ras gcig mi bca brgyad kyis dras kyang ma ral bar rmi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa de ni de nyid kyi bstan pa sde bca brgyad du gyes par gyur kyang rnam par grol ba'i ras ni ngal bar bya bar mi nus te de'i snga ltas yin no/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis skye bo3tshogs chen po gcig tu 'dus nas 'thab pa dang rtsod pa dang g.yul 'gyed pa dang / mtshang 'bru bar rmi lam du mthong ba gang yin pa de ni de nyid kyi bstan pa rtsod pas nub par 'gyur te de'i snga ltas yin no/ /rgyal po chen po de ltar mi bzad pa rnams ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal 334
pa /tsho gang bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung la'ang rgyal po kṛ kī dang / gser phreng can gyis thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed pa yin no/ /dge slong dag 'di ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe na gser phreng can gang yin pa de ni ma ga dhā bzang mo 'di nyid yin te/ de'i tshe yang 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byas te/ da ltar yang 'di 'ongs nas sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byas so/ /yang dge slong rnams the tshom skyes nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa gser phreng can gyisalas ci zhig bgyidragan gser gyi phreng ba btags par skyes/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di nyid kyis las byas pa yod de/ sngon byung ba na zhing pa dzozhan zhig gi spung mar gyur te/ rang sangs rgyas kyi mchos rten la kha dog sna tshogs paldi dz+nyo spra dzo n+dha/snas khri spra dī dri ༷sa nas btags te/ las de' rnam par sman pas gser gya de bas na dge slong dag las gcig tu gnag pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gcig tu gnag pa yin la/ gcig tu dkar ba rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni gceg tu dkar ba yin te/ 'dren ma rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni 'dren ma'o/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu gnag pa rnams dang 'dren ma rnams ni spangs la/ las gcig tu dkar ba rnams la mngon par brtson par bya ste/ dge slong dag khyed rnams kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /ma ga dhā bzang mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa rdzogs so/ / / /335
no༅ñca/ /bu mo 'od bzang ma 'bras bu thob ste rdzu'aphrul bstan nasasems can 'bum phrag du ma bden pa la bkod tshul/rtogasabargya pa lasabatus/mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na/ tshong dpon phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba yongs su 'dzin pa yangasashing rgya che ba rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ldan pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des/ rigs mnyam pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa lasachung ma la bu chags nas de zla ba brgyad dam dgu 'o1na pa dang bu byung ste/ bu mo gzugs bzang zhing lta na sdug la mdzes pa lha'i rgyan gyis bklubasapa nor bu rin po che mgul na thogs pa zhig btsas te/ de las 'od byung ba des mnyan du yod pa thams cad snang bar byas so/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas/ bu mo 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogasapar byed de/ nye du rnamasan re bu mo 'di btsas ma thag tu nor bu rin po che'i 'od kyis mnyan du yod pa thams cad spyaX par byas pas na/ de'i phyir bu mo 'di'i ming 'od bzang ma zhes gdags so zhes de nas bu mo 'od bzang ma pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te/ ma ma brgyad la gtad nas/ de ma ma brgyad kyis 'o ma dang3 /36zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar
gyi nying khu dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog gis bskyed bsrings te mtsho'i nang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /bu mo de yang dad pa dang ldan la dge zhing bsam pa bzang la/ bdag la phan pa dang ga'an la phan pa la zhugs pa zhig ste/ dela slong ba su dang su 'ongs kyang rung ba de dang de dag la mgul nas rgyan bkrol te sbyin par byed do/ /byin nas kyang yang rgyan 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gang gi tshe bu mo de mthar gyis chen mor gyur pa de'i tshe rgyal po〉bu rnams dang / blon po'ibu rnamasadang / tshong dpon gyi bu mang po dag de slong du 'ong ngo / /de nas de dag gis gnong par gyur nas/ de'i pha lag pa la rkom tshugs bcas te bsams pa/gal te gcig la pyin na ni gzhan rnams bdag gi dgrar 'gyur ro snyam nas/sems khong du chud cing 'dug go /de nas re zhig na bu mo des pha sems khong du chud pa mthong nas/ smras pa/ yab ci zhig gis sems khong du chud cing bzhugs/ de nas des de'i don rgyas par bsnyad do/ /de nas bu mo de na re yab thugs ngan ma mdzad cig dang /da ste zhag bdun na bdag nyid kyisakhyim thab 'dam par 'tshal lo zhes zer ro/ /de nas tshong dpon desargyal po gsal rgyal la gsol nas mnyan du yod par dril bsgrags te/de ste zhag bdun na bu mo 'od bzang ma rang nyid khyim thab 'dam par chad kyis khyed kyis bya ba gang yin pa de gyis shig ces byas so/ /de nas zhag bdun lon pa dang bu mo 'od bzang ma shing rta la zhon te chos gos tshon can gyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasakyi sku gzugs ri mor brisate bstod pa 'don cing srang du zhugs so/ /de nas der rgyal po'ibu rnams dang / blon po'i bu rnams dang / tshong dpon gyi bu rnams de la yid smon byed cing lta ba de dag la gtam rnam pa sna tshogs kyis shad kyis byang bar bshad de/ bdag gis khyed la gang gi sgo nasakyang sku brnyas ni mi 'tshal na yong 337
ye bad ga 'dod pa rnams la don du gnyer ba ma lags pa kho nar bas so/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ste/ de'i thad du rab tu 'byung ngo zhes byas nas de dag phyir log go /bu mo 'od bzang ma yang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go /de nas bcom ldan 'dasakyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang / khams dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chosabastan te/ de thosanas bu mo 'od bzang mas 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjesabacom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'brasabu thob ste/ des bden pa mthong nasamangon par shes pa yang bsgrubasaso/ /de nasabu mo 'od bzang ma stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag kyang legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzo gas shing dge slong ma'i dngos po 'thob tu rung na bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du changs par spyod pa snyad par 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan pa 'di la gdul bar bya ba mang po dag des 'dren par 'gyur bar thugasasu chud nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyisabaka' stsal pa/ bu mo song la 'khor rnams kyang ltos shig de nas bu mo 'od bzang ma rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal nas byung ste mang po 'dus pa'i nang du song ba dang /der so so nas bsams pa/ 'di mthus dbrog par bya'o snyam ste/ de dag gis de bzung bar byasaso/ /de nasabu mo 'od bzang ma de dag gis bsnyagasapa dang / ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dab ma brkyang ba bzhin du nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags te cho 'phrul rnam pa sna 338
tshogs bstan to/ /so soyiskye bo rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyis myur du dad par byed de de nas de dag bis lha dang mi rnams dad par byed pa'i cho 'phrul de mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang spu zing zhes byas nas sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du rkang pa la phyag 'chal nas gsol ba btab pa/ sru mar spyon mar spyon khyod kyis chos 'di lta bu dag mngon sum du byas pa las na/ khyod 'dod pa spyod pa 'di ni mi srid do zhes byas so/ /de nas bu mo 'od bzang ma nam mkha' las babs nasaskye bo phal po che'i gung la 'dug ste/ gang thos pas srog chagasa'abum phrag du mas bden pa mthong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos bstan to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo la gtad de des de rab tu byung ste bsnyen par rdzogs par byas so/ /de nas des brtson pa dang / bsgrub pa dang / 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas 'du byed kyi rnam pa tham/sa cad snyil ba dang / lhung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongasapa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/tsan dan spangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang chags pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong dag the tshom skyesate the tshom thamadragacad gcod pa sangadrangargyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcun pa 'od bzang gis las gang dag bgyis na/ des gzugs bzang zhing lta na sdug la 339
mdzes pa dang / mgul pa nasakyang nor bu rin po che byung la rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'od bzang ma nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogasarnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byung la gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ 'od bzang ma nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni / phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsagasapa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dusal bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dudragan/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnam/sa kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste / de rgyal polipho brang gnyen ldan na rten cing bzhugs pa las/ re zhig na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs sangs rgyas kyi phrin las thams cad mdzad nas/ shing zad pa'i me bzhin du phung polilhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas rgyal po gnyen yod kyis/ bcom ldan 'dasade'i sku gdung la sku gdung gi mchod pa byas nas/ rin po che sna bzhi las byas 340
pa'i mchod rten kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod la/ 'phang du rgyang grags gcig yod pa zhig brtsigasaso/ /de nasare zhig na rgyal po gnyen yod kyi bston mo dam pa rgas nas rgyan rnam pa sna tshogasalusalasabakrol te mchod rten de la phul lo/ /de nas zhags la phyag 'tshal te smon lam btab pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis na bdag gis kyang dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'dasakyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po gnyen yod kyi btsun mo dam par gyur pa gang yin pa de ni 'od bzang ma 'di yin te/ desabacom ldan 'dasarnam par gzigs kyi mchod rten la rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs btags pa desan gzugs bzang zhing lta na sdug la mdzes pa dang / yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan par gyur te/smon lam btab pa des ni da ltar dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /dge slong dag de ltar na lasagacig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges pa ra gnag par 'gyur ro/ /las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'dren ma rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang 'dren mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de lta bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang las 'dren ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste/ dge slong khyod kyis de ltar bslab par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi rangs te bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ / / /341
rabyañja/ /khyim bdag mgon med zasasbyin gyi bu mo rab sdug ma'i rnam thar/nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal hūm̐ /rdzu rnyirdo la~X /khyim bdag mgon med zasasbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugasaso/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi chung ma la bu chagasanas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa dang /bu byung ste bu mo gzugasabazang zhing lta na sdug la mdzes pa yan lag dang nying lag thams cad dang ldan pa/ mnyan du yod pa na gnas pa'i skye po'itshogs rnams kyi snying du rab tu sdug pa zhig btsasaso/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsasaston byasanas/ bu mo 'di'i ming ji skad gdags zhes ming 'dogs par byed de/ nye du rnams na re bu mo 'di skye bo thams cad kyi snying du sdug pas na de'i phyir bu mo 'di'i ming rab sdug ma zhes gdags so zhes zer ro/ /de yang tshe rabasadran te/ btsasam thag tu migs su bcad pa smrasapa/ sbyin pa byin pa mang nyung ci yang rung / /zhing gi khyad par gzhi las 'phel bar 'gyur/ /de phyir mkhas pas bsgrims te 'jig rten du/ /dad pas lha mi dbang phyug sangasargyas sbyin/ /de nas de'i pha ma dang gzhan yang khyim de na gnas pa rnams kyis tshig brjod pa de thos nas skrag cing dngangasate mi dga' bar gyur la/ skyi bung zhig byas nas smras pa kye ma bu mo 'di sge sha za mo zhig go /nges smras pa/ yum bdag ni sha za mo yang ma lags/ srin mo yang ma lags kyi/ bdag ni bu mo lags te sbyin pa dag sbyin par 'tshal lo/ /de nas de'i mas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la bu mo ༷ ༷di skad mchi'o/ /zhes bsnyad do/ /de nas
khyim bdag de dga' zhing mgu la rab tu dga' nas/ bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcasapa khyim gyi nang du bzhophugasol te/ de'i phyir sbyin pa'i rabs gdon du bcug go /de nasagang gi tshe bu mo de mthar gyis lo bdun lon pa de'i tshe pha ma la gsol te| bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ de dge slong ma thams cad la sdug pa dang / phongasapa dang / snying du sdug pa dang / yid du 'ong bar gyur to/ /re zhig na de'i tshe mu ge'i bar gyi bskal pa dang 'dra ba'i mu ge chen po byung nas/ der srog chags 'bum phrag du ma bza' ba dang btung ba med pasashi'o/ /de nasader bcom ldan 'dasakyis/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo khyod song la rab sdug ma la nga na re 'khor bzhi po rnamasal khyod kyis zla ba gsum gyi bar du gos dang / zasadang / mal cha dang / stan dang / nad gsos dang / sman zong rnams phul cig ces gyis shig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo rab sdug ma'i thad du song nas smras pa/ bcom ldan 'dasakyi zhal nas khyod kyisa'akhor bzhi po rnams zla ba gsum gyi bar du gosadang / zasadang / mal cha dang / stan dang / nad gsos dang /sman zong rnams phul cig ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas rab sdug mas thal mo sbyar te/bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' spyi bos mnos nas bka' bzhin 'tshal zhes smras so/ /de nas rab sdug ma spyod yul gyi grong blta ba'i phyir mnyan du yod par chas so/ /de nas re zhig na khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis gtam de thos nas shin tu rings par rab sdug ma'i mdun du song ste smras pa/ rab sdug ma gar 'gro/ des smras pa/ bcom ldan 'dasakyis bka' stsal to/ /zla ba gsum gyi bar du zhal ta ba'i la sabyed par bskosaso/ /mgon med zas sbyin gyis smras pa/ khyod kyi de dag thamasacad bdag bis sbyar gyis khyod kyis bya mi dgos so/ /rab sdug mas smras pa/ gal te yab bden pa mthong ba lags la 343
sa'i 'og thog dag tu sbas pa'i gter rnams kyang mngon du gzigasan/ sbyar ba 'di la ngo mtshar che ba ci mchis/ 'on kyang bdag ni skye bo dbul po la phan gdagasapa'i slad du zhal ta bgyid do/ /de bzhin du dge bsnyen lnga brgya dang / btsun mo phreng rgyud ma dang /rgyal rigs kyi bu mo dbyar tshul ma dang / btsun mo 'khor gyi bla drang sgong sbyin dang /gna' mi dang ri dwags 'dzin gyi ma sa ga dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal rnams kyis kyang skabs phye ste/ khyod kyis bya mi dgos so zhes byas so/ /de nas nags khung du song nas der mi ma yin pa mi'i cha lugasacan dag gis kyang skabs phye'o/ /de ltar skabs phye nas kyang / des bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa zla ba gsum gyi bar du na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzim cha dang / gdan dang / snyun gsosadang / sman zong rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byasaso/ /des zla ba gsum po de nyid kyi skabs su brtson pa dang bsgrub pa dang 'bad pas phol mig lnga pa'i 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid g.yo zhing mi brtan par rig nas/ 'du byed kyi rnam pa thams cad snyil ba dang / lhung ba dang / rnam par 'thor ba dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin par rtsad chod de/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang 'ong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i spu bas bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur sti la mi lta ba/ dbang po dang / nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das zla ba /stam 'das pa dang / chos gosamadzad de chos
gos zin nas chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang thabasacig tu mnyan du yod pa nasargyal polikhab tu chas te gshegs so/ /de nas rab sdug mas bcom ldan 'das dang lam du phrad nas 'o brgyal mi 'chal zhes gsol to/ /de nas re zhig na nags khung chu dang ldan pa zhig tu phyin nas dro la bab na rgyags kyang med nas/ bcor/ ldan 'dasanyan thosakyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bzhugs par gsol to/ /de nasalhung bzed lag pa g.yon pa la bzhag ste/ tshig tu smrasapa/ gal te bsod nams dag gi rnam par smin pa yod ce na/ bdag gi lhung bzed bza' ba dang bca' ba la sogasapa rnam pa sna tshogasakyisagang bar gyur cig cesabyasaso/ /de nasalhasalha'i bdud rtsis bkang ngo / /de nas rab sdug gisagral rims bzhin du dge slong gi dge 'dun thams cad kyi lhung bzed rnams zhal zas kyis bkang nas/ded bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag nga'i nyan thos kyi dge slong ma bsod nams byas pa rnams kyi mchog 2 'di lta snye dge slong ma rab sdug ma 'di yin no/ /de nas dge slong dag ze tshom skyes te/ the tshom thams cad gcod pa sangadragargyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa rab sdug mas las gang dag bgyis na des phyug po'i rigs su skyes te gzugs bzang zhing lta na sdu ga la mdzes pa dang / skye bo thams cad kyis bkur la rab tu byung nas dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum bgyis 'a gas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rab sdug ma nyid kyis sngon tshe rabs gzhan dag tu tshogs rnyed cing rkyen grub pa dang ldan te/ dba' rgal bzhin du byung 'a gdon mi za bar 'ong ba'i las de dag byas shing bsags pas na/ rab sdug ma nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur te / dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la na ma nga/ra 345
smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khamasadang / me'i khamasadang / rlung gi khamasal rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang mi dge ba byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang / khamasadang / skye mched rnamasa'aba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegasapa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangasargyas bcom ldan 'dasa'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na drang srong smra ba ri dwagasakyi nagasan rten cing bzhugs so/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas/ dge slong gi tshogs kyisazhabs 'bring byas te/mdun du bdar nas bhā rā ṇa sīr bsod snyoms la gshegs pa dang / re zhig na tshong dpon zhig g.yog 'khor dang bcas te skyed mos tshal du song nas bza' ba dang bca' ba mang po dag kyang khyer ro/ /de nas re zhig na de'i mngag gzhug ma bu mo zhig 'bras chan gyi gzeb khyer te jo boliphyi bzhin du 'gro ba las bu mo mngag gzhug ma des/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa lam khar mthong nas de dga' bge gyur te blo skyes pa/ bdag la jo bos lan gnyis su bran mor byar ci yod kyis bdag gis bcom ldan 'das bshos gsol gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas des gsad pa dang /bcing ba dang brdeg pa dang bsdos nas 'bras chan gyi gzeb phye ste/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa zhal zas sna tshogs kyis tshim par byas so/ /de nas 346
tshong dpon gyi thad du song ba dang / re zhig na tshong dpon gyisabu mo 'bras chan gyi gzeb de ga re zhe'(dridragaso/ /des smradragapa bdag gis bcom ldan 'daphuyang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas 'od srung la zhanya zadragaphul lo 'khasabyaphupa dang / tshong dpon gyis de thos nasamachog tu ya mtshan du gyur to/ /de nas de dga' zhid mgu la rab tu dga' nas smras pa bu mo khyod deng phyin chab bran mo las phyung gis song zhig khyod kyis bdag gnyid kyis log pa na mel tshe byasapa yin no zhesasmrasaso/ /de nasadedragathal mo sbyar te khyim bdag la gsol ba/ bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu 'byung bar ci gnang zhes byas so/ /de nas khyim bdag des lhung bzed dang chosagos kyang byin nas/ de jo bos byin pa'i lhung bzed dang chos gos khyer te bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ des bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gi gsung rab la lo dgu stong gi bar du zhal ta ba'i las byas te/ 'bras chan dang / skyo ma dang / thug pa gacho ba dang / rtag resa'akhor dang / mgron du bod pa dang / mar me'i phreng ba dang / chos gos sra brkyang rnams dang / sbyin pa dang rab tu sbyin pa rnams kyang ku' te/smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis dka' bas bsgrubs te/ bcom ldan 'das 'od srung la sbyin pa dang rab tu sbyin pa dag phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sems bskyed pa dang sbyin par bya ba'i chos yongs su gtong ba 'dis na/ bdag bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i gsung rab la rab tu 'byung ba thob par gyur cig ces byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na bu mo mngag gzhug mar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni rab sdug ma 'di yin te/ des bcom ldan 'das 'od srung 6 ro zhal zas phul ba des na phyug po'i rigs su skyes te/ gzugs bzang zhing lta na sdu ga la mdzes pa dang skye bo thams cad kyis bkur bar gyur to/ /smon lam btab pa des ni 347
de lta ra dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byasaso/ /dge slong dag de ltar na lasagacig tu nges par gnag pa rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par gnag par 'gyur rog/ / las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams ni rnam par smin pa yang gcig tu nges par dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /lasa'adren ma rnamasani rnam par smin pa yang 'dren mar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bas na las gcig tu nges par gnag pa rnams dang / las 'dren ma rnams spangs la/ las gcig tu nges par dkar ba rnams 'ba' zhig la gtad par bya ste / dge slong khyod kyis de ltar bsladzo par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'dapa kyis de skad ces byi(( sprapa dzo(khro/ khu/ge slong de dag ya rangs te bcom ldan 'das sa gsungs pa la
ra༅༅/ /bcun 3sna bde bas bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa blangs nas btson pa la zas ster du phyin pas lam bar gyi srin mo'i 'jigs pa las thar te phyug por gyur chul/mdo lde mdzangasablun 'a phubatus/'di skad bdag gisathos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya ka lan da ka gnas pa 'od ma'i tshal na dge slong grangs med pa dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe yul de na bram ze shin tu dbul zhing phongs pa ci yang mi bdog pa zhig yod de/ bram ze phongs ches nas kun la ci ltar byas na tshe 'di la longs spyod dang ldan par 'gyur zhes dris so/ /de la mi zhig gisasmras pa/ ci khyod mi shes sam/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba da ltar 'jig rten du gshegs te/ sems can thams cad 'a phan pa'i don mdzad do/ /de'i nye gnas 'od srung chen po dang mod gal ya na dang shā ri'i bu dang / ma 'gags pa la sogs pa 'phags pa bzhi yang rtag tu dbul phongs pa la phan pa'i ngon byed kyis/ gal te khyod dad pa'i sems kyis 'phags pa de dag la zhal zas kyis ma chod na/ 'phags pa de dag gis tshe 'di nyid la ci dang ci 'dod pa de dang de dag dang ldan par mdzad do zhes smras so/ /de'i tshe na bram zes mi des smras pa thos nas rab ñca dga' ste kun tu rgyu zhing slong mo dang / gla zos nas nor cung zad cig rnyed de phyir khyim du 'ongs nas zhal zas sbyar te/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams spyan drangs nas/ brdzogs gsol te 'jig rten 'di nyid la phan pa ༷'o/ /de'i tshe na bram ze de'i chung ma/ bde ba
zhes bya ba des dge 'dun la bshos gsol nas nyin zhag gcig pa'i bslab tshigs ma/nos so/ /de'i tshe na rgyal po gsal rgyal 'chag tu song ba las/ phyir 'ong ba'i lam du nyes pa byas pa'i btson zhig lam kha na shing la bcings shing 'dug pa mthong ngo bcon des rgyal po gshegs pa mthong nas/ ngus te kha zas zhig bslangs pa dang / rgyal pos kyang sbyin no zhes byas nas/ phyir pho brang du gshegs pa dang / brjed pa las de'i nub mo nam phyed cam na btson la kha zasasbyin pa dran te/ kha zas bskyal bar byas nas/ pho brang nang gi mi ni gcig kyang 'gro phod pa med de/ nam phyed tsam na kha zas bskur du lam na 'dre gdon dang srin poli'ajigs pas srog dang bsdos te 'gro nus pa med do/ /de'i tshe na rgyal pos mi de'i sdug bsngal ba dang bkres pas nyen pa dran nas/ de la shin tu snying brtse nas/ nga'i yul 'di nas su zhig btson de la kha zas bskyal du nus na/ gser srang stong sbyin no/ /zhes bsgrags kyang 'gro nus pa ma byung ngo / /de'i tshe na bram ze de'i chung ma bde ba des gtam du thos na/ 'jig rten pa su yang rung ste nyin zhag gcig pa'i bslab tshigs brgyad mnos nas 'dre gdon la sogs pas mi/ brdzi ste/ gdon thams cad kyis gnod pa byed mi nus so zhes thos kyis/ bdag ni rgyal pos gang btang bar kho mo 'gro snyam bsams nas mchis so/ /de nas rgyal pos bde ba la khyod kha zas 'di dag khyer la che ge mo zhig na btson 'dug pa de la byin cig dang / gser srang stong sbyin no zhes dam bcas so de nasabade ba rgyal poslabaka' bzhin du kha zas thogasate/ chul khrims dran par byasanas/ lam du zhugs te song song ba las/grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu srin mo lam pa dang phrad do/ /de'i tshe na srin mo de'i bu lnga brgya gsar du bcas pas bkres skom gyis nyen te/ bde ba 'ong ba mthong nas/ bza' bar gzas te/ de'i tshe na dge bsnyen ma tshul khrims ma nyams pasasrin mos mthong nas skrag 350
ste / dge bsnyen ma khyod khyer ba'i kha zas las cung zad cig bslang ngo zhes smras pa dang /dge bsnyen mas kyang nyung ngu zhig byin te byin pa nyung mod kyi dge bsnyen ma'i mthus mang du sprul pas srin mo ma smad shin tu 'grangs par gyur to/ /de nas srin mosadage bsnyen ma la khyod ci ming zhesadris pa dang / kho mo ni bde ba'o zhes smras so/ /'o na kho mo ma smad kyang ltogs pa las khyod kyisagasos kyis/ kho mo 'dug pa 'di na gser bum pa gang yod kyis phyir log pa'i lam du khyer cig khyod phar 'gro na kho mo'i nu mo a lam pa yang lam kha na 'dug ste/ khyod dang phrad kyis kho mo'i 'phrin du khyod bde'am/ kho mo yang bu lnga brgya bde bar btsas so zhes gyis shig de nas dge bsnyen ma lam du zhugs te/ song song ba las ring por ma lon par a lam pa dang 'phrad do/ /a lam pa la phu mo'i 'phrin spring ba dang / bu lnga brgya bde bar btsas so zhes gtam byas nas/ a lam pa dga' ste dge bsnyen ma khyod kho mo'i phu mo'i 'phrin dang gtam snyan pa byas pa legs kyis/ kho mo 'dug pa'i gnas 'di na gser bum pa gang yod kyis phyir log pa'i lam du khyer cig kho mo cag gi ming po cig kyang lam kha na 'dug gi /de dang phrad na kho mo cag spun gnyisakyi 'phrin dang / bu lnga brgya btsas pa'i gtam yang gyis shig ces bsgo nas song ngo / /de nas yun ring por ma phyin par sring mo gnyis kyi ming po dang phrad de/ de la bu mo gnyis kyi 'phrin dang / bu lnga brgya bde bar bcas pa'i gtam byas nas de yang rab tu dga' ste/ khyod kho bo'i sring mo gnyis kyi gtam dang 'phrin byas pa legs kyis/ kho bo 'dug pa 'i gnas 'dir/ gser bum pa gang yod kyis phyir log pa'i lam du khyer shig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas dge bsnyen ma chas te song song ba las btson de'i drung du phyin te/ kha zas bsnyod nas phyir log pa'i lam du gser bum pa gsum rnyed do/ /rgyal pos kyang gser srung stong bya dgar byin pas/ bram ze dkupa po khyo 35/
shug gnyis yul de na shin tu phyug cing nor mang bar gyur pas/ lhag par bsod nam sa byed cing ri na po che mang bar gyur to/ /rgyal pos kyang de bsod nams las gyur par shes nas blon por bcug ste shin tu phyug par gyur te/ lhag par bsod nams byed pa la dad pa'i sems bskyed de/ sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun spyan drangs te/ mchod pa chen po byas so/ /de la bcom ldan 'das kyisachosabastan pasasems rnam par grol te/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /'khor mang po de rnamasadang kun dga' bo la sogasapa sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa la rjesasu yi rangs nasamangon par dga'o/ / / /
ra༅༅/ /rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu mo ras+tha zhes bya ba gzugs shin tu mi sdu ga pa la sangadragargya'asnakyi thugs rjes rjes bzung nas byad gzugs mdzes par gyur cing 'bras bu thob tshul/rtogaphubargya pa lasabatus/mi sdug ces bya ba ni/ sangs rgyasabacom ldan 'das la rgyal po rnams dang / blon po chen po rnams dang / phyug po rnams dang / pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnamasadang / tshong dpon rnams dang / ded dpon rnamasadang / lha rnamasadang / klu rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / mi'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnamasakyisabakur sti byas/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod pa byas te/ ñca dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang /lto 'phye chen po rnams kyis mchod cing shes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsod namasachen po dang ldan pa/ na bza' dang / zhal zasadang / gzim cha dang / gdan dang /snyun gsos dang / sman zong rnamasabarnyesapa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugasaso/ /de nas de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal rgyal po byed de/de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang /mi me nga pos gang ba dang / rtsod pa dang / 'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'brug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang / chom rkun dang / mu ge dang / nad rnaXsdu med pa dang / 'bras swa lu dang / bu ram
r+shang dang / ba lang dang / ma he dang ldan par 'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkyugs la bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du rgyal srid bskyangs so/ /de nas re zhig na rgyal po de btsun mo zhig dang lhan cig tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /de rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las btsun mo la bu chags nas/ de zla ba brgyad dam dgu lon pa ngang bu byung ste/ bu mo mi sdug pa'i sna grangs bca brgyad dang ldan pa zhig btsasaso/ /de nas de btsas pa'i btsas ston byas nas/ ming rasmra zhes btags so/ /de nas gang gi tshe mthar gyis bag mar gtang ran par gyur pa de'i tshe su la byin na yang de mi sdug ches pas sus kyang ma blangs so/ /de nas re zhig na lho phyogs nas ded dpon gang ga zhes bya ba phyug chen zhig 'ongs so/ /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi blo skyes pa/ ded dpon gang ga 'di ni 'di'i skyon gyi rgyus mi shes kyis ngas 'di de la sbyin gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal pos mtshan mo mun sros pa dang gang ga pho nyas bkug nas bu mo de rgyan thams cad kyis bklubs te chung mar byin no/ /de nas rasba gang ga la byin nas gang ga rasbra gang ga rasba zhes bya ba'i ming byung bar gyur to/ /de nas re zhig nas ded dpon gang gas phyi de nyin par nam langs te bu mo de bltas na mchog tu mi sdug par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang skrag par gyur nas rgyal po las bsams te 'dor ma phod nas bdag gi khyim 'ba' zhig tu 'jog go /de nas re zhig na ded dpon gang ga dus ston zhig la chas te mdza' sde rnams kyi nang du song ngo /mdza' sde rnams kyis kyang nang khrims bcas te/ su chung ma dang bcas te skyed mos chal ga ge mo zhig tu ma song ba de mdza' sde rnams la chad par/ kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya sbyin du gzhug go zhes byas so/ /de nas gang ga bdag gi khyim du 'ongs nas mya ngan gyi khang bur zhugs te lag pa la rkom tshugs bcas nas sems khong du chud cing 'dug go /de na sa 354
de'i blo skyes pa/ ma la bdag gis chad pa 'jal ba ni ches bla'i bdag gis 'di de dag la bstan du ni mi rung ste/ mthong ma thag tu gtam ngan par 'gyur du 'ong ngo snyam rmo / /de nas gang gas sgo bcad de chad pa kwar ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya khyer nas mdza' sde rnams kyi nang du song ngo / /de nas bu mo de yid mi bde ba chen po skyes nas bdag 'tsho ba 'di 'dra bas 'tsho ba ci rung gson zhing 'dug na khyim thab kyang sems mi bde la bdag kyang sems mi bdes/ da ni bdag gisabadag gsad pa'i dus la bab bo snyam mo/ /de nas thag pa khyer te khang phugs su 'gag tu song ngo / /de'i skabs su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ni mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am/ mi rtog/ sa pa'am/ thugasasu mi chud pa ci yang med la/ sangs rgyasabacom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ 'jigarten la phan 'dogasapa la zhugasapa/ srung ba gcig pa dang ji na rngakhu/gcig tu dpa' ba/ zla med pa/ gnyis su mi gsung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag shā/thong 'a/ gnasapa/ rig pa gsum snang bar mdzad pa/ bslab pa gsum la legasapar bslabs pa//'dul ba'i gzhi gsum la mkhas pa/ chu po bzhi las rgal ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rka nga pa/ bzhi'i zhabs kyi mthil shin tu brtan pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la yun ring po nas 'dris par byas pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ khyu mchog gi yang dag rdza 'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs pa/ yan lag lnga rnam par spangs pa/ 'gro ba lnga las yang da kyu/ par 'das pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa/rtag tu gnas par bya ba drug la gnas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi me tobaka gis phyug pa/ lam yan lag brgyad pa ston pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms para'agrog pa dgu la mkhas pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcur grags pas kun tu rgyas pa/ brgya phrag bcu pa la dbang byed pa bas kyang ches khyad par du 'phags nga rnam sa 355
ni chos nyid kyis nyin dus gsum mtshan dus gsum du sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/ su ni rgud/ su ni dar/ su ni phongs shing 'dug /su ni nyam nga bar gyur/ su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs pa dang / nyam nga ba dang / gnod pa dang ldan/su t+na ngan song du gzhol/ su ni ngan song du 'bab/ su sna ngan song du bab/ su ni ngas ngan song nas phyung ste mtho ris dang / thar pa dang / 'bras bu la gzhag par bya/ su sna 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba lasalag nas drang bar bya/ su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun med pa las 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du gzhug par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ma bskyed pa las bskyed par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed zin pa las yongs su smin par bya/ su ni yongs su smin zin pa las rnam par grol bar bya snyam du ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go /'dir smrasapa/ rgya mtsho chu srin rnamasakyi gnas/ /dudrangarlabs lngardzol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i srathagarnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal na bzhugs pas 'od zer gser gyi kha dog can bkye ste/ des khyim de nyi ma stong gi 'od shar ba bzhin du snang bar byas nas rdzu 'phrul gyis kyang der gshegs te mgul pa nas 'gag thag bkrol nas bu mo de dbugasaphyung ngo / /'jig rten du ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gnas drug 'byung ba yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba dang / mir skye ba dang / 'phags pa gnas par skye ba dang / dbang po tshang ba dang / dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa dang / ngo mchang rmad du byung ba 'jig rten du 'byung ba yod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bu mo de la de dang mthun pa'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas bu mo des 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 356
'brasabu mngon sum du byasaso/ /de nasadad pa rnyed nasabacom ldan 'dasabashophugasol te na bza' yang phul lo/ /de nas bu mo de'i mi sdug pa med par gyur te/ bzang mor gyur nas lha'i bu mo bzhin du khang phug 'od kyisasnang bar byasate 'dug go /bcom ldan 'dasakyang slar gshegs so/ /de nas mdza' sde bo rnams kyis blo skyes pa/ gor ma chag par 'di'i chung ma ni mchog tu sdug pa zhig na des phrag dog gi rang bzhin gyis chad pa 'jal ba dang bsdos te de bstan pa ni mi 'dod kyis/ bdag cag gis 'di chang sna mi mthun pasar ro bar byas la lde mig rnams blangs te 'di'i khyim du song la chung ma blta'o snyam mo/ /de nas de dag gis de chang gar po sna mi mthun pas gtu lum par byas nas lde mig rnams khyed te khyim du song nas sgo rnams phye ste bu mo de mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang ya mtshan du gyur te bsams pa/ gang gas 'di bdag cag la mi bstan pa ri yus so snyam mo/ /de nas de dag phyir log ste gang ga chang gi dbang gis gnyid log cing 'dug pa las bslang nas smras pa/ gang ga khyod kyi chung ma de ltar sdug pa ni khyod kyis rnyed pa legs par rnyed rdo zhes byas so/ /de nas gang ga lhag par yang mi dga' bar gyur te/ chad pa yang bdarga gis gcad la bdag la gtam ngan par yang gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas mi dga' bzhin du bdag gi khyim du 'ongs nas sgo phye ste chung ma la balngas/ na nags chal me tog rgyasapa'i nang na nags kyi lha mo 'dug pa bzhin du shin tu ma dzes pa mthong nas dris pa/ bzang mo de ci/ ci zhig byas na 'di lta bu'i gzugs kyi khyad par can du gyur ces byas so/ /de nas des ji ltar gyur pa thams cad khyim thab la bsnyad de/de thos nas des kyang bcom ldan 'das la dad pa rnyed do/ /de nas re zhig na bu mo des mthar kyis khyim thab la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung chas/357

'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lusacan dag gi ladragarnams ri/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shinang dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dusan grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na tshong dpon gyi chung ma gtum zhing brlang la/ gzu lums can zhig 'dug go /sangs rgyas rnar/sa 'jig rten du mi 'byung ba'i tshe/ rang sangs rgyasasdug cing phongasapa rnamasal snying brtse ba/bas mtha'i gnas mal gyis 'tsho ba/ 'jig rten gyi yon gnas gcig pu rnams 'jig rten du 'byung ste/ de nas re zhig na rang sangs rgyas mi sdug pa zhig de'i khyim du song ba dang / des mi sdug pa 'di lta bu nga'i khyim du ci 'dod ces mang du spyos brgyab nas khyim nasangaskrad do/ /de nas rang sangs rgyas des de la phan gdags pa'i phyir ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dab ma brkyang ba bzhin du nam mkha' la mngon par 'phags nas cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs bstan to/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi chung ma 'gyod pa skyes nas de la bzod pa gsol te bshas kyang phul nas smon lam btab pa/ bdag gis rang sangs rgyas la spyos brgyab pa de'i las kyi rnam par smin pa myong bar ma gyur cig 'di lta bu'i chos dag kyang thob par gyur cig 'di bas kyang khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa mnyes par byed par gyur cis mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na tshong dpon gyi chung mar gyur pa/ gang yin pa de ni rasba 'di yin te/ des rang sangs rgyas la bshos phul ba de'i las kyi rnam par smin pas ni rgyal po phyug po'i rigs su skyes so/ /mi sdug pa'i tshig smras te khyim nas bskrad pa des ni mi sdug par gyur to/ /gzhan yang bcom ldan 'dasa'od srung gi ring la rab tu byung ste/ des der bslabs shing kha don du byas pa dang / phung po la mkhas pa3 ༷༷ / khams la mkhas pa dang / skye mched la
